Most OE friction materials at the start of the transition process were semi-metallic or aggressive non-asbestos organic (NAO) compounds that could contribute to disc thickness variation when even a small amounts of runout were present. Ceramic formulations were being rolled out that on new OE platforms and as aftermarket alternatives. They can be credited, at least in part, with extending rotor life and reducing incidents of brake pedal pulsation.
paras.zh: 这一时期也标志着陶瓷刹车片配方的起步阶段。大多数原厂摩擦材料在过渡过程开始时都是半金属或侵蚀性非石棉有机 (NAO) 化合物，即使存在少量跳动，也会导致摩擦盘厚度变化。陶瓷配方正在新的原厂平台上推出，并作为售后市场的替代品。它们至少可以部分归功于延长转子寿命和减少制动踏板脉动事件。

paras.en: What I remember most was the debate surrounding replacement brake rotors. In the late 1990s, “offshore manufacturers” were selling brake rotors at prices well below fair market value. By 2006, the federal government had begun investigating the situation and imposed antidumping duties on certain imports.
paras.zh: 我印象最深刻的是围绕更换制动盘的争论。 20 世纪 90 年代末，“离岸制造商”以远低于公平市场价值的价格销售制动盘。 2006年，联邦政府开始调查这一情况并对某些进口产品征收反倾销税。

paras.en: Within the aftermarket, some brake brands alleged that these inexpensive rotors were unsafe. Their main argument was that manufacturers were reducing rotor weight by making the friction plates thinner and failing to match the original fin design. I remember several press events that highlighted these design differences. I also remember phone calls from other rotor manufacturers arguing that the practice was acceptable because OE rotors were designed with an “eight-times” safety margin.
paras.zh: 在售后市场，一些刹车品牌声称这些廉价的转子不安全。他们的主要论点是，制造商通过使摩擦片更薄来减轻转子重量，并且未能匹配原始的翅片设计。我记得有几次新闻发布会强调了这些设计差异。我还记得其他转子制造商打来的电话，他们认为这种做法是可以接受的，因为原厂转子的设计具有“八倍”的安全裕度。

paras.en: The lasting effect of these events were on technicians and repair shops. Replacement brake rotors became so inexpensive that installing new ones often cost less than the labor required to machine the originals. The economics allowed shops to recommend new rotors with increasing frequency, based on the rationale that replacement produced a more reliable, comeback-free brake job.
paras.zh: 这些事件对技术人员和维修店产生了持久影响。更换制动盘变得如此便宜，以至于安装新制动盘的成本通常低于加工原始制动盘所需的劳动力。从经济角度考虑，商店可以越来越频繁地推荐新的转子，其理由是更换可以带来更可靠、无复发的制动效果。

paras.en: This replacement mindset even prompted California’s Bureau of Automotive Repair to conduct a sting investigation in 2010 targeting shops that recommended new rotors without first measuring the thickness of the existing ones.
paras.zh: 这种更换心态甚至促使加州汽车维修局在 2010 年针对那些在没有先测量现有转子厚度的情况下推荐新转子的商店进行了一项诱捕调查。

paras.en: Like it or not, we have been spoiled by inexpensive brake rotors over the past 20 years. Their availability permanently changed how some technicians and shops service brake systems. Today, it is not uncommon for technicians to recommend new rotors regardless of whether the existing rotors remain within specification, based on the economics.
paras.zh: 不管你喜欢与否，在过去的 20 年里，我们已经被廉价的制动盘宠坏了。它们的可用性永久地改变了一些技术人员和商店维修制动系统的方式。如今，技术人员根据经济性推荐新转子，无论现有转子是否符合规格，这种情况并不罕见。

paras.en: The market, however, is always changing. Vehicle brake systems have improved, and modern friction formulations have extended rotor life through better ceramic transfer-layer developments. OEMs have also increased the size and mass of many brake rotors to improve braking performance, manage heat and control noise.
paras.zh: 然而，市场总是在变化。车辆制动系统得到了改进，现代摩擦配方通过更好的陶瓷转移层开发延长了转子寿命。原始设备制造商还增加了许多制动盘的尺寸和质量，以提高制动性能、管理热量和控制噪音。

paras.en: On the parts side, replacement rotor prices have increased because of higher transportation costs, inflation, tariffs and other market pressures. Rotors have also become more sophisticated, incorporating improved hat and heat-dam designs. Coatings and treatments such as ferritic nitrocarburizing have further increased the price of replacement rotors.
paras.zh: 在零部件方面，由于运输成本上升、通货膨胀、关税和其他市场压力，更换转子的价格有所上涨。转子也变得更加复杂，采用了改进的帽子和热坝设计。铁素体氮碳共渗等涂层和处理进一步提高了更换转子的价格。

paras.en: In my opinion, we are approaching another perfect storm. As replacement rotor prices rise and original brake rotors become more durable, the economics of replacement versus machining are beginning to converge on some brake jobs—especially when shops compare labor and parts costs while accounting for the rotor’s discard dimension.
paras.zh: 在我看来，我们正在接近另一场完美风暴。随着更换转子价格的上涨和原装制动转子变得更加耐用，更换与加工的经济性开始集中在一些制动作业上，特别是当商店在考虑转子报废尺寸的同时比较劳动力和零件成本时。

paras.en: As an industry veteran who survived the rotor wars, I see this as a win-win for repair shops. On the labor side, machining rotors can be a profitable again. On the parts side, selling a higher-value replacement rotor can generate more gross-profit dollars.
paras.zh: 作为一名在转子战争中幸存下来的行业资深人士，我认为这对于维修店来说是双赢的。在劳动力方面，加工转子可以再次盈利。在零件方面，销售更高价值的替换转子可以产生更多的毛利润。

paras.en: It may be time to dust off your micrometers and tune up your brake lathes.
paras.zh: 也许是时候掸去千分尺上的灰尘并调整刹车车床了。

articles.title: Alignment Specs: 2021–Current Ford Mustang Mach-E
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E uses Ford’s Global Electrified 1 (GE1) platform, a heavily reworked version of the automaker’s C2 architecture. The C2 platform also underpins the fourth-generation Ford Focus and third-generation Kuga, as well as the fourth-generation Escape. While the Mach-E shares its platform lineage with these vehicles, GE1 was adapted for an all-electric SUV. That platform connection provides useful context for technicians approaching its suspension and alignment service, while vehicle-specific procedures and specifications remain essential across model years and configurations.
paras.zh: Mustang Mach-E 使用福特的 Global Electrified 1 (GE1) 平台，这是该汽车制造商 C2 架构的经过大量修改的版本。 C2 平台还支持第四代福特福克斯、第三代 Kuga 以及第四代 Escape。虽然 Mach-E 与这些车辆共享其平台血统，但 GE1 适合于全电动 SUV。该平台连接为技术人员提供悬架和定位服务提供了有用的背景，而车辆特定的程序和规范在不同型号年份和配置中仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E has adjustable camber and toe at both ends, but an alignment service with this car also calls for attention to the vehicle loading, ride height and driver-assistance systems. The procedures provided in this article are for a 2023 AWD Mach-E, so confirm the specifications and service procedure for the vehicle’s exact model year and configuration before making adjustments. The supplied information does not include numerical alignment specifications or acceptable ride-height ranges.
paras.zh: 野马 Mach-E 两端的外倾角和前束均可调节，但该车的对准服务还需要注意车辆负载、行驶高度和驾驶员辅助系统。本文提供的程序适用于 2023 年 AWD Mach-E，因此在进行调整之前请确认车辆的确切型号年份和配置的规格和维修程序。提供的信息不包括数字对准规范或可接受的行驶高度范围。

paras.en: Before measuring toe, Ford’s procedure calls for a level surface, correct tire pressure, and an inspection for tire wear, damage and suspension wear or damage. The steering wheel must be held straight ahead with a suitable holding device during the toe checks.
paras.zh: 在测量前束之前，福特的程序要求地面平整、轮胎压力正确，并检查轮胎磨损、损坏和悬架磨损或损坏。在检查前束时，必须使用合适的固定装置将方向盘保持在正前方。

paras.en: Ride-height measurement has additional preparation requirements. Position the vehicle on a flat, level surface with tires inflated to the correct pressure. The procedure specifies a full tank of fuel, proper fluid levels and no cargo in the cabin or bed. Inspect for aftermarket equipment and changes to steering, suspension, wheels or tires, then jounce the front and rear suspension vigorously to let the vehicle settle.
paras.zh: 行驶高度测量有额外的准备要求。将车辆放置在平坦的水平表面上，轮胎充气至正确的压力。该程序规定燃油箱已满、液位适当且客舱或床上不得有货物。检查售后设备以及转向、悬架、车轮或轮胎的变化，然后用力摇晃前后悬架，让车辆稳定下来。

paras.en: Remember: Alignment readings are only useful when the vehicle is in the specified condition. If ride height is incorrect, look for changes or problems in the suspension and review the vehicle’s service information before treating alignment adjustments as the solution.
paras.zh: 请记住：对准读数仅在车辆处于指定条件时才有用。如果行驶高度不正确，请查找悬架的变化或问题，并查看车辆的维修信息，然后再将定位调整作为解决方案。

paras.en: If you find that you can’t get the vehicle to roll to carry out the rolling compensation measurements, this is because it has Rollaway Protection Mode that activates when the car is turned off and the driver exits. To enable the car to roll, you will have to leave it on and in neutral during the alignment. In some cases, you might want to attach the driver seatbelt and roll the door latch to prevent it from going into park.
paras.zh: 如果您发现无法让车辆滚动以进行滚动补偿测量，这是因为它具有滚动保护模式，该模式会在汽车关闭且驾驶员退出时激活。为了使汽车能够滚动，您必须在对准过程中将其保持在空档位置。在某些情况下，您可能需要系上驾驶员安全带并滚动门锁以防止其进入停车位。

paras.en: Front camber is adjusted at the strut-to-knuckle connection. First, measure camber with alignment equipment, then remove the wheels and tires. The brake flexible hose is unbolted and moved aside, and the wheel knuckle is supported with mechanic’s wire.
paras.zh: 前外倾角在支柱到转向节的连接处进行调整。首先，用定位设备测量外倾角，然后拆下车轮和轮胎。松开制动软管并移到一边，车轮转向节用机械钢丝支撑。

paras.en: The original strut-to-knuckle bolts and nuts are removed and discarded. Ford specifies new service bolts and nuts for reassembly. The service fasteners are smooth and smaller in diameter than the splined original equipment bolts. With the new fasteners installed and snug, move the knuckle inboard or outboard to bring camber into specification. The procedure states that moving from the maximum inboard to maximum outboard position provides 0.5 degree of adjustment.
paras.zh: 原来的支柱到转向节的螺栓和螺母被拆除并丢弃。福特指定了用于重新组装的新维修螺栓和螺母。维修紧固件光滑且直径小于带花键的原始设备螺栓。安装新的紧固件并使其紧贴后，将转向节向内或向外移动，使外倾角符合规格。该程序规定，从最大内侧位置移动到最大外侧位置可提供 0.5 度的调整。

paras.en: Do not fully tighten the strut-to-knuckle fasteners until camber is corrected. After adjustment, torque the bolts and nuts to 173 lb.-ft. (235 Nm). Reinstall the brake hose and torque its bolt to 97 lb.-in. (11 Nm). Reinstall the wheels and tires, recheck alignment and adjust front toe if needed. Because changing camber can affect toe, finish by verifying the toe readings.
paras.zh: 在外倾角得到纠正之前，请勿完全拧紧支柱至转向节的紧固件。调整后，将螺栓和螺母拧紧至 173 磅英尺。 （235 牛米）。重新安装制动软管并将其螺栓拧紧至 97 磅英寸。 （11 纳米）。重新安装车轮和轮胎，重新检查对准情况并根据需要调整前束。由于改变外倾角会影响前束，因此最后要验证前束读数。

paras.en: Front toe is adjusted at the inner tie rods. With the steering wheel held straight, check toe on both sides. Hold each outer tie-rod end stationary while loosening its jam nut; Ford cautions that allowing the tie-rod end to turn can damage the boot. Move the steering gear boot clamp aside, then rotate the inner tie rod to adjust toe. Do not let the steering gear bellows twist as the inner tie rod turns. Recheck toe after adjustment and road test the vehicle.
paras.zh: 前束通过内横拉杆进行调节。保持方向盘伸直，检查两侧前束。松开锁紧螺母时，保持每个外横拉杆端部固定；福特警告说，让横拉杆末端转动可能会损坏行李箱。将舵机靴夹移到一边，然后旋转内横拉杆调整前束。请勿让转向器波纹管随着内拉杆的转动而扭转。调整后重新检查前束并对车辆进行路试。

paras.en: Rear camber is adjusted by moving the upper control arm at its inboard mounting point. Measure camber, loosen the inboard nut approximately two turns, then slide the control arm inboard or outboard to change the reading. Recheck the alignment to verify the change and adjust rear toe if needed. The OEM procedure lists a torque of 76 lb.-ft. (103 Nm) for the upper control arm inboard nut.
paras.zh: 通过移动内侧安装点的上控制臂来调整后外倾角。测量外倾角，松开内侧螺母大约两圈，然后向内或向外滑动控制臂以更改读数。重新检查对齐情况以验证更改并根据需要调整后束。 OEM 程序列出的扭矩为 76 磅-英尺。 (103 Nm) 用于上控制臂内侧螺母。

paras.en: Rear toe is adjusted at the toe link. With the steering wheel held straight ahead, measure toe on both sides. Before turning the toe-link bolt, clean the area around the joint using mild liquids. Ford notes that the cam nut and cam bolt area must be free of foreign material for proper clamping. Loosen the toe-link nut approximately one turn, rotate the toe-link bolt to obtain the specified reading, and tighten without disturbing the setting. The procedure lists 66 lb.-ft. (90 Nm) for the toe-link nut.
paras.zh: 后束角在束角处进行调节。将方向盘保持笔直向前，测量两侧的前束角。转动趾连杆螺栓之前，请使用温和的液体清洁接头周围的区域。福特指出，凸轮螺母和凸轮螺栓区域必须没有异物才能正确夹紧。松开趾连杆螺母大约一圈，旋转趾连杆螺栓以获得指定读数，然后在不干扰设置的情况下拧紧。该程序列出了 66 磅英尺。 (90 Nm) 用于趾连杆螺母。

paras.en: If the Mach-E is equipped with Lane Departure Warning, Ford requires an IPMA camera alignment after rear toe adjustment. Connect a scan tool and follow its directions for the camera alignment procedure. Road test after the adjustment and required camera service.
paras.zh: 如果 Mach-E 配备车道偏离警告，福特需要在后束调整后进行 IPMA 摄像头对准。连接扫描工具并按照其说明进行相机对准过程。调整后的路试和所需的相机服务。

paras.en: The ride-height procedure uses a surface gauge to measure from a flat, level surface to suspension reference points. At the front, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm forward bolt and to the center of the ball-joint pinch bolt. Subtract the lower-arm forward-bolt measurement from the ball-joint pinch-bolt measurement to calculate front ride height.
paras.zh: 行驶高度程序使用表面测量仪来测量从平坦的水平表面到悬架参考点的距离。在前面，从表面到下臂前部螺栓的中心以及球形接头压紧螺栓的中心进行测量。从球窝接头压紧螺栓测量值中减去下臂前向螺栓测量值，即可计算前部行驶高度。

paras.en: At the rear, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm-to-subframe bolt and to the center of the lower arm-to-wheel-knuckle bolt. For the rear, subtract the wheel-knuckle-bolt measurement from the subframe-bolt measurement.
paras.zh: 在后部，从表面到下臂到副车架螺栓的中心以及下臂到车轮转向节螺栓的中心进行测量。对于后部，从副车架螺栓测量值中减去车轮转向节螺栓测量值。

paras.en: The service information provided describes how to take these measurements but does not give target ride-height values. Use the correct model-year service information for the vehicle to determine whether the recorded measurements are within specification. Avoid substituting a visual estimate or a generic ride-height value.
paras.zh: 提供的服务信息描述了如何进行这些测量，但没有给出目标行驶高度值。使用车辆的正确型号年份服务信息来确定记录的测量值是否符合规格。避免用视觉估计或通用行驶高度值代替。

paras.en: The vehicle’s service information shows a headlamp level sensor at both the front and rear suspension. The front sensor is mounted at the left front suspension, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. The rear sensor is also mounted at the left side, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. Each has an electrical connector.
paras.zh: 车辆的维修信息显示前悬架和后悬架上都有前照灯水平传感器。前传感器安装在左前悬架上，其臂支架连接到下臂。后传感器也安装在左侧，其臂支架连接到下臂。每个都有一个电连接器。

paras.en: During a suspension or alignment inspection, check that the sensors, brackets, arms and wiring are present and undamaged. The service procedure covers sensor removal and installation, but it does not specify an adjustment or calibration following a wheel alignment. If a sensor or its linkage has been disturbed or damaged, consult the correct service information for the required repair steps.
paras.zh: 在悬挂或对准检查期间，检查传感器、支架、臂和接线是否存在且未损坏。维修程序涵盖传感器的拆卸和安装，但没有指定车轮定位后的调整或校准。如果传感器或其连杆受到干扰或损坏，请查阅正确的服务信息以了解所需的维修步骤。

articles.title: Read ShopOwner’s October Digital Edition Now
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The interactive and easy-to-use digital edition of ShopOwner’s October issue is available now.
paras.zh: ShopOwner 十月号的交互式且易于使用的数字版现已推出。

paras.en: What happens when some of North America’s best automotive technicians gather in Detroit to compete for the title of 2026 Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper Technician of the Year? There are challenging diagnostic exercises, timed competitions and plenty of pressure, but something even more interesting emerges: camaraderie, mutual respect and a shared passion for solving problems. From military veterans and former electronics technicians to third-generation automotive professionals, this year’s finalists demonstrate that there’s no single road to success in the automotive service industry. Ultimately, Matt Wagg of Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive in Bennington, NE, earned the U.S. championship, while Jake McKie and Roberto Chávez Chairez claimed the Canadian and Latin American honors.
paras.zh: 当北美一些最优秀的汽车技术人员齐聚底特律，争夺 2026 年汽车价值和年度最佳技术人员称号时，会发生什么？这里有具有挑战性的诊断练习、定时竞赛和巨大的压力，但更有趣的东西出现了：友情、相互尊重和解决问题的共同热情。从退伍军人、前电子技术人员到第三代汽车专业人士，今年的决赛入围者证明，汽车服务行业没有单一的成功之路。最终，内布拉斯加州本宁顿 Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive 公司的 Matt Wagg 赢得了美国冠军，而 Jake McKie 和 Roberto Chávez Chairez 则获得了加拿大和拉丁美洲的荣誉。

paras.en: But the real story goes well beyond the winners. Through candid conversations with the finalists, a powerful message emerges about mentorship, ongoing training, professional pride and the importance of recognizing technicians for the work they do every day. Their experiences offer valuable lessons for shop owners looking to develop and retain great employees while building stronger businesses. Read the complete article to meet these outstanding professionals, discover the people and experiences that shaped their careers, and learn why the greatest reward of this competition may have nothing to do with taking home a trophy.
paras.zh: 但真实的故事远远超出了获胜者的范围。通过与决赛入围者的坦诚对话，关于指导、持续培训、职业自豪感以及认可技术人员日常工作的重要性的强有力的信息浮现出来。他们的经验为希望培养和留住优秀员工、同时打造更强大企业的店主提供了宝贵的经验教训。阅读完整的文章来认识这些杰出的专业人士，了解塑造他们职业生涯的人物和经历，并了解为什么本次比赛的最大奖励可能与带回家奖杯无关。

paras.en: PLUS, you’ll find Tech Tips, new products, editorial commentary and technical content from ImportCar, Brake & Front End, Underhood Service, TechShop and Tire Review, all ShopOwner channels.
paras.zh: 另外，您还可以找到来自 ImportCar、Brake & Front End、Underhood Service、TechShop 和 Tire Review 以及所有 ShopOwner 频道的技术提示、新产品、编辑评论和技术内容。

articles.title: Automotive Transmission Market to Reach $94.8 Billion by 2033
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: According to a report from MarketsandMarkets, the global automotive transmission market will grow from $66.1 billion in 2026 to $94.8 billion by 2033. The market will expand at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.3%.
paras.zh: 根据MarketsandMarkets的报告，全球汽车变速器市场将从2026年的661亿美元增长到2033年的948亿美元。该市场将以5.3%的复合年增长率（CAGR）扩大。

paras.en: The shift toward eight- to 10-speed automatic transmissions, advanced dual-clutch transmissions (DCTs) and continuously variable transmissions (CVTs) supports greater efficiency. Low-friction gearsets and predictive shift-control software also help automakers optimize engine performance, reduce power losses and improve drivability.
paras.zh: 转向 8 至 10 速自动变速箱、先进的双离合变速箱 (DCT) 和无级变速箱 (CVT) 可提高效率。低摩擦齿轮组和预测换档控制软件还可以帮助汽车制造商优化发动机性能、减少功率损失并提高驾驶性能。

paras.en: Meanwhile, dedicated hybrid transmissions (DHTs), electronic CVTs (e-CVTs) and integrated motor-transmission systems are gaining importance. Automakers use these technologies to blend internal combustion engines (ICEs) with electric motors, improve regenerative braking and optimize packaging.
paras.zh: 与此同时，专用混合动力变速器 (DHT)、电子无级变速器 (e-CVT) 和集成电机变速器系统变得越来越重要。汽车制造商利用这些技术将内燃机 (ICE) 与电动机融合在一起，改进再生制动并优化包装。

paras.en: Manufacturers are also developing multispeed EV transmissions for applications requiring greater high-speed efficiency, towing capability or performance.
paras.zh: 制造商还在开发多速电动汽车变速箱，用于需要更高高速效率、牵引能力或性能的应用。

paras.en: However, transmission suppliers face significant challenges as they develop conventional, hybrid and EV-specific architectures simultaneously. These include high research and development costs, extensive validation requirements, increasing software complexity and pricing pressures. Battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) also reduce demand for conventional multispeed gearboxes.
paras.zh: 然而，变速箱供应商在同时开发传统、混合动力和电动汽车专用架构时面临着重大挑战。其中包括高昂的研发成本、广泛的验证要求、不断增加的软件复杂性和定价压力。电池电动汽车 (BEV) 也减少了对传统多速变速箱的需求。

paras.en: Single-Speed Systems Lead Automotive Transmission Market
paras.zh: 单速系统引领汽车变速箱市场

paras.en: Single-speed reducers dominate the BEV market because electric motors offer broad operating speed ranges with lower costs, weight and complexity.
paras.zh: 单速减速器在纯电动汽车市场占据主导地位，因为电动机可提供较宽的运行速度范围，并且成本、重量和复杂性较低。

paras.en: Manufacturers are optimizing reduction ratios, improving high-speed gear durability, enhancing lubrication efficiency and reducing gear-mesh noise.
paras.zh: 制造商正在优化减速比，提高高速齿轮的耐用性，提高润滑效率并降低齿轮啮合噪音。

paras.en: Electric motors deliver high torque at low speeds and maintain a broad usable speed range. These characteristics eliminate the need for multiple gear ratios in most passenger EVs.
paras.zh: 电动机在低速下提供高扭矩，并保持广泛的可用速度范围。这些特性消除了大多数乘用电动汽车对多个齿轮比的需求。

paras.en: Fixed-ratio reduction gears simplify drivetrains and reduce mechanical losses, weight, packaging complexity and maintenance requirements. They also enable precise torque delivery and seamless acceleration.
paras.zh: 固定比减速齿轮简化了传动系统并降低了机械损失、重量、包装复杂性和维护要求。它们还能够实现精确的扭矩传递和无缝加速。

paras.en: Advances in high-speed motors, optimized helical gears, low-friction bearings and integrated e-axle designs further improve efficiency and power density.
paras.zh: 高速电机、优化斜齿轮、低摩擦轴承和集成电轴设计的进步进一步提高了效率和功率密度。

paras.en: Multispeed Transmissions Address EV Performance Needs
paras.zh: 多速变速箱满足电动汽车性能需求

paras.en: However, single-speed systems face trade-offs when balancing launch torque with high-speed efficiency. These challenges particularly affect heavy-duty EVs and performance applications.
paras.zh: 然而，单速系统在平衡启动扭矩和高速效率时面临着权衡。这些挑战尤其影响重型电动汽车和高性能应用。

paras.en: Looking ahead, multispeed transmissions will likely remain the preferred solution for high-performance and commercial EVs. Meanwhile, single-speed architectures will maintain an advantage in mainstream passenger EVs because of their simplicity, cost and efficiency.
paras.zh: 展望未来，多速变速箱可能仍然是高性能和商用电动汽车的首选解决方案。与此同时，单速架构因其简单性、成本和效率而将在主流乘用电动汽车中保持优势。

articles.title: TERREPOWER to Showcase New Products at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: TERREPOWER, formerly BBB Industries, will showcase two new products at AAPEX 2026. The company specializes in sustainable aftermarket manufacturing. The products include the Remy Belt Alternator Starter (BAS) for 48-volt mild hybrid vehicles and the mobile S.T.A.R.T. diagnostic application. S.T.A.R.T. stands for Smart Troubleshooting and Resolution Tool.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER（原 BBB Industries）将在 AAPEX 2026 上展示两款新产品。该公司专注于可持续售后市场制造。产品包括用于 48 伏轻度混合动力汽车的 Remy 皮带交流发电机启动器 (BAS) 和移动式 S.T.A.R.T.诊断应用。开始。代表智能故障排除和解决工具。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also highlight an expansion of its steering and braking portfolio. The expansion includes 92 new electric power steering part numbers. The company also plans to expand its NuGeon new brake caliper line to more than 1,800 SKUs in 2027.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将重点介绍其转向和制动产品组合的扩展。此次扩展包括 92 个新的电动助力转向部件号。该公司还计划在 2027 年将其 NuGeon 新型制动卡钳系列扩展到 1,800 多个 SKU。

paras.en: “Today’s aftermarket is changing quickly as new vehicle technologies enter the repair cycle and technicians face increasingly complex diagnostic challenges,” said Duncan Gillis, CEO of TERREPOWER. “Innovation for TERREPOWER means bringing new parts to market as well as technologies to help our customers solve the entire repair. The Remy BAS and S.T.A.R.T. app demonstrate how we are complementing scalable sustainable manufacturing of automotive components with user-friendly tools to help our customers keep vehicles on the road longer.”
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 首席执行官邓肯·吉利斯 (Duncan Gillis) 表示：“随着新技术进入维修周期，当今的售后市场正在迅速变化，技术人员面临着日益复杂的诊断挑战。” “TERREPOWER 的创新意味着将新零件推向市场以及帮助我​​们的客户解决整个维修问题的技术。Remy BAS 和 S.T.A.R.T. 应用程序展示了我们如何通过用户友好的工具补充汽车零部件的可扩展可持续制造，以帮助我们的客户让车辆在路上行驶更长时间。”

paras.en: TERREPOWER Introduces Remy BAS for Mild Hybrids
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 推出适用于轻度混合动力车的 Remy BAS

paras.en: The Remy BAS combines starter and generator functionality in a belt-driven motor-generator for 48-volt mild hybrids. TERREPOWER will feature the product in the AAPEX New Product Showcase.
paras.zh: Remy BAS 将启动器和发电机功能结合在皮带驱动电动发电机中，适用于 48 伏轻度混合动力车。 TERREPOWER 将在 AAPEX 新产品展示会上展示该产品。

paras.en: TERREPOWER is the first company to introduce a remanufactured BAS solution for North American aftermarket distribution. Applications include the Ram 1500 eTorque and Audi 48-volt mild hybrid vehicles.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 是第一家为北美售后市场分销引入再制造 BAS 解决方案的公司。应用包括 Ram 1500 eTorque 和奥迪 48 伏轻度混合动力汽车。

paras.en: As mild hybrid vehicles move beyond their original warranties, the Remy BAS offers an alternative to limited OE supply. TERREPOWER uses the original OE design and remanufactures the unit with qualified components, manufacturing controls and validation testing. The process restores the unit to its original OE performance level.
paras.zh: 随着轻度混合动力汽车超出其原始保修期，Remy BAS 提供了有限原厂供应的替代方案。 TERREPOWER 使用原始 OE 设计，并使用合格的组件、制造控制和验证测试重新制造该装置。该过程将设备恢复到其原始 OE 性能水平。

paras.en: The Remy BAS supports stop-start operation, captures energy during braking and deceleration, and provides torque assistance.
paras.zh: Remy BAS支持启停操作，在制动和减速过程中捕获能量，并提供扭矩辅助。

paras.en: Initial coverage includes H80002 for 2019-2024 Ram 1500 5.7-liter V8 eTorque applications. Part Number H80001 covers 2020-2025 Audi 48-volt mild hybrid applications.
paras.zh: 初始覆盖范围包括适用于 2019-2024 年 Ram 1500 5.7 升 V8 eTorque 应用的 H80002。零件号 H80001 涵盖 2020-2025 年奥迪 48 伏轻度混合动力应用。

paras.en: Remanufacturing Process and Product Support
paras.zh: 再制造流程和产品支持

paras.en: The core-exchange remanufacturing process begins with a returned unit. Technicians disassemble and inspect the unit, replace or renew components, and rebuild it to its original OE design.
paras.zh: 核心交换再制造过程从返回的单元开始。技术人员拆卸并检查设备，更换或更新组件，并将其重建为原始原厂设计。

paras.en: The process keeps serviceable metal and electronic components in circulation. Compared with manufacturing an equivalent new unit, it reduces raw material extraction, energy consumption and landfill waste.
paras.zh: 该过程使可用的金属和电子元件保持流通。与制造同等的新装置相比，它减少了原材料开采、能源消耗和垃圾填埋废物。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will support the introduction with sales materials, electronic catalog support, product videos and training modules with quizzes. These resources will help partners prepare counter staff and technicians for emerging hybrid repair opportunities.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 将通过销售材料、电子目录支持、产品视频和带有测验的培训模块来支持介绍。这些资源将帮助合作伙伴为柜台工作人员和技术人员做好准备，以应对新兴的混合动力维修机会。

paras.en: Expanding Brake Caliper and Steering Coverage
paras.zh: 扩大制动钳和转向覆盖范围

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also preview an expansion of its NuGeon new brake caliper line. The company plans to release more than 1,800 caliper SKUs in 2027. The new calipers aim to simplify stocking and installation.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将预览其 NuGeon 新制动卡钳系列的扩展。该公司计划在 2027 年发布超过 1,800 个卡钳 SKU。新卡钳旨在简化库存和安装。

paras.en: Additionally, TERREPOWER is expanding its electric power steering (EPS) program with 92 new part numbers. The expansion covers more than 20.2 million vehicles in operation in the U.S. and more than 226,000 in Canada.
paras.zh: 此外，TERREPOWER 正在通过 92 个新零件号扩展其电动助力转向 (EPS) 计划。此次扩张涵盖了美国超过 2,020 万辆运营车辆和加拿大超过 226,000 辆运营车辆。

paras.en: S.T.A.R.T. Mobile App Supports Diagnostics
paras.zh: 开始。移动应用程序支持诊断

paras.en: TERREPOWER designed its S.T.A.R.T. app to guide technicians through a structured diagnostic process. The app helps identify the root cause of a failure before technicians install a replacement component. This approach aims to reduce repeat repairs and returns.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 设计了 ​​S.T.A.R.T.应用程序指导技术人员完成结构化诊断过程。该应用程序可帮助技术人员在安装更换组件之前确定故障的根本原因。这种方法旨在减少重复维修和退货。

paras.en: The mobile version launches with turbocharger troubleshooting. TERREPOWER plans to add alternator and starter capabilities before the end of 2026.
paras.zh: 移动版本推出时带有涡轮增压器故障排除功能。 TERREPOWER 计划在 2026 年底前增加交流发电机和起动机功能。

paras.en: - Symptom-based troubleshooting by product type.
paras.zh: - 按产品类型进行基于症状的故障排除。

paras.en: - Diagnostic trouble code lookup, including codes such as P0299 turbo underboost.
paras.zh: - 诊断故障代码查找，包括 P0299 涡轮增压不足等代码。

paras.en: - Direct access to TechEyeQ remote assistance by phone or email.
paras.zh: - 通过电话或电子邮件直接访问 TechEyeQ 远程协助。

paras.en: “S.T.A.R.T. is another example of how we’re thinking beyond the replacement part,” Gillis said. “Giving technicians better diagnostic support can help them identify the underlying problem before installing a new component. That means greater confidence in the repair for technicians, distributors and ultimately the vehicle owner.”
paras.zh: “S.T.A.R.T. 是我们超越替换部件思考的另一个例子，”吉利斯说。 “为技术人员提供更好的诊断支持可以帮助他们在安装新部件之前识别根本问题。这意味着技术人员、经销商以及最终车主对维修更有信心。”

paras.en: The S.T.A.R.T. app is available on Apple’s App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac and on Google Play for Android devices.
paras.zh: S.T.A.R.T.该应用程序可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的 Apple App Store 以及 Android 设备的 Google Play 上下载。

paras.en: TERREPOWER also offers alternator and starter troubleshooting through its expanded desktop application at www.partinstall.com/start.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还通过 www.partinstall.com/start 上的扩展桌面应用程序提供交流发电机和起动机故障排除服务。

paras.en: Additional Aftermarket Products at AAPEX
paras.zh: AAPEX 上的其他售后产品

paras.en: The Remy BAS, S.T.A.R.T. app and expanded parts portfolio reflect TERREPOWER’s focus on products and repair support. The company combines remanufactured components with diagnostic technology, training and resources for aftermarket customers.
paras.zh: 雷米 BAS、S.T.A.R.T.应用程序和扩展的零件组合反映了 TERREPOWER 对产品和维修支持的关注。该公司将再制造部件与售后市场客户的诊断技术、培训和资源相结合。

paras.en: TERREPOWER will also highlight products and services across rotating electrical, turbochargers, braking, steering and electric vehicle battery lifecycle services.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 还将重点介绍旋转电气、涡轮增压器、制动、转向和电动汽车电池生命周期服务等领域的产品和服务。

paras.en: AAPEX 2026 takes place Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas. TERREPOWER will exhibit at booth V8405 in the Remanufacturing/Sustainable Manufacturing area.
paras.zh: AAPEX 2026 将于 11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯举行。 TERREPOWER 将在再制造/可持续制造领域的 V8405 展位展出。

paras.en: Visitors can view the Remy BAS and watch demonstrations of the S.T.A.R.T. app. TERREPOWER technical experts will also discuss product applications, diagnostic technology and sustainable manufacturing.
paras.zh: 参观者可以参观 Remy BAS 并观看 S.T.A.R.T. 的演示。应用程序。 TERREPOWER技术专家还将讨论产品应用、诊断技术和可持续制造。

articles.title: AISIN Launches Expanded Product Lineup
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: AISIN Corporation, a Top 10 global Tier One supplier of automotive components and systems and one of the industry’s largest manufacturers of aftermarket parts, will introduce a new product line at the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas, Nov. 3-5, 2026. Built on its reputation for delivering OE-quality products to the professional aftermarket, the expansion marks a new chapter for AISIN, the company said.
paras.zh: 爱信公司是全球十大汽车零部件和系统一级供应商，也是业内最大的售后零件制造商之一，将于 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯举行的汽车售后产品博览会 (AAPEX) 上推出新产品线。该公司表示，凭借向专业售后市场提供原厂品质产品的声誉，此次扩张标志着爱信翻开了新篇章。

paras.en: Pilot Program Expands Access and Categories
paras.zh: 试点计划扩大了准入范围和类别

paras.en: To support the rollout, AISIN vetted and established a pilot program with a China-based global supply chain partner. The pilot enabled AISIN to maintain its OE-quality standards while expanding into new, high-volume maintenance-related categories, the company said.
paras.zh: 为了支持该计划的推出，爱信与一家位于中国的全球供应链合作伙伴审查并建立了试点计划。该公司表示，该试点使爱信能够维持其原厂质量标准，同时扩展到新的、大批量维护相关的类别。

paras.en: Parts available through this program include products in cooling systems, drivetrain, steering, suspension, chemicals and fluids. AISIN will bring a selection of the approximately 10,000 SKUs of replacement parts to AAPEX.
paras.zh: 通过该计划提供的零件包括冷却系统、传动系统、转向装置、悬架、化学品和液体等产品。爱信将在 AAPEX 上精选约 10,000 个 SKU 替换零件。

paras.en: Online-First Launch and Joint Venture Plans
paras.zh: 在线首发和合资计划

paras.en: “With a broader, more accessible product offering, AISIN is opening the door for a wider range of customers to experience the quality, performance and reliability that define the AISIN name,” said Dwayne Bates, president of AISIN Aftermarket and Service of America. “Part of our growth strategy announced in 2024 is to create an online auto parts mall where customers can access affordable, AISIN-quality replacement parts. This aligns perfectly with that strategy, allowing us to maintain the quality standards our customers know and trust, while expanding into new product categories that meet the needs of today’s evolving automotive market.”
paras.zh: 爱信美国售后市场和服务总裁德韦恩·贝茨 (Dwayne Bates) 表示：“通过提供更广泛、更容易获得的产品，爱信正在为更广泛的客户打开大门，让他们体验定义爱信品牌的质量、性能和可靠性。” “我们在 2024 年宣布的增长战略的一部分是创建一个在线汽车零部件商城，客户可以在这里获得价格实惠、爱信品质的替换零部件。这与该战略完美契合，使我们能够保持客户了解和信任的质量标准，同时扩展到新的产品类别，以满足当今不断发展的汽车市场的需求。”

paras.en: The new AISIN product range has begun rolling out through online sellers first, including Amazon, and will expand into offline channels by the end of the year. Following the pilot, the company has a pending joint venture in the works, with additional details to be announced at completion.
paras.zh: 新的爱信产品系列已开始首先通过包括亚马逊在内的在线卖家推出，并将在今年年底扩展到线下渠道。试点结束后，该公司正在筹建一家合资企业，更多细节将在完成后公布。

paras.en: AAPEX Display to Feature New Product Range
paras.zh: AAPEX 展示将展示新产品系列

paras.en: AAPEX 2026 will be the first time the new product line is shown at an industry event. The display will include catalytic converters, turbochargers, AC compressors, fuel pumps, hub bearings, shock absorbers, mass airflow sensors, lift strut supports, alternators and expansion tanks.
paras.zh: AAPEX 2026 将是新产品线首次在行业活动中展示。该展示将包括催化转换器、涡轮增压器、交流压缩机、燃油泵、轮毂轴承、减震器、质量气流传感器、提升支柱支架、交流发电机和膨胀水箱。

paras.en: The new line of products will be on display at booth V3261 in The Venetian Expo at AAPEX, Nov. 3-5, 2026.
paras.zh: 新系列产品将于 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 5 日在 AAPEX 威尼斯人博览会 V3261 展位展出。

articles.title: Bumper Removal & ADAS Recalibration
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Removing a front bumper cover for repairs or modifications can affect advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Cameras, radar and other sensors require precise alignment to function properly.
paras.zh: 拆卸前保险杠盖进行维修或改装可能会影响高级驾驶员辅助系统 (ADAS)。摄像头、雷达和其他传感器需要精确对准才能正常工作。

paras.en: Remind customers that bumper removal or replacement may require ADAS recalibration, even during routine radiator, condenser or headlight repairs. Always consult manufacturer procedures to ensure proper operation and safety.
paras.zh: 提醒客户，即使在常规散热器、冷凝器或前灯维修期间，拆卸或更换保险杠也可能需要 ADAS 重新校准。请务必查阅制造商程序以确保正确操作和安全。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Simple Steps for Successful Wiper Blade Installation
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Installing wiper blades is a valuable customer service, but proper installation requires care. Never place blades on a vehicle’s paint or leave an exposed wiper arm upright, where it could damage the windshield.
paras.zh: 安装雨刷片是一项有价值的客户服务，但正确安装需要小心。切勿将刀片放在车辆的油漆上或将暴露的雨刷臂直立放置，否则可能会损坏挡风玻璃。

paras.en: Use a pocket screwdriver to help remove stubborn blades, select the correct adapter and ensure it snaps securely into place before lowering the arm.
paras.zh: 使用袖珍螺丝刀帮助移除顽固的刀片，选择正确的适配器并确保其在放下臂之前牢固地卡入到位。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: James Webb telescope discovers rare ring galaxy and 'intruder' 2 billion years after the Big Bang
articles.author: Shreejaya Karantha

paras.en: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have discovered a galaxy with a glowing ring of newborn stars shining in the early universe. The galaxy, which the researchers observed as it appeared just 2.1 billion years after the Big Bang, is the most distant ring galaxy ever found.
paras.zh: 天文学家使用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 发现了一个星系，其中有一个由新生恒星组成的发光环，在早期宇宙中闪闪发光。研究人员观察到的这个星系是在大爆炸后仅 21 亿年出现的，是迄今为止发现的最遥远的环形星系。

paras.en: The ring galaxy, known as GS18660, may be the result of a collision between two galaxies, the researchers reported in their study, published Sept. 8 in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 9 月 8 日发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的研究中报告称，这个被称为 GS18660 的环形星系可能是两个星系碰撞的结果。

paras.en: It's rare to find the possible snapshot of a merger like this, given the timescales involved in these systems, Christopher Conselice, a professor of extragalactic astronomy at the University of Manchester in the U.K. who was not involved in the study, told Live Science. Although interactions between galaxies may have been common in the early universe, the creation of ringed systems like this is thought to be unusual.
paras.zh: 英国曼彻斯特大学河外天文学教授克里斯托弗·康塞利斯（Christopher Conselice）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《生活科学》杂志，考虑到这些系统所涉及的时间尺度，很难找到像这样的合并可能的快照。尽管星系之间的相互作用在早期宇宙中可能很常见，但像这样的环状系统的形成被认为是不寻常的。

paras.en: "In this sense, the galaxy system is quite unique and may give us important information about early galaxy formation," Conselice said in an email.
paras.zh: 康塞利斯在一封电子邮件中说：“从这个意义上说，这个星系系统非常独特，可能为我们提供有关早期星系形成的重要信息。”

paras.en: Scientists selected GS18660 for observation because it looked stretched out in older Hubble Space Telescope images.
paras.zh: 科学家选择 GS18660 进行观测，因为它在哈勃太空望远镜的旧图像中看起来被拉长了。

paras.en: "We therefore did not target GS18660 specifically as a ring galaxy," Michele Perna, a postdoctoral researcher at the Spanish Astrobiology Center and the first author of the study, told Live Science in an email. "When we observed it with JWST [Near-Infrared Spectrograph instrument], the much more detailed data revealed the prominent ring structure and allowed us to investigate the galaxy in three dimensions."
paras.zh: 西班牙天体生物学中心的博士后研究员、该研究的第一作者米歇尔·佩尔纳（Michele Perna）在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“因此，我们并没有专门将 GS18660 作为环状星系。” “当我们用 JWST（近红外光谱仪）观察它时，更详细的数据揭示了显着的环结构，使我们能够在三个维度上研究星系。”

paras.en: Using JWST, the team looked at the galaxy's unique shape, tracked the motions of its hot gas, analyzed the gas's chemical properties, and studied the galaxy's star formation history.
paras.zh: 利用 JWST，研究小组观察了星系的独特形状，跟踪了其热气体的运动，分析了气体的化学性质，并研究了星系的恒星形成历史。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: When a small galaxy plunges through the center of a larger galaxy, the impact creates a wave of dense gas that ripples outward, similar to how water moves when a stone is dropped into a pond. As a result, a collisional galaxy is formed. Gas piles up along the wave and forms stars, producing a ring. These galaxies are rare in the local universe, and the few candidates found in the distant universe have been hard to confirm.
paras.zh: 当一个小星系冲入一个较大星系的中心时，撞击会产生一波向外扩散的致密气体，类似于将石头扔进池塘时水的移动方式。结果，形成了碰撞星系。气体沿着波堆积并形成恒星，形成一个环。这些星系在本地宇宙中很少见，而在遥远的宇宙中发现的少数候选星系也很难确认。

paras.en: Several clues support the case for GS18660 as a collisional ring galaxy. For one, the researchers spotted a small companion galaxy, moving away from GS18660 at about 264 miles per second (425 kilometers per second). They also detected a bridge of gas linking the two, and the velocity along it changed, Perna noted. The change in velocity along this bridge-like structure indicates that the companion and GS18660 may be interacting.
paras.zh: 有几条线索支持 GS18660 是一个碰撞环星系。首先，研究人员发现了一个小型伴星系，它以每秒约 264 英里（每秒 425 公里）的速度远离 GS18660。佩纳指出，他们还发现了一座连接两者的气体桥，并且沿着它的速度发生了变化。沿着这个桥状结构的速度变化表明同伴和 GS18660 可能正在相互作用。

paras.en: Its position is also important, Perna added — the companion is located roughly along the main galaxy's minor axis, consistent with where an intruder would be expected to appear after a head-on plunge through the galaxy's disk.
paras.zh: 佩尔纳补充说，它的位置也很重要——伴星大致位于主星系的短轴上，与入侵者正面冲入星系盘后预计出现的位置一致。

paras.en: Using the companion's speed and distance, the team estimated a rough timeline for the impact. It revealed that the collision happened about 17 million to 42 million years earlier in the galaxy's history. This time scale seems reasonable, Conselice said.
paras.zh: 利用同伴的速度和距离，研究小组估计了撞击的粗略时间表。它揭示了这次碰撞发生在银河系历史上大约 1700 万到 4200 万年前。康塞利斯说，这个时间尺度似乎是合理的。

paras.en: He explained that it is difficult to determine the age of a past interaction directly, but that if one did occur, it must have happened around the time a rapid star-formation episode began and its age should be consistent with the average ages of the star clusters.
paras.zh: 他解释说，很难直接确定过去相互作用的年龄，但如果确实发生了，它一定是在快速恒星形成事件开始的时候发生的，而且它的年龄应该与星团的平均年龄一致。

paras.en: Looking at star formation rates with different instruments, the team estimates that 10% to 20% of the stellar mass in the ring formed in the past few tens of millions of years. This suggests that the collision and the ring's burst of new stars might have happened at the same time, so they were most likely caused by the same event, Perna explained.
paras.zh: 研究小组利用不同仪器观察恒星形成率，估计环中 10% 到 20% 的恒星质量是在过去几千万年里形成的。佩纳解释说，这表明碰撞和环中新恒星的爆发可能是同时发生的，因此它们很可能是由同一事件引起的。

paras.en: "It is not, by itself, definitive proof of a collision, but together with the bridge and the ring morphology, it strengthens the case for a recent impact," Perna noted.
paras.zh: 佩纳指出：“它本身并不是碰撞的明确证据，但与桥和环的形态一起，它强化了最近发生碰撞的证据。”

paras.en: The discovery may also shed light on how common these kinds of collisions used to be. Whereas earlier estimates suggested that collisional rings in the early universe might be about as rare as they are today — around 1 in 10,000 galaxies — the new findings hint that head-on collisions that form ring galaxies may be more common in the early universe.
paras.zh: 这一发现也可能揭示出此类碰撞过去是多么普遍。虽然早期的估计表明，早期宇宙中的碰撞环可能和今天一样罕见——大约万分之一，但新的发现表明，形成环形星系的正面碰撞在早期宇宙中可能更常见。

paras.en: "If GS18660 is confirmed as a collisional ring, it would therefore suggest that we need to revisit our estimates of how frequently these systems occur in the distant universe," Perna said
paras.zh: 佩尔纳说：“如果 GS18660 被确认为碰撞环，那么这表明我们需要重新审视这些系统在遥远宇宙中出现频率的估计。”

paras.en: The team expressed caution about how much the data can prove. "It is really the combination of several pieces of evidence rather than one single observation," Perna said. "So we regard the collisional interpretation as our preferred scenario rather than a definitive conclusion."
paras.zh: 该团队对数据能证明多少表示谨慎。 “这实际上是几项证据的结合，而不是单一的观察，”佩纳说。 “因此，我们将碰撞解释视为我们的首选方案，而不是确定的结论。”

paras.en: Conselice thinks the evidence presented in the paper is consistent with a genuine collisional origin for the ring. "It looks to me like the merger hypothesis is more likely, given the nearby galaxy intruder and the stability of the intruder galaxy and the main galaxy itself," Conselice said. “Overall, it is convincing evidence that a past interaction and/or merger has occurred for this galaxy system based on the light distribution."
paras.zh: 康塞利斯认为论文中提供的证据与戒指的真正碰撞起源一致。康塞利斯说：“在我看来，考虑到附近的星系入侵者以及入侵者星系和主星系本身的稳定性，合并假说的可能性更大。” “总的来说，这是令人信服的证据，表明这个星系系统过去根据光分布发生过相互作用和/或合并。”

paras.en: The other competing explanation involves a stellar bar. It proposes that the ring was not made by an intruder at all. GS18660 also shows a bar-like structure running north to south, and bars can funnel gas and stars into rings at specific distances from the center. Perna said the team cannot yet tell whether this is a true stellar bar or a result of the interaction.
paras.zh: 另一种相互竞争的解释涉及恒星酒吧。它表明这枚戒指根本不是入侵者制造的。 GS18660还显示了一个从北向南延伸的条状结构，条状结构可以将气体和恒星汇集到距中心特定距离的环中。佩尔纳表示，团队还无法判断这是否是真正的恒星酒吧或相互作用的结果。

paras.en: A bar would be an exciting finding, too. JWST has already discovered barred galaxies in the early universe, including CEERS-2112. But researchers have not yet found a clear example of a bar-driven ring so early in the universe.
paras.zh: 酒吧也是一个令人兴奋的发现。 JWST 已经在早期宇宙中发现了棒状星系，包括 CEERS-2112。但研究人员尚未在宇宙早期发现杆驱动环的明显例子。

paras.en: "Whether the ring was triggered by another galaxy or by the internal dynamics of GS18660," Perna said, "the result would tell us something important about how galaxies were already becoming structurally organised when the universe was only a few billion years old."
paras.zh: 佩尔纳说：“无论这个环是由另一个星系还是由 GS18660 的内部动力学触发的，结果都会告诉我们一些重要的信息，即当宇宙只有几十亿年的时候，星系在结构上是如何组织起来的。”

paras.en: Perna, M., Arribas, S., Costantin, L., Pérez-González, P. G., Prieto-Jiménez, C., Rodríguez Del Pino, B., D’Eugenio, F., Lamperti, I., Mannucci, F., Übler, H., Cresci, G., Böker, T., Bunker, A. Based in India, she works as a writer and research specialist at The Secrets of the Universe, where she contributes to scripts for research-based and explainer videos. Shreejaya holds a bachelor's degree in science and a master's degree in physics with a specialization in astrophysics.

articles.title: Rare tiger behaviors captured on camera show 'we really know nothing about them'
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: A male tiger approaches his cubs and greets them with a head-bobbing motion while their mother rests nearby. The surprising interaction, captured in the PBS Nature documentary "Tiger Island," a two-part series that follows two big-cat families across Nepal.
paras.zh: 一只雄性老虎靠近它的幼崽，并用摇头的动作向它们打招呼，而它们的母亲则在附近休息。 PBS Nature 纪录片《老虎岛》捕捉到了这种令人惊讶的互动，该纪录片分为两部分，讲述了尼泊尔各地的两个大型猫科动物家庭的故事。

paras.en: The footage marks the first time a tiger "family" has been documented spending time together, and it could challenge conventional assumptions about how the seemingly solitary cats behave around their young, said Dan O'Neill, a wildlife biologist and filmmaker who contributed to "Tiger Island." Previously, it was thought that tiger moms raise their cubs for up to two years without any help from the male tiger.
paras.zh: 为《老虎岛》做出贡献的野生生物学家兼电影制片人丹·奥尼尔表示，这段视频标志着第一次有记录显示老虎“家庭”在一起度过时光，它可能挑战关于这些看似孤独的猫科动物在幼崽面前如何表现的传统假设。此前，人们认为虎妈妈在没有雄性老虎帮助的情况下抚养幼崽长达两年。

paras.en: "It just shows that we really know nothing about them," O'Neill told Live Science. "And they're so much more complex than people realize."
paras.zh: “这只是表明我们真的对它们一无所知，”奥尼尔告诉《生活科学》。 “而且它们比人们意识到的要复杂得多。”

paras.en: That's just one of the scenes in Tiger Island that challenges our understanding of the tigers' solitary nature. In another scene, a female tiger cares for another tigress's cubs.
paras.zh: 这只是老虎岛的场景之一，挑战了我们对老虎孤独本性的理解。在另一个场景中，一只母老虎正在照顾另一只母老虎的幼崽。

paras.en: "We have these very rigid ideas of how these animals live," O'Neill told Live Science. But the natural world is "diverse and ever-changing," and tigers are no exception, he said.
paras.zh: “我们对这些动物的生活方式有非常严格的想法，”奥尼尔告诉《生活科学》。但他说，自然世界是“多样化且不断变化的”，老虎也不例外。

paras.en: The footage of the female caring for another tiger's cubs could offer clues about how mother tigers protect their young. Male tigers, like male lions, sometimes kill cubs — a behavior known as infanticide — particularly when a new male takes over a territory. Allowing another female tiger to care for cubs might help more cubs survive to adulthood, O'Neill suggested. Previous observations of female tigers have shown females helping to co-parent each other's cubs, but it's a rare event.
paras.zh: 雌性照顾另一只老虎幼崽的镜头可以为了解母虎如何保护幼崽提供线索。雄性老虎和雄性狮子一样，有时会杀死幼崽——这种行为被称为杀婴——尤其是当新的雄性老虎占领领地时。奥尼尔建议，让另一只雌虎照顾幼崽可能会帮助更多的幼崽存活到成年。此前对雌性老虎的观察表明，雌性老虎会帮助共同抚养彼此的幼崽，但这种情况很少见。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: To capture these scenes, the crew used drones with powerful optical-zoom lenses and quiet propellers to observe the tigers in places that were difficult to access without disturbing the big cats. Traditional camera traps often capture animals along trails, leaving much of their private lives unseen. O'Neill noted that the drone propellers were quieter than the local bees where the filming took place, thus giving the crew candid views of the tigers as they went about their lives.
paras.zh: 为了捕捉这些场景，工作人员使用配备强大光学变焦镜头和安静螺旋桨的无人机在难以到达的地方观察老虎而不打扰大型猫科动物。传统的相机陷阱经常捕捉小径上的动物，而无法看到它们的大部分私生活。奥尼尔指出，无人机螺旋桨比拍摄现场的当地蜜蜂更安静，因此摄制组可以清楚地看到老虎的生活。

paras.en: Though tigers (Panthera tigris) are solitary animals, they often live close to or share habitat with human communities. That means tigers sometimes attack people and kill livestock, O'Neill said. "It would be absolutely naive and wrong to suggest that they [attacks on people] don't happen," O'Neill said. As a result, conservation efforts must account for the circumstances in which people and big cats encounter one another, rather than treating human communities as separate from wildlife, he said.
paras.zh: 尽管老虎（Panthera tigris）是独居动物，但它们通常生活在人类社区附近或与人类社区共享栖息地。奥尼尔说，这意味着老虎有时会攻击人类并杀死牲畜。奥尼尔说：“如果认为这些事件（对人的攻击）不会发生，那绝对是天真和错误的。”因此，保护​​工作必须考虑到人类和大型猫科动物彼此相遇的情况，而不是将人类社区与野生动物分开对待，他说。

paras.en: The same issue affects other big cats. O'Neill, a researcher with the wild-cat conservation organization Panthera, has spent years studying jaguars, pumas and snow leopards. He said the popular image of these animals living in remote wilderness can obscure how closely they overlap with human lives.
paras.zh: 同样的问题也影响到其他大型猫科动物。奥尼尔是野猫保护组织 Panthera 的研究员，多年来一直在研究美洲虎、美洲狮和雪豹。他说，这些生活在偏远荒野的动物的流行形象可能会掩盖它们与人类生活的密切程度。

paras.en: For O'Neill, conservation requires more than studying the animals' behaviors or protecting their habitats. It also means helping people who bear the cost of living alongside these apex predators.
paras.zh: 对于奥尼尔来说，保护需要的不仅仅是研究动物的行为或保护它们的栖息地。这也意味着帮助那些与这些顶级掠食者一起承担生活费用的人们。

paras.en: "Helping those people is how you help tiger conservation," he said.
paras.zh: “帮助这些人就是帮助老虎保护，”他说。

paras.en: In the U.S. "Tiger Island" Part Two airs on Wednesday, Oct. 28 at 12:30 am on the PBS channel.
paras.zh: 在美国，《老虎岛》第二部分将于 10 月 28 日星期三中午 12:30 在 PBS 频道播出。

paras.en: Think you know about lions and tigers? Test your smarts with our big cat quiz!
paras.zh: 你认为你了解狮子和老虎吗？通过我们的大型猫科动物测验来测试您的聪明才智！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.

articles.title: Is AI making you lazier?
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools like chatbots are becoming part of everyday life, helping people write messages, answer questions and learn new skills. While some of these processes may save people time, a new study reveals a possible new downside of consistently relying on AI assistance.
paras.zh: 聊天机器人等人工智能 (AI) 工具正在成为日常生活的一部分，帮助人们编写消息、回答问题和学习新技能。虽然其中一些流程可能会节省人们的时间，但一项新的研究揭示了持续依赖人工智能辅助可能带来的新缺点。

paras.en: - Can AI detect cognitive decline better than a doctor? New study reveals surprising accuracy
paras.zh: - 人工智能能否比医生更好地检测认知能力下降？新研究揭示了惊人的准确性

paras.en: - Doctors say AI model can predict 'biological age' from a selfie — and want to use it to guide cancer treatment
paras.zh: - 医生表示人工智能模型可以通过自拍照预测“生物年龄”，并希望用它来指导癌症治疗

paras.en: - 'There's a sense that these algorithms are objective and they get to know you': How social media warps our understanding of healthcare
paras.zh: - “有一种感觉，这些算法是客观的，它们会了解你”：社交媒体如何扭曲我们对医疗保健的理解

paras.en: The research, presented at the 2026 Conference on Language Modeling in San Francisco earlier this month, found that people who relied on AI assistance for tasks like math problems and reading comprehension were more likely to give up or struggle when the assistance was taken away. The findings suggest that leaning too heavily on AI could weaken people's motivation to push through challenges.
paras.zh: 这项研究于本月早些时候在旧金山举行的 2026 年语言建模会议上发表，研究发现，依赖人工智能帮助完成数学问题和阅读理解等任务的人在援助被取消时更有可能放弃或陷入困境。研究结果表明，过度依赖人工智能可能会削弱人们应对挑战的动力。

paras.en: The research raises the question of what happens when people stop exercising their brains. So do you think AI is making you less motivated, or even "dumber," or is it simply making you more efficient? Vote in our poll, and let us know your thoughts in the comments.
paras.zh: 这项研究提出了一个问题：当人们停止锻炼大脑时会发生什么。那么，您认为人工智能是否会降低您的积极性，甚至让您变得“愚蠢”，或者只是让您变得更有效率？在我们的民意调查中投票，并在评论中让我们知道您的想法。

articles.title: Two Thousand Years Ago, a New Ice Age Began—but Human-Caused Climate Change Recently Reversed It, According to New Research

paras.en: Humanity’s greenhouse gas emissions may have warmed the planet enough to reverse the next ice age.
paras.zh: 人类的温室气体排放可能已经使地球变暖，足以逆转下一个冰河时代。

paras.en: In a study published October 22 in the journal Science, researchers reconstructed the growth and retreat of Canada’s Barnes Ice Cap, which was once a massive stretch of ice called the Laurentide Ice Sheet. The timeline they put together suggests that the ice cap started to expand around 2,000 years ago—a sign a new ice age was beginning—but it was cut short by planet-warming industrialization in the 1960s.
paras.zh: 在《科学》杂志 10 月 22 日发表的一项研究中，研究人员重建了加拿大巴恩斯冰盖的生长和消退，巴恩斯冰盖曾经是一片巨大的冰层，称为劳伦泰德冰盖。他们整理的时间线表明，冰盖在大约 2000 年前开始扩张——这是新冰河时代开始的迹象——但由于 20 世纪 60 年代全球变暖的工业化而缩短了扩张时间。

paras.en: The Laurentide Ice Sheet dominated the landscape of modern-day Canada and the northern United States tens of thousands of years ago. At its peak around 20,000 years ago, it covered almost 30 percent of the continent, extending from above the Arctic Circle to what is now Illinois. The ice was more than two miles thick in some spots.
paras.zh: 数万年前，劳伦泰德冰盖主宰了现代加拿大和美国北部的景观。在大约 20,000 年前的鼎盛时期，它覆盖了非洲大陆近 30% 的面积，从北极圈上方一直延伸到现在的伊利诺伊州。有些地方的冰厚超过两英里。

paras.en: All that’s left of this formidable feature today is the Barnes Ice Cap. It’s a Delaware-size ice cap on central Baffin Island in Nunavut, Canada.
paras.zh: 今天，这个令人敬畏的景点只剩下巴恩斯冰帽了。这是一个特拉华州大小的冰盖，位于加拿大努纳武特地区巴芬岛中部。

paras.en: Over the past 2.6 million years, Earth has been cycling between times with large ice sheets, called glacial periods or colloquially, ice ages, and times without them, or interglacial periods. The last glacial period ended around 11,700 years ago, and we are now in an interglacial period named the Holocene.
paras.zh: 在过去的 260 万年里，地球一直在有大冰盖的时期（称为冰川期或通俗地称为冰河期）和没有大冰盖的时期（或间冰期）之间循环。上一次冰期结束于大约 11,700 年前，现在我们正处于一个名为全新世的间冰期。

paras.en: Did you know? Scientifically speaking, we’re still in an Ice Age
paras.zh: 你可知道？从科学角度来说，我们仍处于冰河时代

paras.en: Technically, we’re in the Late Cenozoic Ice Age, which started around 34 million years ago. The Earth flip-flops between glacial and interglacial periods within this Ice Age.
paras.zh: 从技术上讲，我们正处于大约 3400 万年前开始的新生代晚期冰河时代。在这个冰河时期，地球在冰期和间冰期之间翻转。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers took advantage of the vegetation once encased in the Barnes Ice Cap. After a period of retreat, “mosses eventually colonized this newly exposed land” on the edge of the ice, lead author Nicolás Young, a paleoclimatologist at Columbia University, tells Wired’s Molly Taft. “These mosses are living there, and things are normal—then, eventually, the ice cap starts to re-expand. The ice covers the moss and kills it.”
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员利用了巴恩斯冰盖中曾经包裹的植被。哥伦比亚大学古气候学家、主要作者尼古拉斯·杨（Nicolás Young）告诉《连线》杂志的莫莉·塔夫脱（Molly Taft），经过一段时间的撤退，“苔藓最终在冰层边缘的这片新暴露的土地上定居”。 “这些苔藓生活在那里，一切都很正常——然后，最终，冰盖开始重新膨胀。冰覆盖了苔藓并杀死了它。”

paras.en: Unlike other glaciers that slide around, the Barnes Ice Cap is frozen onto its bedrock. While a sliding glacier would have crushed older vegetation, during periods of expansion, this ice cap encased the greens that had grown around it.
paras.zh: 与其他滑动的冰川不同，巴恩斯冰盖被冻结在基岩上。虽然滑动的冰川会压碎较古老的植被，但在扩张期间，这个冰盖包裹了周围生长的绿色植物。

paras.en: So, Young and colleagues looked at the buildup of a form of beryllium in newly exposed bedrock and in surrounding boulders. The element can tell researchers when rock was exposed to the atmosphere and cosmic rays. They also carbon-dated the recently exposed dead vegetation to figure out when it first died, corresponding to when the ice cap last expanded across that area.
paras.zh: 因此，杨和同事观察了新暴露的基岩和周围巨石中铍的堆积情况。该元素可以告诉研究人员岩石何时暴露于大气和宇宙射线。他们还对最近暴露的死亡植被进行了碳年代测定，以确定其首次死亡的时间，即冰盖最后一次在该地区扩张的时间。

paras.en: Analyses revealed that the Barnes Ice Cap reached its smallest size around 3,600 years ago. It then started growing again around 2,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 分析显示，巴恩斯冰盖在大约 3,600 年前达到最小尺寸。然后它在大约 2000 年前再次开始生长。

paras.en: “Our approach helped us see the first steps of ice-sheet growth preserved in the landscape. It gave us a rare opportunity to understand how re-glaciation begins and how the Laurentide Ice Sheet re-forms,” study co-author Joerg Schaefer, a geochemist at Columbia University, says in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们的方法帮助我们看到了冰盖生长的第一步。它为我们提供了一个难得的机会来了解再冰川作用如何开始以及劳伦泰德冰盖如何重新形成，”该研究的合著者、哥伦比亚大学地球化学家乔尔格·谢弗（Joerg Schaefer）在一份声明中说。

paras.en: Barnes Ice Cap kept growing until the late 1950s. However, its expansion stopped cold, and it began retreating in the next decade, when increased summer temperatures caused the feature to lose more ice than it could gain in the winter. That period of regrowth may have been the beginning of a new ice age, which was brought to an early end by human-driven climate change. The findings support previous research highlighting the same conclusion.
paras.zh: 巴恩斯冰帽一直在增长，直到 20 世纪 50 年代末。然而，它的扩张停止了寒冷，并在接下来的十年中开始消退，当时夏季气温升高导致该地貌失去的冰量超过了冬季获得的冰量。那段再生期可能是新冰河时代的开始，而新冰河时代因人类驱动的气候变化而提前结束。这些发现支持了先前的研究，强调了相同的结论。

paras.en: This isn’t the first time researchers have speculated about the start of a modern ice age. Some climate scientists suggested in the 1970s that the world was on the verge of a new ice age. Climate deniers used the claim to argue human-caused global warming wasn’t real, according to Wired.
paras.zh: 这并不是研究人员第一次推测现代冰河时代的开始。一些气候科学家在 20 世纪 70 年代提出，世界正处于新冰河时代的边缘。据《连线》报道，气候否认者利用这一说法来辩称人为造成的全球变暖并不真实。

paras.en: The new findings, however, point to the devastating effects of climate change, which is drastically altering natural, predictable climate patterns.
paras.zh: 然而，新发现指出了气候变化的破坏性影响，它正在彻底改变自然的、可预测的气候模式。

paras.en: “Will another ice age ever transpire? The next glacial inception is generally considered unlikely to occur in the next predicted cycle, but ultimately how many skipped glacial cycles occur is left to choices made by humanity and tied to the future carbon emissions,” Shaun Marcott, an Earth scientist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who did not participate in the study, writes in a perspective article accompanying the new work.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的地球科学家肖恩·马科特（Shaun Marcott）没有参与这项研究，他在新研究附带的一篇观点文章中写道：“另一个冰河时代会发生吗？人们普遍认为下一次冰川起始不太可能发生在下一个预测的周期中，但最终会发生多少次冰川周期的跳过取决于人类做出的选择，并与未来的碳排放有关。”

paras.en: “Humans are now geologic agents capable of thwarting millions of years of natural glacial cycles and offsetting Earth’s climate for hundreds of thousands of years to come.”
paras.zh: “人类现在是地质力量，能够阻止数百万年的自然冰川循环，并在未来数十万年里抵消地球气候的影响。”

articles.title: Specialists Removed Three Thrilling, Century-Old Murals From the Walls of a French Monastery. Beneath, They Made 'a Discovery for the History of Art'

paras.en: Since 1911, a stunning series of murals by the French Symbolist artist Odilon Redon have graced the library walls of the Abbaye de Fontfroide, an 11th-century Cistercian monastery in Narbonne, France.
paras.zh: 自 1911 年以来，法国象征主义艺术家奥迪隆·雷东 (Odilon Redon) 创作的一系列令人惊叹的壁画为法国纳博讷 11 世纪的西多会修道院 Abbaye de Fontfroide 的图书馆墙壁增色不少。

paras.en: Framed by wooden bookshelves, Le Jour (Day) and La Nuit (Night) are each more than 20 feet long and depict sweeping landscapes, animals, humans and vivid floral arrangements. Above the door, a third mural, Le Silence (Silence), shows a figure reminiscent of a monk with a finger raised to his lips, surrounded by yellow blooms.
paras.zh: 《Le Jour》（白天）和《La Nuit》（夜晚）均以木质书架为框架，长度均超过 20 英尺，描绘了广阔的风景、动物、人类和生动的花卉布置。门上方是第三幅壁画《沉默》，画中的人物让人想起一位僧侣，他将手指举到嘴唇上，周围环绕着黄色的花朵。

paras.en: Earlier this year conservators removed the panels of the murals for the first time ever, to be loaned to an exhibition in Paris. Beneath, they discovered something no one had ever seen: colorful drawings, also by Redon, sketched directly onto the wall.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，管理员有史以来第一次拆除了壁画面板，以便借给巴黎的一个展览。在下面，他们发现了一些从未见过的东西：同样由雷东绘制的彩色图画，直接绘制在墙上。

paras.en: “It was a great surprise, nobody imagined the existence of these sketches,” Alexandre d’Andoque de Sériège, director of the abbey, tells ARTnews’ Maximilíano Durón. “It amuses just to imagine Redon painting them on the wall.”
paras.zh: “这是一个巨大的惊喜，没有人想象到这些草图的存在，”修道院院长亚历山大·德安多克·德塞里热告诉艺术新闻的马克西米利亚诺·杜龙。 “光是想象雷东把它们画在墙上就很有趣。”

paras.en: In some instances, the sketches loosely resemble the figures and characters that appear on the finished murals placed over them, but they are noticeably smaller and more colorful. Researchers are unsure why Redon drew them. Were they tests for the final mural? Or were they aborted attempts at a fresco, painted directly on the library wall?
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，草图与完成的壁画上出现的人物和人物大致相似，但它们明显更小、色彩更丰富。研究人员不确定雷东为什么画它们。他们对最终的壁画进行了测试吗？或者他们直接在图书馆墙上画壁画的尝试失败了？

paras.en: Redon first came to Fontfroide under the commission of Gustave Fayet, a friend and prominent collector who bought the former abbey in 1908. In a bid to transform it from a medieval religious space into a modern, creative one, Fayet funded all manner of renovations and installations, including a rebuilt church with art nouveau stained glass windows.
paras.zh: 雷东最初是在古斯塔夫·费耶 (Gustave Fayet) 的委托下来到丰弗鲁伊德 (Gustave Fayet)，古斯塔夫·费耶 (Gustave Fayet) 是一位朋友，也是一位著名的收藏家，他于 1908 年买下了这座前修道院。为了将其从中世纪的宗教空间转变为现代、富有创意的空间，费耶 (Fayet) 资助了各种翻修和设施建设，包括重建一座带有新艺术风格彩色玻璃窗的教堂。

paras.en: After an initial visit in 1908, Redon returned to the abbey for a 10-day stay in March 1910. With the renovations on the library completed, Redon had a better sense of how his murals, which he was painting in Paris, would appear in the space. D’Andoque de Sériège tells ARTNews he is “99 percent sure” that visit is when Redon drew the sketches, as a way to visualize the artwork in the room.
paras.zh: 1908 年初次参观后，雷东于 1910 年 3 月返回修道院，并在那里逗留了 10 天。随着图书馆的翻修完成，雷东对他在巴黎绘制的壁画将如何出现在这个空间有了更好的了解。 D’Andoque de Sériège 告诉 ARTNews，他“99% 确定”这次访问是雷东画草图的时候，以此来可视化房间里的艺术品。

paras.en: “A fresco in the library would have required Redon to stay very long in Fontfroide. It’s also physically a very hard job,” he adds.
paras.zh: “在图书馆绘制壁画需要雷东在丰弗里德呆很长时间。这对体力来说也是一项非常艰苦的工作，”他补充道。

paras.en: Seeing Le Jour, La Nuit and Le Silence is one of “the most thrilling art moments in the south of France,” the London Times’ Waldemar Januszczak writes. But in the monastery’s library, they can usually only be seen “twice a month on a special tour.”
paras.zh: 《伦敦时报》的 Waldemar Januszczak 写道，观看《白天》、《夜》和《寂静》是“法国南部最激动人心的艺术时刻”之一。但在修道院的图书馆里，通常只能“每月两次在特别游览中”看到它们。

paras.en: Removed from the walls for the first time ever, the panels are now among the 86 artworks by Redon currently on view at the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris as part of an exhibition about Fayet’s legacy.
paras.zh: 这些面板首次从墙上移除，现在是雷东的 86 件艺术作品之一，目前正在巴黎路易威登基金会展出，这是有关费耶遗产的展览的一部分。

paras.en: “Gustave Fayet: Collector-Designer” displays more than 250 works which one composed Fayet’s collection, as well as 374 of his own creations. The exhibition will include 10 canvases by Vincent van Gogh, 78 by Paul Gauguin and a smattering of works by Edgar Degas, Paul Cézanne, Henri Matisse, Pierre-Auguste Renoir and many more.
paras.zh: “古斯塔夫·法耶：收藏家设计师”展出了法耶收藏的250多件作品，以及他自己的374件作品。展览将包括文森特·梵高的 10 幅油画、保罗·高更的 78 幅油画以及埃德加·德加、保罗·塞尚、亨利·马蒂斯、皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿等人的少量作品。

paras.en: “Though little known today, Fayet was one of the most influential advocates and pioneers of the avant-garde of his time … He was among the first to collect works by van Gogh, to exhibit Picasso and to establish a Gauguin ‘museum’ in his home in the heart of Paris, housing a collection of nearly 200 works and attracting artists and leading collectors of the time,” according to a statement.
paras.zh: 一份声明称：“虽然今天鲜为人知，但费耶是他那个时代最有影响力的先锋派倡导者和先驱之一……他是最早收集梵高作品、展出毕加索作品并在巴黎市中心的家中建立高更‘博物馆’的人之一，收藏了近 200 件作品，吸引了当时的艺术家和领先收藏家。”

paras.en: Gauguin, in particular, was a passion for Fayet, who made his fortune in wine and also married rich. “Fayet bankrolled him and started buying every Tahitian picture he could get his hands on” before turning to Gauguin’s earlier works, set in France, per the Times.
paras.zh: 尤其是高更，他对费耶特情有独钟，费耶特靠葡萄酒发家致富，也嫁给了有钱人。据《泰晤士报》报道，“费耶特为他提供了资金，并开始购买他能拿到的每一幅大溪地画作”，然后转向高更早期以法国为背景的作品。

paras.en: The admiration appeared to be mutual. “Looking through your collection, I see that I am in the company of masters, and that makes me happy, but also rather shy,” Gauguin wrote in a letter to Fayet in 1902. “So, after all, there are people who know how to appreciate painting.”
paras.zh: 这种钦佩似乎是相互的。高更在 1902 年写给费耶的信中写道：“浏览你的收藏，我看到自己与大师为伴，这让我很高兴，但也很害羞。所以，毕竟有人知道如何欣赏绘画。”

paras.en: At the end of the Fayet show, the three Redon murals will be returned to their original locations inside the Fontfroide library. Visitors will have only until March to come and see the newly exposed wall drawings before they are covered again.
paras.zh: Fayet 展览结束后，三幅 Redon 壁画将被放回 Fontfroide 图书馆内的原始位置。游客们只有到三月份才能看到新暴露的壁画，然后它们才会被再次覆盖。

paras.en: “It’s a great emotion,” d’Andoque de Sériège tells France 3 Occitanie’s Théa Achterfeld and Frédéric Guibal. “First, because it’s a discovery for the history of art, but equally because it allows us to see that Redon truly invested himself in this work to the point that he did tests beforehand on the wall.”
paras.zh: “这是一种伟大的情感，”d’Andoque de Sériège 告诉 France 3 Occitanie 的 Théa Achterfeld 和 Frédéric Guibal。 “首先，因为这是艺术史的一个发现，但同样因为它让我们看到雷东真正投入到这件作品中，以至于他事先在墙上做了测试。”

paras.en: “Gustave Fayet: Collector-Designer” will be on view at Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris until March 8, 2027.
paras.zh: “Gustave Fayet：收藏家设计师”将于 2027 年 3 月 8 日在巴黎路易威登基金会展出。

articles.title: Looted by Nazis and Recently Restituted, a Kaleidoscopic Kandinsky Painting Just Sold for Nearly $42 Million

paras.en: A 1907 painting by Russian artist Wassily Kandinsky was stolen by the Nazis during World War II and spent half a century hanging in a German museum before its restitution to its original owners’ heirs in 2023. Now, the painting titled Das bunte Leben, or The Colorful Life, has sold at auction for about $42 million.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯艺术家瓦西里·康定斯基 (Wassily Kandinsky) 的一幅 1907 年画作在二战期间被纳粹偷走，在一家德国博物馆里挂了半个世纪，然后于 2023 年归还给原主人的继承人。现在，这幅名为 Das Bunte Leben（即《多彩生活》）的画作已在拍卖会上以约 4200 万美元的价格售出。

paras.en: During Christie’s 20th/21st Century: London Evening Sale earlier this month, auctioneer Adrien Meyer introduced the painting as “the most important early work by the artist to ever come to auction,” Daniel Cassady and Hikmat Mohammed report for ARTnews.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，在佳士得 20 世纪/21 世纪：伦敦晚拍期间，拍卖师阿德里安·迈耶 (Adrien Meyer) 介绍说，这幅画是“拍卖会上艺术家最重要的早期作品”，丹尼尔·卡萨迪 (Daniel Cassady) 和希克马特·穆罕默德 (Hikmat Mohammed) 向 ARTnews 报道。

paras.en: Over six tense minutes, bids flooded the packed saleroom and telephone banks. The final price went far past the painting’s pre-sale high estimate of $33 million. The auction house did not disclose the buyer’s identity, per the New York Times’ Claire Moses.
paras.zh: 在紧张的六分钟内，拍卖室和电话银行里挤满了竞标者。最终成交价远远超过了这幅画预售时3300万美元的最高估价。据《纽约时报》的克莱尔·摩西报道，拍卖行没有透露买家的身份。

paras.en: Kandinsky completed the painting during a stay in Paris with his partner, the German painter Gabriele Münter. Measuring over five feet wide, Das bunte Leben was his largest painting at the time of its creation. Influenced by both French Fauvism and traditional Russian folklore, Kandinsky said he wanted to “let the viewer take a stroll within the picture” and “become absorbed” in it, according to the Christie’s website.
paras.zh: 康定斯基在巴黎与他的搭档、德国画家加布里埃莱·穆特一起完成了这幅画。 《Das Bunte Leben》宽超过五英尺，是他创作时最大的画作。据佳士得网站介绍，受到法国野兽派和俄罗斯传统民间传说的影响，康定斯基表示他希望“让观众在画中漫步”并“全神贯注”。

paras.en: Against a dark background, Kandinsky’s luminous pigments depict an assortment of wanderers, monks and revelers, including an elderly traveler whose beard glows mint green and lovers embracing, oblivious to a distant funeral procession.
paras.zh: 在黑暗的背景下，康定斯基的发光颜料描绘了各种各样的流浪者、僧侣和狂欢者，其中包括一位胡须泛着薄荷绿光芒的老年旅行者和拥抱的恋人，他们没有注意到远处的送葬队伍。

paras.en: “This is an iconic piece,” art dealer Daniella Luxembourg told the Guardian’s Holly Watt in 2017. “He painted this at a key point in his life, just before he moved to pure abstract works. It is one of his most important works.”
paras.zh: “这是一件标志性的作品，”艺术品经销商丹妮拉·卢森堡 (Daniella Luxembourg) 2017 年告诉《卫报》的霍莉·瓦特 (Holly Watt)。“他在人生的一个关键时刻画了这幅作品，就在他转向纯抽象作品之前。这是他最重要的作品之一。”

paras.en: In the 1920s, the masterpiece entered the private collection of Emanuel Lewenstein, a Dutch Jewish industrialist, and his wife, Hedwig Lewenstein-Weyermann. Following Lewenstein’s death in 1930, Lewenstein-Weyermann loaned the piece to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam for safekeeping. After her death in 1937, the couple’s art collection passed to their adult children, who in turn fled Europe amid the rise of Nazism.
paras.zh: 20 年代，这幅杰作被荷兰犹太实业家伊曼纽尔·莱文斯坦 (Emanuel Lewenstein) 和他的妻子海德薇格·莱文斯坦-魏尔曼 (Hedwig Lewenstein-Weyermann) 私人收藏。 1930 年 Lewenstein 去世后，Lewenstein-Weyermann 将这件作品借给阿姆斯特丹市立博物馆保管。 1937 年她去世后，这对夫妇的艺术收藏传给了他们的成年子女，他们在纳粹主义兴起时逃离了欧洲。

paras.en: In May 1940, Nazi troops invaded the Netherlands. Just five months later, works from the Lewenstein collection were auctioned off in Amsterdam. Das bunte Leben went under the hammer for a meager 250 Dutch guilders, roughly 10 to 20 percent of its market value at the time, per the Guardian. The family never authorized the transaction, nor did they receive any proceeds.
paras.zh: 1940年5月，纳粹军队入侵荷兰。仅仅五个月后，莱文斯坦收藏的作品在阿姆斯特丹拍卖。据《卫报》报道，《Das Bunte Leben》以微薄的 250 荷兰盾成交，大约相当于其当时市场价值的 10% 至 20%。该家族从未授权该交易，也没有收到任何收益。

paras.en: - Among the figures in Das bunte Leben is an armored knight on horseback, inspired by Russian folk epics.
paras.zh: - 《Das Bunte Leben》中的人物中有一位骑在马背上的铠甲骑士，其灵感来自俄罗斯民间史诗。

paras.en: - Kandinsky transformed the motif into the official emblem of Der Blaue Reiter, the pioneering expressionist group he helped established in 1911.
paras.zh: - 康定斯基将这一图案转变为“蓝骑士”的官方标志，这是他于 1911 年帮助建立的先锋表现主义团体。

paras.en: After changing hands privately, the canvas was eventually purchased in 1972 by the German bank Bayern LB and placed on long-term loan at the Lenbachhaus museum in Munich, where it hung for nearly fifty years.
paras.zh: 在私下转手后，这幅画布最终于 1972 年被德国拜仁 LB 银行购买，并长期租借于慕尼黑的伦巴赫豪斯博物馆 (Lenbachhaus Museum)，并在那里悬挂了近 50 年。

paras.en: The Lewenstein descendants waged a decades-long campaign to recover the work, filing a lawsuit against the bank in 2017. The legal impasse finally broke in 2023, when Germany’s advisory commission on Nazi-looted art recommended that the painting should be returned to the family. The government panel affirmed that “there are numerous indications that this was a case of a seizure as a result of Nazi persecution,” the New York Times’ Catherine Hickley reported in 2023.
paras.zh: 莱文斯坦的后裔发起了长达数十年的追回这幅画作的运动，并于 2017 年对银行提起诉讼。法律僵局最终在 2023 年打破，当时德国纳粹掠夺艺术品咨询委员会建议将这幅画归还给莱文斯坦家族。 《纽约时报》的凯瑟琳·希克利 (Catherine Hickley) 在 2023 年报道称，政府小组确认，“有大量迹象表明这是一起因纳粹迫害而导致的扣押案件”。

paras.en: While Das bunte Leben did not surpass Kandinsky’s all-time auction high—set in 2023, when Murnau With Church II sold for $45 million at Sotheby’s—the sale brought a triumphant close to a family’s multi-generational pursuit of justice.
paras.zh: 虽然《生活的美好》并没有超越康定斯基在 2023 年创下的拍卖纪录，当时《穆瑙与教堂 II》在苏富比拍卖行以 4500 万美元的价格售出，但这次拍卖为一个家族几代人对正义的追求画上了圆满的句号。

paras.en: “The restitution of Das bunte Leben … represents an important moment in the painting’s history,” Marc Porter, the chairman of Christie’s Americas, says in a statement. “Its return to the market marks the beginning of a new chapter for a work that holds such a significant place in modern art.”
paras.zh: “《Das Bunte Leben》的归还……代表了这幅画历史上的一个重要时刻，”佳士得美洲区主席马克·波特 (Marc Porter) 在一份声明中表示。 “它重返市场标志着这件在现代艺术中占有如此重要地位的作品开启了新篇章。”

articles.title: Google Workspace Promo Codes: 14% Off for October 2026
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: Google Workspace is that ubiquitous modern business tool that almost feels invisible. We use it every day here at WIRED, whether that's for writing first drafts of articles in Docs, analyzing data in Sheets, or sharing files in Drive. And recently, I've been using the Gemini AI implementation that's built right into these tools, which is handy in all sorts of ways.
paras.zh: Google Workspace 是一种无处不在、几乎看不见的现代商业工具。我们每天在《连线》杂志上都使用它，无论是在文档中撰写文章初稿、在表格中分析数据，还是在云端硬盘中共享文件。最近，我一直在使用内置于这些工具中的 Gemini AI 实现，它在各个方面都很方便。

paras.en: Google Workspace grants access to all kinds of productivity features that can help streamline processes and increase communication within a team or organization. It's not free, but here's the good news: If you're looking at a Workspace account for yourself (or for your team), Google is offering discounts until the end of 2026 using one of the Google Workspace coupon codes below. You can save up to 14 percent on plans for the first three months, whether you're signing up as an individual or as a business. Either way, the Google Workspace promo code down below is what you want to use.
paras.zh: Google Workspace 允许使用各种生产力功能，这些功能有助于简化流程并加强团队或组织内的沟通。它不是免费的，但有个好消息：如果您正在为自己（或您的团队）寻找 Workspace 帐号，Google 将在 2026 年底之前使用下面的 Google Workspace 优惠券代码之一提供折扣。无论您是以个人还是企业身份注册，前三个月的计划均可节省高达 14% 的费用。无论哪种方式，您都可以使用下面的 Google Workspace 促销代码。

paras.en: Save up to 14% Off These Google Workspace Promo Codes 2026
paras.zh: 这些 2026 年 Google Workspace 促销代码可节省高达 14% 的费用

paras.en: There are some notable differences between each Workspace plan – I’ll dig into them in the next section – but all three plans come with access to the full slate of Workspace apps. You get Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Meet, of course, but even the cheapest Starter plan includes basic access to Google’s other apps, such as NotebookLM and Gemini inside the Workspace suite. If you want to save, make sure to click one of the promo codes at the top of this page to secure your discount.
paras.zh: 每个 Workspace 计划之间都有一些显着的差异 - 我将在下一节中深入研究它们 - 但所有三个计划都可以访问完整的 Workspace 应用程序。当然，你可以使用 Gmail、Drive、Calendar 和 Meet，但即使是最便宜的 Starter 套餐也包含对 Google 其他应用程序的基本访问权限，例如 Workspace 套件中的 NotebookLM 和 Gemini。如果您想保存，请务必点击本页顶部的促销代码之一以确保您的折扣。

paras.en: Google offers four different Workspace plans, though only three are relevant for most people. There’s Starter, Standard, and Plus, as well as Enterprise, which is only available if you contact Google’s sales team. There isn’t a minimum number of users on any of the plans, but the bottom three options (Starter, Standard, and Plus) support up to 300 users. If you need more than that, you’ll need an Enterprise plan.
paras.zh: 谷歌提供了四种不同的工作空间计划，但只有三种与大多数人相关。有 Starter、Standard 和 Plus，以及 Enterprise，只有联系 Google 的销售团队才能使用。任何计划都没有最低用户数量限制，但底部的三个选项（Starter、Standard 和 Plus）最多支持 300 个用户。如果您需要更多，则需要企业计划。

paras.en: Although you have access to all the apps regardless of the plan you choose, there are some important differences, particularly between the Starter and Standard plans. Both include secure storage through Google Drive, but Starter comes with 30GB per user while Standard comes with a massive 2TB per user. Plus bumps that up to 5TB per user. Across all plans, storage is in a shared pool, so each additional user adds to the total pool of storage your organization can use.
paras.zh: 尽管无论您选择哪种计划，您都可以访问所有应用程序，但仍存在一些重要差异，特别是在入门计划和标准计划之间。两者都包括通过 Google Drive 的安全存储，但 Starter 为每个用户提供 30GB，而 Standard 为每个用户提供 2TB 的海量存储空间。另外，每个用户的存储容量高达 5TB。在所有计划中，存储都位于共享池中，因此每个额外的用户都会添加到您的组织可以使用的总存储池中。

paras.en: Gemini is also a big difference between Starter and Standard. Although both have access to the Gemini app, Starter only has Gemini in Gmail and Vids. Standard (and Plus) includes Gemini across the full suite, including in Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Meet, and Chat.
paras.zh: Gemini也是Starter和Standard之间的一个很大的区别。虽然两者都可以访问 Gemini 应用程序，但 Starter 仅在 Gmail 和 Vids 中具有 Gemini。标准版（和增强版）包括整个套件中的 Gemini，包括文档、表格、幻灯片、云端硬盘、会议和聊天。

paras.en: Starter is a great option for anyone just getting started, regardless of whether you’re a freelancer or a small business with a handful of employees. In addition to 30GB per user and limited access to Gemini, Starter comes with a few other limitations. It doesn’t support e-signatures in Docs, nor advanced features of Meet, such as noise cancellation. The bread and butter of Workspace is all here, though. You get a custom domain in Gmail, up to 100 participants in Meet, and the full Google suite of productivity apps.
paras.zh: 对于任何刚刚起步的人来说，Starter 都是一个不错的选择，无论您是自由职业者还是拥有少数员工的小型企业。除了每个用户 30GB 和对 Gemini 的访问受限之外，Starter 还存在一些其他限制。它不支持文档中的电子签名，也不支持 Meet 的高级功能，例如噪音消除。不过，Workspace 的主要功能都在这里。您可以在 Gmail 中获得自定义域，在 Meet 中获得最多 100 名参与者，以及全套 Google 生产力应用程序套件。

paras.en: Standard, as the name suggests, is Workspace proper, and it’s built for teams that need room to grow. That shows up most clearly in storage space, jumping from 30GB to 2TB per user. Standard basically cuts all the red tape on Starter. There aren’t any limitations on Gemini (it’s available across the full suite), Meet features like noise cancellation are available, and you can host up to 150 participants in a Meet call. Standard even comes with expanded access to NotebookLM, Google’s AI-driven note and research tool, with different chat modes and up to 20 generative audio overviews per day.
paras.zh: 标准，顾名思义，就是工作空间，它是为需要成长空间的团队而构建的。这在存储空间上表现得最为明显，每个用户的存储空间从 30GB 跃升至 2TB。 Standard 基本上消除了 Starter 上的所有繁文缛节。 Gemini 没有任何限制（整个套件均可用），可以使用降噪等 Meet 功能，并且您可以在 Meet 通话中主持最多 150 名参与者。标准版甚至还可以扩展对 NotebookLM（Google 人工智能驱动的笔记和研究工具）的访问，具有不同的聊天模式和每天最多 20 个生成音频概述。

paras.en: At the top of the range is Plus, which is focused on larger businesses. You don’t get any extra apps with this plan, but you do get 5TB of storage per user, along with up to 500 participants in Meet calls. The real reason to upgrade to Plus is security and admin controls, however. It includes Vault for data retention, along with LDAP access—basically a server for centralized account management, if you aren’t familiar.
paras.zh: 该系列中的顶级产品是 Plus，它专注于大型企业。通过此计划，您不会获得任何额外的应用程序，但每个用户可以获得 5TB 的存储空间，以及最多 500 名 Meet 通话参与者。然而，升级到 Plus 的真正原因是安全性和管理控制。它包括用于数据保留的 Vault 以及 LDAP 访问——如果您不熟悉的话，它基本上是一个用于集中帐户管理的服务器。

paras.en: Most people should use the Standard plan, not only for the large amount of storage space over Starter, but also due to the extra Gemini functionality. If you need to upgrade to Plus down the line, you can. And, more than likely, you’ll have a member of your IT team begging you to do so.
paras.zh: 大多数人应该使用标准计划，不仅因为 Starter 拥有大量存储空间，而且还因为额外的 Gemini 功能。如果您需要升级到 Plus，也可以。而且，很可能您的 IT 团队成员会恳求您这样做。

paras.en: Why Teams Love Using Google Workspace Flows with Google Workspace
paras.zh: 为什么团队喜欢将 Google Workspace Flows 与 Google Workspace 结合使用

paras.en: Google has updated Workspace a lot over the past several months, building in new functionalities via Gemini throughout the suite. But earlier this year, Google announced that it’s bringing all of those functionalities together through Workspace Flows. It’s a no-code automation tool that lets you build automatic workflows; i.e., update a Sheet when there’s a new email in Gmail from a particular address. The interesting thing about Flows, however, is that Gemini is built into it.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，谷歌对 Workspace 进行了多次更新，通过 Gemini 在整个套件中构建了新功能。但今年早些时候，谷歌宣布将通过 Workspace Flows 将所有这些功能整合在一起。它是一个无代码自动化工具，可让您构建自动工作流程；即，当 Gmail 中有来自特定地址的新电子邮件时更新工作表。然而，Flows 的有趣之处在于，Gemini 内置于其中。

paras.en: You can set up basic automations, which is great given how interconnected Google’s Workspace apps already are, but Flows become powerful when you throw Gems into the mix. Gems are AI agents built with Gemini, and you can create them with specific parameters.
paras.zh: 您可以设置基本的自动化，考虑到 Google 的 Workspace 应用程序已经相互关联，这非常好，但是当您将 Gems 加入其中时，Flows 就会变得强大。 Gems 是用 Gemini 构建的 AI 代理，您可以使用特定参数创建它们。

paras.en: Let me give you an example. Say you need a marketing plan, and an employee sends you a draft. You can have a workflow set up with a Gem that’s been trained on the budget, requirements, and tone of the campaign to quickly know if it can be approved or not. Or, you can create a Gem to scan your email, trained on your organization chart and role responsibilities, to notify you whenever you receive an email that has action items for you.
paras.zh: 让我举个例子。假设您需要一份营销计划，一名员工向您发送了一份草稿。您可以使用 Gem 设置工作流程，该 Gem 已接受过预算、要求和营销活动基调方面的培训，以便快速了解是否可以获得批准。或者，您可以创建一个 Gem 来扫描您的电子邮件，并根据您的组织结构图和角色职责进行培训，以便在您收到包含您的操作项目的电子邮件时通知您。

paras.en: Flows give you a way to add a bit of context and reasoning to the often rigid constraints of simple automation systems, and they can save you a lot of time in the process. You may be able to gather customer feedback and put it into Sheets easily, for example, but Gemini can automatically sort, summarize, and categorize that feedback so you know what you should tackle first. Flows are centralized in Workspace, as well; you don’t need to install add-ons or configure anything outside of setting up your Workspace account.
paras.zh: 流程为您提供了一种为简单自动化系统通常严格的约束添加一些上下文和推理的方法，并且它们可以在此过程中为您节省大量时间。例如，您可以轻松收集客户反馈并将其放入表格中，但 Gemini 可以自动对反馈进行排序、总结和分类，以便您知道应该首先解决什么问题。流程也集中在工作区中；除了设置 Workspace 帐户之外，您无需安装附加组件或配置任何内容。

paras.en: Google Workspace Flows is a new tool integrated with Google Workspace. It is powered by Google’s Gemini AI and helps you get tasks done with Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Chat. It can fix up emails, make plans, correct sheets, or write a follow-up message. No apps or links are needed.
paras.zh: Google Workspace Flows 是与 Google Workspace 集成的新工具。它由 Google 的 Gemini AI 提供支持，可帮助您通过 Gmail、文档、表格、日历和聊天完成任务。它可以修复电子邮件、制定计划、更正表格或撰写后续消息。不需要应用程序或链接。

paras.en: Does Google Workspace Offer a Free Trial?
paras.zh: Google Workspace 提供免费试用吗？

articles.title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
articles.author: Joel Khalili
