paras.en: In a few days, judge Geoffrey Vos will retire as Master of the Rolls, the most senior position in England’s civil justice system. As one of his final acts, he’s trying to stoke a debate about whether—and how—judges should be using artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 几天后，杰弗里·沃斯法官将以“审判长”的身份退休，这是英格兰民事司法系统中最高级别的职位。作为他最后的行动之一，他试图引发一场关于法官是否应该以及如何使用人工智能的辩论。

paras.en: Under the latest guidance, judges in England are advised to confine their use of AI to administrative tasks, and Vos tells WIRED he uses Microsoft Copilot all the time to locate far-flung documents and summarize large bodies of text. But recently, he visited a court in Shenzhen, China, where civil disputes are already being decided by judges with heavy assistance from AI. Impressed by what he saw, Vos believes that courts across the globe should consider following.
paras.zh: 根据最新的指导意见，英国法官被建议将人工智能的使用仅限于行政任务，沃斯告诉《连线》杂志，他一直使用微软 Copilot 来定位遥远的文档并总结大量文本。但最近，他参观了中国深圳的一家法院，那里的民事纠纷已经由法官在人工智能的大力协助下做出裁决。沃斯对他所看到的印象深刻，他认为全球法院应该考虑效仿。

paras.en: That road is littered with pitfalls. Multiple lawyers have been caught citing case law hallucinated by AI, and in a first for the UK, somebody recently lost their license to practice in part because they misused the technology. Meanwhile, with chatbots as their legal counsel, litigants are flooding the courts with an unprecedented number of claims, some of them bogus.
paras.zh: 这条路充满了陷阱。多名律师因援引人工智能幻觉的判例法而被捕，最近有人因滥用该技术而失去了执业执照，这在英国尚属首次。与此同时，在聊天机器人作为法律顾问的情况下，诉讼当事人向法院提出了数量空前的索赔要求，其中一些索赔是伪造的。

paras.en: Yet Vos remains convinced that AI will someday help resolve civil disputes more rapidly and in ways that cost far less. While complicated commercial disputes and sensitive family cases might require a human judge, he believes that personal injury claims, low-value professional negligence cases, and the like could easily be adjudicated by AI.
paras.zh: 然而，沃斯仍然坚信，人工智能有一天将帮助更快地解决民事纠纷，而且成本要低得多。虽然复杂的商业纠纷和敏感的家庭案件可能需要人类法官，但他认为人身伤害索赔、低价值的职业过失案件等可以很容易地由人工智能来裁决。

paras.en: “What most people desperately want in civil disputes is resolution,” Vos tells WIRED. “The question is, where is the line to be drawn?”
paras.zh: “大多数人在民事纠纷中迫切希望得到解决，”沃斯告诉《连线》杂志。 “问题是，界限在哪里？”

paras.en: Given his impending retirement, the debate for Vos is largely a philosophical one. But for everyone else in the profession—and for coders, cybersecurity experts, math professors, and a whole host of others—the rules are changing fast.
paras.zh: 鉴于沃斯即将退休，关于他的争论主要是一场哲学争论。但对于这个行业的其他人——以及程序员、网络安全专家、数学教授和其他许多人来说——规则正在快速变化。

paras.en: In October, WIRED met with Vos at his office at the Royal Courts of Justice, London. We discussed the ways that AI is spilling into the courts, the practical and ethical issues it raises, and how the justice system might adapt to serve a new generation raised alongside the technology.
paras.zh: 10 月，《连线》杂志在沃斯位于伦敦皇家法院的办公室会见了他。我们讨论了人工智能渗透到法院的方式、它引发的实际和道德问题，以及司法系统如何适应服务与技术一起成长的新一代。

paras.en: This conversation has been edited for length and clarity.
paras.zh: 为了篇幅和清晰度，本次对话已被编辑。

paras.en: WIRED: You’re just a few days away from retirement. How do you feel about leaving the post at this particular juncture, as AI begins to reshape how law is practiced and justice administered?
paras.zh: 连线：你距离退休只有几天了。当人工智能开始重塑法律的实施和司法的执行方式时，您对在这个特定时刻离职有何感想？

paras.en: GEOFFREY VOS: When I started as a lawyer, we had foolscap paper, typists, and Tipp-Ex. We moved rapidly into word processors, faxes, and eventually computers.
paras.zh: GEOFFREY VOS：当我开始担任律师时，我们有傻瓜纸、打字员和 Tipp-Ex。我们迅速转向文字处理机、传真机，最终进入计算机领域。

paras.en: Lawyers are conservative with a lowercase c. But that doesn’t mean that they should be backward-looking or retrogressive. It means they should be adopting change cautiously, with their eyes open.
paras.zh: 律师是保守派，用小写的c。但这并不意味着他们应该向后看或倒退。这意味着他们应该睁大眼睛谨慎地采取变革。

paras.en: The legal system is for the people of this country. You can’t be effective in providing access to justice if you’re not on the same technological wavelength. But it’s time to leave it to a new generation of leadership judges.
paras.zh: 法律制度是为这个国家的人民服务的。如果你们不在同一技术波长上，就无法有效地提供诉诸司法的机会。但现在是时候把它留给新一代的领导力评判者了。

paras.en: How have you built AI into your practice to date?
paras.zh: 迄今为止，您是如何将人工智能融入到您的实践中的？

paras.en: I don’t use it for writing judgments, but I use it for finding things out, navigating large quantities of material, and checking things. It saves me time. I have 11 meetings a day. I know there’s a document created years ago that’s relevant to my meeting—and Copilot finds it in seconds. I do that every day.
paras.zh: 我不会用它来写判断，但我用它来找出问题、浏览大量材料和检查事情。它节省了我的时间。我每天有 11 个会议。我知道有一份多年前创建的文档与我的会议相关，Copilot 在几秒钟内就找到了它。我每天都这样做。

paras.en: In law, isn’t the devil always in the details? Doesn’t confidence in the legal system depend on the understanding that a judge will review and consider every inch of every court submission?
paras.zh: 在法律上，魔鬼不总是存在于细节之中吗？对法律制度的信心难道不取决于法官会审查和考虑法庭提交的每一份材料的理解吗？

paras.en: I’m a little more cautious about using it to read papers for my cases, but that’s because I do the most important cases in the system.
paras.zh: 我对于用它来阅读我的案例论文更加谨慎，但那是因为我处理的是系统中最重要的案例。

paras.en: People have confidence in our justice system because they believe that our judges have absolute integrity. In order not to lose that integrity, you have to explain how you’re adopting technology and achieve a broad consensus that it is appropriate.
paras.zh: 人们对我们的司法系统充满信心，因为他们相信我们的法官绝对正直。为了不失去这种完整性，您必须解释您如何采用技术并就其适当性达成广泛共识。

paras.en: How is AI spilling into the courts right now? Is it changing how litigants and legal professionals behave? What issues is it throwing up?
paras.zh: 人工智能现在如何渗透到法庭？它是否改变了诉讼当事人和法律专业人士的行为方式？它抛出了什么问题？

paras.en: It’s changing everything remarkably quickly. We see a 10 percent rise in the number of county court cases started every year—and it looks as if this may increase. That’s because everybody who has a legal problem now puts it into Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude. Ask it to create a particulars of claim, a case, a claim form—it can.
paras.zh: 它正在以惊人的速度改变一切。我们发现县法院立案的案件数量每年增加 10%，而且这一数字似乎还会增加。那是因为现在每个遇到法律问题的人都会将其放入 Gemini、ChatGPT 或 Claude 中。要求它创建索赔细节、案件、索赔表——它可以。

paras.en: What proportion of these claims are based on sound legal principles, though? How often are people led by a chatbot to mistakenly believe they have a claim?
paras.zh: 然而，这些主张中有多少是基于合理的法律原则的呢？人们有多少次被聊天机器人错误地认为自己有索赔？

paras.en: We don’t have the data. But I think it’s a mistake to assume that just because a claim is created by AI, it’s totally frivolous.
paras.zh: 我们没有数据。但我认为，仅仅因为某个声明是由人工智能创建的，就认为它是完全无意义的，这是错误的。

paras.en: In a way it’s a good problem, because it shows there’s greater access to justice because of technology. One of the problems with justice in the past is that it’s only been available to rich people.
paras.zh: 在某种程度上，这是一个好问题，因为它表明由于技术的存在，人们有更多机会诉诸司法。过去正义的问题之一是它只适用于富人。

paras.en: If people have a problem sufficient to bother ChatGPT, they probably genuinely think they have a claim. When you explore their problem in detail, you might find it is actually a bit different, but it may still be a legal problem and may still be reasonable for them to have wanted to bring it to attention.
paras.zh: 如果人们遇到足以困扰 ChatGPT 的问题，他们可能真的认为自己有权利主张。当你详细探讨他们的问题时，你可能会发现它实际上有点不同，但这可能仍然是一个法律问题，并且他们想要引起人们的注意可能仍然是合理的。

paras.en: People are not generally time wasters. They’re not generally trying to make trouble.
paras.zh: 人们通常不会浪费时间。他们一般不会想惹麻烦。

paras.en: What about the opportunity for AI to fabricate evidence on which judges have previously been able to rely—images, video, voice recordings? Where does that leave the courts?
paras.zh: 人工智能是否有机会伪造法官以前可以依赖的证据——图像、视频、录音？法院会怎样处理呢？

paras.en: Often, judges have to decide whether a person is telling the truth. That is the most difficult thing to do, because humans are not bad at lying. But judges make these decisions every day. There’s absolutely no difference—in scale or qualitatively—in somebody producing a false image created by AI.
paras.zh: 通常，法官必须决定一个人是否说真话。这是最难做到的事情，因为人类并不擅长撒谎。但法官每天都会做出这些决定。制作由人工智能创建的虚假图像的人在规模上或质量上绝对没有区别。

paras.en: The only reason we’re all getting so excited about deepfakes is because they are so new. But actually, that is the stuff of judging.
paras.zh: 我们对深度造假如此兴奋的唯一原因是它们太新了。但实际上，这就是判断的内容。

paras.en: But we’re talking about a whole category of evidence that’s now somewhat compromised. Doesn’t that affect a judge’s ability to decide whether somebody is lying?
paras.zh: 但我们正在谈论的一整类证据现在都受到了一定程度的损害。这不会影响法官判定某人是否撒谎的能力吗？

paras.en: It was always thus. We always had to decide whether wills were forged, because people used to do that. It’s exactly the same with voice recordings, and video. It’s just an extension of the type of false information that is produced to the court.
paras.zh: 一直都是这样。我们总是必须决定遗嘱是否是伪造的，因为人们过去常常这样做。录音和视频也是如此。这只是向法庭提供的虚假信息类型的延伸。

paras.en: People will find out when they produce fake images to the court that they are committing perjury and they will go to prison, just as if they’d forged a will.
paras.zh: 人们会发现，当他们向法庭出示虚假图像时，他们正在作伪证，他们会入狱，就像他们伪造了一份遗嘱一样。

paras.en: I think we need to be cautious about predicting disaster. I’m very optimistic.
paras.zh: 我认为我们在预测灾难时需要谨慎。我很乐观。

paras.en: You’ve previously described an “inevitable” future where simpler civil cases are adjudicated entirely by AI. Why are you confident that’s where we’re headed?
paras.zh: 您之前曾描述过“不可避免”的未来，即更简单的民事案件完全由人工智能来裁决。您为何确信这就是我们的发展方向？

paras.en: You need to find a way to deliver justice that is within the cultural grain. That doesn’t mean you just conduct all your cases on TikTok. But if you don’t understand that people are asking LLMs for the answer to almost every question under the sun, including legal questions, you’re likely to get it wrong when you try to devise a process fit for the 21st century.
paras.zh: 你需要找到一种在文化范围内伸张正义的方法。这并不意味着您只需在 TikTok 上处理所有案件。但如果你不明白人们向法学硕士寻求几乎所有问题的答案，包括法律问题，那么当你试图设计适合 21 世纪的流程时，你很可能会出错。

paras.en: It’s all about consensus. It will only be possible to ask people to accept algorithmic decision-making if they consent to the process in a particular case, or if society decides through legislation.
paras.zh: 这一切都与共识有关。只有当人们同意特定情况下的流程，或者社会通过立法做出决定时，才有可能要求人们接受算法决策。

paras.en: When people go to court and get an adverse outcome, even if they regard the outcome as idiosyncratic or even wrong, when it’s delivered in a human way, it can be accepted over time. With AI, we have to be careful; it may be less easy for people to accept an adverse machine-driven decision.
paras.zh: 当人们上法庭并得到不利的结果时，即使他们认为结果是特殊的甚至是错误的，但当它以人性化的方式交付时，随着时间的推移，它可以被接受。对于人工智能，我们必须小心；人们可能不太容易接受机器驱动的不利决策。

paras.en: I very much want to see a very open, international discussion about how we should resolve disputes.
paras.zh: 我非常希望看到关于我们应该如何解决争端的非常开放的国际讨论。

paras.en: I suspect part of the reason people object to trial by AI is because we can’t know precisely how a model has arrived at a decision. What’s to be done about this problem of explainability?
paras.zh: 我怀疑人们反对人工智能审判的部分原因是我们无法准确地知道模型是如何做出决定的。对于这个可解释性问题该怎么办？

paras.en: I don’t think it’s about reasoning; it’s about outcomes. The AI can produce very plausible reasoning. You can’t see how it produced that reasoning, but you can see the reasoning it produced, and you can judge the plausibility.
paras.zh: 我不认为这与推理有关；而是与推理有关。这是关于结果的。人工智能可以产生非常合理的推理。你看不到它是如何产生这个推理的，但是你可以看到它产生的推理，并且你可以判断其合理性。

paras.en: I don’t think you’ll ever do away with human judges. There’s something almost biblical about the human judge; it’s in the human psyche to want to be judged by their fellow man. But that does not mean that in some situations people wouldn’t rather have a quick outcome—even if it’s not a human outcome.
paras.zh: 我认为你永远不会废除人类法官。关于人类法官，有一些几乎符合圣经的东西；希望被同胞评判是人类的心理。但这并不意味着在某些情况下，人们不愿意快速得到结果——即使这不是人为的结果。

paras.en: I don’t think judges are yet in the position to say. It’s a question for society, politicians, and legislation to resolve. That debate is really important.
paras.zh: 我认为法官还没有资格做出决定。这是社会、政治家和立法需要解决的问题。这场辩论非常重要。

paras.en: I think that custody and family cases are one of the areas where essentially human judgment is expected, even by the younger generation. In complex commercial cases, I think that’s also the case. But I think we will whittle away at how commercial cases are decided by using AI to collate information to make the decision-making process better and easier.
paras.zh: 我认为监护权和家庭案件是基本上需要人类判断的领域之一，即使是年轻一代也是如此。在复杂的商业案件中，我想也是如此。但我认为我们将通过使用人工智能来整理信息来削弱商业案件的决策方式，从而使决策过程变得更好、更容易。

paras.en: We will allow more people access to justice more cheaply and more quickly using technology. That will be an overall good for the economy and for the people we serve.
paras.zh: 我们将利用技术让更多的人以更便宜、更快速的方式诉诸司法。这对经济和我们服务的人民​​来说总体上是有利的。

articles.title: DOJ sues Maryland school district over preferred names, pronouns

paras.en: Oct. 27 (UPI) -- The Justice Department is suing a Maryland school district, accusing it of violating federal laws governing parental rights by enforcing policies that permit staff to use students' preferred pronouns and names without their parents' knowledge, amid the Trump administration's broader efforts to restrict transgender rights.
paras.zh: 10 月 27 日（UPI）——司法部正在起诉马里兰州的一个学区，指控该学区在特朗普政府更广泛地限制变性人权利的情况下，执行允许工作人员在家长不知情的情况下使用学生喜欢的代词和名字的政策，违反了有关父母权利的联邦法律。

paras.en: The eight-count lawsuit filed Tuesday in the United States District Court for the District of Maryland specifically accuses Anne Arundel County Public Schools of violating the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act and the Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment.
paras.zh: 周二向美国马里兰州地区法院提起的八项诉讼特别指控安妮阿伦德尔县公立学校违反《家庭教育权利和隐私法》以及《学生权利保护修正案》。

paras.en: The lawsuit largely centers on a single student, identified in the complaint as Mary Doe, who asked school staff to refer to them by a male name that the document does not disclose.
paras.zh: 这起诉讼主要集中在一名学生身上，该学生在起诉书中被确认为玛丽·多伊(Mary Doe)，她要求学校工作人员用男性名字来称呼他们，但文件没有透露这一点。

paras.en: Federal lawyers allege that the school violated FERPA by disclosing Mary Doe's preferred name without her parents' consent in a field-trip roster emailed to other parents in May 2026. They also allege the district violated FERPA when it denied Mary's parents access to internal staff communications and other documents concerning their child's preferred name and pronouns, and denied them an opportunity to challenge such records. The federal lawyers, however, acknowledge in the complaint that Mary's official school records continued to reflect her legal name and birth gender.
paras.zh: 联邦律师声称，学校未经玛丽·多伊父母同意，在 2026 年 5 月通过电子邮件发送给其他家长的实地考察花名册中披露了玛丽·多伊的首选姓名，从而违反了《家庭教育权和隐私法案》。他们还指控，学区拒绝玛丽的父母查阅内部员工通讯和有关孩子首选姓名和代词的其他文件，并拒绝他们质疑此类记录的机会，从而违反了《家庭教育权和隐私法》。然而，联邦律师在诉状中承认，玛丽的官方学校记录继续反映她的法定姓名和出生性别。

paras.en: The school district is also accused of violating PPRA after a staff member individually asked each student, including Mary, for their preferred names and held one-on-one discussions about preferred pronouns without parental involvement. The federal lawyers also allege that these lines of questioning involving legally protected sensitive information require prior written parental consent or, at a minimum, advance parental notification and an opportunity to opt out, which they say the school district did not provide Mary's parents.
paras.zh: 该学区还被指控违反 PPRA，因为一名工作人员单独询问包括玛丽在内的每个学生的首选名字，并在没有家长参与的情况下就首选代词进行了一对一的讨论。联邦律师还声称，这些涉及受法律保护的敏感信息的询问需要事先获得家长的书面同意，或者至少需要提前通知家长并有选择退出的机会，他们说学区没有向玛丽的父母提供选择退出的机会。

paras.en: The remaining three counts concern broader district policies, including allegedly disclosing personally identifiable student gender information to Maryland education authorities without parental consent, failing to provide parents with opportunities to challenge gender-related education records and restricting parental access to education records.
paras.zh: 其余三项罪名涉及更广泛的学区政策，包括据称未经家长同意向马里兰州教育当局披露个人可识别的学生性别信息、未能向家长提供质疑与性别相关的教育记录的机会以及限制家长获取教育记录。

paras.en: "Schools should not discuss preferred pronouns or 'gender identity' with a student without parental notification and consent," Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division said in a statement.
paras.zh: “未经家长通知和同意，学校不应与学生讨论首选代词或‘性别认同’，”司法部民权部门助理总检察长哈米特·迪隆(Harmeet Dhillon)在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: "Parents should not be lied to, stonewalled or branded as 'safety concerns' when they ask to see the education records that reveal what schools are secretly doing to their children."
paras.zh: “当家长要求查看揭露学校秘密对孩子做了什么的教育记录时，他们不应该被欺骗、阻挠或被贴上‘安全问题’的标签。”

paras.en: UPI has contacted the school district for comment.
paras.zh: UPI 已联系学区征求意见。

paras.en: President Donald Trump campaigned on restricting the rights of transgender Americans, and since returning to the White House, his administration has taken numerous actions targeting this minority group, from ordering federal agencies to recognize only two biological sexes while replacing the term "gender" with "sex," to restricting access to gender-affirming care, especially for minors.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在竞选时主张限制跨性别美国人的权利，自返回白宫以来，他的政府针对这一少数群体采取了许多行动，从命令联邦机构只承认两种生物性别，并用“性别”取代“性别”一词，到限制获得性别肯定护理的机会，特别是针对未成年人。

paras.en: The federal government has opened more than 10 investigations into state education agencies and county school districts concerning transgender-student policies, citing federal laws, including FERPA or PPRA. The Anne Arundel County lawsuit is the second such case filed by the Justice Department, following its first lawsuit against Kansas City and Kansas Public Schools on Sept. 1.
paras.zh: 联邦政府已援引联邦法律（包括 FERPA 或 PPRA），对州教育机构和县学区开展了 10 多项有关跨性别学生政策的调查。安妮阿伦德尔县诉讼是司法部继 9 月 1 日对堪萨斯城和堪萨斯公立学校提起第一起诉讼后提起的第二起此类案件。

paras.en: The Department of Education announced enforcement actions against Anne Arundel County Public Schools in late July after receiving complaints from parents who "discovered that the school was secretly helping their daughter pretend to be a male at school."
paras.zh: 教育部在收到家长投诉后，于 7 月下旬宣布对安妮阿伦德尔县公立学校采取执法行动，这些家长“发现学校秘密帮助他们的女儿在学校假扮成男性”。

articles.title: Rays avoid World Series sweep, edge Brewers in extra-innings Game 4

paras.en: Oct. 28 (UPI) -- Ben Williamson slammed a sinker into the dirt and over the infield for a dramatic walk-off single, completing a Game 4 rally past the Milwaukee Brewers and extending the 2026 World Series on Wednesday in St. Petersburg, Fla.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日（合众国际社）——星期三，本·威廉姆森 (Ben Williamson) 在佛罗里达州圣彼得堡将一记坠球击入泥土中，越过内场，打出一记戏剧性的离场单打，完成了第四场比赛，击败了密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers)，并延长了 2026 年世界职业棒球大赛的时间。

paras.en: Williamson's game-winning hit came in the bottom of the 12th inning of the 4-3 triumph, which started Tuesday and ended after midnight at Tropicana Field. With the win, the Rays forced a Game 5 and denied the Brewers of becoming the first team to sweep their final two best-of-seven-game series en route to a title.
paras.zh: 威廉姆森在第 12 局下半打出致胜一击，以 4-3 获胜，这场比赛于周二开始，在纯果康纳球场午夜后结束。凭借这场胜利，光芒队逼入了第五场比赛，并阻止了酿酒人队成为第一支横扫最后两场七战四胜系列赛并最终夺冠的球队。

paras.en: "It just shows the resiliency of this group," said Williamson, who was 1 for 15 this postseason before his pinch-hit, game-winning single. "We continue to fight."
paras.zh: “这只是显示了这支球队的韧性，”威廉姆森说道，他在本次季后赛中15投1中，随后打出了绝杀的绝杀单曲。 “我们继续战斗。”

paras.en: Game 5 will be held Wednesday in St. Petersburg.
paras.zh: 第五场比赛将于周三在圣彼得堡举行。

paras.en: The Brewers, who remain one win away from their first title, rallied from two deficits in Game 4. Rookie shortstop Cooper Pratt hit a go-ahead homer in the top of the 12th, but the Rays responded by reaching base safely five consecutive times to start the bottom of the inning.
paras.zh: 距离首个冠军仅差一场胜利的酿酒人队在第四场比赛中从两场落后的局面中恢复过来。新秀游击手库珀·普拉特在第 12 局上半打出一记反超本垒打，但光芒队的回应是连续五次安全上垒，开始了本局的下半局。

paras.en: Center fielder Jonny DeLuca tied the score with an RBI single. Williamson ended the game two at-bats later, plating pinch runner Nick Fortes when he hit the first pitch he saw from relief pitcher Shane Drohan to right field.
paras.zh: 中外野手乔尼·德卢卡（Jonny DeLuca）打点单打将比分追平。威廉姆森在两击球后结束了比赛，当他从后援投手肖恩·德罗汉（Shane Drohan）看到的右外野投出第一个球时，他将替补跑垒员尼克·福特斯（Nick Fortes）击中。

paras.en: "We are going to keep fighting until the end," said Rays left fielder Chandler Simpson, who went 3 for 5 in the win.
paras.zh: “我们将继续战斗到最后，”光芒队左外野手钱德勒·辛普森(Chandler Simpson)说道，他在这场胜利中5投3中。

paras.en: Simpson plated Game 4's first run with an RBI double in the second. Pratt tied the score with an RBI double in the fourth, but the Rays regained the lead off a throwing error in the bottom of the frame.
paras.zh: 辛普森在第四场比赛中打出一记打点双打，在第二场比赛中打出了第一分。普拉特在第四节打点双打将比分追平，但光芒队因投篮失误重新领先。

paras.en: Brewers third baseman David Hamilton led off the fifth with his second homer of the postseason. That 391-foot solo shot tied the score at 2-2.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队三垒手大卫·汉密尔顿在第五局中以季后赛第二支全垒打领先。那记 391 英尺的单人射门将比分追成 2-2。

paras.en: Both teams continued to threaten, but did not score over the next four frames, forcing extra innings. Neither team recorded a hit in the first two extra frames. Pratt then settled in against relief pitcher Ian Seymour to start the 12th. He proceeded to smack a 2-2 Seymour sweeper over the left field fence for his first playoff home run.
paras.zh: 两队继续威胁，但在接下来的四局中都没有得分，被迫进行加时赛。两支球队在前两局加时赛中都没有安打。普拉特随后在第 12 局比赛中对阵替补投手伊恩·西摩 (Ian Seymour)。他将 2-2 的西摩清道夫击出左外野围栏，打出他的首支季后赛全垒打。

paras.en: Rays third baseman Junior Caminero reached on a fielding error to lead off the bottom of the final inning. Catcher Liam Hicks, DeLuca, Simpson and Williamson connected for singles over the game's final four at-bats to extend the Rays' season.
paras.zh: 光芒队三垒手朱尼尔·卡米内罗因守备失误而在最后一局下半取得领先。捕手利亚姆·希克斯、德卢卡、辛普森和威廉姆森在比赛的最后四次击球中联手打出单打，延长了光芒队的赛季。

paras.en: Rays starter Griffin Jax allowed four hits and two runs over four innings. The Rays bullpen surrendered just four hits and one run over the final eight.
paras.zh: 光芒队先发球员格里芬·贾克斯在四局比赛中失四支安打和两分。光芒队牛棚在最后八场比赛中仅失四支安打和一分。

paras.en: Brewers starter Dustin May allowed three hits and two runs over three innings. Brewers relief pitcher Aaron Ashby, who did not allow a hit over 2 1/3 innings, set a record for the most consecutive scoreless innings in a single postseason, with 18.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队先发球员达斯汀·梅在三局比赛中失三支安打和两分。酿酒人队的后援投手亚伦·阿什比在 2.5 局内未失安打，以 18 分创造了季后赛单场连续无得分最多的纪录。

paras.en: Hicks went 2 for 5 in the win. Designated hitter Yandy Diaz, who went 1 for 4 with a walk, joined Simpson and Hicks as the only Rays players to reach base more than once in Game 4.
paras.zh: 希克斯5投2中获胜。指定击球手扬迪·迪亚兹（Yandy Diaz）四保送出一球，与辛普森和希克斯一起成为光线队球员中唯一在第四场比赛中多次上垒的球员。

paras.en: Pratt went 4 for 5 with two RBIs and a run scored. His Brewers teammates went a combined 4 for 38 in the loss. Left fielder Jackson Chourio, who went 2 for 6, tied Babe Ruth's 1928 record for the the most hits through four games of a World Series, with 10.
paras.zh: 普拉特5投4中，打点2分，跑分得分。在这场失利中，他的酿酒人队队友总共38投4中。左外野手杰克逊·乔里奥 (Jackson Chourio) 6 投 2 中，以 10 支安打追平了贝比·鲁斯 (Babe Ruth) 1928 年在世界大赛四场比赛中安打最多的纪录。

paras.en: The Rays (1-3) will host the Brewers (3-1) in Game 5 at 8 p.m. EDT Wednesday in St. Petersburg.
paras.zh: 光芒队 (1-3) 将在晚上 8 点在第 5 场比赛中主场迎战酿酒人队 (3-1)。美国东部时间周三在圣彼得堡。

articles.title: U.S. kills 5 in boat strike as Pentagon adviser likens cartels to ISIS

paras.en: Oct. 27 (UPI) -- The U.S. military killed five people in a "kinetic strike" targeting a boat operating along what it called "established narco-trafficking routes" in the Eastern Pacific on Tuesday, as a senior Pentagon official compared Latin American drug cartels to Al-Qaida and ISIS and accused them of orchestrating legal challenges to the military campaign.
paras.zh: 10 月 27 日（UPI）——周二，美国军方对一艘在东太平洋所谓的“既定毒品贩运路线”上航行的船只进行了“动能打击”，造成 5 人死亡，五角大楼一名高级官员将拉丁美洲贩毒集团与基地组织和伊斯兰国进行了比较，并指责他们策划对军事行动的法律挑战。

paras.en: The strike is the 72nd known attack by the U.S. military on alleged drug-trafficking boats in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific since the launch of the operation in September 2025. In those strikes, it has killed at least 243 people it alleges were involved in drug trafficking, though family members of some of the dead have said their loved ones were fishermen and farmers.
paras.zh: 此次袭击是自 2025 年 9 月发起行动以来，美国军方对加勒比海和东太平洋地区涉嫌贩毒的船只进行的第 72 次已知袭击。在这些袭击中，美国军方已造成至少 243 人死亡，据称这些人涉嫌参与贩毒，不过一些死者的家人表示，他们的亲人是渔民和农民。

paras.en: U.S. Southern Command said Tuesday's strike by Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere, which coordinates U.S. military operations against drug-trafficking networks, targeted a "go-fast vessel."
paras.zh: 美国南方司令部表示，负责协调美国打击贩毒网络的军事行动的西半球联合特遣部队周二发动的袭击针对的是一艘“快速船只”。

paras.en: "Confirmed intelligence revealed the vessel's active involvement in narco-trafficking," SOUTHCOM said in a brief statement, without evidence of the vessel's alleged involvement in drug trafficking or identifying the individuals aboard it.
paras.zh: 南方司令部在一份简短声明中表示，“经证实的情报显示该船积极参与毒品贩运”，但没有证据表明该船涉嫌参与毒品贩运，也没有确认船上人员的身份。

paras.en: Black-and-white SOUTHCOM video of the strike shows the boat seemingly stationary on the water. It then explodes into flames and smoke. The command described those killed as "narco-terrorists" but did not identify them or the criminal organization they were associated with.
paras.zh: 南方司令部拍摄的罢工黑白视频显示，这艘船似乎静止在水面上。然后它会爆炸并产生火焰和烟雾。该司令部将被杀者描述为“毒品恐怖分子”，但没有透露他们的身份或与他们相关的犯罪组织。

paras.en: The strike came as leaders of the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition gathered for a forum in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, to implement plans to combat and dismantle drug-trafficking criminal networks.
paras.zh: 此次袭击发生之际，美洲反卡特尔联盟领导人齐聚多米尼加共和国圣多明各举行论坛，以实施打击和瓦解贩毒犯罪网络的计划。

paras.en: In opening remarks at the forum, Eric Geressy, a senior adviser to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, praised the U.S. military 's campaign against alleged drug-trafficking boats, claiming that in its first 12 months, it "severed" drug cartel maritime corridors.
paras.zh: 国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的高级顾问埃里克·杰雷西在论坛开幕致辞中赞扬了美国军方打击贩毒船只的行动，声称在最初的12个月里，它“切断了”贩毒集团的海上走廊。

paras.en: "We imposed catastrophic friction on their logistic lines. We shattered their command and control," he said, but added that the cartels -- which he called "violent extremist organizations" -- were adapting.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们对他们的后勤线路造成了灾难性的摩擦。我们破坏了他们的指挥和控制。”但他补充说，这些卡特尔——他称之为“暴力极端主义组织”——正在适应。

paras.en: "They operate as the Al-Qaida and ISIS of the Western Hemisphere."
paras.zh: “他们作为西半球的基地组织和伊斯兰国运作。”

paras.en: He then alleged that the cartels, unable to compete against the U.S. military, were behind legal challenges to the strikes, claiming, without proof, that they finance and run NGOs, and "file spurious human rights petitions" in an attempt to "paralyze our decision cycle."
paras.zh: 他随后声称，卡特尔无法与美国军方竞争，他们在背后对袭击提出法律挑战，在没有证据的情况下声称他们资助和运营非政府组织，并“提交虚假的人权请愿书”，试图“瘫痪我们的决策周期”。

paras.en: "They want to collapse our operational tempo from the courtroom because they cannot survive it in the battle space," he said.
paras.zh: “他们想要破坏我们在法庭上的行动节奏，因为他们无法在战斗空间中生存，”他说。

paras.en: The allegations come as the Trump administration faces mounting criticism of its military campaign, with Democratic lawmakers, human rights advocates and international legal experts accusing it of conducting extrajudicial killings against individuals who have not been charged with a crime, let alone tried or convicted.
paras.zh: 这些指控是在特朗普政府对其军事行动面临越来越多的批评之际提出的，民主党议员、人权倡导者和国际法律专家指责其对尚未被指控犯罪、更不用说审判或定罪的个人进行法外处决。

paras.en: The U.N. special rapporteur on counter-terrorism and human rights, Ben Saul, has said that there are reasonable grounds to believe that the attacks constitute the crime against humanity of murder under international law. He has also said there is growing evidence they have not been effective in reducing drug trafficking int he United States.
paras.zh: 联合国反恐和人权问题特别报告员本·索尔表示，有合理的理由相信这些袭击构成国际法规定的反人类谋杀罪。他还表示，越来越多的证据表明，他们并没有有效减少美国境内的贩毒活动。

paras.en: The Trump administration, meanwhile, maintains it is in armed conflict with the criminal organizations it has designated as terrorist organizations.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普政府坚称其与被其指定为恐怖组织的犯罪组织存在武装冲突。

paras.en: During Tuesday's forum, Geressy maintained that U.S. military operations comply with international law, rejecting allegations that the strikes are unlawful.
paras.zh: 在周二的论坛上，杰雷西坚称美国的军事行动符合国际法，并否认袭击是非法的。

paras.en: "Let me establish our position with absolute clarity: The United States and every coalition partner assembled here strictly observed the law of armed conflict. Our forces adhere uncompromisingly to the core tenets of the rule of law: military necessity, distinction, proportionality and the prevention of unnecessary suffering.
paras.zh: “让我绝对明确地表明我们的立场：美国和聚集在这里的每一个联盟伙伴都严格遵守武装冲突法。我们的军队毫不妥协地坚持法治的核心原则：军事必要性、区别、相称性和防止不必要的痛苦。

paras.en: "However, we will not allow the law of war to be weaponized by a one-way shield by terrorists who respect no law."
paras.zh: “然而，我们不会允许不尊重法律的恐怖分子以单向盾牌将战争法武器化。”

paras.en: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere, which conducted Tuesday's strike, was established in August to replace Joint Task Force Southern Spear. It coordinates U.S. military operations with the 18 partner nations of the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition.
paras.zh: 执行周二袭击的西半球联合特遣部队于八月成立，以取代南矛联合特遣部队。它协调美国与美洲反卡特尔联盟 18 个伙伴国的军事行动。

paras.en: Tuesday's attack was the task force's second publicly announced strike of October.
paras.zh: 周二的袭击是该工作组十月份第二次公开宣布的袭击。

articles.title: Israel’s economic future is on the ballot after Netanyahu offers a grim forecast.
articles.author: Isabel Kershner

paras.en: Israelis voted in the largest numbers in a generation on Tuesday, and exit polls suggested that a bloc of opposition parties was roughly even with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s alliance in what many described as a make-or-break moment for the nation.
paras.zh: 周二，以色列人进行了一代人中最多的投票，出口民意调查显示，反对党集团与总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的联盟大致持平，许多人称这是国家的成败时刻。

paras.en: The election did not appear to immediately determine who would lead the country next, even as the leading candidates — Mr. Netanyahu and the leader of a coalition of opposition parties, Gadi Eisenkot — struck tones of victory in late-night addresses to supporters. Vote counting was expected to last days, followed by a potentially lengthy effort by the blocs to assemble a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 尽管主要候选人——内塔尼亚胡和反对党联盟领导人加迪·艾森科特——在深夜向支持者发表的讲话中透露出胜利的基调，但这次选举似乎并没有立即决定谁将领导该国。计票工作预计将持续几天，随后各集团可能需要花费很长时间才能获得议会多数席位。

paras.en: The exit polls, if accurate, suggest that neither Mr. Netanyahu’s bloc nor the one led by Mr. Eisenkot, a former military chief whose son was killed in the Gaza war, will be able to form a government without relying on two Arab parties that were projected to win as many as 17 or 18 seats in Parliament. Mr. Netanyahu effectively ruled out including them in a governing coalition, and Mr. Eisenkot and his partners have balked at the idea, too.
paras.zh: 如果出口民意调查准确的话，内塔尼亚胡的集团和艾森科特领导的集团都无法在不依赖两个阿拉伯政党的情况下组建政府。艾森科特是一名前军事首长，其子在加沙战争中被杀。这两个政党预计将在议会赢得多达 17 或 18 个席位。内塔尼亚胡先生实际上排除了将他们纳入执政联盟的可能性，而艾森科特先生和他的合作伙伴也对这个想法犹豫不决。

paras.en: One option analysts are already weighing is whether Mr. Netanyahu, who has led the most far-right government in Israeli history, could join with Mr. Eisenkot or others in the opposition to form a unity government. But a unity government would face major obstacles, given how deeply Mr. Eisenkot’s voters despise Mr. Netanyahu, and because the two would have to agree on which of them would serve as prime minister. Mr. Netanyahu is unlikely to give up control, while Mr. Eisenkot has called the prime minister unfit to lead Israel.
paras.zh: 分析人士已经在权衡的一个选择是，领导以色列历史上最右翼政府的内塔尼亚胡是否可以与艾森科特或其他反对派一起组建联合政府。但考虑到艾森科特的选民对内塔尼亚胡的鄙视程度，以及两人必须就谁将担任总理达成一致，联合政府将面临重大障碍。内塔尼亚胡不太可能放弃控制权，而艾森科特则称总理不适合领导以色列。

paras.en: Much remained unclear early Wednesday morning in Israel. Making matters even murkier, Israel’s exit polls have a spotty history of accuracy, particularly in tight races.
paras.zh: 周三清晨，以色列的情况仍不明朗。使事情变得更加扑朔迷离的是，以色列的出口民意调查的准确性历来参差不齐，尤其是在激烈的竞选中。

paras.en: Mr. Eisenkot appeared onstage past midnight at his post-election party and attempted to strike a tone of triumph — as well as defiance toward Mr. Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在午夜过后出现在选举后派对的舞台上，试图表现出胜利的基调，同时也对内塔尼亚胡表示蔑视。

paras.en: “Tonight we got the answer: The public wants change,” he said.
paras.zh: “今晚我们得到了答案：公众想要改变，”他说。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu addressed his supporters a few hours later, invoking his relationship with President Trump and repeating his pre-election talking points about removing the threat of Iran. He sounded triumphant, saying it was clear that Likud had emerged as the largest party in Israel and mocking months of pre-election polls that showed his party trailing behind that of Mr. Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，内塔尼亚胡向他的支持者发表讲话，援引他与特朗普总统的关系，并重申了他在选举前关于消除伊朗威胁的谈话要点。他听起来得意洋洋，表示利库德集团显然已经成为以色列最大的政党，并嘲笑几个月前的民意调查显示利库德集团落后于艾森科特。

paras.en: “We must form a strong right-wing government,” he declared.
paras.zh: “我们必须组建一个强大的右翼政府，”他宣称。

paras.en: In the coming days, after official vote totals are released and parliamentary seats are allocated to parties, Israel’s president, Isaac Herzog, will invite the party leader he thinks has the best chance to assemble a governing coalition. Such a coalition would usually have to be made up of at least 61 lawmakers, though Mr. Eisenkot has floated the idea of forming a minority government.
paras.zh: 未来几天，在官方公布总票数并将议会席位分配给各政党后，以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格将邀请他认为最有机会组建执政联盟的政党领导人。尽管艾森科特提出了组建少数派政府的想法，但这样的联盟通常必须由至少 61 名议员组成。

paras.en: One factor not reflected in exit polls are the hundreds of thousands of votes cast by Israelis at special polling stations, including at military bases, hospitals, prisons and embassies. In the previous election, those votes tended to favor the coalition of Mr. Netanyahu and his allies.
paras.zh: 出口民意调查中没有反映的一个因素是以色列人在特殊投票站（包括军事基地、医院、监狱和大使馆）投下的数十万张选票。在上次选举中，这些选票往往有利于内塔尼亚胡先生及其盟友的联盟。

paras.en: - War fears: Amid reports that Mr. Netanyahu has been pushing for renewed attacks on Iran, Mr. Eisenkot warned him in his speech to supporters not to abuse his power as caretaker prime minister to influence the process of forming a new government. “Netanyahu, don’t dare use Israel’s security for your political needs,” he said.
paras.zh: - 战争恐惧：有报道称内塔尼亚胡先生一直在推动对伊朗发动新一轮袭击，艾森科特先生在向支持者发表的讲话中警告他不要滥用看守总理的权力来影响组建新政府的进程。 “内塔尼亚胡，不敢利用以色列的安全来满足你的政治需要，”他说。

paras.en: It’s nearly 4 a.m. in Israel, and there is no clear winner. News is expected to slow down in the coming hours, but pick up again in the morning, when party leaders are expected to begin discussing potential alliances. The official results are still a long way off: Election authorities have so far counted nearly a million votes, about a fifth of the total votes cast.
paras.zh: 以色列时间已近凌晨 4 点，目前还没有明显的赢家。预计未来几个小时内新闻将会放缓，但早上会再次升温，届时政党领导人预计将开始讨论潜在的联盟。距离正式结果还有很长的路要走：选举当局迄今为止已清点了近百万张选票，约占总选票的五分之一。

paras.en: In a nod to the fact he is now a caretaker prime minister pending the formation of a new government, Netanyahu said the exit polls were only a preview and he was waiting for official results. Yet he sounded triumphant, if not quite saying he had won the election. He said it was clear that his Likud party had emerged as the largest party in the Parliament, and he mocked months of pre-election polls that showed Likud trailing behind the party of his main rival, Gadi Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡承认自己现在是看守总理，等待组建新政府，他表示出口民意调查只是预览，他正在等待官方结果。然而，他听起来似乎很得意，即使不是说他赢得了选举。他表示，很明显，他的利库德集团已经成为议会中最大的政党，他嘲笑了几个月的选举前民意调查，显示利库德集团落后于他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特的政党。

paras.en: - Jalaa Marey/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images
paras.zh: - Jalaa Marey/法新社 — 盖蒂图片社

paras.en: Listing Israel’s enemies who have now been killed, including Ayatollah Ali Khamenei of Iran, Netanyahu declared, “Iran is weaker than ever, Israel is stronger than ever.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡列出了现已被杀的以色列敌人，其中包括伊朗的阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊，他宣称：“伊朗比以往任何时候都更弱，以色列比以往任何时候都更强大。”

paras.en: “But it’s still not over,” he said, adding that with his “friend” President Trump, it would be possible to remove the threat from Iran once and for all, repeating his pre-election talking points.
paras.zh: “但这还没有结束，”他说，并补充说，与他的“朋友”特朗普总统一起，有可能一劳永逸地消除来自伊朗的威胁，并重复他选前的谈话要点。

paras.en: Netanyahu showed no hint of extending a hand to the opposition as he addressed supporters early Wednesday. Arriving onstage at 3:15 a.m., looking reinvigorated and in an ebullient mood, he declared, “We must form a strong right-wing government.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周三早些时候向支持者发表讲话时，没有表现出向反对派伸出援助之手的迹象。凌晨 3 点 15 分，他登上舞台，看上去精神焕发，心情愉快，他宣称：“我们必须组建一个强大的右翼政府。”

paras.en: One updated exit poll has given Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc a small edge over the opposition. The exit polls by Israel’s three largest television networks at first projected a small lead for Gadi Eisenkot’s anti-Netanyahu alliance, but now one has Netanyahu and his allies ahead, and the other two show the two blocs even. Exit polls have not always been reliable indicators of the result, and the official count is far from complete. But it appears that neither side has a clear path to forming a government without the help of the Arab parties, unless one or more parties defects from one of the main blocs.
paras.zh: 一项最新的出口民意调查显示，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的阵营比反对派稍占优势。以色列三大电视网的出口民意调查最初预计加迪·艾森科特的反内塔尼亚胡联盟稍稍领先，但现在内塔尼亚胡及其盟友领先，另外两项则显示两个集团旗鼓相当。出口民调并不总是可靠的结果指标，官方统计也远未完成。但在没有阿拉伯政党帮助的情况下，双方似乎都没有明确的组建政府的途径，除非一个或多个政党脱离其中一个主要集团。

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu’s main rival, took the stage in the early hours of Wednesday morning like a winner, embracing members of his Yashar party who were waiting for him there and waving to an enthusiastic crowd of flag-waving supporters who hailed him as the next prime minister.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特周三凌晨像胜利者一样走上舞台，拥抱在那里等候他的亚沙尔党成员，并向热情的挥舞旗帜的支持者挥手致意，他们欢呼他为下一任总理。

paras.en: Although Eisenkot’s path to forming a government is far from clear, he gave what amounted to a victory speech for the opposition bloc, declaring, “We’ve made history.” Describing the election as a referendum on who should lead Israel in the coming years, he added: “Tonight we got the answer. The public wants change.”
paras.zh: 尽管艾森科特组建政府的道路还远未明朗，但他发表了相当于反对派集团的胜利演说，宣称“我们创造了历史”。他将这次选举描述为一场关于谁应该在未来几年领导以色列的公投，他补充道：“今晚我们得到了答案。公众想要改变。”

paras.en: In an unusual and pointed message, Eisenkot told the country’s security chiefs and public servants that Netanyahu now heads a transitional government that has lost the confidence of the people. “Stand strong and firm against any attempt to challenge you,” Eisenkot said. “You have my clear backing.” Amid reports that Netanyahu has been pushing for renewed attacks on Iran, Eisenkot said, “Netanyahu, don’t dare use Israel’s security for your political needs.”
paras.zh: 艾森科特在一条不寻常且尖锐的信息中告诉该国安全负责人和公务员，内塔尼亚胡现在领导的过渡政府已经失去了人民的信任。艾森科特说：“要坚强、坚决地反对任何挑战你的企图。” “我明确支持你。”有报道称内塔尼亚胡一直在推动对伊朗发动新一轮袭击，艾森科特表示，“内塔尼亚胡，不敢利用以色列的安全来满足你的政治需要。”

paras.en: Two Israeli news channels have recently updated their exit polls, which now show a tie between the bloc led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and that of his main challenger, Gadi Eisenkot. Neither bloc, however, has enough seats to form a government without the support of Arab parties. Earlier versions of the same exit polls had shown small leads for the opposition alliance. The official vote count is still too preliminary to draw any conclusions, and counting will take days.
paras.zh: 两个以色列新闻频道最近更新了出口民调，显示总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的集团与其主要挑战者加迪·艾森科特领导的集团之间势均力敌。然而，在没有阿拉伯政党支持的情况下，这两个集团都没有足够的席位来组建政府。同一出口民意调查的早期版本显示反对党联盟略有领先。官方计票仍处于初步阶段，无法得出任何结论，计票需要数天时间。

paras.en: One of the most striking results from the election in Israel on Tuesday was the unusually strong showing by two leading Arab parties, whose voters turned out in record numbers to express their opposition to the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 周二以色列选举中最引人注目的结果之一是两个主要阿拉伯政党异常强劲的表现，这两个政党的选民数量创纪录地表达了对本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理政府的反对。

paras.en: The final results have not been announced, but a range of exit polls conducted by Israeli broadcasters suggest that two of the parties — the socially conservative United Arab List, or Raam, and the left-wing Joint List — may have won a historically large number of seats in parliament and an important role in the formation of the country’s next government.
paras.zh: 最终结果尚未公布，但以色列广播公司进行的一系列出口民意调查显示，其中两个政党——社会保守的阿拉伯联合名单党（Raam）和左翼联合名单党——可能赢得了历史上数量最多的议会席位，并在该国下一届政府的组建中发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Mansour Abbas, the leader of Raam, told a television interviewer that the turnout showed that Arab voters, who make up about 20 percent of Israel’s population, had channeled their “frustration and despair” into “hope.”
paras.zh: 拉姆领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯对电视采访者表示，投票率表明，占以色列人口约 20% 的阿拉伯选民已将“沮丧和绝望”转化为“希望”。

paras.en: He said he wanted to replace Mr. Netanyahu’s government “in every possible way” and that his first priority was to “ensure that there is a chance of forming a government” that achieved that goal.
paras.zh: 他说，他希望“以一切可能的方式”取代内塔尼亚胡先生的政府，而他的首要任务是“确保有机会组建一个政府”来实现这一目标。

paras.en: The Arab parties’ strong showing may make them kingmakers. But building a governing coalition with Arab participation remains a fraught exercise in Israel. Many Israeli Jews believe that a parliamentary majority should not rely on the support of Arab lawmakers.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党的强劲表现可能会让他们成为国王的拥护者。但在以色列建立一个有阿拉伯人参与的执政联盟仍然是一项充满挑战的工作。许多以色列犹太人认为，议会多数不应依赖阿拉伯立法者的支持。

paras.en: Most Arab citizens are the descendants of Palestinians who remained in their homes during the 1948 Arab-Israel war at the time of Israel’s independence.
paras.zh: 大多数阿拉伯公民是巴勒斯坦人的后裔，他们在 1948 年阿以战争期间以色列独立时仍留在家乡。

paras.en: Today, they mostly live in separate towns from Jewish Israelis and face violence and discriminatory housing policies.
paras.zh: 如今，他们大多居住在与犹太以色列人不同的城镇，面临暴力和歧视性住房政策。

paras.en: Over the decades, disagreements, including over Israel’s nature as a Jewish state, have led many Arab voters to avoid the ballot box.
paras.zh: 几十年来，包括以色列作为犹太国家性质在内的分歧导致许多阿拉伯选民避开投票箱。

paras.en: This week, many Arab voters said they were furious at Mr. Netanyahu for his treatment of the Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza and for policies that they feel treat Palestinians in Israel as second-class citizens. Indeed, throughout the campaign, Mr. Netanyahu made overt appeals to anti-Arab prejudice.
paras.zh: 本周，许多阿拉伯选民表示，他们对内塔尼亚胡对待约旦河西岸和加沙巴勒斯坦人的方式以及他们认为将以色列境内的巴勒斯坦人视为二等公民的政策感到愤怒。事实上，在整个竞选过程中，内塔尼亚胡先生公开呼吁反阿拉伯偏见。

paras.en: Of the two Arab parties that did well on Tuesday, only Raam has joined a coalition government in the past. That happened in 2021, when it joined the short-lived anti-Netanyahu coalition of Prime Minister Naftali Bennett.
paras.zh: 在周二表现出色的两个阿拉伯政党中，只有拉姆过去曾加入过联合政府。这发生在 2021 年，当时它加入了总理纳夫塔利·贝内特领导的短暂的反内塔尼亚胡联盟。

paras.en: Raam’s participation in that government outraged many right-wing Jewish voters, and when it collapsed after roughly one year, they backed Mr. Netanyahu, who went on to form the most hard-line government in Israel’s history.
paras.zh: 拉姆参与该政府激怒了许多右翼犹太选民，大约一年后该政府垮台时，他们支持了内塔尼亚胡，内塔尼亚胡后来组建了以色列历史上最强硬的政府。

paras.en: That government now faces the possibility that it may be brought down by an election result that has been deeply shaped by robust Arab turnout.
paras.zh: 该政府现在面临着一种可能性，即它可能会因阿拉伯人强劲投票率而深受影响的选举结果而垮台。

paras.en: Scores of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s supporters and lawmakers from his Likud party are gathered at the party’s election-night headquarters, in a conference hall in Jerusalem. It’s past 1:30 a.m., and some of the crowd here is ecstatic, waiting for the prime minister to come and speak onstage. Activists are wearing “Make Israel Great Again” baseball hats and throwing the party’s voting slips like confetti. But others, including party officials, acknowledged to me their path to forming a coalition is narrow, and feelings here are mixed.
paras.zh: 总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的支持者和利库德集团的数十名议员聚集在该党位于耶路撒冷会议厅的选举之夜总部。凌晨 1 点 30 分多了，这里的一些人群欣喜若狂，等待总理上台讲话。活动人士戴着“让以色列再次伟大”的棒球帽，并像五彩纸屑一样扔出该党的选票。但其他人，包括党的官员，向我承认他们组建联盟的道路是狭窄的，而且他们的感受很复杂。

paras.en: Bezalel Smotrich, the current finance minister and leader of the far-right Religious Zionism party, focused his post-election speech on delegitimizing the predominantly Arab parties whose support could help the anti-Netanyahu bloc form a government. “Parties that are unable to condemn the massacre of Oct. 7 and are not willing to declare Hamas as a terrorist organization are not legitimate actors in Israeli politics,” Smotrich told his supporters.
paras.zh: 现任财政部长、极右宗教犹太复国主义党领袖贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇在选举后的讲话中重点讨论了废除以阿拉伯人为主的政党的合法性，这些政党的支持可能有助于反内塔尼亚胡集团组建政府。 “那些无法谴责 10 月 7 日大屠杀并且不愿意宣布哈马斯为恐怖组织的政党不是以色列政治中的合法参与者，”斯莫特里奇告诉他的支持者。

paras.en: Naftali Bennett, who leads a party in the alliance opposing Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc, said the sitting prime minister had lost the election. In a fiery televised address to a gathering of supporters, he tied Netanyahu to the Hamas-led attack on Oct. 7, 2023, Israel’s worst security failure in decades. “The government of Oct. 7 will go home,” he said.
paras.zh: 反对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡集团的联盟党魁纳夫塔利·贝内特表示，现任总理在选举中失败。在向支持者集会发表的激烈电视讲话中，他将内塔尼亚胡与 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击联系在一起，这是以色列几十年来最严重的安全失败。 “10 月 7 日政府将回家，”他说。

paras.en: He said the anti-Netanyahu parties “will do everything, setting ego aside” to form a government that will insist on conscription of ultra-Orthodox Jews into the military. He did not address whether that might include Netanyahu’s Likud party, or one or more Arab parties.
paras.zh: 他表示，反内塔尼亚胡政党“将竭尽全力，抛开自我”，组建一个坚持将极端正统犹太人征召入伍的政府。他没有说明这是否可能包括内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团，或者一个或多个阿拉伯政党。

paras.en: Not reflected in exit polls are hundreds of thousands of ballots cast at special polling stations, including on military bases, in hospitals, prisons, and embassies. In the previous election, those votes leaned toward Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition. This year, the election authorities estimated that roughly 600,000 such votes would be cast, accounting for about 10 percent of eligible voters. Results from those ballots are not expected to be announced before Thursday.
paras.zh: 出口民意调查中没有反映出在特殊投票站（包括军事基地、医院、监狱和大使馆）投出的数十万张选票。在上次选举中，这些选票倾向于总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的联盟。今年，选举当局估计大约有60万张这样的选票，约占合格选民的10%。这些投票的结果预计不会在周四之前公布。

paras.en: Itamar Ben-Gvir, the far-right national security minister, was the first leader of a party in Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition to speak following tonight’s exit polls. He neither declared victory for his bloc nor conceded defeat. “The night is still young,” he told supporters at a televised gathering. He said he hoped that the bloc led by Netanyahu “was close to forming a right-wing government.”
paras.zh: 极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本格维尔是本杰明·内塔尼亚胡联盟中第一位在今晚的出口民意调查后发表讲话的政党领导人。他既没有宣布自己的阵营获胜，也没有承认失败。 “夜晚还很年轻，”他在电视转播的集会上对支持者说。他说，他希望内塔尼亚胡领导的集团“接近组建右翼政府”。

paras.en: The leader of the Democrats party, Yair Golan, declared victory on Tuesday night for the opposition bloc, which includes his party, and asserted that the exit polls showed that the Israeli public had “fired Netanyahu and Likud.” Addressing supporters, Golan urged opposition leaders to swiftly form a “change government” without letting ego or political calculations delay the process. “From tonight, Israel can breathe,” he said. “Tomorrow, we begin rebuilding.” He expressed a willingness to rely on support from outside the opposition alliance to secure a parliamentary majority, an apparent reference to the Arab parties.
paras.zh: 民主党领袖亚伊尔·戈兰周二晚宣布包括其政党在内的反对派集团获胜，并声称出口民意调查显示以色列公众“解雇了内塔尼亚胡和利库德集团”。戈兰向支持者发表讲话，敦促反对派领导人迅速组建“变革政府”，不要让自我或政治算计拖延这一进程。 “从今晚开始，以色列可以喘口气了，”他说。 “明天，我们就开始重建。”他表示愿意依靠反对派联盟之外的支持来确保议会多数席位，这显然是指阿拉伯政党。

paras.en: Another surprise in the exit polls was Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s apparent surge on Election Day. While the most recent pre-election surveys showed his Likud party with about 20 seats in Parliament, the exit polls show Likud winning 24, more than any other party. That is an important symbolic victory for Netanyahu, and one that few could have foreseen for the prime minister who was in charge on Oct. 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 出口民调中的另一个意外是总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在选举日的支持率明显飙升。虽然最近的选前调查显示，他的利库德集团在议会中拥有约 20 个席位，但出口民意调查显示，利库德集团赢得了 24 个席位，比任何其他政党都多。对于内塔尼亚胡来说，这是一场重要的象征性胜利，对于 2023 年 10 月 7 日上任的总理来说，很少有人能预见到这一胜利。

paras.en: It suggests that Netanyahu’s hair-on-fire appeal to voters on Election Day worked — but only so much. The extra four seats he picked up, according to the exit polls, came at the expense of his allies, not the opposition bloc.
paras.zh: 这表明内塔尼亚胡在选举日对选民的强烈呼吁起到了作用，但也仅限于此。根据出口民意调查，他获得的额外四个席位是以牺牲他的盟友而非反对派集团为代价的。

paras.en: Judging by exit polls, one major suprise in this election is the high turnout among Israel’s Arab citizens, who were furious at the current government over its housing policies and its failure to curb violent crime in Arab communities.
paras.zh: 从出口民意调查来看，这次选举的一大惊喜是以色列阿拉伯公民的高投票率，他们对现任政府的住房政策及其未能遏制阿拉伯社区暴力犯罪感到愤怒。

paras.en: Pre-election surveys suggested that the two main Arab parties would win about 13 seats, but the exit polls suggest they will end up with closer to 17 or 18 seats. In the past, Arab parties have never won more than 15.
paras.zh: 选前调查显示，两个主要的阿拉伯政党将赢得约 13 个席位，但出口民意调查显示，他们最终将获得接近 17 或 18 个席位。过去，阿拉伯政党从未赢得超过15场胜利。

paras.en: Mansour Abbas, the leader of the Raam party, told a television interviewer on Tuesday night that the turnout showed that “frustration and despair” in Israel’s Arab society had “turned to hope.”
paras.zh: 拉姆党领袖曼苏尔·阿巴斯周二晚间对电视采访者表示，投票率表明以色列阿拉伯社会的“沮丧和绝望”已“转变为希望”。

paras.en: Mansour Abbas, the leader of an Arab party that could prove pivotal to the opposition’s efforts to form a majority coalition, said he wanted to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government “in every possible way.” In an interview with Israel’s Channel 12, he said his immediate priority was to “ensure that there is a chance of forming a government” opposed to Netanyahu. “And then, we will discuss the details,” he said, “and address the challenges.”
paras.zh: 曼苏尔·阿巴斯是一个阿拉伯政党的领导人，该政党可能对反对派组建多数联盟的努力至关重要，他表示，他希望“以一切可能的方式”取代总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的政府。他在接受以色列第 12 频道采访时表示，他的当务之急是“确保有机会组建一个反对内塔尼亚胡的政府”。 “然后，我们将讨论细节，”他说，“并应对挑战。”

paras.en: Initial exit polls suggest that Arab parties are likely to win a historic number of seats in Israel’s Parliament.
paras.zh: 初步出口民意调查显示，阿拉伯政党可能会在以色列议会中赢得历史数量的席位。

paras.en: The polls released by Israeli TV channels gave Raam and the Joint List, the two major Arab parties, either 17 or 18 of the Knesset’s 120 seats.
paras.zh: 以色列电视频道公布的民意调查显示，阿拉伯两大政党拉姆党和联合名单党在以色列议会 120 个席位中分别获得 17 或 18 个席位。

paras.en: “The Arabs feel this government did everything to marginalize them and even incite against them,” said Thabet Abu Ras, an expert in Arab-Jewish relations and an Arab citizen of Israel. “They understood they needed to fight for their citizenship and play the political game fully.”
paras.zh: “阿拉伯人认为这个政府竭尽全力边缘化他们，甚至煽动反对他们，”阿拉伯与犹太关系专家、以色列阿拉伯公民塔贝特·阿布·拉斯 (Thabet Abu Ras) 说。 “他们明白，他们需要为自己的公民身份而奋斗，并充分参与政治游戏。”

paras.en: Israel’s Central Election Committee just updated the country’s turnout rate to 77.7 percent, the highest since 1999. Israelis headed in large numbers to the polls on Tuesday, particularly among the country’s Arab minority, who were spurred by a desire to unseat Benjamin Netanyahu’s hardline coalition.
paras.zh: 以色列中央选举委员会刚刚将该国的投票率更新为 77.7%，为 1999 年以来的最高水平。周二，大批以色列人前往投票站，尤其是该国的阿拉伯少数民族，他们受到推翻本杰明·内塔尼亚胡强硬联盟的愿望的刺激。

paras.en: In 2021, Israel’s short-lived anti-Netanyahu government included for the first time an independent Arab party, Raam. The backlash to that catapulted anti-Arab politicians like Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich into the next government. According to exit polls, the backlash to that government appears to have resulted today in a record showing for Israel’s Arab parties.
paras.zh: 2021年，以色列短命的反内塔尼亚胡政府首次纳入了独立的阿拉伯政党拉姆。对伊塔马尔·本格维尔（Itamar Ben-Gvir）和贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇（Bezalel Smotrich）等反阿拉伯政客的强烈反对促使他们进入下一届政府。根据出口民意调查，对该政府的强烈反对似乎导致以色列阿拉伯政党今天的支持率创历史新高。

paras.en: The exit polls suggest Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition may well be deadlocked with his Jewish opponents, and neither would be able to form a government on their own without relying on Arab parties. One option already being weighed by analysts is whether Netanyahu and his main rival, Gadi Eisenkot, could form a unity government of Israel’s right-wing and centrist parties. Such an alliance might be hard for Eisenkot to accept given how deeply his own voters despise Netanyahu. And then there’s also the question of who would run the government. Netanyahu is unlikely to give up control, and Eisenkot has vowed not to join a government run by someone he has called unfit to lead Israel.
paras.zh: 出口民调显示，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的联盟很可能与他的犹太对手陷入僵局，如果不依赖阿拉伯政党，他们都无法独自组建政府。分析人士已经在权衡的一个选择是，内塔尼亚胡和他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特是否可以组建以色列右翼和中间派政党的联合政府。考虑到艾森科特自己的选民多么鄙视内塔尼亚胡，这样的联盟可能很难接受。此外还有谁来管理政府的问题。内塔尼亚胡不太可能放弃控制权，艾森科特也发誓不会加入一个他认为不适合领导以色列的人领导的政府。

paras.en: There have been precedents in the past where the party with the most seats in Parliament does not end up forming a government. In Israel’s 2009 election, Tzipi Livni’s centrist Kadima party won 28 seats, narrowly beating Benjamin Netanyahu’s conservative Likud, which won 27. But Netanyahu had more support from allied parties and came back as prime minister after a decade spent out of politics or in the opposition.
paras.zh: 过去曾有过在议会中拥有最多席位的政党最终未能组建政府的先例。在以色列 2009 年的选举中，齐皮·利夫尼领导的中间派前进党赢得了 28 个席位，以微弱优势击败了本雅明·内塔尼亚胡领导的保守派利库德集团，赢得了 27 个席位。但内塔尼亚胡得到了盟友更多的支持，并在远离政坛或在反对派 10 年后重新担任总理。

paras.en: A few activists were celebrating at the Likud Party’s election headquarters in Jerusalem even though most exit polls suggested that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s alliance of parties had won fewer seats than the bloc of parties seeking his ouster. “Bibi is the king! The king is Bibi!” they shouted, using a nickname for the Israeli leader.
paras.zh: 尽管大多数出口民调显示，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的政党联盟赢得的席位少于寻求下台的政党集团，但一些活动人士仍在耶路撒冷的利库德集团选举总部庆祝。 “比比是国王！国王是比比！”他们喊道，用的是以色列领导人的绰号。

paras.en: Polls have closed in Israel, and initial exit polls by Israeli broadcasters are expected to be released shortly afterward. But it will be hours before the definitive results are known, and it could be weeks until a new government is formed.
paras.zh: 以色列的民意调查已经结束，以色列广播公司的初步出口民意调查预计将在不久后公布。但最终结果还需要数小时才能得知，新政府组建可能还需要数周时间。

paras.en: - Early indicator: Exit polls in Israel can be useful to get a sense of each party’s relative strength, but they are not considered a reliable gauge of precise results — particularly in a tight race like this one.
paras.zh: - 早期指标：以色列的出口民意调查有助于了解各方的相对实力，但它们并不被认为是准确结果的可靠衡量标准——尤其是在像这样的激烈竞争中。

paras.en: - Vote-counting: Votes are tallied in Israel by hand, with ballot slips tabulated at more than 12,000 polling places across the country. The counters are monitored by camera-toting election observers.
paras.zh: - 计票：以色列采用人工计票，全国 12,000 多个投票站的选票均以表格形式列出。柜台由携带摄像机的选举观察员监控。

paras.en: - First results: After the hand count is completed, paper tallies are taken to regional hubs where the results are recorded electronically. The whole process takes hours, and the authorities begin to release the results once they are completed.
paras.zh: - 初步结果：手工清点完成后，纸质计数将被送到区域中心，在那里以电子方式记录结果。整个过程需要几个小时，当局在完成后开始发布结果。

paras.en: - Possible delay: Israel is a parliamentary democracy, and no party is expected to win anywhere near an outright majority of the votes. Once the results are in, the process of forming a government will begin. That could take weeks or even months.
paras.zh: - 可能的延迟：以色列是一个议会民主国家，预计没有任何政党能够赢得接近绝对多数的选票。一旦结果出来，组建政府的过程就会开始。这可能需要几周甚至几个月的时间。

paras.en: - Next government: The party with the most votes and the most seats in the Parliament may not be the one to form a government. In 2021, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party won the most seats but was unable to assemble a majority coalition. Instead, after months of wrangling, an eclectic coalition of anti-Netanyahu forces cobbled together a single-seat majority in Parliament.
paras.zh: - 下一届政府：在议会中拥有最多选票和最多席位的政党可能不是组建政府的政党。 2021年，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团赢得了最多席位，但未能组建多数联盟。相反，经过几个月的争吵，反内塔尼亚胡势力的折衷联盟在议会中拼凑出单席位多数。

paras.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s governing coalition has the distinction of surviving for a full four-year term in office, something no government in Israel has achieved for more than 30 years. Since first taking office in 1996, he has tallied 19 years in power and become Israel’s longest-serving prime minister by far.
paras.zh: 本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理领导的执政联盟在任期内完成了四年任期，这是以色列 30 多年来从未有过的政府取得的成就。自1996年上任以来，他已执政19年，成为以色列迄今为止任期最长的总理。

paras.en: On Tuesday, he is seeking a seventh term, in Israel’s first parliamentary election since the deadly Hamas-led attack in 2023 that prompted its devastating war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 周二，他正在寻求第七个任期，这是以色列自 2023 年哈马斯领导的致命袭击导致加沙毁灭性战争以来的首次议会选举。

paras.en: The longevity of his most recent governing coalition followed three years during which a cycle of collapsed coalitions and five snap elections had left the country without a functional government or national budget.
paras.zh: 他最近的执政联盟的寿命长达三年，在此期间，联盟崩溃和五次提前选举的周期导致该国没有一个正常运作的政府或国家预算。

paras.en: In 2021, Israelis ousted Mr. Netanyahu from power and then returned him to office 18 months later. He had staged a previous comeback, in 2009, becoming prime minister a decade after his party was voted out of power.
paras.zh: 2021 年，以色列将内塔尼亚胡先生赶下台，18 个月后又让他重新掌权。 2009年，他曾卷土重来，在他的政党被投票下台十年后成为总理。

paras.en: In 2021, Mr. Netanyahu’s government collapsed after failing to pass a budget, setting off legislative elections. At the time, he had been indicted on charges of fraud, bribery and breach of trust, and the coalition he was leading was shaky. According to analysts, heading into an election was a gambit by Mr. Netanyahu to strengthen his grip on power before his criminal trial.
paras.zh: 2021 年，内塔尼亚胡政府因未能通过预算而垮台，引发了立法选举。当时，他因欺诈、贿赂和失信等罪名被起诉，他领导的联盟也摇摇欲坠。分析人士称，参加选举是内塔尼亚胡在刑事审判前加强权力控制的一个策略。

paras.en: But the electorate that voted that March didn’t give him the seats he needed, ending a period of 12 straight years in office for him. It took months of wrangling for an eclectic coalition of anti-Netanyahu forces to cobble together a single-seat majority in the Parliament. Naftali Bennett, a right-wing former ally of Mr. Netanyahu’s, led the coalition as prime minister, hammering out a deal with Yair Lapid, a centrist and former broadcaster who was appointed foreign minister.
paras.zh: 但3月投票的选民并没有给他所需的席位，结束了他连续12年的执政生涯。经过数月的角力，反内塔尼亚胡势力的折衷联盟才在议会中拼凑出单席位多数。内塔尼亚胡先生的右翼前盟友纳夫塔利·贝内特 (Naftali Bennett) 作为总理领导了这个联盟，并与被任命为外交部长的中间派、前广播员亚伊尔·拉皮德 (Yair Lapid) 敲定了一项协议。

paras.en: The eight-party coalition proved too unwieldy to endure. After two right-wing lawmakers defected and several on the left rebelled in critical votes, that government collapsed in June 2022.
paras.zh: 事实证明，八党联盟过于笨拙，难以持久。在两名右翼议员叛逃和几名左翼议员在关键投票中反叛后，该政府于 2022 年 6 月垮台。

paras.en: Returned to office by a hard-line coalition
paras.zh: 由强硬联盟重新执政

paras.en: After the resulting elections, held in November 2022, Mr. Netanyahu returned to power as right-wing voters moved to more extreme parties, diminishing the center left.
paras.zh: 2022 年 11 月举行的选举结束后，内塔尼亚胡先生重新掌权，右翼选民转向更极端的政党，削弱了中左翼势力。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party allied with far-right and ultra-Orthodox lawmakers to secure a clear majority in the Parliament, forming the most hard-line and religious conservative government in Israel’s history.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团与极右翼和极端正统派议员结盟，获得了议会的绝对多数席位，组建了以色列历史上最强硬、宗教保守的政府。

paras.en: The coalition accounted for 48.4 percent of the vote but had a parliamentary majority because two anti-Netanyahu parties — one leftist, one Arab nationalist — fell just short of the share of votes needed to obtain seats.
paras.zh: 该联盟获得了 48.4% 的选票，但在议会中占据多数席位，因为两个反内塔尼亚胡政党——一个是左派，一个是阿拉伯民族主义者——未能达到获得席位所需的票数。

paras.en: It was a reminder of how tiny swings among voters can have a big effect under Israel’s parliamentary system.
paras.zh: 这提醒人们，在以色列议会制度下，选民之间的微小波动可以产生巨大影响。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu has since overseen an acceleration of the country’s rightward shift, including an effort to overhaul the judiciary that prompted huge street protests. Questions about whether his government could have better pre-empted the Oct. 7 attack have also become hot-button issues.
paras.zh: 此后，内塔尼亚胡先生见证了该国的加速右转，其中包括改革司法机构的努力，这引发了大规模的街头抗议。关于他的政府是否可以更好地预防 10 月 7 日袭击的问题也成为热点问题。

paras.en: In April, Mr. Lapid and Mr. Bennett said they would reconstitute their centrist alliance of 2021 for the 2026 election. Mr. Netanyahu will also face Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief of staff who leads the largest opposition party.
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，拉皮德和贝内特表示，他们将重组 2021 年中间派联盟，以备 2026 年大选之用。内塔尼亚胡还将面对领导最大反对党的前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特。

paras.en: Days before Tuesday’s pivotal Israeli election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shocked his country by offering a bleak economic forecast that critics said could make Israel more like Iran, Russia and North Korea.
paras.zh: 在周二关键的以色列选举前几天，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡提出了黯淡的经济预测，批评者称这可能会让以色列变得更像伊朗、俄罗斯和朝鲜，震惊了以色列。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu told an Israeli financial journalist on Friday that he was preparing for international sanctions against Israeli banks by drawing up plans for a “bypass economy” based on cryptocurrency. He also told Israelis to prepare for the end of billions of dollars of annual American assistance.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周五对以色列财经记者表示，他正在准备制定基于加密货币的“旁路经济”计划，以应对国际社会对以色列银行的制裁。他还告诉以色列人为结束美国每年数十亿美元的援助做好准备。

paras.en: “It’s over,” he said. “It’s only a matter of time.”
paras.zh: “结束了，”他说。 “这只是时间问题。”

paras.en: The comments were a reflection of Israel’s deepening global isolation, with even once-staunch allies imposing or threatening economic sanctions and embargoes after years of war in Gaza and rampant violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 这些言论反映了以色列日益加深的全球孤立，在加沙多年的战争以及犹太定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的猖獗暴力之后，甚至一度坚定的盟友也实施或威胁实施经济制裁和禁运。

paras.en: With settlers advancing into areas that were previously off limits, Britain last month decried what it called “ethnic cleansing” and announced trade sanctions on settlements that it said would also apply to entities that financed their construction. Though Israel’s banking system has not been directly targeted by sanctions, a dozen countries, including Canada, France and Spain, have said they support restrictions on trade with settlements, raising the prospect of further penalties that could affect Israeli financial institutions.
paras.zh: 随着定居者进入以前禁止进入的地区，英国上个月谴责了所谓的“种族清洗”，并宣布对定居点实施贸易制裁，称这也将适用于为其建设提供资金的实体。尽管以色列的银行系统并未直接成为制裁的目标，但包括加拿大、法国和西班牙在内的十几个国家已表示支持对定居点贸易的限制，这增加了可能影响以色列金融机构的进一步处罚的可能性。

paras.en: Opponents of Mr. Netanyahu’s government decried his pronouncements, which also drew a rebuke from the generally reserved central bank.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡政府的反对者谴责他的言论，这也招致了总体上持保留态度的央行的谴责。

paras.en: “Crypto currencies cannot serve as a route to bypass sanctions against Israel,” the Bank of Israel said in a statement. The bank added that the government would do better “to focus on preventing sanctions” and preserving Israel’s economic ties with its main trading partners.
paras.zh: 以色列央行在一份声明中表示：“加密货币不能成为绕过对以色列制裁的途径。”该银行补充说，政府将更好地“专注于防止制裁”并维护以色列与其主要贸易伙伴的经济联系。

paras.en: Commentators said that Mr. Netanyahu’s outlook sounded apocalyptic, and some said it was part of a scare campaign to improve his election prospects.
paras.zh: 评论人士表示，内塔尼亚胡先生的前景听起来像是世界末日，一些人表示，这是旨在改善他的选举前景的恐吓活动的一部分。

paras.en: Last year, amid growing global condemnation of the Israeli military’s conduct of the war against Hamas in Gaza, where it has been accused of war crimes, and the imposition of some arms embargoes, he warned that Israel would have to become a more self-sufficient “super-Sparta.” That reference to the ancient, insular Greek city-state that practiced militaristic self-reliance was, to critics, a frightening scenario for a small country whose economy is largely driven by a tech sector that is reliant on foreign investment.
paras.zh: 去年，全球越来越多地谴责以色列军队在加沙对哈马斯发动的战争，以色列被指控犯有战争罪，并实施了一些武器禁运，他警告说，以色列必须成为一个更加自给自足的“超级斯巴达”。在批评者看来，对于一个经济主要由依赖外国投资的科技行业驱动的小国来说，希腊这个实行军国主义自力更生的古希腊城邦是一个可怕的场景。

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, Mr. Netanyahu’s main rival in Tuesday’s election, said in a social media post that the prime minister’s “Bibi-coin vision,” a nod to cryptocurrency, would “dismantle the Israeli economy for generations.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在周二选举中的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特 (Gadi Eisenkot) 在社交媒体帖子中表示，总理的“Bibi-coin 愿景”（对加密货币的认可）将“摧毁以色列几代人的经济”。

paras.en: “No internet purchases, no high-tech investments, no national security,” he added.
paras.zh: “没有互联网购买，没有高科技投资，没有国家安全，”他补充道。

paras.en: Yair Lapid, the opposition leader who has served as prime minister and finance minister, wrote on social media that a vote for Mr. Netanyahu was a vote for “a ruined economy, sanctions that will lead to insane price hikes, and no military alliance with the United States.”
paras.zh: 曾担任总理和财政部长的反对党领袖亚伊尔·拉皮德在社交媒体上写道，投票给内塔尼亚胡先生就是投票给“被破坏的经济、将导致物价疯狂上涨的制裁以及不与美国建立军事联盟”。

paras.en: And a former governor of the Bank of Israel, Jacob Frenkel, told Israel’s Channel 12 on Sunday that moving away from the international financial system would turn Israel into “a leper.”
paras.zh: 以色列银行前行长雅各布·弗伦克尔 (Jacob Frenkel) 周日对以色列第 12 频道表示，脱离国际金融体系将使以色列变成“麻风病人”。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu later walked back his remarks slightly, saying that he had heard the criticism and that cryptocurrency was only one option to deal with potential financial sanctions.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡后来稍微收回了自己的言论，称他听到了批评，加密货币只是应对潜在金融制裁的一种选择。

paras.en: In a somewhat jarring contrast, Mr. Netanyahu’s campaign has argued that Israel’s economy overall is healthy despite years of war, helped by record export revenues, relatively low inflation and unemployment, and a strong shekel.
paras.zh: 与此形成鲜明对比的是，内塔尼亚胡的竞选团队辩称，尽管经历了多年的战争，但得益于创纪录的出口收入、相对较低的通胀和失业率以及坚挺的谢克尔，以色列的经济总体健康。

paras.en: But many Israelis are not feeling it. The State Comptroller, a government watchdog, warned last year that the cost of living was “skyrocketing” in part because of structural challenges in Israel’s consumer market and low competition levels.
paras.zh: 但许多以色列人并没有感觉到。政府监管机构国家审计长去年警告说，生活成本“飙升”，部分原因是以色列消费市场的结构性挑战和低竞争水平。

paras.en: While foreign affairs and national security have dominated the political conversation ahead of the election, a recent survey by the Israel Democracy Institute, a nonpartisan research group, found that the economy was the top issue for many voters heading into Tuesday.
paras.zh: 尽管外交事务和国家安全主导了选举前的政治对话，但无党派研究团体以色列民主研究所最近的一项调查发现，经济是许多选民进入周二的首要问题。

paras.en: The stakes of the Israeli elections are high for Palestinians in the West Bank, but they do not have the right to vote in them.
paras.zh: 对于西岸的巴勒斯坦人来说，以色列选举的赌注很高，但他们没有投票权。

paras.en: In interviews, some Palestinians voiced objections to not being allowed to vote, especially as they felt Israel’s occupation of the West Bank was becoming more permanent.
paras.zh: 在采访中，一些巴勒斯坦人对不被允许投票表示反对，特别是因为他们认为以色列对约旦河西岸的占领正在变得更加永久。

paras.en: “The Israeli government has enormous influence over our lives,” said Montaser Amro, 32, a supermarket owner in Majd, a village near the southern city of Hebron. “It chooses when roadblocks open and close, it controls the borders, and it decides on how much of our economy functions.”
paras.zh: “以色列政府对我们的生活有着巨大的影响力，”32 岁的蒙塔瑟·阿姆罗 (Montaser Amro) 说，他是南部城市希伯伦附近马吉德村的一家超市老板。 “它选择路障何时打开和关闭，它控制边界，并决定我们的经济发挥多少作用。”

paras.en: He added, “Why can’t we vote when settlers living hundreds of meters away can?”
paras.zh: 他补充道，“为什么我们不能投票，而住在数百米外的定居者可以投票？”

paras.en: Israel captured the West Bank in 1967 and reached an agreement with the Palestine Liberation Organization to establish the Palestinian Authority in the 1990s. The Palestinian Authority administers parts of the West Bank and has not held parliamentary or presidential elections for roughly 20 years.
paras.zh: 以色列于1967年占领约旦河西岸，并于20世纪90年代与巴勒斯坦解放组织达成协议建立巴勒斯坦权力机构。巴勒斯坦权力机构管理着约旦河西岸部分地区，大约 20 年没有举行议会或总统选举。

paras.en: Many Palestinians have long hoped the Palestinian Authority would transform into an independent Palestinian state. In recent years, those hopes have dwindled. The Israeli government promotes the expansion of settlements in the West Bank that are widely considered illegal under international law and rejects Palestinian self-determination there and in Gaza. Palestinian officials have also failed to unify their ranks and renew their leadership.
paras.zh: 许多巴勒斯坦人长期以来一直希望巴勒斯坦权力机构能够转变为一个独立的巴勒斯坦国。近年来，这些希望已经越来越渺茫。以色列政府推动在西岸扩建定居点，这些定居点根据国际法被广泛认为是非法的，并拒绝在那里和加沙的巴勒斯坦人自决。巴勒斯坦官员也未能团结他们的队伍并更新他们的领导层。

paras.en: Alaa al-Khabass, 40, a resident of Hebron, said it was unjust that Palestinians could not cast ballots.
paras.zh: 40 岁的希伯伦居民阿拉·哈巴斯 (Alaa al-Khabass) 表示，巴勒斯坦人无法投票是不公正的。

paras.en: “Israel controls just about everything related to us, and I don’t see that changing any time soon,” he said. “We should be able to vote, but we live in painful reality where we lack rights and sovereignty.”
paras.zh: “以色列几乎控制着与我们有关的一切，我认为这种情况不会很快改变，”他说。 “我们应该能够投票，但我们生活在缺乏权利和主权的痛苦现实中。”

paras.en: The election in Israel on Tuesday is unlikely to yield quick answers about who might lead the next government.
paras.zh: 周二的以色列选举不太可能很快给出谁将领导下一届政府的答案。

paras.en: Voters don’t directly pick a prime minister in Israel’s proportional parliamentary system. They choose a party or slate, the first step in determining who may be selected to try to form a government. The process is not guaranteed to succeed and can lead to another election if it does not. Here are four things to watch for.
paras.zh: 在以色列的比例议会制中，选民不会直接选出总理。他们选择一个政党或名单，这是决定谁可以被选来组建政府的第一步。该过程不能保证成功，如果不成功，可能会导致另一次选举。这里有四件事需要注意。

paras.en: This is considered one of the most consequential elections in Israel’s history, and voters turned out in record numbers.
paras.zh: 这被认为是以色列历史上最重要的选举之一，投票人数创历史新高。

paras.en: Recent polls had suggested that voter turnout could be at least as high or higher than in the last general election, in 2022. That year, slightly more than 70 percent of eligible voters — nearly 4.8 million out of nearly 6.8 million people — participated. That election followed four other votes in quick succession from 2019 to 2021 in which turnout hovered near 70 percent.
paras.zh: 最近的民意调查显示，选民投票率可能至少与上一次 2022 年大选一样高或更高。那一年，略高于 70% 的合格选民（近 680 万人中的近 480 万人）参与了投票。在那次选举之后，从 2019 年到 2021 年，又连续进行了四次投票，投票率徘徊在 70% 左右。

paras.en: This year, there are 7.3 million eligible voters, about 540,000 more than in 2022.
paras.zh: 今年，有730万合格选民，比2022年增加约54万。

paras.en: Parties must clear a threshold of 3.25 percent of the total vote in order to get a seat in the Knesset, or Parliament.
paras.zh: 政党必须达到总选票 3.25% 的门槛才能获得以色列议会的席位。

paras.en: But no party is expected to gain a majority of 61 parliamentary seats, according to the polls. That means there will likely be lots of post-election negotiations among those parties who pass the threshold.
paras.zh: 但根据民意调查，预计没有一个政党能够获得 61 个议会席位中的多数席位。这意味着通过门槛的政党之间可能会进行大量的选举后谈判。

paras.en: Parties or lists that do not reach the threshold lose those ballots. As a result, parties and candidates lobby voters not to waste their votes on a list that seems unlikely to meet this criterion.
paras.zh: 未达到门槛的政党或名单将失去这些选票。因此，政党和候选人游说选民不要将选票浪费在似乎不太可能满足这一标准的名单上。

paras.en: At least one party has also faced repeated attacks from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party and the far-right Religious Zionism party led by Bezalel Smotrich, Israel’s finance minister.
paras.zh: 至少有一个政党还面临总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团和以色列财政部长贝扎莱·斯莫特里奇领导的极右翼宗教犹太复国主义党的多次攻击。

paras.en: The targeted party, People of Israel, is led by Ofer Winter, a former Israeli brigadier general with hawkish views on national security. Some polls show that much of Mr. Winter’s support comes from voters who would normally choose Likud. Mr. Winter has faced claims that a vote for his party will be wasted or may end up going to the leading challengers.
paras.zh: 目标政党“以色列人民”由前以色列准将奥弗·温特领导，他对国家安全持鹰派观点。一些民意调查显示，温特先生的大部分支持来自通常会选择利库德集团的选民。温特先生面临着这样的说法，即他的政党的选票将被浪费，或者最终可能会落到主要挑战者手中。

paras.en: While Mr. Winter initially said that he would support Mr. Netanyahu, he has refused any deals to withdraw from the race and has since signaled the pledge may have been premature.
paras.zh: 虽然温特先生最初表示他将支持内塔尼亚胡先生，但他拒绝了任何退出竞选的协议，并表示这一承诺可能为时过早。

paras.en: Israeli election officials have said there is no evidence of threats to the integrity of this election in terms of widespread fraud or vote counting irregularities. But experts are concerned about disinformation campaigns undermining the vote or thwarting turnout.
paras.zh: 以色列选举官员表示，没有证据表明广泛的舞弊或计票违规行为对这次选举的公正性构成威胁。但专家们担心虚假信息活动会破坏投票或阻碍投票率。

paras.en: Critics fear that some moves by the governing right-wing coalition may cast doubt on the outcome even before the vote happens or may thwart turnout among some voters.
paras.zh: 批评者担心，执政的右翼联盟的一些举动可能会在投票发生之前就对结果产生怀疑，或者可能会阻碍一些选民的投票率。

paras.en: Absentee voting is mostly prohibited in Israel. But by some estimates, tens of thousands of Israelis living abroad were expected to fly in to vote, a factor that could potentially swing the outcome.
paras.zh: 以色列基本上禁止缺席投票。但据估计，数万名居住在国外的以色列人预计将飞来投票，这一因素可能会影响结果。

paras.en: Likud had filed a lawsuit challenging an initiative to fly in Israeli voters from abroad — a move widely perceived as an effort to limit opposition voters from showing up. The party had said the nonpartisan program provided benefits that could sway voters in violation of Israeli law. But it withdrew the suit this month after the initiative’s organizers agreed to limit flights and not to defray travelers’ costs.
paras.zh: 利库德集团已提起诉讼，质疑一项从国外飞往以色列选民的倡议——此举被广泛认为是为了限制反对派选民到场。该党曾表示，这项无党派计划提供的好处可能会影响选民，违反了以色列法律。但在该倡议的组织者同意限制航班且不支付旅客费用后，该公司于本月撤回了诉讼。

paras.en: Likud and other right-wing parties also filed motions to limit participation of several Arab candidates in the election.
paras.zh: 利库德集团和其他右翼政党也提出了限制几名阿拉伯候选人参加选举的动议。

paras.en: The Central Elections Committee can vote to bar candidates or lists on certain grounds, such as expressing support for armed conflict against Israel. But the nation’s Supreme Court gets the final say. This month, it rejected a challenge to the Joint List, a merger of three majority-Arab parties, and to Raam, a historically Islamist party led by Mansour Abbas, who is running with Yoav Segalovitz, a former deputy minister of national security who was previously in the centrist Zionist party There Is a Future.
paras.zh: 中央选举委员会可以以某些理由投票禁止候选人或名单，例如表达支持针对以色列的武装冲突。但国家最高法院拥有最终决定权。本月，它拒绝了对“联合名单”（三个占多数阿拉伯政党的合并）以及对由曼苏尔·阿巴斯领导的历史上伊斯兰主义政党拉姆的挑战，阿巴斯与前国家安全部副部长约阿夫·塞加洛维茨一起竞选，后者曾在中间派犹太复国主义政党“有未来”中任职。

paras.en: In 2022, turnout in five of the largest Arab localities in Israel was lower, sometimes significantly, than the national figures. This year, officials in Arab communities worked to get voters to the polls in larger numbers and prepared for potential resistance.
paras.zh: 2022 年，以色列五个最大的阿拉伯地区的投票率低于全国数字，有时甚至显着低于全国数字。今年，阿拉伯社区的官员努力让更多选民参加投票，并为潜在的阻力做好了准备。

paras.en: Likud and the Religious Zionism party announced plans this month to deploy thousands of religious Jewish “observers” to “prevent fraud in voting and vote-counting in Arab communities.”
paras.zh: 利库德集团和宗教犹太复国主义党本月宣布计划部署数千名宗教犹太“观察员”，以“防止阿拉伯社区的投票和计票欺诈”。

paras.en: Critics contend that the presence of such observers, likely from far-right Zionist parties, was intended to intimidate Arab citizens of Israel, who make up 20 percent of the population and could be critical to the election’s outcome.
paras.zh: 批评者认为，这些观察员的出现可能来自极右犹太复国主义政党，目的是恐吓以色列的阿拉伯公民，他们占以色列人口的 20%，可能对选举结果至关重要。

paras.en: “The main issue we want to avoid is ‘fake news,’” said Abed Shahada, who leads voter turnout efforts for an organization representing mayors and other officials in Arab localities.
paras.zh: “我们要避免的主要问题是‘假新闻’，”代表阿拉伯地区市长和其他官员的组织负责选民投票率工作的阿贝德·沙哈达 (Abed Shahada) 说。

paras.en: One major issue expected to drive voters is high crime in Arab communities. But if there are reports of or disinformation about criminal or violent episodes on Election Day that could keep people from the polls, Mr. Shahada said, teams are preparing by setting up a system to share verified information.
paras.zh: 预计将推动选民投票的一大问题是阿拉伯社区的高犯罪率。但沙哈达表示，如果选举日有关于犯罪或暴力事件的报道或虚假信息可能导致人们无法参加投票，各团队正在准备建立一个系统来共享经过验证的信息。

paras.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel accused Arab citizens of “trying to steal the elections” on Tuesday, as he repeatedly used brazen and overtly racial appeals to push his right-wing base to vote.
paras.zh: 周二，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡指责阿拉伯公民“试图窃取选举”，因为他多次利用公然和公开的种族诉求来推动其右翼基地投票。

paras.en: “There are buses heading to the polls and long lines in Arab towns. Meanwhile, right-wing strongholds have yet to wake up!” he said on social media. “If we don’t go vote now, we will find ourselves with a government of Arab parties.”
paras.zh: “有巴士前往投票站，阿拉伯城镇里排着长队。与此同时，右翼据点还没有苏醒！”他在社交媒体上说道。 “如果我们现在不去投票，我们就会发现自己是一个由阿拉伯政党组成的政府。”

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu has a long track record of appealing to his supporters by invoking the specter of the Arab vote. Arab citizens represent about 20 percent of Israel’s population, but have long complained that they are treated as second-class citizens and subject to discrimination.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生长期以来一直通过援引阿拉伯投票的幽灵来吸引他的支持者。阿拉伯公民约占以色列人口的 20%，但长期以来一直抱怨他们被视为二等公民并受到歧视。

paras.en: In 2015, Mr. Netanyahu called on right-wing Israelis to vote because “Arabs were heading in droves to the polls.” His comments were widely condemned at home and abroad, including by the Obama administration. Mr. Netanyahu was accused of race-baiting and was forced to issue an apology for the remark.
paras.zh: 2015年，内塔尼亚胡先生呼吁右翼以色列人投票，因为“阿拉伯人成群结队地前往投票站”。他的言论遭到国内外的广泛谴责，其中包括奥巴马政府。内塔尼亚胡被指控进行种族诱饵，并被迫为该言论道歉。

paras.en: On Tuesday, as initial data showed high turnout in Arab cities and towns, Mr. Netanyahu again used almost the same language to vilify Arab voters in several different statements over the course of the day.
paras.zh: 周二，初步数据显示阿拉伯城镇的投票率很高，内塔尼亚胡先生在当天的几份不同声明中再次使用几乎相同的语言来诽谤阿拉伯选民。

paras.en: “They say their voters are heading to the polls in droves. You too must head to the polls in droves,” Mr. Netanyahu said in a video statement, addressing right-wing voters.
paras.zh: “他们说他们的选民将成群结队地前往投票站。你们也必须成群结队地前往投票站，”内塔尼亚胡在视频声明中对右翼选民说道。

paras.en: Yousef Jabareen, who leads the Joint List alliance of Arab parties, accused Mr. Netanyahu of “inciting against Arab citizens and undermining the legitimacy of our vote.”
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党联合名单联盟的领导人优素福·贾巴林指责内塔尼亚胡“煽动反对阿拉伯公民并破坏我们投票的合法性”。

paras.en: “I’m telling you: the Arab community knows how to punish you,” Mr. Jabareen said. “Today we’re sending you and your bloodstained government packing.”
paras.zh: “我告诉你：阿拉伯社会知道如何惩罚你，”贾巴林先生说。 “今天我们要送你和你沾满血迹的政府走人。”

paras.en: Arab citizens have tended to vote at lower rates than their Jewish counterparts. But in the run-up to this election, surveys suggested that they would turn out in higher numbers in an effort to vote out Mr. Netanyahu and his far-right allies. In Rahat, a large Bedouin town in southern Israel, turnout just before 5 p.m. was already at 60 percent — matching the town’s final turnout in the previous election.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯公民的投票率往往低于犹太公民。但在这次选举前夕，调查显示，为了推翻内塔尼亚胡先生及其极右翼盟友，他们的投票人数会更高。在以色列南部的一个贝都因人大城镇拉哈特，下午 5 点左右就有人参加投票。已经达到 60%——与该镇上次选举的最终投票率相当。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party and some hard-right ministers in his government have also deployed incendiary messaging to appeal to supporters to vote.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团和政府中的一些极右翼部长也发布了煽动性信息，呼吁支持者投票。

paras.en: The Likud party released images suggesting that there had been higher turnout in the Arab city of Rahat than Bat Yam, a Likud stronghold, which it called “a state of emergency.”
paras.zh: 利库德集团发布的图像显示，阿拉伯城市拉哈特的投票率高于利库德集团据点巴特亚姆，该党称其为“紧急状态”。

paras.en: Another poster showed women in Muslim religious veils with the caption: “Right-wing voters, don’t stay home.”
paras.zh: 另一张海报上展示了戴着穆斯林宗教面纱的妇女，并配上标题：“右翼选民，不要呆在家里。”

paras.en: Itamar Ben-Gvir, the far-right national security minister, joined in the prime minister in trying to stoke fears over high Arab turnout. In a video filmed near the entrance of the Arab town of Kufr Qassim in central Israel, he said that Arab voters were heading to the polls “at hitherto never-before-seen rates,” threatening Israel’s Jewish character.
paras.zh: 极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 与总理一起试图引发人们对阿拉伯国家高投票率的担忧。在以色列中部阿拉伯小镇库夫尔卡西姆入口附近拍摄的一段视频中，他说阿拉伯选民“以前所未有的速度”前往投票站，这威胁到了以色列的犹太性格。

paras.en: The prime minister also pointed to the arrests of three people suspected of planning to bribe voters for Raam, an Arab Israeli party, on Tuesday. Dean Livne, the acting director of Israel’s central elections committee, told reporters that there were no reports of widespread irregularities.
paras.zh: 总理还指出，周二逮捕了三名涉嫌计划向阿拉伯以色列政党拉姆选民行贿的人。以色列中央选举委员会代理主任迪安·利夫内告诉记者，没有关于普遍存在违规行为的报道。

paras.en: Lia Lapidot and Johnatan Reiss contributed reporting.
paras.zh: 利亚·拉皮多特和乔纳坦·赖斯贡献了报道。
