paras.en: The reason skeleton and monobob are considered different from two- or four-man bobsled is simply because of the lack of a team aspect. There is only one person on a skeleton sled – the discipline where sliders go headfirst down the track -- and one woman in a monobob.
paras.zh: 骷髅雪橇和单人雪橇被认为不同于两人或四人雪橇的原因仅仅是因为缺乏团队方面。骨架雪橇上只有一个人，即滑行者头朝下沿着轨道滑行的运动，还有一名坐在单人雪橇上的女人。

paras.en: "After thorough discussion and our presentation of facts about the involvement of the Russian Bobsleigh Federation and Russian athletes in actively supporting the actions of their government, and in some cases even their affiliation with the Russian army, a fair decision was adopted by a convincing majority of votes," Ukrainian skeleton athlete Vladyslav Heraskevych wrote in a statement posted on social media.
paras.zh: 乌克兰钢架雪车运动员弗拉迪斯拉夫·赫拉斯克维奇（Vladyslav Heraskevych）在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中写道：“经过深入讨论并介绍了俄罗斯有舵雪橇联合会和俄罗斯运动员积极支持政府行动的事实，甚至在某些情况下他们与俄罗斯军队的关系，最终以令人信服的多数票通过了一项公平的决定。”

paras.en: Heraskevych, a likely medal contender at the Milan-Cortina Games, was barred from racing in his event last February after refusing a last-minute plea by the International Olympic Committee to not use a helmet honoring more than 20 athletes and coaches killed since Russia invaded his country more than four years ago.
paras.zh: Heraskevych可能是米兰-科尔蒂纳奥运会的奖牌竞争者，他在去年2月拒绝了国际奥林匹克委员会的最后一刻请求，即不要使用头盔来纪念自俄罗斯入侵该国四年多以来被杀害的20多名运动员和教练。

paras.en: The first World Cup bobsled and skeleton races of the season are Nov. 27 at Altenberg, Germany.
paras.zh: 本赛季首届世界杯雪橇和钢架雪车比赛将于 11 月 27 日在德国阿尔滕堡举行。

articles.title: Prague honors Roma resistance fighters against Hitler

paras.en: For more than half a million Roma in Czechia and Slovakia, October 15, 2026, marks an important milestone.
paras.zh: 对于捷克和斯洛伐克超过 50 万的罗姆人来说，2026 年 10 月 15 日是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: That day, an exhibition on a largely forgotten chapter of Czech history opened at the Museum of the Romani National Revival in Prague. The exhibit explores the role of Czech and Slovak Romani resistance fighters during the Nazi German occupation and the dismantling of Czechoslovakia from 1938 to 1945.
paras.zh: 那天，一场关于捷克历史上被遗忘的章节的展览在布拉格罗姆民族复兴博物馆开幕。该展览探讨了 1938 年至 1945 年纳粹德国占领和捷克斯洛伐克解体期间捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人抵抗战士的作用。

paras.en: Until now, Czech and Slovak Roma appeared in the history of World War II almost exclusively as victims of the Holocaust against Roma and Sinti. In the so-called Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, Nazi Germany murdered approximately 90% of the Czech Roma during World War II.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人在二战历史上几乎都是作为针对罗姆人和辛提人的大屠杀的受害者出现的。在所谓的波西米亚和摩拉维亚保护国，纳粹德国在第二次世界大战期间杀害了大约 90% 的捷克罗姆人。

paras.en: However, what is less well known is that a large number of Czech and Slovak Roma fought against the German occupiers as partisans in resistance groups and as soldiers in the Czechoslovak Underground Army, or Defense of the Nation, ON.
paras.zh: 然而，鲜为人知的是，大量捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人作为抵抗组织的游击队员和捷克斯洛伐克地下军（或称“保卫国家”）的士兵与德国占领者作战。

paras.en: The exhibition at the Museum of the Roma National Movement therefore marks a turning point in how the Roma are viewed during World War II. At least that is the hope of museum director Emil Scuka, a lawyer, former prosecutor and one of the best-known Czech Roma activists.
paras.zh: 因此，罗姆人民族运动博物馆的展览标志着二战期间如何看待罗姆人的转折点。至少这是博物馆馆长埃米尔·斯卡卡（Emil Scuka）的希望，他是一名律师、前检察官，也是捷克最著名的罗姆活动家之一。

paras.en: "We were not only victims; we were also heroes," Scuka said in his speech to several hundred attendees at the exhibition opening, most of whom were Roma from Czechia and Slovakia. "Many people, not even among the Roma themselves, are aware that we Roma fought against Nazism," he noted. In his view, "organizing and opening the exhibition was something my generation owed to these Roma heroes and today we are repaying that debt."
paras.zh: “我们不仅是受害者；我们也是英雄，”斯卡在展览开幕式上向数百名与会者发表讲话时说，其中大多数是来自捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人。 “许多人，甚至罗姆人自己也不知道，我们罗姆人曾与纳粹主义作斗争，”他指出。在他看来，“组织和举办这次展览是我们这一代人对这些罗马英雄的感谢，今天我们正在偿还这笔债务。”

paras.en: Scuka called on those present: "Bring your children and grandchildren here so they can see for themselves and realize that the Roma have heroes too!"
paras.zh: 斯卡呼吁在场的人：“带你的孩子和孙子来这里，让他们亲眼目睹并认识到罗姆人也有英雄！”

paras.en: He also pointed out that this topic had been completely marginalized in Czech and Slovak historical writing for decades and that the Roma had therefore decided on their own to document the fates of their war heroes.
paras.zh: 他还指出，几十年来，这个话题在捷克和斯洛伐克的历史写作中完全被边缘化，因此罗姆人决定自己决定记录他们的战争英雄的命运。

paras.en: The exhibition presents the detailed life stories of 100 of the most significant Roma partisans and Roma soldiers from the Czech underground army and resistance groups who fought against the Nazis.
paras.zh: 该展览详细介绍了来自捷克地下军和抵抗组织的 100 名最重要的罗姆游击队员和罗姆士兵与纳粹作战的生活故事。

paras.en: "We found over 1,400 Romani fighters in the archives. From among them, we selected the 100 most interesting stories for this exhibition," said exhibition curator Radoslav Scuka at the opening.
paras.zh: 展览策展人拉多斯拉夫·斯卡 (Radoslav Scuka) 在开幕式上表示：“我们在档案中发现了超过 1,400 名罗姆战士。我们从其中挑选了 100 个最有趣的故事来举办这次展览。”

paras.en: Groundbreaking research on Roma resistance fighters
paras.zh: 对罗姆抵抗战士的开创性研究

paras.en: Among these figures is Anton Facuna, a sergeant in the American intelligence agency Office of Strategic Services (OSS), who was flown to Slovakia in October 1944 on a secret mission. Slovakia had been a puppet state of Hitler from 1939 to 1945.
paras.zh: 这些人物中包括美国情报机构战略服务办公室 (OSS) 的中士安东·法库纳 (Anton Facuna)，他于 1944 年 10 月飞往斯洛伐克执行一项秘密任务。 1939年至1945年，斯洛伐克一直是希特勒的傀儡国家。

paras.en: Another is Josef Serinek, known by the nickname "Black Partisan from Vysocina," who managed to escape from the Nazi concentration camp for Roma in Lety and subsequently founded and commanded the large Capajev-Cerny partisan unit in the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands.
paras.zh: 另一位是约瑟夫·塞里内克（Josef Serinek），绰号“来自维索西纳的黑人游击队”，他成功逃离莱蒂的罗姆人纳粹集中营，随后在波西米亚-摩拉维亚高地建立并指挥了大型卡帕耶夫-塞尔尼游击队。

paras.en: In 2022, Czech President Milos Zeman posthumously awarded him the Medal for Heroism. Toward the end of his life, Serinek shared his memories with historian Jan Tesar, who later wrote the three-volume book "Ceska cikanska rapsodie", which translates to Czech Gypsy Rhapsody.
paras.zh: 2022年，捷克总统米洛斯·泽曼追授他英雄主义勋章。在塞里内克生命的最后阶段，塞里内克与历史学家扬·泰萨尔分享了他的记忆，后者后来写了三卷本《Ceska cikanska rapsodie》，翻译过来就是捷克吉普赛狂想曲。

paras.en: Except for Tesar's book, the history of Roma resistance against Nazism has not been researched by Czech and Slovak historians to this day. "I am not aware of any scholarly historical work that deals with Roma resistance against Nazism," Prokop Tomek, a historian at the Military History Institute in Prague, told DW.
paras.zh: 除了特萨尔的书之外，捷克和斯洛伐克的历史学家至今还没有研究过罗姆人抵抗纳粹主义的历史。布拉格军事历史研究所历史学家普罗科普·托梅克 (Prokop Tomek) 告诉德国之声：“我不知道有任何学术历史著作涉及罗姆人反抗纳粹主义的问题。”

paras.en: "The number of 1,400 Roma who took part in the fight against Nazism as members of the resistance or in the foreign army does not strike me as an exaggeration and corresponds to the proportion of the Roma population in Czechoslovakia," Tomek said, adding that the "exhibition on the Roma resistance against Nazism during the war is undoubtedly groundbreaking."
paras.zh: 托梅克说：“在我看来，作为抵抗组织成员或外国军队参加反纳粹斗争的罗姆人有 1,400 人，这一数字并不夸张，这与捷克斯洛伐克罗姆人人口的比例相当。”他补充说，“关于罗姆人在战争期间抵抗纳粹主义的展览无疑是开创性的。”

paras.en: To this day, many Roma in Czechia and Slovakia do not publicly acknowledge their ethnic identity. This is partly due to experiences with the Holocaust during the Nazi era that have been passed down through generations. Czech historians and politicians continue to debate the extent to which the Czech authorities of the Protectorate were complicit in the extermination of the Czech Roma.
paras.zh: 直到今天，捷克和斯洛伐克的许多罗姆人还没有公开承认他们的民族身份。部分原因是纳粹时代代代相传的大屠杀经历。捷克历史学家和政治家继续争论捷克保护国当局在多大程度上参与了灭绝捷克罗姆人的活动。

paras.en: However, one thing is certain: the police registration of all Roma, which had been enshrined in law in Czechoslovakia since 1927, facilitated the extermination of the Roma by the German Nazis.
paras.zh: 然而，有一件事是肯定的：自 1927 年以来，捷克斯洛伐克对所有罗姆人进行警察登记已成为法律，这促进了德国纳粹对罗姆人的灭绝。

paras.en: According to estimates by the Czech government, approximately 250,000 Roma live in the country today. In the 2021 census, however, only 21,000 people identified as Roma.
paras.zh: 据捷克政府估计，目前约有 25 万罗姆人居住在该国。然而，在 2021 年人口普查中，只有 21,000 人被认定为罗姆人。

paras.en: Of all ethnic groups in Czechia, which has a population of 10 million, the Roma are among the three largest ethnic minorities in terms of numbers. However, they are the most socially disadvantaged, have very little political representation, and are therefore scarcely present in Czech politics.
paras.zh: 在拥有1000万人口的捷克各民族中，罗姆人是人口数量最多的三个少数民族之一。然而，他们在社会上处于最不利的地位，几乎没有政治代表性，因此很少出现在捷克政治中。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Gadi Eisenkot campaigns on Moroccan roots in challenge to Netanyahu

paras.en: Campaign posters with various slogans promote the right-wing Likud and the far-right Otzma Yehudit parties. However, one poster is seen more than any others: that of the liberal Yashar party.
paras.zh: 带有各种口号的竞选海报宣传右翼利库德集团和极右翼奥兹马·耶胡迪特政党。然而，有一张海报比其他海报出现得最多：自由派亚沙尔党的海报。

paras.en: Its slogan, "Rosh Memshala Dialna," combines the terms "prime minister" in Hebrew and the words "of our own" in Moroccan Arabic.
paras.zh: 其口号“Rosh Memshala Dialna”结合了希伯来语中的“总理”和摩洛哥阿拉伯语中的“我们自己的”一词。

paras.en: And there is a good reason why Eisenkot's campaign in Sderot and other cities on Israel's sociopolitical periphery focuses on his Moroccan roots.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在斯德洛特和以色列社会政治边缘其他城市的竞选活动重点关注他的摩洛哥根源，这是有充分理由的。

paras.en: Sderot — located in the Negev desert, about 75 kilometers (45 miles) to Tel Aviv's south and just a kilometer away from the Gaza border — is a city with a large Moroccan Jewish community. In recent decades, the city has become symbolic of Moroccan-Jewish culture in Israel, finding its expression in music, cinema and state politics.
paras.zh: 斯德洛特位于内盖夫沙漠，距特拉维夫南部约 75 公里（45 英里），距加沙边境仅一公里，是一座拥有大型摩洛哥犹太人社区的城市。近几十年来，这座城市已成为以色列摩洛哥犹太文化的象征，在音乐、电影和国家政治中都有体现。

paras.en: Historically, Sderot is considered a bastion of the Israeli right, and especially a stronghold of Prime MinisterBenjamin Netanyahu's Likud. In 2022, Likud received more than 40% of the votes in Sderot, compared with 23% nationwide. Other members of Israel's far-right coalition received a lot of support there in the last election.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，斯德洛特被认为是以色列右翼的堡垒，尤其是总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团的据点。 2022年，利库德集团在斯德洛特获得超过40%的选票，而全国这一比例为23%。以色列极右翼联盟的其他成员在上次选举中获得了很多支持。

paras.en: This pattern reflects deeper historical divisions in Israel between Ashkenazim, or Jews of European origin, and Mizrahim, or Jews mostly from Middle Eastern and North African backgrounds. According to estimates, half of Israel's Jewish population is of Mizrahi origin, amounting to about 4 million people.
paras.zh: 这种模式反映了以色列在德系犹太人（欧洲血统的犹太人）和米兹拉希姆（主要来自中东和北非背景的犹太人）之间更深层次的历史分歧。据估计，以色列犹太人口中有一半是米兹拉希裔，约400万人。

paras.en: Mizrahi Jews have faced discrimination and neglect since the early days of the Israeli state. This inequality still shapes the economic and social reality in Israel ― and its political discourse.
paras.zh: 自以色列建国初期以来，米兹拉希犹太人就一直面临歧视和忽视。这种不平等仍然影响着以色列的经济和社会现实及其政治话语。

paras.en: The issue has received special attention in the 2026 campaign. Eisenkot, Netanyahu's major challenger, is of Moroccan origin and grew up in Eilat, a city with a large North African Jewish population. Eisenkot's Yashar party accused Likud of sidelining its Mizrahi politicians. The campaign slogan, "Netanyahu: Let the Mizrahim give interviews,” mocked that omission.
paras.zh: 这个问题在2026年的竞选活动中受到了特别关注。内塔尼亚胡的主要挑战者艾森科特有摩洛哥血统，在埃拉特长大，埃拉特是一个拥有大量北非犹太人口的城市。艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党指责利库德集团排挤其米兹拉希政客。竞选口号“内塔尼亚胡：让米兹拉希姆接受采访”嘲笑了这一遗漏。

paras.en: On live television, the right-wing journalist Yinon Magal — one of Netanyahu's most vocal supporters — claimed that Eisenkot was being controlled by elitist Ashkenazim and called him a "monkey."
paras.zh: 在电视直播中，右翼记者伊农·马加尔（内塔尼亚胡最直言不讳的支持者之一）声称艾森科特受到精英主义德系人士的控制，并称他为“猴子”。

paras.en: Netanyahu, who is of European origin, condemned the remark.
paras.zh: 欧洲裔内塔尼亚胡谴责了这一言论。

paras.en: Morocco-born Daniel Ben-Simon, an award-winning Israeli journalist and a former member of parliament, told DW that Eisenkot's embrace of his roots might have been forced upon him by Magal's comments — but it has historical value nevertheless.
paras.zh: 出生于摩洛哥、屡获殊荣的以色列记者、前议会议员丹尼尔·本-西蒙 (Daniel Ben-Simon) 告诉德国之声，艾森科特可能是因为马加尔的言论而被迫接受自己的根源，但这仍然具有历史价值。

paras.en: "People don't use terms like 'Dialna' with pride," Ben-Simon said, referring to Eisenkot's embrace of the Arabic term "of our own" in campaign posters. He said Israeli society had long tried to erase the Arab identities of North African Jews.
paras.zh: “人们不会自豪地使用‘Dialna’这样的术语，”本-西蒙说，他指的是艾森科特在竞选海报中使用的阿拉伯语术语“我们自己的”。他说，以色列社会长期以来一直试图消除北非犹太人的阿拉伯身份。

paras.en: Eisenkot's embrace of his identity serves as a way of "leaving the frame" set by society. "By using such a term, you're creating a new identity: an Israeli-Moroccan identity," Ben-Simon said. "Eisenkot is the first to allow this double identity to be expressed and still feel at home."
paras.zh: 艾森科特对自己身份的接受是一种“脱离社会设定的框架”的方式。 “通过使用这样的术语，你正在创造一个新的身份：以色列-摩洛哥身份，”本-西蒙说。 “Eisenkot 是第一个允许表达这种双重身份并且仍然有宾至如归的感觉的人。”

paras.en: After Israel's founding, the ruling socialist party, Mapai, whose leadership was largely Ashkenazi, pursued discriminatory policies against Mizrahim. Mizrahim were often expected to "Europeanize” rather than preserve their own culture, heritage, or Arabic language.
paras.zh: 以色列建国后，执政的社会党马派（其领导层主要是阿什肯纳兹人）对米兹拉希姆实行歧视性政策。人们常常期望米兹拉希姆“欧洲化”，而不是保留自己的文化、遗产或阿拉伯语言。

paras.en: These inequalities also took a material form. In the state's early decades, while European immigrants often received better housing and jobs, many Jews from Arab-speaking countries were sent to Ma'abarot, or temporary transit camps, often in remote areas with little infrastructure. Many later became "development towns,” which remained underfunded compared with Israel's central regions. That in turn resulted in poverty. Sderot, in the south, is one of the best-known development towns.
paras.zh: 这些不平等也表现为物质形式。在该州成立的最初几十年，虽然欧洲移民往往能获得更好的住房和工作，但许多来自阿拉伯语国家的犹太人被送往马巴罗特（Ma'abarot）或临时中转营，这些营地通常位于基础设施匮乏的偏远地区。许多后来成为“发展城镇”，与以色列中部地区相比，这些城镇仍然资金不足。这反过来又导致了贫困。南部的斯德洛特是最著名的开发城镇之一。

paras.en: For many Mizrahim, limited access to jobs, education and infrastructure symbolized long-standing exclusion by the Mapai establishment. Likud, founded as a right-wing alliance in 1973, used this frustration effectively under Menachem Begin. Mizrahi support for Begin helped produce the Mahapach, or upheaval, when Likud first defeated the socialist camp and took power. Since then, Mizrahim have often been associated with Likud, even though the party has never had a Mizrahi leader.
paras.zh: 对于许多米兹拉希姆人来说，获得就业、教育和基础设施的机会有限象征着马派机构长期的排斥。 1973 年作为右翼联盟成立的利库德集团在梅纳赫姆·贝京的领导下有效地利用了这种挫败感。当利库德集团首次击败社会主义阵营并掌权时，米兹拉希对贝京的支持促成了马哈帕赫（Mahapach）或剧变。从那时起，米兹拉希姆经常与利库德集团联系在一起，尽管该党从未有过米兹拉希姆领导人。

paras.en: Over the past two decades, Sderot's proximity to Gaza has made the city a frequent target of rocket attacks launched by the militant group Hamas. During the Hamas-led terrorist attacks on October 7, 2023, the city of Sderot was hit especially hard. More than 50 people were killed. In the three years since the attack, the city's population has grown by about 5,000 people, bringing it to 40,000, with many young families making the town their home, both as a result of idealism and government benefits.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年里，斯德罗特靠近加沙，使得该市经常成为激进组织哈马斯发动火箭袭击的目标。 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的恐怖袭击中，斯德洛特市受到的打击尤其严重。超过50人被杀。袭击发生后的三年里，该市人口增加了约 5,000 人，达到 40,000 人，许多年轻家庭在该镇安家落户，这既是理想主义的结果​​，也是政府福利的结果。

paras.en: Walking around the town, it's hard not to notice that the so-called national-religious community is becoming increasingly dominant. This community tends to vote for Bezalel Smotrich's far-right Religious Zionism party, a main member of Netanyahu's coalition. Though votes for Smotrich and his party are de facto votes for Netanyahu's bloc, the prime minister's Likud party itself could suffer losses in Sderot.
paras.zh: 走在镇上，很难不注意到所谓的民族宗教团体正变得越来越占主导地位。这个社区倾向于投票支持贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇领导的极右宗教犹太复国主义党，该党是内塔尼亚胡联盟的主要成员。尽管斯莫特里奇及其政党的选票实际上是内塔尼亚胡集团的选票，但总理所在的利库德集团本身可能会在斯德洛特遭受损失。

paras.en: Regardless of the election's results, the perception of Sderot as a city of Moroccan Jews is not bound to change anytime soon. Ben-Simon said Eisenkot's election could serve as an opportunity for reshaping Moroccan Jews' future identity in Israel.
paras.zh: 无论选举结果如何，斯德洛特作为摩洛哥犹太人城市的看法不会很快改变。本-西蒙表示，艾森科特的当选可能成为重塑摩洛哥犹太人未来在以色列身份的机会。

paras.en: "The connection cities like Sderot have to their Moroccan roots would grow stronger as a result of an Eisenkot win," Ben-Simon said.
paras.zh: “艾森科特获胜后，像斯德洛特这样的城市与其摩洛哥根源的联系将会变得更加紧密，”本-西蒙说。

articles.title: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny

paras.en: The first confirmed Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria may have crossed paths at Uganda's Entebbe International Airport, according to African health officials, as new information from Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account of the Nigerian patient's travel history.
paras.zh: 非洲卫生官员称，肯尼亚和尼日利亚首例确诊的埃博拉患者可能曾在乌干达恩德培国际机场相遇，因为来自瑞士的新信息与乌干达对尼日利亚患者旅行史的描述相矛盾。

paras.en: Uganda, a country reporting no active Ebola infections, has become a focus of investigations into cases thousands of kilometers apart.
paras.zh: 乌干达没有报告活跃的埃博拉感染病例，已成为相距数千公里的病例调查的焦点。

paras.en: Uganda insists that it has no confirmed active cases of the deadly virus. Yet health authorities in Kenya and Nigeria are investigating Ebola infections involving people whose travel histories or contacts are connected to the East African nation.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的致命病毒活跃病例。然而，肯尼亚和尼日利亚的卫生当局正在调查涉及与东非国家有旅行史或接触史的人的埃博拉感染情况。

paras.en: Both patients passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, according to Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC).
paras.zh: 非洲疾病控制和预防中心 (Africa CDC) 应急准备和响应负责人韦萨姆·曼库拉 (Wessam Mankoula) 表示，两名患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。

paras.en: Health officials say the two may have crossed paths, although it has not been established whether they encountered each other or whether any transmission occurred at the airport.
paras.zh: 卫生官员表示，两人可能有过接触，但尚不清楚他们是否相遇，也不清楚是否在机场发生了传播。

paras.en: The differing accounts have raised questions about whether Uganda was simply a transit point for infected travelers. Or could infections be going undetected along some of Africa's busiest cross-border routes?
paras.zh: 不同的说法引发了人们的疑问：乌干达是否只是受感染旅行者的中转站。或者，在非洲一些最繁忙的跨境路线上，感染是否可能未被发现？

paras.en: The latest developments come after Switzerland disputed claims that the Nigerian patient had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where an Ebola outbreak is underway.
paras.zh: 最新事态发展是在瑞士对尼日利亚患者曾访问过正在爆发埃博拉疫情的刚果民主共和国的说法提出质疑之后发布的。

paras.en: Did the two Ebola patients cross paths in Uganda?
paras.zh: 两名埃博拉患者是否在乌干达相遇？

paras.en: Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate confirmed an Ebola case in the capital, Abuja, involving a woman who had recently traveled to East Africa, including Uganda.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚卫生部长穆罕默德·阿里·帕特证实首都阿布贾发生埃博拉病例，涉及一名最近前往东非（包括乌干达）的妇女。

paras.en: "Today we are confirming that there has been one imported case of Ebola virus disease in the Federal Capital Territory," Pate said.
paras.zh: 佩特说：“今天我们确认联邦首都地区出现一例输入性埃博拉病毒病病例。”

paras.en: The woman developed symptoms on October 7 and visited a private health facility on October 11. Further laboratory testing confirmed Ebola, and she was subsequently isolated for treatment.
paras.zh: 该女子于10月7日出现症状，并于10月11日到一家私人医疗机构就诊。进一步的实验室检测证实她感染了埃博拉病毒，随后她被隔离接受治疗。

paras.en: Pate said the patient was stable and health officials had identified 44 contacts, including health care workers, caregivers, patients and people who may have encountered her during her travels.
paras.zh: 佩特表示，该患者情况稳定，卫生官员已确定了 44 名接触者，包括医护人员、护理人员、患者以及可能在她旅行期间遇到过她的人。

paras.en: But the woman's journey has become central to the investigation.
paras.zh: 但这名女子的旅程已成为调查的核心。

paras.en: Speaking on Thursday, Mankoula said the first confirmed patients in Kenya and Nigeria were both known to have traveled through Entebbe International Airport on October 3. Investigators are examining whether the two patients were at the airport at the same time and whether their movements overlapped.
paras.zh: 曼库拉周四表示，已知肯尼亚和尼日利亚的首例确诊患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。调查人员正在检查这两名患者是否同时到达机场以及他们的活动是否重叠。

paras.en: Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account
paras.zh: 瑞士反驳乌干达的说法

paras.en: Uganda's Health Ministry says preliminary findings indicate that the Nigerian patient traveled to eastern DRCfor business before passing through Uganda without symptoms and returning to Nigeria.
paras.zh: 乌干达卫生部表示，初步调查结果表明，这名尼日利亚患者前往刚果民主共和国东部出差，然后在没有症状的情况下经过乌干达并返回尼日利亚。

paras.en: "Travel through Uganda does not establish that infection occurred here. The location of exposure remains under investigation," the ministry said in an October 20 statement.
paras.zh: 该部在 10 月 20 日的一份声明中表示：“通过乌干达旅行并不能证明这里发生了感染。暴露地点仍在调查中。”

paras.en: But, on Friday, Switzerland's Federal Department of Foreign Affairs directly disputed the account.
paras.zh: 但周五，瑞士联邦外交部直接对这一说法提出质疑。

paras.en: "She and her husband did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo," the department said in a statement to Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: “她和她的丈夫没有前往刚果民主共和国，”该部门在给路透社的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The woman, identified by Swiss authorities as a Swiss national of Ugandan origin, is married to a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja.
paras.zh: 瑞士当局确认该女子为乌干达裔瑞士国民，嫁给了驻阿布贾的一名瑞士外交官。

paras.en: On Thursday, the Swiss government told Reuters that she was believed to have contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband in Uganda, although that assessment has not been independently confirmed.
paras.zh: 周四，瑞士政府告诉路透社，据信她与丈夫在乌干达旅行时感染了埃博拉病毒，尽管这一评估尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa CDC also said Thursday that they had not received confirmed information establishing that the woman had traveled to the DRC.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）和非洲疾病预防控制中心周四也表示，他们尚未收到证实该妇女曾前往刚果民主共和国的信息。

paras.en: The conflicting accounts raise fresh questions about where the woman was exposed to the virus and how accurately her movements were initially reconstructed. They do not, however, establish that she contracted Ebola in Uganda.
paras.zh: 这些相互矛盾的说法引发了新的问题：这名妇女在哪里接触了病毒，以及最初重建她的动作的准确性如何。然而，他们并没有证实她在乌干达感染了埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: Uganda maintains that it has no confirmed active Ebola cases and says it is awaiting more detailed information from Nigeria about the woman's movements.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的埃博拉活跃病例，并表示正在等待尼日利亚提供有关该妇​​女活动的更多详细信息。

paras.en: Kenya's missing contact complicates investigation
paras.zh: 肯尼亚失踪联系人使调查变得复杂

paras.en: In Kenya, Uganda has emerged in a separate investigation involving the country's first confirmed Ebola patient, who died in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, on October 5. The patient had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda before reaching Kenya.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，乌干达出现在另一项调查中，涉及该国首例确诊的埃博拉患者，该患者于 10 月 5 日在肯尼亚首都内罗毕死亡。该患者从刚果民主共和国经乌干达抵达肯尼亚。

paras.en: Health officials have now established that the patient passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, the same day as the woman subsequently diagnosed in Nigeria. Kenyan authorities have since reported additional infections linked to the initial case.
paras.zh: 卫生官员现已确定，该患者于 10 月 3 日通过恩德培国际机场，与随后在尼日利亚确诊的该妇女同一天。此后，肯尼亚当局报告了与最初病例有关的更多感染病例。

paras.en: But one aspect of the investigation remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 但调查的一个方面仍未解决。

paras.en: According to Kenya's Daily Nation, health officials are searching for a Ugandan national identified as a contact of the deceased patient.
paras.zh: 据肯尼亚《国家日报》报道，卫生官员正在寻找一名与死者有过接触的乌干达国民。

paras.en: "We know him (the Ugandan) by name and passport number and from his phone but we are not able to reach him," Kenya's director-general for health, Patrick Amoth, told the newspaper.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯告诉该报：“我们通过姓名、护照号码以及电话号码认识了他（乌干达人），但我们无法联系到他。”

paras.en: The Daily Nation reported that the man was using a South Sudanese telephone number, complicating efforts to establish his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 据《国家日报》报道，该男子使用的是南苏丹的电话号码，这使得确定他的下落变得更加困难。

paras.en: Being an untraced contact does not mean that he is infected. However, locating potentially exposed individuals is essential to preventing further transmission.
paras.zh: 未被追踪的接触者并不意味着他被感染了。然而，找到可能暴露的个人对于防止进一步传播至关重要。

paras.en: Uganda shares a lengthy border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola outbreaks have repeatedly challenged health authorities.
paras.zh: 乌干达与刚果民主共和国有着漫长的边界，那里的埃博拉疫情多次给卫生当局带来挑战。

paras.en: Cross-border trade, population movements and international travel make it difficult to establish where someone was exposed to the virus.
paras.zh: 跨境贸易、人口流动和国际旅行使得确定某人接触该病毒的地点变得困难。

paras.en: Ebola symptoms typically develop two to 21 days after infection. According to the WHO, people infected with Ebola are not considered infectious until symptoms appear.
paras.zh: 埃博拉症状通常在感染后 2 至 21 天出现。根据世界卫生组织的说法，埃博拉病毒感染者在出现症状之前并不被认为具有传染性。

paras.en: Even well-functioning border surveillance systems cannot identify every infected traveler.
paras.zh: 即使运作良好的边境监控系统也无法识别每一位受感染的旅行者。

paras.en: The discovery that both patients traveled through the same international airport on the same day illustrates the complexity of tracing potential exposures across multiple countries. It also highlights the importance of reconstructing travel histories and identifying close contacts.
paras.zh: 两名患者在同一天经过同一国际机场的发现说明了追踪多个国家潜在暴露的复杂性。它还强调了重建旅行历史和识别密切接触者的重要性。

paras.en: Uganda says it is strengthening screening and public health controls at points of entry. Nigeria has intensified contact tracing and infection prevention measures.
paras.zh: 乌干达表示正在加强入境口岸的筛查和公共卫生控制。尼日利亚加强了接触者追踪和感染预防措施。

paras.en: The challenge is ensuring that authorities across different countries can exchange accurate information quickly enough to identify potential exposures.
paras.zh: 挑战在于确保不同国家的当局能够足够快地交换准确的信息，以识别潜在的风险。

paras.en: In Abuja, the confirmed infection has revived memories of previous Ebola outbreaks. Resident Peace Kolawole expressed concern about the consequences of another outbreak. "So here is my hand sanitizer, so I'm actually very concerned about it," she told DW.
paras.zh: 在阿布贾，确诊的感染事件让人们重新回忆起之前爆发的埃博拉疫情。居民 Peace Kolawole 对再次爆发的后果表示担忧。 “这是我的洗手液，所以我实际上非常担心它，”她告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Others fear that Nigeria's health care system may struggle to respond while many citizens face economic hardship. "Because now people are not even worried about sickness anymore, people are worried about surviving," Abuja resident Jonathan Steven told DW.
paras.zh: 其他人担心尼日利亚的医疗保健系统可能难以应对，而许多公民面临经济困难。阿布贾居民乔纳森·史蒂文告诉德国之声：“因为现在人们不再担心疾病，而是担心生存。”

paras.en: Nigeria's health authorities say the patient is receiving medical care and contact tracing is continuing.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚卫生当局表示，该患者正在接受医疗护理，并且正在继续追踪接触者。

paras.en: Uganda's position between the DRC and other regional destinations offers one explanation for its appearance in both investigations.
paras.zh: 乌干达介于刚果民主共和国和其他地区目的地之间的立场为其出现在两项调查中提供了一种解释。

paras.en: But the latest findings have added two significant questions: Did the patients from Kenya and Nigeria come into contact at Entebbe International Airport on October 3? And where did the Nigerian woman contract the virus if, as Switzerland insists, she never traveled to DR Congo?
paras.zh: 但最新发现又增加了两个重要问题：来自肯尼亚和尼日利亚的患者是否于10月3日在恩德培国际机场有过接触？如果正如瑞士坚称的那样，这名尼日利亚妇女从未去过刚果民主共和国，那么她是在哪里感染病毒的呢？

paras.en: The conflicting accounts from Uganda and Switzerland have made establishing the Nigerian patient's travel history an urgent part of the investigation. The WHO and Africa CDC have yet to confirm the disputed DR Congo travel history.
paras.zh: 乌干达和瑞士的说法相互矛盾，使得确定尼日利亚患者的旅行史成为调查的紧迫部分。世界卫生组织和非洲疾病预防控制中心尚未确认有争议的刚果民主共和国旅行史。

paras.en: Uganda's declaration of zero confirmed active cases does not establish that all infections have been ruled out. Equally, the travel histories do not prove an undetected outbreak.
paras.zh: 乌干达宣布零确诊活跃病例并不能证明所有感染都已被排除。同样，旅行历史并不能证明疫情未被发现。

paras.en: For Kenya and Nigeria, the immediate priority is containing confirmed infections. For Uganda, the challenge is demonstrating that its surveillance systems are effective and reassuring both its citizens and neighboring countries.
paras.zh: 对于肯尼亚和尼日利亚来说，当务之急是控制确诊感染。对于乌干达来说，面临的挑战是证明其监控系统有效并让其公民和邻国放心。

paras.en: The Africa CDC will convene an "extraordinary virtual meeting" of national health officials on October 28 as the continent's latest Ebola outbreak continues to spread.
paras.zh: 随着非洲大陆最新的埃博拉疫情继续蔓延，非洲疾病预防控制中心将于 10 月 28 日召开一次由国家卫生官员组成的“特别虚拟会议”。

articles.title: Syria-Jordan border reopens amid probe into deadly air strikes

paras.en: Syria is reopening its border crossing with Jordan, and the two countries will investigate Jordanian strikes on suspected ISIL (ISIS) sites that killed seven in southern Syria.
paras.zh: 叙利亚正在重新开放与约旦的过境点，两国将调查约旦对叙利亚南部疑似伊斯兰国（ISIS）地点的袭击，造成七人死亡。

paras.en: Nassib, Jordan’s only border crossing with Syria, will reopen on Wednesday morning, with regular passenger and commercial traffic resuming, the state news agency SANA reported.
paras.zh: 据国家通讯社 SANA 报道，纳西布是约旦与叙利亚唯一的过境点，将于周三上午重新开放，并恢复常规客运和商业交通。

paras.en: The crossing was briefly closed following the Jordanian airstrikes, which targeted ISIL “hideouts” in southern Syria on Monday in response to a Greek Orthodox church shooting by gunmen in Jordan’s Karak on Friday, the Jordanian military said in a statement. ISIL took responsibility for the attack.
paras.zh: 约旦军方在一份声明中表示，约旦周一针对叙利​​亚南部的伊斯兰国“藏身处”发动空袭，以回应周五约旦卡拉克希腊东正教教堂遭枪手枪击事件，该过境点被短暂关闭。伊斯兰国承认对此次袭击负责。

paras.en: Jordan’s strikes on Syria killed at least seven people in Deraa and Suwayda, including five members of the same family, three of whom were children. Syria’s Ministry of Emergency and Disaster Management said its teams had responded to attacks at four sites.
paras.zh: 约旦对叙利亚的袭击导致德拉和苏韦达至少七人死亡，其中包括同一家庭的五名成员，其中三人是儿童。叙利亚紧急和灾害管理部表示，其团队已对四个地点的袭击事件做出反应。

paras.en: The two countries also agreed to form a security committee to examine the aftermath of the strikes, foreign ministers said in a statement following a phone call between the two countries’ top diplomats.
paras.zh: 两国外交部长在两国高级外交官通电话后发表的声明中表示，两国还同意成立一个安全委员会来研究袭击的后果。

paras.en: Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi said Monday’s air attacks were based on field intelligence and aimed at “neutralising confirmed threats and imminent terrorist operations targeting Jordan’s security”.
paras.zh: 约旦外交部长艾曼·萨法迪表示，周一的空袭是基于现场情报，旨在“消除针对约旦安全的已确认的威胁和迫在眉睫的恐怖行动”。

paras.en: Safadi expressed “deep regret” over civilian deaths in his call with Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani and stressed Jordan’s respect for Syria’s sovereignty and stability.
paras.zh: 萨法迪在与叙利亚外长阿萨德·沙巴尼的通话中对平民死亡表示“深切遗憾”，并强调约旦尊重叙利亚的主权和稳定。

paras.en: Jordan had claimed that the strikes were coordinated with the Syrian government, which Damascus denied.
paras.zh: 约旦声称袭击是与叙利亚政府协调的，但大马士革否认了这一点。

paras.en: In addition to investigating the attacks, the security committee will develop “field and intelligence coordination in dealing with terrorist threats” to ensure the protection of innocent civilians.
paras.zh: 除了调查袭击事件外，安全委员会还将开展“应对恐怖主义威胁的现场和情报协调”，以确保保护无辜平民。

paras.en: The church shooting claimed the lives of at least nine people and wounded 34 others. Jordanian security forces arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law on suspicion of carrying out the attack.
paras.zh: 教堂枪击事件造成至少 9 人死亡、34 人受伤。约旦安全部队因涉嫌实施袭击而逮捕了两兄弟及其妹夫。

articles.title: Global stock markets rise as investors continue to bet on AI

paras.en: Global stock markets have climbed as investors continue to bet on bright prospects for the tech giants driving the AI boom.
paras.zh: 随着投资者继续押注推动人工智能繁荣的科技巨头的光明前景，全球股市上涨。

paras.en: In the United States, all three major stock indexes rose on Tuesday, led by the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite, which gained 1.18 percent.
paras.zh: 美国三大股指周二均上涨，其中以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数领涨，上涨 1.18%。

paras.en: The benchmark S&P 500 rose 0.6 percent, while the narrower Dow Jones Industrial Average edged up 0.03 percent.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.6%，道琼斯工业平均指数小幅上涨 0.03%。

paras.en: Five of the “Magnificent Seven” tech stocks rose, led by Tesla, up 4.04 percent.
paras.zh: “七大”科技股中有五只上涨，其中特斯拉领涨，上涨 4.04%。

paras.en: Amazon gained 1.61 percent, while Apple and Alphabet gained 0.93 percent and 0.9 percent, respectively.
paras.zh: 亚马逊上涨 1.61%，苹果和 Alphabet 分别上涨 0.93% 和 0.9%。

paras.en: Nvidia, the world’s most valuable public company, rose almost 1 percent after announcing a $3bn investment in Meta’s equity offering.
paras.zh: 全球市值最高的上市公司英伟达 (Nvidia) 宣布投资 30 亿美元投资 Meta 股票发行后，股价上涨近 1%。

paras.en: Meta fell 1.64 percent, while Microsoft fell 0.24 percent.
paras.zh: Meta 下跌 1.64%，微软下跌 0.24%。

paras.en: Other big movers in tech included Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom and Intel, which gained 5.45 percent, 4 percent and 3.61 percent, respectively.
paras.zh: 其他科技股的大涨包括 Advanced Micro Devices、Broadcom 和 Intel，分别上涨 5.45%、4% 和 3.61%。

paras.en: Gains continued in the Asia Pacific on Wednesday, with stock markets in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Australia climbing.
paras.zh: 周三亚太地区继续上涨，日本、韩国、台湾和澳大利亚的股市攀升。

paras.en: The KOSPI in Seoul led the gains, with the benchmark index up 5.84 percent as of 03:00 GMT.
paras.zh: 首尔 KOSPI 指数领涨，截至格林威治标准时间 03:00 基准指数上涨 5.84%。

paras.en: The surge came as South Korea’s SK Hynix, one of the world’s top three memory chip makers, announced blockbuster third-quarter results on Wednesday, with operating profit soaring about 630 percent year-on-year to 83.33 trillion won ($62.8bn).
paras.zh: 全球三大存储芯片制造商之一的韩国 SK 海力士周三公布了重磅第三季度业绩，营业利润同比飙升约 630% 至 83.33 万亿韩元（628 亿美元）。

paras.en: SK Hynix shares listed in South Korea surged more than 8 percent following the results.
paras.zh: 业绩公布后，韩国上市的 SK 海力士股价飙升逾 8%。

paras.en: In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 was up 1.26 percent, while the TAIEX in Taipei was up 1.32 percent.
paras.zh: 东京基准日经 225 指数上涨 1.26%，台北 TAIEX 指数上涨 1.32%。

paras.en: The S&P/ASX 200 in Sydney was up 0.11 percent.
paras.zh: 悉尼 S&P/ASX 200 指数上涨 0.11%。

paras.en: Investors are keenly anticipating upcoming earnings reports from major tech players as they try to gauge whether their massive investments in AI will pay dividends.
paras.zh: 投资者热切期待主要科技公司即将发布的收益报告，因为他们试图衡量他们对人工智能的大规模投资是否会带来红利。

paras.en: Microsoft and Alphabet report their latest results on Wednesday, followed by Amazon on Thursday and Apple on Monday.
paras.zh: 微软和 Alphabet 将于周三公布最新业绩，亚马逊于周四公布，苹果于周一公布。

paras.en: On Monday, AI giant Anthropic filed paperwork for its hotly anticipated IPO, reporting a net loss of $80.7bn in the first half of 2026 on $16.3bn in revenue.
paras.zh: 周一，人工智能巨头 Anthropic 为其备受期待的 IPO 提交了文件，报告称 2026 年上半年净亏损 807 亿美元，营收 163 亿美元。

paras.en: Tech firms have poured hundreds of billions of dollars each into AI infrastructure, fuelling debate over whether a speculative market bubble could be forming similar to the one that preceded the 2000 dot-com crash.
paras.zh: 科技公司各自向人工智能基础设施投入了数千亿美元，引发了关于投机性市场泡沫是否可能形成类似于 2000 年互联网泡沫之前的泡沫的争论。

paras.en: Global AI investment is forecast to hit $2.7 trillion in 2026 and $3.6 trillion in 2027, according to Gartner, a technology insights company.
paras.zh: 技术洞察公司 Gartner 预计，2026 年全球人工智能投资将达到 2.7 万亿美元，2027 年将达到 3.6 万亿美元。

paras.en: Oil prices, which have been elevated since the start of the US-Israel war on Iran, rose about 1 percent as Asian markets opened on Wednesday amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, including hostilities between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis.
paras.zh: 自美以对伊朗战争爆发以来，油价一直在上涨，周三亚洲市场开盘时，由于中东冲突持续不断，其中包括沙特阿拉伯和也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装之间的敌对行动，油价上涨了约1%。

paras.en: Futures for Brent crude, the global benchmark, stood at about $115 a barrel, up 59 percent from before the war began.
paras.zh: 全球基准布伦特原油期货价格约为每桶 115 美元，比战前上涨 59%。

articles.title: Mahmoud Khalil credits Palestinian activism for reshaping US politics

paras.en: Pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil says campus advocacy has shifted public perception and encouraged a generation of leaders to question their views on Israel, speaking as he returned to Columbia University for the first time since his arrest.
paras.zh: 亲巴勒斯坦活动人士马哈茂德·哈利勒表示，校园宣传改变了公众的看法，并鼓励一代领导人质疑他们对以色列的看法。他在被捕后首次返回哥伦比亚大学时发表了讲话。

paras.en: The 31-year-old Columbia graduate, who became a figurehead of the campus movement that swept the United States in 2024, returned to campus on Tuesday to discuss his new memoir, No Land to Stand On: Notes from Detention, marking his first visit since his arrest on March 8, 2025.
paras.zh: 这位 31 岁的哥伦比亚大学毕业生成为 2024 年席卷美国的校园运动的名义领袖，他于周二返回校园讨论他的新回忆录《无立足之地：拘留笔记》，这是他自 2025 年 3 月 8 日被捕以来的首次访问。

paras.en: “The American public is finally changing, is finally looking at the Palestinian as an equal human,” he told the AFP news agency in an interview.
paras.zh: 他在接受法新社采访时表示：“美国公众终于发生了变化，终于将巴勒斯坦人视为平等的人。”

paras.en: While Khalil described the event, attended by about 100 people, as a “victory”, he accused university leadership of seeking “to erase me, to erase any Palestinian voices on campus”.
paras.zh: 卡利勒将这次约有 100 人参加的活动描述为一次“胜利”，但他指责大学领导层试图“抹掉我，抹掉校园里任何巴勒斯坦人的声音”。

paras.en: Some Jewish groups on social media opposed his return to campus. In response, a Columbia spokesperson said the university is “committed to rigorous debate, inquiry, and respectful dialogue across differing perspectives”.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的一些犹太团体反对他重返校园。对此，哥伦比亚大学发言人表示，该校“致力于针对不同观点进行严格的辩论、调查和尊重的对话”。

paras.en: “Columbia supports the right of faculty members to organize academic events,” the statement carried by US media read. “An invitation to speak does not signify university endorsement of a speaker’s views.”
paras.zh: 美国媒体发表的声明称：“哥伦比亚支持教职员工组织学术活动的权利。” “邀请演讲并不意味着大学认可演讲者的观点。”

paras.en: Khalil helped lead student demonstrations at Columbia in 2024, which became the epicentre of nationwide campus protests against Israel’s genocidal war in Gaza. He was later arrested by immigration authorities at the height of a federal crackdown on foreign student activists and held for three months without criminal charge, despite holding permanent US residency.
paras.zh: 2024 年，哈利勒帮助领导了哥伦比亚大学的学生示威活动，该校成为全国校园抗议以色列在加沙的种族灭绝战争的中心。尽管他拥有美国永久居留权，但他后来在联邦打击外国学生活动人士最激烈的时候被移民当局逮捕，并在没有刑事指控的情况下被关押了三个月。

paras.en: He has repeatedly slammed the university for its handling of the demonstrations, which included authorising the New York Police Department to clear protesters from the Manhattan campus.
paras.zh: 他多次批评该大学对示威活动的处理方式，其中包括授权纽约警察局将抗议者从曼哈顿校园清除。

paras.en: “They chose brutality. They chose repression,” Khalil told AFP.
paras.zh: 卡利勒告诉法新社：“他们选择了残暴。他们选择了镇压。”

paras.en: Columbia maintained at the time that the demonstrations presented a safety threat. Khalil also accused the university of failing to protect him from harassment prior to his detention.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚当时坚称示威活动构成安​​全威胁。卡里尔还指责大学未能在他被拘留之前保护他免受骚扰。

paras.en: Despite the personal toll, Khalil credited Palestinian student advocacy with driving broader political shifts in the United States, pointing to gains by progressive candidates.
paras.zh: 尽管造成个人损失，哈利勒仍认为巴勒斯坦学生的倡导推动了美国更广泛的政治转变，并指出进步候选人取得了进展。

paras.en: “Also, we can see on the ground that we have more progressive candidates being elected into US Congress and positions of power,” he said, citing candidates like Dr Abdul El-Sayed, running for the US Senate in Michigan, and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani.
paras.zh: 他说：“此外，我们可以看到，有更多进步的候选人被选入美国国会并担任权力职位。”他引用了竞选密歇根州美国参议院议员的阿卜杜勒·赛义德博士和纽约市市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼等候选人的话。

paras.en: Khalil was released from immigration custody on June 20, 2025, though the Trump administration continues to seek his deportation.
paras.zh: 哈利勒于 2025 年 6 月 20 日从移民拘留所获释，但特朗普政府仍在寻求将他驱逐出境。

paras.en: “A big part of my fight is like fighting for normalcy,” he said. “To go back to being the young father who would go to the park with his son and wife, and no one would bother them.”
paras.zh: “我的斗争的很大一部分就是为常态而战，”他说。 “回到年轻的父亲身边，和儿子和妻子一起去公园，没有人会打扰他们。”

paras.en: Despite the ongoing legal battle, he expressed resolve over his public role.
paras.zh: 尽管法律斗争仍在继续，但他表达了对自己公共角色的决心。

paras.en: “My fight is not only about whether I get to stay in this country,” Khalil said. “It is about whether, you know, people in this country can speak their minds.”
paras.zh: “我的斗争不仅仅是关于我是否能留在这个国家，”哈利勒说。 “你知道，这关系到这个国家的人们能否说出自己的想法。”

articles.title: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
articles.author: Jonathan Lambert

paras.en: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records — and just marked a grim milestone
paras.zh: 埃博拉疫情正在打破记录——并且刚刚标志着一个严峻的里程碑

paras.en: The fastest spreading Ebola outbreak in history has surpassed another grim milestone. More than 10,000 people have been infected since the outbreak was first declared in May, according to the latest government figures from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
paras.zh: 历史上传播速度最快的埃博拉疫情已经超越了另一个严峻的里程碑。根据刚果民主共和国政府的最新数据，自 5 月份首次宣布疫情爆发以来，已有超过 10,000 人被感染。

paras.en: "It's a milestone that we're all surprised to be passing this quickly," says Katie Thomas-Canfield, interim Ebola response director for the International Rescue Committee. "10,000 people affected by Ebola in such a short period is really staggering," she says, noting that at this point in the West Africa outbreak of 2014-2016, only about 4,000 people had been infected. But that earlier outbreak still has the highest case count — more than 28,000 cases.
paras.zh: 国际救援委员会埃博拉应对临时主任凯蒂·托马斯·坎菲尔德说：“这是一个里程碑，我们都惊讶于这么快就过去了。”她说：“在如此短的时间内就有 10,000 人受到埃博拉病毒影响，这确实令人震惊。”她指出，在 2014-2016 年西非疫情爆发期间，只有约 4,000 人受到感染。但早些时候爆发的病例数仍然是最高的——超过 28,000 例。

paras.en: The current outbreak is also the largest ever in geographic scope, spanning Nigeria to Kenya. It is second in the death toll, with nearly 5,000 deaths compared to the previous toll of over 11,000.
paras.zh: 目前的疫情也是地理范围内有史以来最大规模的一次，从尼日利亚到肯尼亚。死亡人数排名第二，死亡人数接近 5,000 人，而之前的死亡人数超过 11,000 人。

paras.en: About a third of those who've died in this outbreak have been kids. Children under 5, with their developing immune systems, are hit especially hard — roughly three out of four infected have died.
paras.zh: 在这次疫情中死亡的人中约有三分之一是儿童。 5 岁以下儿童的免疫系统正在发育，受到的打击尤其严重——大约四分之三的感染者已死亡。

paras.en: "Behind every figure is a life interrupted, a family mourning, a health worker under pressure and a community seeking reassurance," said Mohamed Janabi, regional director for the World Health Organization Africa, at a press conference last week. "We must reach people earlier, bring safe care closer, and strengthen trust before fear becomes a barrier to survival."
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比（Mohamed Janabi）在上周的新闻发布会上表示：“每个数字的背后都是生命的中断、家庭的哀悼、承受压力的卫生工作者以及寻求安慰的社区。” “我们必须更早地接触到人们，让安全护理更近，并加强信任，以免恐惧成为生存的障碍。”

paras.en: Here's a look at some of the key questions about the 2026 outbreak.
paras.zh: 以下是有关 2026 年疫情爆发的一些关键问题。

paras.en: Why has the outbreak become so bad so fast?
paras.zh: 为什么疫情会如此严重、如此迅速？

paras.en: Part of the answer lies in uncertainty over when the virus started circulating
paras.zh: 部分答案在于病毒何时开始传播的不确定性

paras.en: While the outbreak was officially declared in May, more recent evidence suggests the virus likely started spreading in February or March.
paras.zh: 虽然五月正式宣布疫情爆发，但最近的证据表明该病毒可能在二月或三月开始传播。

paras.en: "That's a really long time for things to be undetected in communities, and that means we started at a disadvantage," says Thomas-Canfield. A confluence of factors contributed to the delay.
paras.zh: 托马斯-坎菲尔德说：“社区中的事情在很长一段时间内未被发现，这意味着我们一开始就处于劣势。”多种因素共同导致了延误。

paras.en: First, there's the fact that a rarer species of Ebola is behind the outbreak — Bundibugyo. Existing tests weren't calibrated for this species, leading to delays. What's more, this region of northeastern DRC is remote and beset by conflict. And U.S. cuts to foreign aid may have slowed disease surveillance efforts, says Nahid Bhadelia, an infectious disease physician at Boston University.
paras.zh: 首先，有一个事实是，埃博拉病毒是一种更为罕见的物种——本迪布焦（Bundibugyo）。现有的测试没有针对该物种进行校准，导致了延误。更重要的是，刚果民主共和国东北部的这个地区地处偏远，饱受冲突困扰。波士顿大学传染病医生纳希德·巴德利亚 (Nahid Bhadelia) 表示，美国削减对外援助可能减缓了疾病监测工作。

paras.en: In those early days, "the writing was on the wall that this would be a hard road and it would need international cooperation," says Bhadelia. International cooperation and support have been slower in coming than in previous Ebola outbreaks.
paras.zh: 巴德利亚说，在早期，“不祥之兆表明这将是一条艰难的道路，需要国际合作”。与之前的埃博拉疫情相比，国际合作和支持的进展要慢一些。

paras.en: In 2014, for example, healthcare workers from around the globe traveled to West Africa to bolster the response. Bhadelia was one of them.
paras.zh: 例如，2014 年，来自世界各地的医护人员前往西非加强应对工作。巴黛莉亚就是其中之一。

paras.en: "I think you are seeing a lot less American or other healthcare workers coming into DRC because of U.S. policy that Americans may not be allowed back even if they're sick," says Bhadelia. That's different from the policy in the prior major outbreak. "That means that a lot of the burden is being carried by DRC and regional healthcare workers."
paras.zh: 巴德利亚说：“我认为，进入刚果民主共和国的美国或其他医护人员要少得多，因为美国的政策是，即使美国人生病了，也可能不允许他们回来。”这与之前重大疫情爆发时的政策不同。 “这意味着刚果民主共和国和地区医护人员承担了很多负担。”

paras.en: Despite pledges of funding from around the world, including more than $880 million from the U.S., some health workers on the ground say that money is slow to materialize. "The scale of financing that's available for this response is really a fraction of what it was in our previous response," says Thomas-Canfield. "I think the degree of international solidarity has been a lot less."
paras.zh: 尽管世界各地承诺提供资金，其中包括美国提供的超过 8.8 亿美元，但一些当地卫生工作者表示，资金落实缓慢。托马斯-坎菲尔德表示：“此次应对措施可用的融资规模实际上只是我们之前应对措施的一小部分。” “我认为国际团结的程度要低得多。”

paras.en: The response on the ground has improved over the past several months. There are now two dozen or so diagnostic labs and more than 50 treatment centers.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，当地的反应有所改善。现在有大约两打诊断实验室和 50 多个治疗中心。

paras.en: "We're up toward almost 2,000 treatment beds for Ebola, so there's been a lot of progress," says Douglas Noble, global incident manager for Ebola at UNICEF. Nonetheless, roughly two-thirds of deaths are occurring in the community, not in treatment centers — a sign that people are not coming forward with symptoms. That figure has been stubbornly constant for months and needs to improve for the outbreak to get under control, says Noble.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会埃博拉全球事件经理道格拉斯·诺布尔 (Douglas Noble) 表示：“我们准备建设近 2,000 个埃博拉治疗床位，所以已经取得了很大进展。”尽管如此，大约三分之二的死亡发生在社区，而不是治疗中心——这表明人们并没有出现症状。诺布尔说，这个数字几个月来一直保持不变，需要改善才能控制疫情。

paras.en: Part of why people aren't seeking care may be that Bundibugyo infections can seem mild at first. "Things like fever, headache, body ache, they're all symptoms of the most common and largely treatable endemic diseases in the region," says Thomas-Canfield. Those who are infected with Ebola may not decide to seek treatment until it's too late, he says.
paras.zh: 人们不寻求治疗的部分原因可能是本迪布焦感染一开始看起来很轻微。托马斯-坎菲尔德说：“发烧、头痛、身体疼痛等症状都是该地区最常见且基本上可以治疗的地方性疾病的症状。”他说，那些感染埃博拉病毒的人可能不会决定寻求治疗，直到为时已晚。

paras.en: A bigger hurdle, say many healthcare workers on the ground, is community distrust.
paras.zh: 许多现场医护人员表示，更大的障碍是社区的不信任。

paras.en: An October survey from the International Rescue Committee found that 85% of respondents in North Kivu — a current hotspot — say that distrust of community responders is keeping them from seeking care.
paras.zh: 国际救援委员会 10 月份的一项调查发现，当前热点地区北基伍省 85% 的受访者表示，对社区救援人员的不信任阻碍了他们寻求治疗。

paras.en: "We're constantly fighting different kinds of rumors, different kinds of misinformation," says Thomas-Canfield of the International Rescue Committee. Many community members question whether Ebola is real or believe responders are just trying to make money. Others wonder why teams come for Ebola and not other diseases that afflict the region, like malaria or typhoid.
paras.zh: 国际救援委员会的托马斯-坎菲尔德说：“我们不断地与不同类型的谣言、不同类型的错误信息作斗争。”许多社区成员质疑埃博拉病毒是否真实，或者认为救援人员只是想赚钱。其他人想知道为什么医疗队是来应对埃博拉病毒而不是其他困扰该地区的疾病，例如疟疾或伤寒。

paras.en: Community health workers are working hard to rebuild that trust. "I do think that in areas where we've been able to establish a longer-term presence, we're better able to respond," says Thomas-Canfield. But the virus is rapidly spreading to new health zones. Building trust from scratch is hard, she says. That's especially true in conflict zones, where fighting makes it hard to work, and armed groups actively sow disinformation.
paras.zh: 社区卫生工作者正在努力重建这种信任。 “我确实认为，在我们能够建立长期存在的领域，我们能够更好地做出反应，”托马斯-坎菲尔德说。但病毒正在迅速传播到新的卫生区。她说，从头开始建立信任是很困难的。在冲突地区尤其如此，那里的战斗使工作变得困难，武装团体积极散布虚假信息。

paras.en: When trust is low, people don't seek care or engage with health officials trying to find new cases and isolate their contacts. Roughly 80% of new cases are still coming in from people who weren't on health officials' radar. Until that rate goes down, the outbreak will remain out of control, says infectious disease doctor Bhadelia.
paras.zh: 当信任度较低时，人们不会寻求护理或与试图寻找新病例和隔离接触者的卫生官员接触。大约80%的新病例仍然来自没有受到卫生官员监控的人群。传染病医生Bhadelia说，在这一比率下降之前，疫情将继续失控。

paras.en: She points to the cases in Nigeria and Kenya this month as proof of that point. "The sporadic cases that we're seeing in neighboring countries is a sign of the growth in DRC," she says. While daily case counts seem to be plateauing, she says there's likely many regions where the virus is spreading undetected. "It's so far out of control."
paras.zh: 她指出本月尼日利亚和肯尼亚发生的案件就证明了这一点。 “我们在邻国看到的零星病例是刚果民主共和国疫情增长的迹象，”她说。她说，虽然每日病例数似乎已趋于稳定，但病毒可能在许多地区传播而未被发现。 “事情已经完全失控了。”

paras.en: Is there any hope that an Ebola vaccine or better treatments could tamp down numbers?
paras.zh: 埃博拉疫苗或更好的治疗方法是否有希望减少感染人数？

paras.en: No vaccine or treatment is licensed for the Bundibugyo species of Ebola. Several are in the works, but all far from being used in this response.
paras.zh: 目前还没有针对本迪布焦埃博拉病毒的疫苗或治疗方法获得许可。其中有几个正在进行中，但都远未在本次响应中使用。

paras.en: There is an existing vaccine for Ebola. It's called Ervebo, but it targets a different species of the disease. It hasn't been widely deployed, but healthcare workers began receiving the vaccine in late August and researchers just started a clinical trial, dubbed Tumaini after the Swahili word for hope, aimed at testing how well Ervebo works against Bundibugyo. If it proves effective, "that would be amazing, that could make a difference," says Bhadelia. But she cautions that vaccines and new treatments are not a silver bullet.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒已有疫苗。它被称为 Ervebo，但它针对的是不同种类的疾病。该疫苗尚未得到广泛部署，但医护人员已于 8 月下旬开始接种该疫苗，研究人员刚刚开始一项临床试验，该试验被称为“Tumaini”（斯瓦希里语中的“希望”一词），旨在测试 Ervebo 对抗 Bundibugyo 的效果。如果它被证明是有效的，“那将是令人惊奇的，这可能会产生影响，”巴德利亚说。但她警告说，疫苗和新疗法并不是灵丹妙药。

paras.en: "Targeted medical countermeasures are necessary, but they are not sufficient," she says. These interventions need to be coupled with basic public health measures, like tracing all the contacts for a newly infected person and isolating and treating those who are stricken. Improving these strategies takes more work and resources, she says, and she worries that the needed support may not come fast enough.
paras.zh: “有针对性的医疗对策是必要的，但还不够，”她说。这些干预措施需要与基本的公共卫生措施相结合，例如追踪新感染者的所有接触者以及隔离和治疗感染者。她说，改进这些策略需要更多的工作和资源，而且她担心所需的支持可能来得不够快。

paras.en: "In this moment, the question that scares me more than anything is will the international community turn its eyes and forget about DRC?" she says. "I am worried the funding will dry out, that we will not keep paying attention to a public health disaster that is much deeper and bigger in this moment than people realize."
paras.zh: “此时此刻，最让我害怕的问题是，国际社会是否会转而忘记刚果民主共和国？”她说。 “我担心资金会枯竭，我们不会继续关注一场比人们意识到的更深、更大的公共卫生灾难。”

articles.title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
articles.author: NPR's International Desk

paras.en: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
paras.zh: 以色列选民投票率飙升，内塔尼亚胡面临激烈选举

paras.en: Israeli voters turned out in their highest numbers in more than two decades in a tense national election on Tuesday to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his far-right coalition or change course.
paras.zh: 周二，在一场紧张的全国选举中，以色列选民的投票人数达到了二十多年来的最高水平，以决定是继续支持总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡及其极右翼联盟，还是改变路线。

paras.en: Netanyahu was in a tight race with his top rival, Gadi Eisenkot, a center-right former military chief of staff, as exit polls appeared to swing slightly in one and then the other candidate's favor.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡与他的头号竞争对手、中右翼前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特展开了一场激烈的角逐，出口民意调查似乎先是对一名候选人有利，然后又对另一名候选人有利。

paras.en: Still, the final vote tallies may take some time. And even when they're complete, if no bloc wins a majority, it could take days or weeks to decide who will be Israel's next prime minister, as party leaders try to assemble a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，最终的投票统计可能还需要一些时间。即使完成后，如果没有一个集团赢得多数席位，也可能需要几天或几周的时间才能决定谁将成为以色列的下一任总理，因为各党领导人正试图组建一个执政联盟。

paras.en: Israelis consider this one of their most consequential votes in history — the first parliamentary election since the October 2023 Hamas-led attack and the start of the wars in Gaza and elsewhere in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 以色列人认为这是他们历史上最重要的投票之一——自 2023 年 10 月哈马斯领导的袭击以及加沙和中东其他地区战争爆发以来的首次议会选举。

paras.en: The Central Elections Committee said 77.7% of voters cast ballots as of 10 p.m. — calling it the highest turnout since 1999.
paras.zh: 中央选举委员会表示，截至晚上10点，77.7%的选民参加了投票。 — 称这是自 1999 年以来的最高投票率。

paras.en: Enthusiasm was high among voters seeking to replace Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister, with almost two decades in office across multiple tenures.
paras.zh: 寻求取代内塔尼亚胡的选民热情高涨，内塔尼亚胡是以色列任职时间最长的总理，任期近二十年，曾多次担任总理。

paras.en: " Important is an underestimation, because it's much more than important. It's crucial," voter Naama Aaronsohn said of the election. "I'm worried. ... What's going to become of our country if there's not a major change?"
paras.zh: 选民纳马·阿伦森 (Naama Aaronsohn) 在谈到这次选举时表示：“重要的是一种低估，因为它比重要更重要。这是至关重要的。” “我很担心……如果没有重大变化，我们的国家将会变成什么样子？”

paras.en: Another voter, Itamar Ariel, cast his ballot for Netanyahu. He said there are problems in Israel but no one can replace him. It's a matter of security for Israel.
paras.zh: 另一位选民伊塔马尔·阿里尔(Itamar Ariel)将选票投给了内塔尼亚胡。他说以色列存在问题，但没有人可以取代他。这事关以色列的安全问题。

paras.en: But many Israelis question Netanyahu's ability to keep them safe after the deadly Oct. 7, 2023, attack. They have been reeling from reports that the government had repeated warnings from countries in the region that Hamas was planning a major assault on Israel.
paras.zh: 但许多以色列人质疑内塔尼亚胡在 2023 年 10 月 7 日致命袭击后保护他们安全的能力。有报道称，该地区各国政府多次警告哈马斯正计划对以色列发动大规模袭击，这让他们感到震惊。

paras.en: Israel's subsequent wars in Gaza and the region, and its policies in the occupied West Bank, have badly strained its relations with many international governments, and public support for Israel in the United States has plummeted, worrying many Israeli voters.
paras.zh: 以色列随后在加沙和该地区发生的战争，以及在被占领的约旦河西岸的政策，使其与许多国际政府的关系严重紧张，美国公众对以色列的支持率大幅下降，令许多以色列选民感到担忧。

paras.en: Citizens in majority-Arab areas also took the opportunity to make their voices heard.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯人占多数地区的公民也借此机会发出自己的声音。

paras.en: "This government it's not good for us and ... not good for anyone," said Nur Abu Na, a 30-year-old nurse. There are two predominantly Arab blocs in the elections.
paras.zh: “这个政府对我们没有好处，对任何人都没有好处，”30 岁的护士努尔·阿布纳 (Nur Abu Na) 说。选举中有两个以阿拉伯人为主的集团。

paras.en: Netanyahu voiced alarm throughout the day, in multiple social media posts, alerting followers to the high number of Arab citizens of Israel who were voting. He urged his right-wing supporters to get out and vote too.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡全天在多个社交媒体帖子中发出警告，提醒追随者注意以色列的大量阿拉伯公民正在投票。他敦促他的右翼支持者也出去投票。

paras.en: "Good outcome for Eisenkot" but too soon to tell
paras.zh: “艾森科特的结果不错”，但现在下结论还为时过早

paras.en: The early exit polls suggested Netanyahu's Likud Party won the most seats, with Eisenkot's Yashar party coming second. No party won a majority in the 120-seat parliament, known as the Knesset.
paras.zh: 早期的出口民意调查显示，内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团赢得了最多席位，艾森科特的亚沙尔党位居第二。没有一个政党在拥有 120 个席位的议会（即以色列议会）中赢得多数席位。

paras.en: The final results will depend on the math and negotiations among broader alliances.
paras.zh: 最终结果将取决于更广泛联盟之间的计算和谈判。

paras.en: Opposition leaders quickly reacted to the preliminary results, saying they suggested voters dealt a blow to Netanyahu's coalition.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人迅速对初步结果做出反应，称他们建议选民对内塔尼亚胡的联盟造成打击。

paras.en: Shira Efron, an Israeli policy analyst at the Rand Corp. think tank, told NPR it was a "very good outcome for Eisenkot" and his recently formed party.
paras.zh: 兰德公司智囊团的以色列政策分析师希拉·埃夫隆 (Shira Efron) 告诉 NPR，这“对艾森科特和他最近成立的政党来说是一个非常好的结果”。

paras.en: At an election party in Tel Aviv, Eisenkot's supporters cheered as the first exit polls were announced after voting closed at 10 p.m. local time.
paras.zh: 在特拉维夫的一个选举派对上，艾森科特的支持者们欢呼雀跃，因为晚上 10 点投票结束后宣布了首次出口民意调查。当地时间。

paras.en: ""We made history! The public has voted for change," Eisenkot said in a speech.
paras.zh: ” “我们创造了历史！公众投票支持变革，”艾森科特在一次演讲中说。

paras.en: But votes will continue to be counted on Wednesday, and the electoral map could shift. Eisenkot's bloc could lose, or have difficult political negotiations ahead if he is chosen to form a government.
paras.zh: 但周三计票仍将继续，选举地图可能会发生变化。如果艾森科特当选组建政府，他的集团可能会失败，或者面临艰难的政治谈判。

paras.en: "I'm anxious. Listen, the results are good, but they're complex. It takes time before we have a full picture," said opposition supporter Ophelie Namiech.
paras.zh: “我很焦虑。听着，结果很好，但很复杂。我们需要时间才能全面了解情况，”反对派支持者奥菲莉·纳米耶奇(Ophelie Namiech)说。

paras.en: At the Likud election night party in Jerusalem, giant screens played Hollywood-style videos of soldiers marching, airstrikes blowing up buildings and other destruction. Some clips appeared to show massive explosions of villages in Lebanon, where Israeli destruction of civilian infrastructure has drawn condemnation from human rights groups as potential war crimes, which Netanyahu's government denies.
paras.zh: 在耶路撒冷举行的利库德集团选举之夜派对上，大屏幕播放着好莱坞风格的视频，内容包括士兵行进、空袭炸毁建筑物和其他破坏。一些片段似乎显示黎巴嫩村庄发生大规模爆炸，以色列对当地民用基础设施的破坏引起了人权组织的谴责，称其为潜在的战争罪行，但内塔尼亚胡政府对此予以否认。

paras.en: The videos also repeatedly showed President Trump shaking hands with and endorsing Netanyahu. The two leaders plan to potentially launch major attacks against Iran after the Israeli and U.S. midterm elections. Trump urged Israeli voters to reelect Netanyahu to "finish the job that we started."
paras.zh: 这些视频还多次显示特朗普总统与内塔尼亚胡握手并表示支持。两位领导人计划在以色列和美国中期选举后对伊朗发动重大袭击。特朗普敦促以色列选民连任内塔尼亚胡，以“完成我们开始的工作”。

paras.en: Netanyahu's supporters were confident that their candidate, a master political survivor, would pull through.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的支持者相信他们的候选人，一位政治幸存者，将会渡过难关。

paras.en: " I've been here many times at different campaigns where at the first hour, that's what the exit polls show, and then you wait a little bit. And Prime Minister Netanyahu has had a knack of getting over the top when he needed it," said Netanyahu supporter Elie Pieprz.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的支持者埃利·皮耶普兹 (Elie Pieprz) 说：“我曾多次参加不同的竞选活动，在第一个小时，这就是出口民意调查显示的结果，然后你稍等一下。内塔尼亚胡总理有一个在需要时超越巅峰的诀窍。”

paras.en: He said in the end, he believes that Israelis will stand by their current leadership at a time of war.
paras.zh: 他最后表示，他相信以色列人将在战争时期支持他们目前的领导层。

paras.en: "Right now we're in a war ... as unattractive as that may be to sound internationally, that's the reality," he said. "I think it is much more likely that they [Israeli voters] will understand that Prime Minister Netanyahu needs to lead this war against Iran, particularly with President Trump, and will come together because they, we need to have a certain amount of unity."
paras.zh: “现在我们正处于一场战争之中……尽管这在国际上听起来可能没有吸引力，但这就是现实，”他说。 “我认为他们（以色列选民）更有可能明白，内塔尼亚胡总理需要领导这场针对伊朗的战争，特别是与特朗普总统合作，并且会走到一起，因为他们，我们需要有一定程度的团结。”

paras.en: In the early hours of Wednesday, Netanyahu addressed supporters at the event. "Israel faces a singular historical opportunity, together with our partner President Trump, to remove the existential threat of Iran once and for all," he said.
paras.zh: 周三凌晨，内塔尼亚胡在活动中向支持者发表讲话。他说：“以色列面临着一个独特的历史机遇，与我们的伙伴特朗普总统一起，一劳永逸地消除伊朗的生存威胁。”

paras.en: Netanyahu celebrated that Likud was voted to be the largest party in the Knesset, and said the party awaited final results, but vowed to form "a strong right-wing, national government."
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡庆祝利库德集团被选为议会第一大党，并表示该党正在等待最终结果，但誓言要组建“一个强大的右翼国家政府”。

paras.en: Daniel Estrin reported from Tel Aviv, Israel. Ruth Sherlock reported from Jerusalem. Samantha Balaban, Itay Stern, Shir David and Alon Avital contributed reporting in Israel.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 从以色列特拉维夫报道。露丝·夏洛克从耶路撒冷报道。 Samantha Balaban、Itay Stern、Shir David 和 Alon Avital 在以色列提供了报道。

articles.title: U.S. to issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro as his whereabouts remain unclear
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: U.S. to issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro as his whereabouts remain unclear
paras.zh: 由于弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗下落不明，美国将向他发放签证

paras.en: RIO DE JANEIRO, Brazil — The United States says it will issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro and his family, amid multiple reports that the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate has left the country following Sunday's election. His whereabouts have not been independently confirmed.
paras.zh: 巴西里约热内卢——美国表示将向弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗及其家人发放签证，此前有多个报道称这位落败的巴西总统候选人已在周日的选举后离开该国。他的下落尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, a conservative politician and ally of President Donald Trump, lost Sunday's presidential election to incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by more than four million votes, just three weeks after winning the first round. While Bolsonaro's Liberal Party has since recognized Lula's victory, Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat.
paras.zh: 保守派政治家、唐纳德·特朗普总统的盟友博尔索纳罗在周日的总统选举中以超过 400 万票的优势输给了现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦，而此时距离赢得第一轮选举仅三周。尽管博索纳罗领导的自由党承认卢拉的胜利，但博索纳罗拒绝承认失败。

paras.en: On Tuesday a senior U.S. administration official said that the State Department would issue visas to Bolsonaro and his family, allowing them to enter the country.
paras.zh: 周二，一名美国政府高级官员表示，国务院将向博尔索纳罗及其家人发放签证，允许他们进入该国。

paras.en: The visa announcement comes as Bolsonaro faces multiple investigations in Brazil, including allegations of money laundering and tax evasion, which he denies. On Monday Brazil's Supreme Court ordered him to surrender his passports within 24 hours and barred him from leaving the country.
paras.zh: 签证宣布之际，博尔索纳罗在巴西面临多项调查，包括洗钱和逃税指控，但他否认了这些指控。周一，巴西最高法院命令他在 24 小时内交出护照，并禁止他离开该国。

paras.en: The order followed comments by Bolsonaro's brother Eduardo, who lives in self-imposed exile in Florida, suggesting Flávio should leave Brazil if he lost the election.
paras.zh: 该命令是在博尔索纳罗的弟弟爱德华多发表评论后提出的，爱德华多目前在佛罗里达州自我流放，他建议弗拉维奥如果输掉选举就应该离开巴西。

paras.en: In a video released that day, Bolsonaro said federal police officers had stopped him outside the home of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, and ordered him to surrender his passports. The former far-right leader is under house arrest after being sentenced to 27 years in prison for plotting a coup following his own defeat by Lula in the 2022 presidential election.
paras.zh: 在当天发布的视频中，博尔索纳罗表示，联邦警察在他父亲、前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗的家外拦住了他，并命令他交出护照。这位前极右翼领导人在 2022 年总统选举中被卢拉击败后，因策划政变被判处 27 年监禁，目前已被软禁。

paras.en: "I never thought about leaving the country," Flávio Bolsonaro said in the video. "I will hand over my passports and defend myself against this aberration." He described the order as an attempt to intimidate him.
paras.zh: “我从未想过离开这个国家，”弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在视频中说道。 “我将交出我的护照，并保护自己免受这种失常行为的影响。”他称该命令是为了恐吓他。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Brazilian media reported that Bolsonaro had left for the United States. His campaign manager, his lawyer and other political allies had earlier said they did not know his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 周二，巴西媒体报道称博尔索纳罗已启程前往美国。他的竞选经理、律师和其他政治盟友早些时候表示，他们不知道他的下落。

paras.en: Lula won the election with just over 51% of the valid votes, or approximately 64.2 million, compared with more than 48%, or nearly 59.8 million, for Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卢拉以略高于 51% 的有效选票（约 6420 万张）赢得选举，而博尔索纳罗则超过 48%（约 5980 万张）。

paras.en: President Trump has repeatedly cast doubt on Lula's victory, suggesting on Monday that the election was "rigged", without offering any evidence. He returned to the subject at a campaign rally in Texas on Tuesday night, as he accused Democrats of election fraud.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统多次对卢拉的胜利表示怀疑，周一暗示选举被“操纵”，但没有提供任何证据。周二晚上，他在德克萨斯州的一次竞选集会上再次回到这个话题，指责民主党存在选举舞弊。

paras.en: "Brazil is also doing a good job of it, aren't they? Did you see that? I didn't take sides, but it didn't look very good," he said.
paras.zh: “巴西在这方面也做得很好，不是吗？你看到了吗？我没有选边站队，但看起来不太好，”他说。

paras.en: Lula criticised Bolsonaro's reported departure during celebrations for his 81st birthday in Brasília on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 卢拉批评博尔索纳罗周二在巴西利亚庆祝他 81 岁生日期间辞职的报道。

paras.en: "Those who have nothing to hide have nothing to fear," Lula told supporters.
paras.zh: 卢拉对支持者说：“那些没有什么可隐瞒的人就没有什么可害怕的。”

paras.en: "He could have stayed and proven that the accusations [against him] are not true," Lula said, adding that he regretted Bolsonaro's departure.
paras.zh: 卢拉说：“他本可以留下来，证明（针对他的）指控并不真实。”他补充说，他对博尔索纳罗的离开感到遗憾。

paras.en: He also took aim at the Bolsonaro family's close ties to the Trump administration. "Brazil is their second home; their first home is the United States," he said.
paras.zh: 他还瞄准了博尔索纳罗家族与特朗普政府的密切关系。 “巴西是他们的第二故乡；他们的第一故乡是美国，”他说。

articles.title: US military kills five in eastern Pacific strike on suspected drug-trafficking vessel

paras.en: The U.S. military on Tuesday carried out a lethal strike on a vessel in the eastern Pacific that it said was involved in drug trafficking, killing five people it identified as "narco-terrorists," according to U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM).
paras.zh: 据美国南方司令部（SOUTHCOM）称，美国军方周二对东太平洋的一艘据称参与贩毒的船只进行了致命袭击，造成五名被认定为“毒品恐怖分子”的人员死亡。

paras.en: "On October 27, under the direction of SOUTHCOM, Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere executed a lethal, kinetic strike on a go-fast vessel operating along established narco-trafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific," SOUTHCOM said in a statement.
paras.zh: 南方司令部在一份声明中表示：“10 月 27 日，在南方司令部的指导下，西半球联合特遣部队对一艘沿着东太平洋既定毒品贩运路线运行的快速船只进行了致命的动能打击。”

paras.en: "Confirmed intelligence revealed the vessel's active involvement in narco-trafficking," the statement continued.
paras.zh: 声明继续说：“经证实的情报显示该船积极参与毒品贩运。”

paras.en: SOUTHCOM said five people it described as narco-terrorists were killed during the operation.
paras.zh: 南方司令部表示，五名被称为毒品恐怖分子的人在行动中被杀。

paras.en: Tuesday's strike was the latest in the Trump administration's monthslong campaign targeting suspected cartel vessels, which has now resulted in at least 240 deaths from more than 70 strikes, according to The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，周二的袭击是特朗普政府针对涉嫌卡特尔船只长达数月的行动中的最新一次，该行动目前已导致 70 多次袭击中至少 240 人死亡。

paras.en: Video of Tuesday's operation released by SOUTHCOM shows a vessel in the water before it erupts into a massive fireball.
paras.zh: 南方司令部发布的周二行动视频显示，一艘船只在水中，然后喷发出巨大的火球。

paras.en: SOUTHCOM did not specify where the strike occurred beyond identifying the eastern Pacific and saying the vessel was operating along established drug-trafficking routes.
paras.zh: 南方司令部没有具体说明袭击发生的地点，只是确定了东太平洋，并表示这艘船是沿着既定的贩毒路线行驶。

paras.en: Throughout its campaign targeting suspected drug-trafficking networks, the military has released videos and statements describing those aboard the targeted vessels as "narco-terrorists" or alleging links to designated terrorist organizations. However, it has generally not identified those killed or provided evidence that the vessels were carrying narcotics.
paras.zh: 在针对可疑贩毒网络的行动中，军方发布了视频和声明，将目标船只上的人员描述为“毒品恐怖分子”，或声称与指定的恐怖组织有联系。然而，它通常没有确认遇难者的身份，也没有提供船只载有毒品的证据。

paras.en: The strikes have generated scrutiny from lawmakers, legal experts and human rights groups who have questioned the legal basis for using lethal military force against suspected traffickers outside a traditional battlefield.
paras.zh: 这些袭击引起了立法者、法律专家和人权组织的密切关注，他们质疑在传统战场之外对涉嫌贩运者使用致命武力的法律依据。

paras.en: SOUTHCOM's continued operations in Latin America and the Caribbean come after Secretary of State Marco Rubio said last month that the U.S. was increasingly seeking to conduct counter-narcotics operations in cooperation with regional allies and in accordance with their laws.
paras.zh: 在美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥上个月表示，美国越来越多地寻求与地区盟友合作并根据其法律开展缉毒行动之后，南方司令部继续在拉丁美洲和加勒比地区开展行动。

paras.en: Rubio told reporters that while the U.S. has "the capacity to act unilaterally," it would rather work with its allies because that is "the most effective way to do it."
paras.zh: 卢比奥告诉记者，虽然美国有“单方面行动的能力”，但它宁愿与盟友合作，因为这是“最有效的方式”。

paras.en: Rubio also said the U.S. military would "still blow up ships if need be" and that decisions would be made on "a strike-by-strike or operation-by-operation" basis.
paras.zh: 卢比奥还表示，美国军方“如果需要，仍会炸毁船只”，并且将在“逐次打击或逐次行动”的基础上做出决定。

paras.en: In recent months, SOUTHCOM has also released several videos showing military personnel intercepting and boarding vessels it said were involved in narco-trafficking before removing their crews and sinking the boats.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，南方司令部还发布了多段视频，显示军事人员拦截并登上据称参与毒品贩运的船只，然后驱逐船员并击沉船只。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Rays stay alive in World Series, walk off Brewers in thrilling extra-inning Game 4

paras.en: The Tampa Bay Rays live to play another day, coming through with a two-run 13th inning to walk off the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 of the World Series 4-3.
paras.zh: 坦帕湾光芒队在第 13 局打出两分，在世界系列赛第 4 场比赛中以 4-3 击败密尔沃基酿酒人队。

paras.en: The Brewers, smelling its first World Series title in franchise history after 22-year-old Cooper Pratt broke an innings-long 2-2 tie with a solo home run in the top of the 13th inning, were just three outs away from celebrating.
paras.zh: 22 岁的库珀·普拉特 (Cooper Pratt) 在第 13 局上半打出一记全垒打，打破了全局 2-2 平局，酿酒人队嗅到了球队历史上第一个世界大赛冠军的味道，距离庆祝只有 3 个出局机会。

paras.en: But after an error allowed Junior Caminero to reach base to start the frame, the Rays finally smelled some life. Liam Hicks made even more believers in Tropicana Field when his single moved Caminero to third base, and Jonny DeLuca told the Brewers, "Not so fast!"
paras.zh: 但在一次失误让朱尼奥·卡米内罗到达基地开始比赛后，光芒队终于嗅到了一丝生机。当利亚姆·希克斯 (Liam Hicks) 的一垒安打将卡米内罗 (Caminero) 推到三垒时，让纯果康纳球场 (Tropicana Field) 更加相信他，乔尼·德卢卡 (Jonny DeLuca) 告诉酿酒人队，“别那么快！”

paras.en: DeLuca’s RBI single to center field scored the tying run, and the rally was on. Chandler Simpson, who had an RBI double to begin the scoring in this game, made it bases loaded with no outs.
paras.zh: 德卢卡的打点单打中外野得分，扳平比分，比赛开始了。钱德勒·辛普森(Chandler Simpson)在这场比赛中打点双打，在没有出局的情况下上垒。

paras.en: Then, Ben Williamson, the last player on the Rays’ bench after they exhausted all options to keep the season alive, delivered a pinch-hit single to cap a thrilling Game 4 with Tampa Bay’s first win in this series, and a necessary one to force Game 5 on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 然后，本·威廉姆森（Ben Williamson）是光芒队在用尽了所有保持赛季活力的选择后板凳上的最后一名球员，他打出了一记扣击单打，为坦帕湾队在本系列赛中的第一场胜利赢得了激动人心的第四场比赛，这也是周三晚上第五场比赛的必要胜利。

paras.en: It truly looked as if the hero for the Brewers would be Pratt, who had a 4-for-5 night including an RBI double earlier in the game, when he finally broke a 2-2 tie with his solo blast to left field.
paras.zh: 看起来酿酒人队的英雄确实是普拉特，他在比赛中打出了 4 投 5 的表现，其中包括在比赛早些时候打点的双打，最终他凭借左外野的单打打破了 2-2 的平局。

paras.en: The last time the Brewers were in the Fall Classic was 1982, where they fell to the St. Louis Cardinals. It took 44 years to get back, and the Brewers, who owned the best record in the regular season at 103-59, were hoping to end their magical season with another sweep after doing the same in shocking fashion to the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队上一次参加秋季经典赛是在 1982 年，当时他们输给了圣路易斯红雀队。酿酒人队花了 44 年才卷土重来，以 103 胜 59 负的常规赛最佳战绩，在 NLCS 中以令人震惊的方式横扫洛杉矶道奇队后，希望以另一场横扫结束他们神奇的赛季。

paras.en: The only postseason game Milwaukee lost before this one was Game 3 of the ALDS against the San Diego Padres.
paras.zh: 在此之前，密尔沃基唯一一场输掉的季后赛是 ALDS 对阵圣地亚哥教士队的第三场比赛。

paras.en: Heading into Game 4, it felt almost imperative the Rays score first after what transpired on Monday night in Game 3, where the Brewers scored eight runs with two outs in the fifth inning. It was a brutal loss to take at home, but weirder things have happened in sports when teams are down 3-0 in a series.
paras.zh: 进入第四场比赛后，在周一晚上的第三场比赛中，酿酒人队在第五局两出局中拿下八分，之后，光芒队首先得分几乎是势在必行。这对主场来说是一场残酷的失利，但体育界也发生过更奇怪的事情，当球队在系列赛中0-3落后时。

paras.en: Simpson came through against Brewers starter Dustin May, doubling down the right field line to score DeLuca for the 1-0 lead.
paras.zh: 辛普森在对阵酿酒人队先发球员达斯汀·梅的比赛中，在右外野线加倍得分，为德卢卡得分，以 1-0 领先。

paras.en: But Pratt remained confident at the plate for Milwaukee, hitting his own double for, yes, another two-out clutch hit to tie the game.
paras.zh: 但普拉特对密尔沃基队的本垒板仍然充满信心，他打出了自己的双垒安打，是的，又一个两出关键球将比分扳平。

paras.en: The Rays, though, hit back with DeLuca simply putting the ball in play, and Brewers third baseman David Hamilton throwing it away in the bottom of the fourth to allow Caminero to cross the plate for the 2-1 lead in the bottom of the fourth.
paras.zh: 然而，光芒队反击，德卢卡简单地把球打进了球，布鲁尔队的三垒手大卫·汉密尔顿在第四节下半场将球扔掉，让卡米内罗在第四节下半场越过本垒，以 2-1 领先。

paras.en: However, Hamilton made up for it the next frame in a big way, leading off the top of the fifth inning with a solo home run to right center field off Griffin Jax, whose solid start ended on a bad note.
paras.zh: 然而，汉密尔顿在下一局大幅弥补了这一不足，在第五局上半时，他在格里芬·贾克斯的右中外野打出了一个单独的本垒打，而格里芬·贾克斯的良好开局却以糟糕的成绩告终。

paras.en: From there, both bullpens were put to the test, as each pitcher got through their batters and frames without letting a run through, forcing extra innings.
paras.zh: 从那里开始，两个牛棚都受到了考验，每个投手都通过了他们的击球手和框架，没有让跑垒通过，迫使加时赛。

paras.en: But Shane Drohan, who hadn't pitched in a month due to injury issues and a poor outing his last time out, was no match for the hungry Rays desperate to keep their season alive following Pratt's potential game-winner.
paras.zh: 但是谢恩·德罗汉（Shane Drohan）由于伤病问题和上一次比赛的糟糕表现已经一个月没有上场了，他无法与渴望保住赛季的光芒队（Pratt 潜在的制胜球）的对手匹敌。

paras.en: The series stays alive and we get another thriller lined up in Game 5 between these pennant winners.
paras.zh: 这个系列赛仍然充满活力，我们在第五场比赛中这些锦旗获胜者之间又上演了另一场惊悚片。

articles.title: Federal judge rules Bill Essayli unlawfully serving as de facto US attorney in California

paras.en: A federal judge has disqualified Bill Essayli, the top federal prosecutor in Southern California, from overseeing two criminal cases after finding that he is unlawfully serving as a "de facto" U.S. attorney.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官在发现南加州最高联邦检察官比尔·埃萨利非法担任“事实上的”美国检察官后，取消了他监督两起刑事案件的资格。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge J. Michael Seabright ruled Tuesday that Essayli cannot participate in or supervise the prosecutions in the two criminal cases.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官 J. Michael Seabright 周二裁定，埃萨利不能参与或监督这两起刑事案件的起诉。

paras.en: However, the disqualification will not take effect immediately, giving the Justice Department time to seek a stay pending appeal.
paras.zh: 然而，取消资格不会立即生效，从而使司法部有时间寻求暂缓上诉。

paras.en: "We respectfully disagree with the court's order," Essayli said in a statement provided to Fox News.
paras.zh: 埃萨利在向福克斯新闻提供的一份声明中表示：“我们谨表示不同意法院的命令。”

paras.en: "The President and the Attorney General have every right to select supervisors within the Justice Department," Essayli continued, adding that "ultimately, this question will be decided by the Supreme Court, and I look forward to serving in my current role until then."
paras.zh: 埃萨利继续说道：“总统和总检察长完全有权在司法部内选择监察员。”他补充道，“最终，这个问题将由最高法院决定，我期待着在那之前继续担任目前的职务。”

paras.en: Essayli originally served as interim U.S. attorney under an appointment that expired after 120 days. Then-Attorney General Pam Bondi subsequently appointed him as a special attorney and designated him first assistant U.S. attorney. He was never formally nominated by the president or confirmed by the U.S. Senate.
paras.zh: 埃萨利最初担任临时美国检察官，任期 120 天后到期。时任司法部长帕姆·邦迪随后任命他为特别检察官，并任命他为美国第一助理检察官。他从未被总统正式提名或得到美国参议院的确认。

paras.en: Seabright previously found that the arrangement did not lawfully make Essayli acting U.S. attorney but allowed him to continue supervising prosecutions under his other titles.
paras.zh: 西布赖特此前发现，这一安排并未合法地使埃萨利担任美国检察官，但允许他继续以其他头衔监督起诉。

paras.en: However, after the Ninth Circuit ruled over the summer against a similar arrangement involving a federal prosecutor in Nevada, Seabright decided to revisit the issue, according to the Los Angeles Times.
paras.zh: 然而，据《洛杉矶时报》报道，在第九巡回法院今年夏天对涉及内华达州联邦检察官的类似安排作出裁决后，西布赖特决定重新审视这一问题。

paras.en: Attorney General Todd Blanche issued a revised designation last month to narrow Essayli's authority and distinguish his situation from the Nevada case, but Seabright ruled the modified arrangement still gave Essayli enough authority to effectively occupy the vacant U.S. attorney position.
paras.zh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇上个月发布了修改后的任命，以缩小埃萨利的权限，并将他的情况与内华达州案件区分开来，但西布赖特裁定，修改后的安排仍然赋予埃萨利足够的权力，以有效填补空缺的美国检察官职位。

paras.en: "In sum, Essayli is unlawfully serving as a 'de facto' United States Attorney," Seabright wrote.
paras.zh: “总而言之，埃萨利非法担任‘事实上的’美国检察官，”西布赖特写道。

paras.en: The ruling came as Essayli has been helping lead a high-profile Justice Department effort challenging California over more than 20,000 registered voters the administration says are likely noncitizens.
paras.zh: 这项裁决出台之际，埃萨利一直在帮助领导司法部一项备受瞩目的行动，就加州政府称超过 20,000 名登记选民可能是非公民的问题向加州发起挑战。

paras.en: The Justice Department has asked a federal court to require ballots associated with those individuals to be separated while their eligibility is reviewed, and U.S. District Judge David O. Carter said he would issue a ruling Wednesday on the administration's request.
paras.zh: 司法部已要求联邦法院要求在审查这些人的资格时将与这些人相关的选票分开，美国地区法官戴维·卡特表示，他将于周三根据政府的要求做出裁决。

paras.en: "I think this case is really on the forefront of the administration's battle to fight for election integrity," Essayli said during a news conference Tuesday.
paras.zh: 埃萨利在周二的新闻发布会上表示：“我认为此案确实处于政府争取选举公正性斗争的最前沿。”

paras.en: "We wanna stop illegal voting. We don't wanna chase it later," he added.
paras.zh: “我们想阻止非法投票。我们不想稍后再追究，”他补充道。

paras.en: When asked about Seabright's ruling during the news conference, Essayli gave reporters a brief response.
paras.zh: 当在新闻发布会上被问及西布赖特的裁决时，埃萨利对记者做了简短的回应。

paras.en: "That case will be decided by the Supreme Court."
paras.zh: “该案将由最高法院裁决。”

articles.title: ‘Emotional intimacy’ from AI chatbots would be banned under Australia’s digital duty of care laws
articles.author: Josh Butler

paras.en: The federal government wants to ban AI chatbots which seek to create “emotional intimacy” after prime minister Anthony Albanese raised the alarm in a heartfelt speech about children treating these agents as their “best friend”.
paras.zh: 在总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese）在一次衷心演讲中警告儿童将这些机器人视为“最好的朋友”后，联邦政府希望禁止试图创造“情感亲密”的人工智能聊天机器人。

paras.en: But Labor is coming under increasing pressure to empower the telecommunications ombudsman to become a watchdog for social media and AI to give Australians an external complaints mechanism and allow the “naming and shaming” of big tech.
paras.zh: 但工党面临着越来越大的压力，要求电信监察员成为社交媒体和人工智能的监督者，为澳大利亚人提供外部投诉机制，并允许对大型科技公司进行“点名和羞辱”。

paras.en: The digital duty of care bill passed the House of Representatives on Wednesday and will be debated by the Senate in coming weeks. The government hopes to pass the bill by the end of 2026, but its pathway through the upper house remains unclear. The Greens support the bill, while the Coalition has said it will not vote for it, though Labor still appears keen to win the opposition’s support and remains open to amendments.
paras.zh: 数字谨慎责任法案于周三在众议院获得通过，并将在未来几周内由参议院进行辩论。政府希望在 2026 年底前通过该法案，但其在上议院获得通过的途径仍不清楚。绿党支持该法案，而联盟党则表示不会投票支持该法案，不过工党似乎仍然渴望赢得反对派的支持，并对修正案持开放态度。

paras.en: The planned framework would apply new online safety standards to social media, games, apps and chatbots. Labor said it would place “an overarching obligation” on tech platforms “to provide a safe online environment for all Australians” and replace a range of existing online codes and standards with a broader duty-of-care requirement to protect users from certain “harmful” content. It would also require social media platforms to offer an “opt-out” feature for its algorithm and suggested content.
paras.zh: 计划中的框架将把新的在线安全标准应用于社交媒体、游戏、应用程序和聊天机器人。工党表示，它将对科技平台赋予“首要义务”，“为所有澳大利亚人提供安全的在线环境”，并用更广泛的注意义务要求取代一系列现有的在线规范和标准，以保护用户免受某些“有害”内容的侵害。它还要求社交媒体平台为其算法和建议内容提供“选择退出”功能。

paras.en: The communications minister, Anika Wells, has suggested content that that promotes misogyny, terrorism, suicide, self-harm and eating disorders would be captured by the laws.
