On Wednesday, the government accepted amendments from crossbencher Kate Chaney which would add certain AI chatbot activity to the list of harms, requiring platforms to ban “material or conduct that simulates emotional intimacy and encourages or fosters a child’s dependence on it in place of human relationships”.
paras.zh: 通讯部长阿尼卡·威尔斯 (Anika Wells) 建议，宣扬厌女症、恐怖主义、自杀、自残和饮食失调的内容将受到法律制裁。周三，政府接受了中立议员凯特·钱尼 (Kate Chaney) 的修正案，该修正案将某些人工智能聊天机器人活动添加到危害清单中，要求平台禁止“模拟情感亲密并鼓励或培养孩子对其依赖而不是人际关系的材料或行为”。

paras.en: In an emotional address on Tuesday night, where he again implored the Coalition to consider voting for the bill, Albanese said: “the stories we hear about people identifying a chatbot, a non person as their best friend, should be a huge wake up call for every member of this Parliament to be prepared to act.”
paras.zh: 在周二晚上的一次激动人心的演讲中，阿尔巴内塞再次恳求联盟党考虑投票支持该法案，他说：“我们听到的关于人们将聊天机器人、非人类视为自己最好朋友的故事，应该给议会的每一位议员敲响警钟，让他们做好采取行动的准备。”

paras.en: The opposition voted against the bill in the House, alongside One Nation. Political opponents have accused Labor of an “Orwellian” system of “censorship” and of seeking to influence conversations online – claims Wells strongly denied.
paras.zh: 反对派与一国党一起在众议院投票反对该法案。政治对手指责工党采用“奥威尔式”的“审查制度”，并试图影响网上对话——威尔斯强烈否认这一说法。

paras.en: “If they really care, the test is simple here, they should bring an amendment, not a slogan to ‘kill the bill’,” Wells told ABC radio on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “如果他们真的关心，这里的测试很简单，他们应该提出修正案，而不是‘废除该法案’的口号，”威尔斯周三告诉美国广播公司电台。

paras.en: Another Chaney amendment accepted by Labor would require the algorithm opt-out features to be “accessible, easy to use” and “prominently available” on platforms,amid concerns that social media giants may offer only small or hard-to-find features.
paras.zh: 工党接受的另一项钱尼修正案将要求算法选择退出功能在平台上“可访问、易于使用”和“显着可用”，因为人们担心社交媒体巨头可能只提供小或难以找到的功能。

paras.en: The bill now moves to the Senate, where the Greens have set up an inquiry to probe the laws due to report back in late November. Senator Sarah Hanson-Young backed a digital duty of care, calling for the government’s legislation to be strengthened The Greens want Australians to have the right to pursue private legal action against platforms and for penalties to be increased.
paras.zh: 该法案现已移交参议院，绿党已在参议院启动调查，以调查该法律，并于 11 月底提交报告。参议员莎拉·汉森-杨 (Sarah Hanson-Young) 支持数字谨慎义务，呼吁加强政府立法。绿党希望澳大利亚人有权对平台采取私人法律行动，并加大处罚力度。

paras.en: “Australians also need an external complaints pathway, free from the profit-driven whims of ‘big tech’s’ content moderation,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“澳大利亚人还需要一条外部投诉途径，摆脱‘大型科技’内容审核的利润驱动的突发奇想。”

paras.en: Independent MP Sophie Scamps had proposed changes to the bill to expand the remit of the telecommunications industry ombudsman. She said such a watchdog – which does not currently exist for big tech – would allow ordinary social media users to seek remedies to their accounts being hacked or inaccessible, including compensation, and investigate broader issues to name and shame companies behaving badly.
paras.zh: 独立议员索菲·斯坎普斯提议修改该法案，以扩大电信行业监察员的职权范围。她表示，这样的监管机构（目前大型科技公司并不存在）将允许普通社交媒体用户针对其账户被黑客攻击或无法访问的情况寻求补救措施，包括赔偿，并调查更广泛的问题，点名批评行为不当的公司。

paras.en: Labor did not accept this amendment in the lower house and Wells declined to voice support for such an idea, but the Greens will push for such a reform in their Senate negotiations.
paras.zh: 工党没有在下议院接受这一修正案，威尔斯也拒绝表示支持这一想法，但绿党将在参议院谈判中推动这一改革。

paras.en: Cynthia Gebert, the telecommunications industry ombudsman, said her office would be well placed to carry out such a role for big tech. She said such roles were funded by the industries they regulate and that expanding its remit could be financed by big tech.
paras.zh: 电信行业监察员辛西娅·格伯特 (Cynthia Gebert) 表示，她的办公室非常适合为大型科技公司扮演这样的角色。她表示，这些角色的资金来自其监管的行业，而扩大其职权范围可以由大型科技公司提供资金。

paras.en: “There are some real strengths in the DDOC [digital duty of care] because it’s putting the onus on platforms to make things safe … but I think the area that needs to be strengthened is giving people somewhere to go if they can’t get their complaints resolved with the platform,” Gebert told Guardian Australia.
paras.zh: “DDOC（数字注意义务）有一些真正的优势，因为它将保证安全的责任交给了平台……但我认为需要加强的领域是，如果人们无法通过平台解决投诉，可以为他们提供去处，”格伯特告诉澳大利亚卫报。

paras.en: “It risks leaving Australians in the safe place they are now, where they get automated responses or escalation procedures that don’t go anywhere.”
paras.zh: “这有可能让澳大利亚人处于现在的安全境地，他们得到的自动响应或升级程序不会有任何进展。”

paras.en: Gebert said the government should make it mandatory for big tech to be part of an ombudsman scheme, saying it would “hold industry to account and drive system improvement”.
paras.zh: 格伯特表示，政府应该强制大型科技公司成为监察员计划的一部分，并表示这将“让行业承担责任并推动系统改进”。

paras.en: “[The telecommunications industry ombudsman] can help with your Telstra account, but we can’t help with your Gmail account. Consumers come to us sometimes and ask, ‘why this, not that?’,” she said.
paras.zh: “[电信行业监察员]可以为您的 Telstra 帐户提供帮助，但我们无法为您的 Gmail 帐户提供帮助。消费者有时会来找我们，问‘为什么是这个，而不是那个？’”她说。

paras.en: “We want to help but don’t have the powers to do so now.”
paras.zh: “我们想提供帮助，但现在没有权力这样做。”

articles.title: From a seed in China to the ‘backdrop for countless love stories’: a ginko’s 167-year journey to Victorian tree of the year
articles.author: Caitlin Cassidy

paras.en: For more than 160 years, a humble ginkgo tree raised from seed in Geelong’s botanic gardens has been the backdrop to “countless local love stories”. Standing beneath it is the most popular spot to get married at the park, its branches forming the backdrop of many wedding photos.
paras.zh: 160 多年来，吉朗植物园中一棵不起眼的银杏树一直是“无数当地爱情故事”的背景。它的下面是公园里最受欢迎的结婚地点，它的树枝构成了许多婚纱照的背景。

paras.en: Now, in addition to being the largest ginkgo biloba in the state – and possibly Australia – at a whopping 20 metres tall, it has a new claim to fame. The much-adored Geelong icon has been crowned Victoria’s tree of the year.
paras.zh: 现在，它除了是该州（甚至可能是澳大利亚）最大的银杏叶（高达 20 米）之外，还因新的名声而声名鹊起。备受喜爱的吉朗标志被加冕为维多利亚年度树。

paras.en: The National Trust of Australia (Victoria), which runs the awards, announced on Tuesday that Geelong’s ginkgo beat eight other finalists to the 2026 title, receiving 27% of 4,435 public votes cast. Second place went to the smooth bark apple myrtle in Prahran, while Apollo Bay’s myrtle beech was voted third.
paras.zh: 负责举办该奖项的澳大利亚国家信托基金会（维多利亚州）周二宣布，吉朗的银杏击败其他 8 名决赛入围者，获得 4,435 名公众投票中的 27%，荣获 2026 年桂冠。第二名是普拉兰的光滑树皮桃金娘，而阿波罗湾的香桃木山毛榉被评为第三名。

paras.en: To be eligible, trees have to be listed on the National Trust significant tree register, which recognises 2,500 trees in Victoria for their cultural, scientific, and historic value. More than 40 were nominated this year, then narrowed down to nine by a panel of 12 experts and arboriculturists.
paras.zh: 要符合资格，树木必须被列入国家信托重要树木登记册，该登记册承认维多利亚州有 2,500 棵树木的文化、科学和历史价值。今年提名了 40 多名提名者，随后由 12 名专家和树艺家组成的小组将提名范围缩小到 9 名。

paras.en: The executive manager of gardens and landscapes at the National Trust Victoria, Justin Buckley, said the ginkgo was a “very popular winner”.
paras.zh: 维多利亚国民信托基金会花园和景观执行经理贾斯汀·巴克利 (Justin Buckley) 表示，银杏是“非常受欢迎的赢家”。

paras.en: “It’s a really special tree, and very well loved in that area,” he said.
paras.zh: “这是一棵非常特别的树，在该地区很受欢迎，”他说。

paras.en: The ginkgo was planted in 1859, just two decades after the township of Geelong was formally established. The seeds were transported from China, rumoured to have been delivered by a ship’s captain making a stop at Geelong’s port.
paras.zh: 银杏种植于 1859 年，距吉朗镇正式成立仅二十年。这些种子是从中国运来的，据传是由停泊在吉朗港口的船长送来的。

paras.en: Since then, generations of botanic garden workers and volunteers have helped it thrive. Not all have been able to see the unusual stalactite-like growths from its trunk and branches, which only occur in much older female gingko varieties, or enjoy its fruit – which has a reputation for being smelly.
paras.zh: 从那时起，一代又一代的植物园工作人员和志愿者帮助它蓬勃发展。并不是所有人都能看到它的树干和树枝上不寻常的钟乳石状生长，这种情况只出现在更古老的雌性银杏品种中，也不是所有人都能够欣赏它的果实——这种果实以臭着称。

paras.en: Ginkgos, also known as maidenhairs, are among the most ancient trees on earth, dating back to the Jurassic period more than 160m years ago. In Japan, they’re a symbol of hope, longevity and peace, after six survived the 1945 atomic blast in Hiroshima. They were thought to be extinct in the wild for many centuries before being revived.
paras.zh: 银杏，也被称为银杏，是地球上最古老的树木之一，其历史可以追溯到 1.6 亿多年前的侏罗纪时期。在日本，它们是希望、长寿与和平的象征，1945 年广岛原子弹爆炸中有六人幸存。人们认为它们在复活之前已经在野外灭绝了许多个世纪。

paras.en: Botanic gardens supervisor Sheree Parker said the ginkgo was one of the first trees planted in the park and was also its “most visited and talked about”.
paras.zh: 植物园主管谢里·帕克 (Sheree Parker) 表示，银杏是公园里最早种植的树木之一，也是“参观人数最多、谈论最多的树木”。

paras.en: “It’s just starting to awaken now after being dormant,” she said. “We’re really excited.
paras.zh: “它在休眠之后现在才开始苏醒，”她说。 “我们真的很兴奋。

paras.en: “It’s our most popular destination to get married as well. We have a lot of weddings on this lawn and a lot of couples like to get married underneath the ginkgo.”
paras.zh: “这也是我们最受欢迎的结婚目的地。我们在这片草坪上举办了很多婚礼，很多新人喜欢在银杏下结婚。”

paras.en: The city of greater Geelong staff had been strongly lobbying for the ginkgo to be crowned since the finalists were announced, posting regularly to social media encouraging people to vote.
paras.zh: 自决赛入围名单公布以来，吉朗市的工作人员一直在大力游说银杏加冕，并定期在社交媒体上发帖鼓励人们投票。

paras.en: “As … the backdrop for countless local love stories, she holds a special place in all our hearts,” they said a post earlier this month.
paras.zh: “作为……无数当地爱情故事的背景，她在我们心中占有特殊的地位，”他们在本月早些时候的一篇帖子中说道。

paras.en: The competition was established in 2016 to celebrate Victoria’s best-loved trees, while also calling for greater protection of green spaces.
paras.zh: 该竞赛成立于 2016 年，旨在庆祝维多利亚州最受欢迎的树木，同时呼吁加强对绿色空间的保护。

paras.en: A recent urban greening framework, released by Stonnington city council, found over the past decade, more than 17.9 hectares of tree canopy had been lost on private lands in the inner Melbourne suburb alone.
paras.zh: 斯托宁顿市议会最近发布的一份城市绿化框架发现，在过去十年中，仅墨尔本内城区的私人土地上就有超过 17.9 公顷的树冠消失。

paras.en: The National Trust is urging the Victorian government to give automatic statutory protection to trees on its register and those of local councils, while also introducing a “retain first” planning principle making tree removal a genuine last resort.
paras.zh: 国家信托基金会敦促维多利亚州政府对其登记册上的树木和地方议会的树木给予自动法定保护，同时引入“保留第一”的规划原则，使砍伐树木成为真正的最后手段。

paras.en: In the past year, the Victorian government introduced uniform protection of canopy trees, but Buckley said it remained “quite limited” and there was “large scope” for significant trees to be removed without a permit.
paras.zh: 去年，维州政府对树冠树木实行了统一保护，但巴克利表示，这仍然“相当有限”，而且在未经许可的情况下砍伐重要树木的“范围很大”。

paras.en: “The reason we continue to draw attention to trees through this competition is because they really don’t have adequate protection, certainly not the same protection that heritage buildings have,” Buckley said.
paras.zh: 巴克利说：“我们之所以通过这次比赛继续引起人们对树木的关注，是因为它们确实没有得到足够的保护，当然也没有得到与遗产建筑相同的保护。”

paras.en: “You can’t just think, well, we’ll take this one out, we’ll put another tree in there and everything will be fine. Big significant trees are virtually irreplaceable.
paras.zh: “你不能只是想，好吧，我们把这棵树去掉，再在那里种上另一棵树，一切都会好起来的。重要的大树实际上是不可替代的。

paras.en: “As we need to accommodate growing populations and more housing … there’s going to be a lot of pressure on trees.”
paras.zh: “由于我们需要容纳不断增长的人口和更多的住房……树木将承受很大的压力。”

articles.title: Israel election results live: vote count underway as exit polls point to tie between Netanyahu and Eisenkot blocs
articles.author: Jonathan Yerushalmy

paras.en: It’s just after 6am in Tel Aviv where Israelis are waking up to exit polls that show no clear victor in yesterday’s elections, with uncertainty guaranteed at this point.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫凌晨 6 点刚过，以色列人一觉醒来就开始接受出口民意调查，结果显示昨天的选举没有明显的胜利者，目前的不确定性是存在的。

paras.en: The polls published by Israel’s major TV networks show Benjamin Netanyahu’s governing bloc tied with the opposition grouping led by Gadi Eisenkot on 51 seats each, short of the 61 seats needed to form a majority coalition government.
paras.zh: 以色列主要电视网络公布的民意调查显示，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的执政集团与加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派集团各获得51个席位，低于组建多数联合政府所需的61个席位。

paras.en: Earlier exit polls had Eisenkot winning most seats in the Knesset by a slight margin. Israeli exit polls are often revised after publication and are notoriously imprecise, with the final count often swinging by several seats.
paras.zh: 早些时候的出口民意调查显示，艾森科特以微弱优势赢得了议会大部分席位。以色列的出口民意调查经常在公布后进行修改，而且非常不精确，最终的计票结果往往会在几个席位之间摇摆不定。

paras.en: Voter turnout surged to the highest level in more than two decades, underscoring the stakes of an election that has been labelled the most important in the country’s history. More than 77% of eligible voters cast a ballot, according to Israel’s central elections committee, about 7 percentage points higher than in 2022.
paras.zh: 选民投票率飙升至二十多年来的最高水平，凸显了这场被称为该国历史上最重要的选举的风险。根据以色列中央选举委员会的数据，超过 77% 的合格选民参加了投票，比 2022 年高出约 7 个百分点。

paras.en: Final counting is ongoing, with more than 30% of the votes tabulated so far.
paras.zh: 最终计票工作正在进行中，目前已计票数超过 30%。

paras.en: The Palestinian parties are projected to dramatically increase their representation in the Knesset, with predictions they could win as many as 18 seats, up from 10. Experts have said that if Eisenkot falls short of a majority, as the exit polls suggest, he would be obliged to sit down to talk to the Palestinian groupings, the Joint List and Ra’am, to try to form a government – which could take weeks.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦各党派预计将大幅增加在以色列议会中的代表权，预计他们可能会赢得多达 10 个席位，从 10 个增加到 18 个。专家表示，如果艾森科特如出口民意调查显示的那样未能获得多数席位，他将不得不坐下来与巴勒斯坦组织“联合名单”和“拉阿姆”进行对话，以尝试组建政府 — — 这可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: It is also possible that Eisenkot could try to govern as a minority government, with informal vote-by-vote agreements that would keep the new coalition afloat.
paras.zh: 艾森科特也有可能尝试以少数派政府的身份执政，通过非正式的逐票表决协议来维持新联盟的运转。

paras.en: Netanyahu took the stage at a post-election rally in Jerusalem just after 3am, telling his supporters official results will show that “Likud is the largest party in Israel”. He told his supporters that the country must “establish a strong, right-wing national government” – adding that a government that relies on the support of Palestinian parties must not be formed.
paras.zh: 凌晨 3 点刚过，内塔尼亚胡在耶路撒冷举行的选举后集会上登台，告诉他的支持者，官方结果将显示“利库德集团是以色列最大的政党”。他告诉他的支持者，该国必须“建立一个强大的右翼国家政府”，并补充说，决不能组建一个依赖巴勒斯坦政党支持的政府。

paras.en: Eisenkot told cheering supporters in Tel Aviv that the “Israeli public has voted against Netanyahu’s service as Israel’s prime minister … a worthy leader would have accepted the people’s non-confidence and announced today his retirement from politics.” In his speech, he also warned Netanyahu not to “use Israel’s security” for political ends, playing on fears that the prime minister could use this period of uncertainty to launch a new attack on Iran.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在特拉维夫对欢呼的支持者说，“以色列公众投票反对内塔尼亚胡担任以色列总理……一位有价值的领导人会接受人民的不信任，并在今天宣布退出政坛。”他在讲话中还警告内塔尼亚胡不要“利用以色列的安全”达到政治目的，并利用了人们对总理可能利用这段不确定时期对伊朗发动新攻击的担忧。

paras.en: The exit polls were released after a last-ditch effort by Netanyahu and several other parties to keep polling stations open beyond their 10pm deadline was rejected by the Central Elections Committee. The prime minister suggested publicly that efforts were being made by the “left and Arabs” to steal the election, a claim rejected by the committee, which said it had seen no evidence of systematic tampering.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡和其他几个政党为在晚上 10 点截止日期后继续开放投票站所做的最后努力被中央选举委员会拒绝，随后公布了出口民意调查。总理公开暗示“左派和阿拉伯人”正在努力窃取选举结果，但该委员会拒绝了这一说法，称没有发现系统性篡改的证据。

paras.en: The lead that exit polls gave to the opposition bloc early in the night has disappeared, with Netanyahu’s grouping now neck and neck with Gadi Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 昨晚出口民意调查对反对派集团的领先优势已经消失，内塔尼亚胡的阵营现在与加迪·艾森科特并驾齐驱。

paras.en: Israeli television networks gave the two blocs approximately 51 seats each in the 120 member Knesset – well below the 61 needed to govern. Palestinian parties meanwhile saw a surge in support, with exit polls showing them winning 17 or 18 seats between them.
paras.zh: 以色列电视网络在议会 120 名议员中为这两个集团各分配了约 51 个席位，远低于执政所需的 61 个席位。与此同时，巴勒斯坦政党的支持率大幅上升，出口民意调查显示，他们赢得了 17 或 18 个席位。

paras.en: Parties will attempt to reach a majority
paras.zh: 政党将努力获得多数席位

paras.en: No single party has ever reached the requisite 61 seats needed to form a government in the Knesset, so parties must work together to form governing coalitions.
paras.zh: 没有任何一个政党能够在议会中获得组建政府所需的 61 个席位，因此各党派必须共同努力组建执政联盟。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog will name a candidate who has the best chance to form a government – not necessarily the party with the most seats – but with the exit polls showing both parties falling short of a majority that process could take weeks.
paras.zh: 艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统将提名一位最有机会组建政府的候选人 — — 不一定是拥有最多席位的政党 — — 但由于出口民意调查显示两党都未能获得多数席位，这一过程可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: Coalition building in Israel has always been difficult because mainstream parties usually refuse to collaborate with parties run by Palestinian citizens of Israel. However some have suggested Eisenkot could begin discussions with the Palestinian groupings who have seen a surge in support.
paras.zh: 以色列的联盟建设一直很困难，因为主流政党通常拒绝与以色列巴勒斯坦公民领导的政党合作。然而，一些人建议艾森科特可以开始与支持率激增的巴勒斯坦团体进行讨论。

paras.en: Palestinian grouping Ra’am is seen as a potential kingmaker if Netanyahu fails to secure enough votes to try to form a government. Their leader, Mansour Abbas, participated in a right-leaning government in the past.
paras.zh: 如果内塔尼亚胡未能获得足够的选票来组建政府，巴勒斯坦组织“拉姆”将被视为潜在的拥王者。他们的领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯过去曾参加过右倾政府。

paras.en: However Eisenkot’s camp kept them at arm’s length during the campaign, perceiving their support as a liability. In the past he has said Arab-led parties do not meet Zionist criteria to govern.
paras.zh: 然而，艾森科特的阵营在竞选期间与他们保持一定距离，认为他们的支持是一种负担。他过去曾表示，阿拉伯领导的政党不符合犹太复国主义的执政标准。

paras.en: For Netanyahu’s bloc, however, there is no obvious place to pick up more seats, save for defections. Addressing his supporters in the early hours of Wednesday morning, he said that a government that relies on the support of Palestinian parties must not be formed.
paras.zh: 然而，对于内塔尼亚胡的集团来说，除了叛逃之外，没有明显的地方可以赢得更多席位。周三凌晨，他向支持者发表讲话说，决不能组建一个依赖巴勒斯坦政党支持的政府。

paras.en: Coalition negotiations can be arduous and can produce unstable governments. It took Netanyahu 58 days to form his government after the previous election in November 2022.
paras.zh: 联合政府谈判可能会很艰难，并可能产生不稳定的政府。自 2022 年 11 月上次选举后，内塔尼亚胡花了 58 天组建政府。

paras.en: A minority government could be attempted
paras.zh: 可以尝试组建少数派政府

paras.en: If no bloc manages to secure 61 seats, a candidate could attempt to govern without a majority but rather through support on an ad hoc basis from other lawmakers.
paras.zh: 如果没有一个集团能够获得 61 个席位，候选人可以尝试在没有多数席位的情况下执政，而是通过其他立法者的临时支持来执政。

paras.en: In this scenario, lawmakers from the Palestinian parties whose representation in the Knesset is likely to have increase, could play a critical role.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，来自巴勒斯坦政党的立法者（其在议会中的代表权可能会增加）可能会发挥关键作用。

paras.en: The Joint List – which represents a number of Israeli Arab parties – has said it would be unlikely to join a coalition government outright, but has offered to provide a “safety net” for anyone that ousts Netanyahu from power.
paras.zh: 代表以色列多个阿拉伯政党的联合名单表示，不太可能彻底加入联合政府，但愿意为任何推翻内塔尼亚胡权力的人提供“安全网”。

paras.en: While appearing fanciful at first glance, Israeli commentators have mused in recent weeks on the possibility of a national unity government in which Netanyahu would jettison his far-right allies as well as ultra-Orthodox parties and team up with Eisenkot, who shares Netanyahu’s views on many security issues.
paras.zh: 虽然乍一看似乎有些异想天开，但以色列评论人士最近几周一直在思考组建民族团结政府的可能性，在该政府中，内塔尼亚胡将抛弃他的极右翼盟友和极端正统政党，并与艾森科特合作，艾森科特在许多安全问题上与内塔尼亚胡观点相同。

paras.en: Amit Segal, the chief political analyst for Channel 12 and journalist seen as close to Netanyahu, suggested that the prime minister’s extortion that the “Zionist majority must come to its senses and unite”, could be interpreted as an olive branch to Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 第 12 频道首席政治分析师、被视为与内塔尼亚胡关系密切的记者阿米特·西格尔 (Amit Segal) 表示，总理勒索的“犹太复国主义多数派必须清醒过来并团结起来”，可以被解读为向艾森科特伸出橄榄枝。

paras.en: This scenario has a recent precedent. In 2020, Netanyahu and Benny Gantz, like Eisenkot a retired general appealing to the centre, reached a power-sharing agreement, but their partnership fell apart after a year, triggering another election.
paras.zh: 这种情况最近就有先例。 2020年，内塔尼亚胡和本尼·甘茨就像一位向中间派发出呼吁的退休将军艾森科特一样，达成了权力分享协议，但一年后他们的伙伴关系破裂，引发了另一次选举。

paras.en: A unity government in the present situation would face strong opposition from both sides, particularly the opposition bloc, which has built its campaign around ousting Netanyahu, casting him as unfit to lead.
paras.zh: 在目前的情况下，联合政府将面临双方的强烈反对，尤其是反对派集团，该集团的竞选活动围绕着推翻内塔尼亚胡，认为他不适合领导。

paras.en: If no candidate manages to form a government, Israel will have to return to the polls.
paras.zh: 如果没有候选人能够组建政府，以色列将不得不重新投票。

paras.en: The country held five elections between 2019 and 2022 due to the inability of politicians to forge a lasting coalition.
paras.zh: 由于政治家无法组建持久的联盟，该国在 2019 年至 2022 年间举行了五次选举。

paras.en: However if we a new set of polls is on the horizon, they are not likely to happen for weeks at the minimum, with the candidate designated by the president having 28 days to form a coalition, with a possible two week extension.
paras.zh: 然而，如果我们即将进行一系列新的民意调查，那么至少几周内都不会发生，总统指定的候选人有 28 天的时间组建联合政府，并可能延长两周。

paras.en: Coalition talks loom as Israel exit polls suggest Netanyahu and Eisenkot blocs tied
paras.zh: 以色列出口民意调查显示内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特集团势均力敌，联盟谈判迫在眉睫

paras.en: Israel could be in for weeks of political haggling after exit polls and partial official results showed neither Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition nor the opposition bloc led by former general Gadi Eisenkot had won enough seats to form a government.
paras.zh: 出口民意调查和部分官方结果显示，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的联盟和前将军加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派集团都没有赢得足够的席位来组建政府，以色列可能会陷入数周的政治争论。

paras.en: The polls published by Israel’s major TV networks show Netanyahu’s governing bloc tied with the opposition grouping led by Eisenkot on 51 seats each, short of the 61 seats needed to form a majority coalition government.
paras.zh: 以色列主要电视网络公布的民意调查显示，内塔尼亚胡的执政集团与艾森科特领导的反对派集团各获得51个席位，低于组建多数联合政府所需的61个席位。

paras.en: Speaking at 3 am local time, Israel’s longest-serving prime minister vowed to assemble a coalition through agreements between his Likud party, far-right factions and Jewish religious parties.
paras.zh: 当地时间凌晨 3 点，以色列任职时间最长的总理发誓要通过其利库德集团、极右派系和犹太宗教政党之间的协议组建一个联盟。

paras.en: “We must put in place a strong government of the right,” Netanyahu told cheering supporters. “The Jewish and Zionist majority must unite,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们必须建立一个强大的右翼政府，”内塔尼亚胡对欢呼的支持者说。 “犹太人和犹太复国主义多数派必须团结起来，”他补充道。

paras.en: Eisenkot, speaking to his own supporters in Tel Aviv, said earlier in the evening that “people decided in favour of change” and Netanyahu should have “announced today his retirement from politics”.
paras.zh: 艾森科特当晚早些时候在特拉维夫对自己的支持者发表讲话时表示，“人们决定支持变革”，内塔尼亚胡应该“今天宣布退出政坛”。

paras.en: The election was marked by a record participation by Israeli citizens of Palestinian origin, a discriminated minority that makes up about 20% of the country’s population. Many in the group have sought a stronger political voice after decades of boycotting polls in the Jewish state. Millions of other Palestinians living under Israeli rule in the occupied West Bank and Gaza cannot vote, leading to accusations of apartheid.
paras.zh: 这次选举的标志是，巴勒斯坦裔以色列公民的参与创历史新高，他们是一个受歧视的少数群体，约占该国人口的 20%。在这个犹太国家数十年抵制民意调查后，该组织中的许多人寻求更强有力的政治声音。生活在被占领的约旦河西岸和加沙地带、生活在以色列统治下的数百万巴勒斯坦人无法投票，导致种族隔离的指控。

paras.en: Exit polls predicted Palestinian parties could win about 18 seats, up from 10. However, their role in any coalition would be difficult. Netanyahu has said it was “out of the question” to have a government backed by Palestinian parties, while Eisenkot has said Arab-led parties do not meet Zionist criteria to govern.
paras.zh: Exit polls predicted Palestinian parties could win about 18 seats, up from 10. However, their role in any coalition would be difficult.内塔尼亚胡表示，由巴勒斯坦政党支持的政府“不可能”，而艾森科特则表示，阿拉伯领导的政党不符合犹太复国主义的执政标准。

paras.en: Donald Trump has said he is “hearing that [Netanyahu] did very well,” speaking to reporters at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland. “I actually heard he did pretty well.”
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地对记者表示，他“听说内塔尼亚胡表现得很好”。 “其实我听说他表现得很好。”

paras.en: Trump cautioned that it was a “little bit early” and said he has not yet spoken with Netanyahu about the results. Trump endorsed Netanyahu late in the campaign, while Netanyahu stressed his close ties with the White House in his election night speech.
paras.zh: 特朗普警告说，现在“有点早”，并表示他尚未与内塔尼亚胡讨论结果。特朗普在竞选后期支持内塔尼亚胡，而内塔尼亚胡在选举之夜的演讲中强调了他与白宫的密切关系。

paras.en: Later on, Trump posted a quote to social media, crediting the support he gave to Benjamin Netanyahu for effecting the outcome of the elections, which remain far from clear.
paras.zh: 随后，特朗普在社交媒体上发布了一段话，称赞他对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的支持影响了选举结果，但目前尚不清楚。

paras.en: Attributing the lines to “Irving C. Schwartz”, the US president has posted:
paras.zh: 美国总统将这些台词归因于“欧文·C·施瓦茨”(Irving C. Schwartz)，并发表了这样的言论：

paras.en: When President Trump endorsed Bibi Netanyahu, the whole tide turned, and now, rather than a decisive defeat for a Great Prime Minister, it looks like a big come-from-behind stalemate, or even a WIN for Netanyahu. It all took place AFTER the Endorsement by President Trump, who only wants what is good for the Middle East, Israel, and the United States of America!”
paras.zh: 当特朗普总统支持比比·内塔尼亚胡时，整个局势发生了转变，现在，对于一位伟大的总理来说，这不是一场决定性的失败，而是一场大逆转，甚至是内塔尼亚胡的胜利。这一切都是在特朗普总统支持之后发生的，他只想对中东、以色列和美利坚合众国有利！”

paras.en: A record number of Israeli’s are expected to have voted at “special polling stations” in 2026, casting more confusion into the mix as the results as these ballots are not expected to be announced before Thursday.
paras.zh: 预计 2026 年，在“特别投票站”投票的以色列人数将创历史新高，这将带来更多混乱，因为这些选票的结果预计不会在周四之前公布。

paras.en: Under Israeli electoral law, each voter is assigned to a specific polling station and can only vote at that station. However in exceptional circumstances, some voters are allowed to cast their ballot at special polling stations they are not registered at. Among those afforded this exception are soldiers stationed at IDF bases, diplomats working abroad, prisoners and prison guards and people in hospital.
paras.zh: 根据以色列选举法，每个选民都被分配到一个特定的投票站，并且只能在该站投票。然而，在特殊情况下，一些选民可以在他们未登记的特殊投票站投票。获得这一例外的人员包括驻扎在以色列国防军基地的士兵、在国外工作的外交官、囚犯和狱警以及住院患者。

paras.en: Ballot boxes from these special polling stations are transported directly to the Knesset where they undergo a series of checks before they are counted.
paras.zh: 这些特殊投票站的选票箱被直接运送到议会，在计票前经过一系列检查。

paras.en: According to some reports, Israel’s Central Elections Committee expects between 600,000 and 650,000 people to vote in such a way, almost 10% of elegible voters and an unprecedented number in Israeli electoral history.
paras.zh: 据报道，以色列中央选举委员会预计将有60万至65万人以这种方式投票，几乎占合格选民的10%，这在以色列选举史上是前所未有的。

paras.en: While the count continues, let’s recap some of the comments made by Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot in their speeches to supporters.
paras.zh: 在计票工作继续进行的同时，让我们回顾一下本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和竞争对手加迪·艾森科特在向支持者发表的演讲中发表的一些言论。

paras.en: Netanyahu greeted cheering supporters at a Jerusalem convention centre after 3am. The 77-year-old prime minister was unusually brief and did not directly claim victory. He called for a “strong government of the right” and said that the “Jewish and Zionist majority must unite”.
paras.zh: 凌晨 3 点后，内塔尼亚胡在耶路撒冷会议中心向欢呼的支持者致意。这位77岁的总理讲话异常简短，没有直接宣布胜利。他呼吁建立一个“强大的右翼政府”，并表示“犹太人和犹太复国主义多数派必须团结起来”。

paras.en: He also listed leaders Israel has killed under his orders and again hinted that he was ready for a third bombing campaign against Iran alongside Donald Trump. “Israel has a unique opportunity with our partner President Trump to forever eliminate the existential threat of Iran,” he said.
paras.zh: 他还列出了以色列根据他的命令杀害的领导人，并再次暗示他已准备好与唐纳德·特朗普一起对伊朗进行第三次轰炸。他说：“以色列拥有与我们的伙伴特朗普总统合作的独特机会，可以永远消除伊朗的生存威胁。”

paras.en: Eisenkot, speaking earlier to his own supporters in Tel Aviv, issued a veiled warning to Netanyahu, who observers say could use a war to push for a unity government.
paras.zh: 艾森科特早些时候在特拉维夫对自己的支持者发表讲话，向内塔尼亚胡发出了含蓄的警告，观察人士称内塔尼亚胡可能会利用战争来推动联合政府。

paras.en: “Netanyahu, don’t you dare use Israel’s security for your political needs,” he said.
paras.zh: “内塔尼亚胡，你不敢利用以色列的安全来满足你的政治需要，”他说。

paras.en: Addressing Israel’s security establishment, Eisenkot said that they served the state and not Netanyahu, calling him “a caretaker prime minister, without a mandate or the people’s trust”.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在谈到以色列安全机构时表示，他们是为国家服务，而不是内塔尼亚胡，并称内塔尼亚胡是“看守总理，没有授权，也没有人民的信任”。

paras.en: Supporters of the opposition bloc breathed a sigh of relief after the first exit polls were announced, but as the night has worn on nervousness has grown on both sides.
paras.zh: 第一次出口民意调查公布后，反对派集团的支持者松了一口气，但随着夜幕降临，双方的紧张情绪都加剧了。

paras.en: With exit polls shifting to put the two sides on equal footing, Agence France-Presse is reporting that voters like former Hamas hostage Ohad Ben Ami have expressed alarm that Netanyahu could come out ahead.
paras.zh: 法新社报道称，随着出口民意调查显示双方处于平等地位，前哈马斯人质奥哈德·本·阿米等选民对内塔尼亚胡可能领先表示担忧。

paras.en: “Three years ago, the government abandoned us,” he said.
paras.zh: “三年前，政府抛弃了我们，”他说。

paras.en: An Israeli citizen should never have spent a year and a half in Hamas tunnels when deals [with Hamas] were on the table.”
paras.zh: 当[与哈马斯]达成协议时，以色列公民不应该在哈马斯地道里度过一年半的时间。”

paras.en: Netanyahu kept supporters waiting until past 3am in a Jerusalem convention centre. Known for his long, passionate speeches, he was unusually brief.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡让支持者在耶路撒冷会议中心一直等到凌晨3点多。他以长篇、充满激情的演讲而闻名，但他的演讲却异常简短。

paras.en: Ari Marx, holding a large sign bearing the prime minister’s image, said he was not “scared” of the results or of another war with Iran, which Netanyahu has threatened.
paras.zh: 阿里·马克思举着印有总理肖像的大牌子，他表示，他并不“害怕”结果，也不“害怕”内塔尼亚胡威胁要与伊朗爆发另一场战争。

paras.en: “Either Bibi is going to win or there’s going to be a new election,” he said, using Netanyahu’s nickname, doubting anyone else could form a government.
paras.zh: “要么比比获胜，要么举行新的选举，”他用内塔尼亚胡的绰号说道，怀疑其他人能否组建政府。

paras.en: It’s just after 6am in Tel Aviv where Israelis are waking up to exit polls that show no clear victor in yesterday’s elections, with uncertainty guaranteed at this point.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫凌晨 6 点刚过，以色列人一觉醒来就开始接受出口民意调查，结果显示昨天的选举没有明显的胜利者，目前的不确定性是存在的。

paras.en: The polls published by Israel’s major TV networks show Benjamin Netanyahu’s governing bloc tied with the opposition grouping led by Gadi Eisenkot on 51 seats each, short of the 61 seats needed to form a majority coalition government.
paras.zh: 以色列主要电视网络公布的民意调查显示，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的执政集团与加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派集团各获得51个席位，低于组建多数联合政府所需的61个席位。

paras.en: Earlier exit polls had Eisenkot winning most seats in the Knesset by a slight margin. Israeli exit polls are often revised after publication and are notoriously imprecise, with the final count often swinging by several seats.
paras.zh: 早些时候的出口民意调查显示，艾森科特以微弱优势赢得了议会大部分席位。以色列的出口民意调查经常在公布后进行修改，而且非常不精确，最终的计票结果往往会在几个席位之间摇摆不定。

paras.en: Voter turnout surged to the highest level in more than two decades, underscoring the stakes of an election that has been labelled the most important in the country’s history. More than 77% of eligible voters cast a ballot, according to Israel’s central elections committee, about 7 percentage points higher than in 2022.
paras.zh: 选民投票率飙升至二十多年来的最高水平，凸显了这场被称为该国历史上最重要的选举的风险。根据以色列中央选举委员会的数据，超过 77% 的合格选民参加了投票，比 2022 年高出约 7 个百分点。

paras.en: Final counting is ongoing, with more than 30% of the votes tabulated so far.
paras.zh: 最终计票工作正在进行中，目前已计票数超过 30%。

paras.en: The Palestinian parties are projected to dramatically increase their representation in the Knesset, with predictions they could win as many as 18 seats, up from 10. Experts have said that if Eisenkot falls short of a majority, as the exit polls suggest, he would be obliged to sit down to talk to the Palestinian groupings, the Joint List and Ra’am, to try to form a government – which could take weeks.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦各党派预计将大幅增加在以色列议会中的代表权，预计他们可能会赢得多达 10 个席位，从 10 个增加到 18 个。专家表示，如果艾森科特如出口民意调查显示的那样未能获得多数席位，他将不得不坐下来与巴勒斯坦组织“联合名单”和“拉阿姆”进行对话，以尝试组建政府 — — 这可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: It is also possible that Eisenkot could try to govern as a minority government, with informal vote-by-vote agreements that would keep the new coalition afloat.
paras.zh: 艾森科特也有可能尝试以少数派政府的身份执政，通过非正式的逐票表决协议来维持新联盟的运转。

paras.en: Netanyahu took the stage at a post-election rally in Jerusalem just after 3am, telling his supporters official results will show that “Likud is the largest party in Israel”. He told his supporters that the country must “establish a strong, right-wing national government” – adding that a government that relies on the support of Palestinian parties must not be formed.
paras.zh: 凌晨 3 点刚过，内塔尼亚胡在耶路撒冷举行的选举后集会上登台，告诉他的支持者，官方结果将显示“利库德集团是以色列最大的政党”。他告诉他的支持者，该国必须“建立一个强大的右翼国家政府”，并补充说，决不能组建一个依赖巴勒斯坦政党支持的政府。

paras.en: Eisenkot told cheering supporters in Tel Aviv that the “Israeli public has voted against Netanyahu’s service as Israel’s prime minister … a worthy leader would have accepted the people’s non-confidence and announced today his retirement from politics.” In his speech, he also warned Netanyahu not to “use Israel’s security” for political ends, playing on fears that the prime minister could use this period of uncertainty to launch a new attack on Iran.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在特拉维夫对欢呼的支持者说，“以色列公众投票反对内塔尼亚胡担任以色列总理……一位有价值的领导人会接受人民的不信任，并在今天宣布退出政坛。”他在讲话中还警告内塔尼亚胡不要“利用以色列的安全”达到政治目的，并利用了人们对总理可能利用这段不确定时期对伊朗发动新攻击的担忧。

paras.en: The exit polls were released after a last-ditch effort by Netanyahu and several other parties to keep polling stations open beyond their 10pm deadline was rejected by the Central Elections Committee. The prime minister suggested publicly that efforts were being made by the “left and Arabs” to steal the election, a claim rejected by the committee, which said it had seen no evidence of systematic tampering.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡和其他几个政党为在晚上 10 点截止日期后继续开放投票站所做的最后努力被中央选举委员会拒绝，随后公布了出口民意调查。总理公开暗示“左派和阿拉伯人”正在努力窃取选举结果，但该委员会拒绝了这一说法，称没有发现系统性篡改的证据。

articles.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say

paras.en: A ceasefire that began with the aim of getting food and medicine to the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky has been extended across the wider southern region of Kherson, according to sources.
paras.zh: 据消息人士透露，停火协议最初的目的是向俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市奥列什基运送食品和药品，现已扩大到赫尔松南部更广阔的地区。

paras.en: Several thousand residents are trapped in the city with no access to food, water and electricity. On one side is the Dnipro river, while Russian forces are on the other and all the roads out are too dangerous.
paras.zh: 数千名居民被困在城里，无法获得食物、水和电力。一侧是第聂伯河，另一侧是俄罗斯军队，所有出去的路都太危险了。

paras.en: However, no breaches of the truce that began early on Tuesday have so far been reported.
paras.zh: 然而，到目前为止，还没有任何违反周二早些时候开始的休战协议的报道。

paras.en: US First Lady Melania Trump, who helped broker the ceasefire along with Pope Leo XIV, said on Tuesday that the area involved had been expanded to provide "safe passage" for humanitarian convoys.
paras.zh: 与教皇利奥十四世一起促成停火的美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普周二表示，涉事区域已扩大，以便为人道主义车队提供“安全通道”。

paras.en: That was later corroborated by the press secretary to Ukraine's public ombudsman, and by Oleksandr Tolokonnikov, deputy head of Kherson, who said Russian shelling had stopped both in Kherson city, which is in Ukrainian hands, and the wider region.
paras.zh: 后来乌克兰公共监察员新闻秘书和赫尔松市副市长亚历山大·托洛科尼科夫证实了这一点，他们表示，俄罗斯在乌克兰手中的赫尔松市和更广泛地区的炮击已经停止。

paras.en: Under the deal, the ceasefire will be followed by deliveries of humanitarian aid to Oleshky and then evacuations, planned for Friday, for anyone wishing to leave.
paras.zh: 根据协议，停火后将向奥列什基运送人道主义援助物资，然后计划于周五对任何希望离开的人进行疏散。

paras.en: An estimated 1,700 to 2,000 people remain in Oleshky itself and a few thousand more in surrounding areas.
paras.zh: 据估计，奥列什基地区仍有 1,700 至 2,000 人，周边地区还有数千人。

paras.en: Many residents have resorted to cooking garden weeds to survive, telling the BBC they are suffering extreme hunger and want to leave.
paras.zh: 许多居民通过烹饪花园杂草来生存，他们告诉英国广播公司，他们正遭受极度饥饿，想要离开。

paras.en: Both sides said the ceasefire was being observed. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said everything was proceeding "according to plan", and paid tribute to US mediation and in particular representatives of Melania Trump.
paras.zh: 双方均表示正在遵守停火协议。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，一切都在“按计划”进行，并对美国的调解，特别是梅拉尼娅·特朗普的代表表示敬意。

paras.en: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said if the ceasefire produced results, it could "pave the way for other steps in the peace process".
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈表示，如果停火取得成果，它将“为和平进程的其他步骤铺平道路”。

paras.en: A key official in President Volodymyr Zelensky's parliamentary party, David Arakhamia, said it would continue until 22:59 Ukrainian time on Sunday 1 November, and described the truce as the "largest de-escalation since 2022".
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基(Volodymyr Zelensky)领导的议会党的一位重要官员大卫·阿拉哈米亚(David Arakhamia)表示，休战将持续到乌克兰时间11月1日星期日22:59，并将休战描述为“2022年以来最大规模的降级”。

paras.en: Before the war Oleshky was home to 24,000 people, but it was seized by Russia during the first days of its full-scale invasion in February 2022.
paras.zh: 战前奥列什基有 24,000 人，但在 2022 年 2 月全面入侵的头几天就被俄罗斯占领。

paras.en: No shops are open, and the city has had no electricity, gas or water since the Kakhovka Dam was blown up in 2023, flooding the area and killing many people in Oleshky itself.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年卡霍夫卡大坝被炸毁、洪水淹没该地区并导致奥列什基市内许多人死亡以来，没有商店开门，该市也没有电、煤气或水。

paras.en: Conditions have become so desperate that not only is getting supplies into the city extremely difficult, but escaping is too risky because the routes out of Oleshky have been mined and subject to drone attack.
paras.zh: 情况已经变得如此危急，不仅将物资运送到城市极其困难，而且逃跑也风险太大，因为离开奥列什基的路线已布满地雷，并容易受到无人机袭击。

paras.en: One woman told the BBC she had stepped on a landmine and was currently in hospital where she had undergone two operations: "I don't know how long I will have to spend there," she said, worried about not being able to join the evacuation.
paras.zh: 一名妇女告诉英国广播公司，她踩到了地雷，目前正在医院接受两次手术：“我不知道我要在那里呆多久，”她说，担心无法参加撤离行动。

paras.en: Pope Leo appealed earlier this month to Russia's President Vladimir Putin to allow food and medical aid into Oleshky as well as a safe evacuation, and urged his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky to co-operate with Moscow over a ceasefire.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥本月早些时候呼吁俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京允许向奥列什基提供食品和医疗援助以及安全疏散，并敦促乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在停火问题上与莫斯科合作。

paras.en: Then the White House said last week that Melania Trump had secured a ceasefire.
paras.zh: 白宫上周表示，梅拉尼娅·特朗普已确保停火。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the US first lady said on X that the area covered by the ceasefire "has expanded beyond Oleshky, within the Kherson region, to provide safe passage for the humanitarian convoys".
paras.zh: 周二，美国第一夫人 X 表示，停火覆盖的区域“已扩大到赫尔松地区的奥列什基以外，为人道主义车队提供安全通道”。

paras.en: The current truce is supposed to enable roads to be cleared of mines for supplies to get into the city possibly on Thursday, and for residents to have safe passage out in an evacuation planned for Friday.
paras.zh: 目前的休战协议应该能够清除道路上的地雷，以便物资可能在周四进入该市，并让居民在计划于周五的疏散中安全撤离。

paras.en: Russia's defence ministry said units from the army's Dnepr group had been conducting "engineering reconnaissance" and clearing main access roads into the village of "explosive and booby-trap devices".
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，陆军第聂伯集团的部队一直在进行“工程侦察”，并清理进入该村的主要道路上的“爆炸装置和诱杀装置”。

paras.en: Many details on the evacuation plans are unclear, and residents are wary of trusting officials with their names and addresses. However, a local volunteer told the BBC that about 500 people had already expressed interest by Tuesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 疏散计划的许多细节尚不清楚，居民对信任官员的姓名和地址持谨慎态度。然而，一名当地志愿者告诉 BBC，截至周二下午，已有约 500 人表达了兴趣。

paras.en: Vladimir Saldo, the Russian-installed head of occupied areas of Kherson, said temporary accommodation had been prepared in the region itself as well as Russian-annexed Crimea and across the Russian border in the Rostov, Krasnodar and Stavropol regions.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯任命的赫尔松被占领地区负责人弗拉基米尔·萨尔多表示，该地区以及俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚以及俄罗斯边境的罗斯托夫、克拉斯诺达尔和斯塔夫罗波尔地区已经准备好了临时住所。

paras.en: Saldo told Russian media that most Oleshky residents wanted to leave the city and stay in Russia, although his account has not been corroborated on the ground.
paras.zh: 萨尔多告诉俄罗斯媒体，大多数奥列什基居民希望离开该市并留在俄罗斯，尽管他的说法尚未得到当地证实。

paras.en: It is hard to make contact with people there as communication is patchy and many are reluctant to speak of the situation in fear of reprisals from the Russians.
paras.zh: 由于沟通不畅，很难与那里的人们取得联系，许多人因为担心遭到俄罗斯人的报复而不愿谈论情况。

paras.en: Those residents or relatives who have spoken to the BBC have expressed fears that Russia may not allow them to return to Ukraine, or might examine their phones and online activity for signs of Ukrainian support, which could put them in danger.
paras.zh: 那些接受英国广播公司采访的居民或亲属表示担心，俄罗斯可能不允许他们返回乌克兰，或者可能会检查他们的手机和在线活动是否有乌克兰支持的迹象，这可能会将他们置于危险之中。

paras.en: Ukraine's military general staff urged people not to trust unverified reports or spread rumours about "the routes, time and place of the movement of people and humanitarian convoys".
paras.zh: 乌克兰总参谋部敦促人们不要相信未经证实的报道或散布有关“人员和人道主义车队流动的路线、时间和地点”的谣言。

paras.en: Zelensky has warned that routes out of Oleshky that are demined by Russia will ensure that those civilians leaving Oleshky will "head towards Russia and stay there".
paras.zh: 泽连斯基警告说，俄罗斯在奥列什基出发的路线上排雷，将确保那些离开奥列什基的平民“前往俄罗斯并留在那里”。

paras.en: He said some residents would get to Ukrainian-controlled territory "one way or another", and that ideally anyone trapped would be able to reach their destination and evacuate to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 他说，一些居民将“以某种方式”到达乌克兰控制的领土，理想情况下，任何被困的人都能够到达目的地并撤离到乌克兰。

paras.en: One resident called Serhii, who fled Oleshky through minefields around three weeks ago, said he had eventually returned to Ukraine via Russia and Belarus. He called for a route across the River Dnipro that avoided Russian-occupied territory, saying "you simply cannot trust the Russian Federation".
paras.zh: 一位名叫谢尔希的居民大约三周前通过雷区逃离了奥列什基，他说他最终通过俄罗斯和白俄罗斯返回乌克兰。他呼吁修建一条穿越第聂伯河、避开俄罗斯占领领土的路线，并表示“你根本不能相信俄罗斯联邦”。

paras.en: However, bridges across the River Dnipro have been destroyed and sources say the riverbank is also mined and dangerous, so crossing into Ukrainian-controlled territory appears impossible.
paras.zh: 然而，横跨第聂伯河的桥梁已被摧毁，消息人士称，河岸上也布满了地雷，十分危险，因此进入乌克兰控制的领土似乎是不可能的。

paras.en: Across the river, in Kherson city, no explosions have been heard and no drone-related injuries reported since 03:00 (01:00 GMT) on Tuesday and cars and pedestrians have been moving freely, according to local reports.
paras.zh: 据当地报道，自周二 03:00（格林威治标准时间 01:00）以来，河对岸的赫尔松市没有听到爆炸声，也没有无人机造成的伤害报告，汽车和行人一直在自由通行。

paras.en: "Judging from the fact that more people are walking around, it feels a bit calmer," Galina Kyrychenko, a resident in the city, told public broadcaster Suspilne.
paras.zh: 该市居民加林娜·基里琴科 (Galina Kyrychenko) 告诉公共广播公司 Suspilne：“从周围走动的人越来越多来看，感觉稍微平静了一些。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Anastasiia Levchenko in Kyiv.
paras.zh: Anastasiia Levchenko 在基辅的补充报道。

articles.title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison in sex trafficking case

paras.en: Three brothers - two of them wealthy real-estate moguls - were sentenced to 30 years each in prison for drugging and raping dozens of women over decades.
paras.zh: 三兄弟——其中两人是富有的房地产大亨——因数十年来对数十名妇女下药和强奸而被分别判处 30 年监禁。

paras.en: Tal Alexander, 40, and twins Oren and Alon Alexander, 39, were found guilty in March of using their wealth and social status to lure women to parties and luxury homes, where they sexually assaulted them.
paras.zh: 40 岁的塔尔·亚历山大 (Tal Alexander) 和 39 岁的双胞胎奥伦·亚历山大 (Oren Alexander) 和阿隆·亚历山大 (Alon Alexander) 三月份被判有罪，罪名是利用自己的财富和社会地位引诱女性参加派对和豪华住宅，并对她们实施性侵犯。

paras.en: "Your conduct was monstrous," said Judge Valerie Caproni before sentencing them. "Your crimes wreaked havoc on their lives."
paras.zh: 瓦莱丽·卡普罗尼法官在对他们宣判前说道：“你们的行为太可怕了。” “你的罪行对他们的生活造成了严重破坏。”

paras.en: On Tuesday morning, the court in New York heard from 12 victims, including one who did not testify during the trial.
paras.zh: 周二上午，纽约法院听取了 12 名受害者的陈述，其中包括一名在审判期间没有出庭作证的受害者。

paras.en: One by one, they spoke of the psychological trauma they endured after the Alexander brothers raped them, and their desire for the shame they had felt to instead fall on the defendants.
paras.zh: 他们一一讲述了亚历山大兄弟强奸他们后所遭受的心理创伤，以及他们希望自己所感受到的耻辱落在被告身上的愿望。

paras.en: Many asked the judge to impose the maximum sentence of life in prison for each brother.
paras.zh: 许多人要求法官对兄弟俩判处最高无期徒刑。

paras.en: Maya Miller told the court that after Tal Alexander raped her in 2014, she lost all sense of safety. "I carry a quiet funeral within me for the person I might've become if this never happened to me," she said.
paras.zh: 玛雅·米勒 (Maya Miller) 在法庭上表示，2014 年塔尔·亚历山大 (Tal Alexander) 强奸她后，她失去了所有安全感。 “如果这件事从未发生在我身上，我会为我可能成为的人举行一场安静的葬礼，”她说。

paras.en: Another victim, using the pseudoym Isa Brooks, said after being raped by Tal and Alon Alexander when she was 16, she lost the ability to trust herself.
paras.zh: 另一位化名伊莎·布鲁克斯 (Isa Brooks) 的受害者表示，16 岁时被塔尔·亚历山大 (Tal Alexander) 和阿隆·亚历山大 (Alon Alexander) 强奸后，她失去了信任自己的能力。

paras.en: "I had no idea the danger I was in till it was too late," she said.
paras.zh: “我不知道自己处于危险之中，直到为时已晚，”她说。

paras.en: Another woman said when she planned to come forward about being raped, Tal Alexander threatened her, saying he knew where her sister worked.
paras.zh: 另一位女士说，当她打算挺身而出讲述被强奸的事情时，塔尔·亚历山大威胁她，说他知道她姐姐在哪里工作。

paras.en: Prosecutor Elizabeth Espinosa said the brothers deserved the maximum punishment for their crimes, saying facts "paint a truly devastating picture".
paras.zh: 检察官伊丽莎白·埃斯皮诺萨表示，兄弟俩的罪行应受到最严厉的惩罚，并称事实“描绘了一幅真正具有毁灭性的画面”。

paras.en: "For years, they honed their methods of luring women with the promise of luxury," she said, adding that they were "completely unmoved by the path of suffering they left behind them."
paras.zh: “多年来，他们磨练了用奢华的承诺来吸引女性的方法，”她说，并补充说，他们“对自己留下的痛苦之路完全无动于衷。”

paras.en: During the women's speeches, the three Alexander brothers showed little emotion. They stared ahead or conferred with their lawyers, who said they advised their clients not to look at the victims so it couldn't be misconstrued.
paras.zh: 在妇女们的讲话中，亚历山大三兄弟几乎没有表现出任何情绪。他们凝视前方或与律师商量，律师表示他们建议客户不要看受害者，以免被误解。

paras.en: Attorneys for the brothers pushed for sentences of 15 years, arguing that they had become devoted fathers whose families would suffer in their absence.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩的律师主张判处 15 年有期徒刑，理由是他们已经成为忠诚的父亲，如果他们缺席，他们的家人将会遭受苦难。

paras.en: The three men all addressed the court, continuing to profess their innocence.
paras.zh: 三人均在法庭上发言，继续声称自己无罪。

paras.en: "We had a work-hard, play-hard mentality," Tal Alexander said, adding he saw how his behavior "hurt people's feelings".
paras.zh: 塔尔·亚历山大说：“我们有一种努力工作、尽情玩乐的心态。”他补充说，他看到自己的行为“伤害了人们的感情”。

paras.en: But their statements did not assuage Caproni, who chastised them for refusing to admit their crimes.
paras.zh: 但他们的声明并没有安抚卡普罗尼，卡普罗尼谴责他们拒绝承认自己的罪行。

paras.en: "How can someone who never acknowledged the wrongs they did be rehabilitated?" she asked.
paras.zh: “一个从来不承认自己所犯错误的人如何能够平反呢？”她问道。

paras.en: At the end of the hearing, she sentenced them each to 30 years in prison for certain crimes. She also sentenced each to 20 years in prison for additional crimes, but said the men would serve the sentences concurrently.
paras.zh: 听证会结束时，她因某些罪行判处他们每人 30 年监禁。她还因其他罪行判处两人 20 年监禁，但表示两人将同时服刑。

paras.en: During the five-week trial, 11 women - several said they were minors at the time of the assaults - testified that the brothers gave them gifts and flew them places including Aspen and the Bahamas where they fed them drugs before raping them.
paras.zh: 在为期五周的审判中，11 名妇女（其中几人称她们在袭击发生时还未成年）作证说，兄弟俩给了她们礼物，并让她们飞到了包括阿斯彭和巴哈马在内的地方，并在强奸她们之前给她们喂了毒品。

paras.en: Prosecutors said the brothers' pattern of abusive behaviour began in high school, though the trial involved crimes starting in 2008.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，兄弟俩的虐待行为从高中就开始了，不过审判涉及的犯罪行为是从 2008 年开始的。

paras.en: They said the three slipped drugs into women's drinks, and "physically restrained and held down their victims during the rapes and sexual assaults and ignored screams and explicit requests to stop".
paras.zh: 他们说，三人将毒品放入女性饮料中，“在强奸和性侵犯期间对受害者进行身体约束和压制，无视尖叫声和明确的停止要求”。

paras.en: Lawyers for the brothers argued the sex was consensual and that they were womanisers, but not abusers.
paras.zh: 兄弟俩的律师辩称，性行为是双方同意的，他们是好色之徒，但不是施虐者。

paras.en: Two of the brothers, Tal and Oren, became wealthy selling luxury properties in New York and Miami.
paras.zh: 塔尔和奥伦两兄弟通过在纽约和迈阿密出售豪华房产而致富。

paras.en: They worked for American real estate giant Douglas Elliman, with clients including Lindsay Lohan, Kim Kardashian and Kanye West. In 2022, they founded their own New York-based firm called Official. Alon worked at the family's private security firm, Kent Security.
paras.zh: 他们为美国房地产巨头道格拉斯艾丽曼工作，客户包括林赛·罗韩、金·卡戴珊和坎耶·维斯特。 2022年，他们在纽约成立了自己的公司，名为Official。阿隆在家族的私人保安公司 Kent Security 工作。

paras.en: As they heard their sentences, the brothers stared straight ahead.
paras.zh: 听到这句话，兄弟俩目光直视前方。

articles.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?

paras.en: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
paras.zh: 观看：以色列大选投票结果接近之后会发生什么？

paras.en: Polls have closed in the Israeli election and votes are being counted.
paras.zh: 以色列选举投票已经结束，计票工作正在进行中。

paras.en: Exit polls suggest there is no clear winner, with neither veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor former military chief Gadi Eisenkot on track to secure a majority.
paras.zh: 出口民意调查显示，没有明显的赢家，资深总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和前军事首长加迪·艾森科特都没有有望获得多数席位。

paras.en: The BBC's Hugo Bachega looks at what might happen next.
paras.zh: BBC 的雨果·巴切加 (Hugo Bachega) 探讨了接下来可能发生的情况。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: SEMA Show to Debut Content Creator Corral
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show announced it will debut the Content Creator Corral, a feature that brings automotive influencers and their custom vehicles into one dedicated space at the Las Vegas Convention Center Nov. 3-6.

Located in the Main Hall Annex, the Content Creator Corral expands on Road to SEMA, an initiative that follows creators as they travel long distances to bring their projects to the annual SEMA Show. The feature builds on the journeys and brings those stories to life, allowing attendees to see the vehicles up close and connect with the influencers behind them.
As creators influence vehicle customization trends and purchasing decisions, the showcase provides exhibitors, manufacturers and attendees with an opportunity to engage directly with these voices.

“Automotive creators are helping introduce new audiences to vehicle customization and the specialty-equipment industry,” said RJ de Vera, vice president of Marketing for SEMA. “Road to SEMA gave us a chance to share their journeys with a wider audience, and the Content Creator Corral builds on that by bringing the creators and their vehicles together at the Show. It’s a chance for attendees to meet the people behind the builds and see firsthand what makes the automotive aftermarket community so special.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The Content Creator Corral will feature custom vehicles from creators across the U.S. and abroad, representing a range of makes, models and builds. The lineup includes vehicles that have traveled thousands of miles and crossed international borders to reach Las Vegas.

Examples include a Ford Mustang rebuilt in Lithuania after being purchased in Florida; a BMW Z3 M Coupé transformed into a Max Power-era Club Sport-inspired showpiece; a Porsche Boxster converted into the Vale Automotive GT1 in Northern Ireland; and a Ford Escort RS Cosworth traveling 3,500 miles across the U.S. The lineup also includes a KVA Ford GT40, Porsche 944 RS4 and a genuine “2 Fast 2 Furious” Yenko Camaro restored by Hard Up Garage.

Beyond the vehicles, the Content Creator Corral highlights the people, creativity and dedication that drive automotive culture. Attendees can meet the creators behind the builds, hear their stories and connect with others who share their passion.

“Getting to share an iconic build with the SEMA community in person is a pretty special experience,” said Ciro Ciampi of Petrolheadonism. “We collectively put in so much time, work and passion into our project with all our partners, so seeing people connect with it and hearing their reactions will make all the effort worthwhile.”

“My SEMA journey began with me as an outsider to the organization – literally, because I didn’t have the industry connections yet to be an official part of the SEMA Show – so it’s an honor to be part of history as one of the content creators being featured at the Content Creator Corral,” said Jordan Graff of Shipboxgarage.

The 2026 SEMA Show will take place Nov. 3-6 in Las Vegas as the centerpiece of a “SEMA Week” experience that culminates with public access on Friday and SEMA Fest. To learn more or register, visit semashow.com.
The 2026 SEMA Show opens on Election Day, Nov. 3. SEMA’s Drive the Vote campaign encourages attendees to make a plan to vote before traveling to Las Vegas. Visit sema.org/vote for more information.

articles.title: BendPak Introduces Slimmer Lifts to Store Four Vehicles in Two Spaces
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The new BendPak PL-12000KDS and PL-12000KDT double-wide parking lifts securely store four vehicles in two parking spots without the hassle associated with traditional double-wide parking lifts. Plus, their narrow footprint allows more lifts to fit in a facility.

The PL-12000KDS/KDT models are the latest in the PL-12000 tandem lift lineup and feature BendPak’s patent-pending independent platform design. Traditional double-wide parking lifts require all vehicles on the bottom to be removed before those on top can be lowered. The PL-12000 series platforms operate independently, so one can be lowered while the other remains stationary. Only one vehicle must be moved to access a vehicle parked above. The platform architecture provides double-car-width open front access to improve entry and exit efficiency.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: With commercial and residential development costs rising, maximizing vehicle capacity within existing space can deliver cost savings.

“Our new PL-12000KDS and PL-12000KDT tandem parking lifts feature a narrower footprint than our original PL-12000 models for customers who want to maximize the number of lifts they can fit in their parking facility,” said Jeff Kritzer, president and CEO of BendPak. “Reducing the width by 15.5 inches, from 221.5 to 206 inches, allows more vehicles to be stored in a facility without expanding the building space. When filling a warehouse, saving just a few inches per lift means 20 lifts can be installed instead of 19 or fewer — that’s space to accommodate at least four more cars.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The PL-12000KDS offers a standard max rise of 70 inches and short platforms, while the PL-12000KDT has an extended rise of 82 inches and long platforms. Each platform is rated for 6,000 lbs., for a total lift capacity of 12,000 lbs. Designed for commercial or residential use, they can store cars and light trucks as well as motorcycles, ATVs, golf carts and other equipment.

The lifts feature heavy-duty steel construction, galvanized lifting cables and a powder-coat finish. A hydraulic drive system delivers power while requiring minimal service and maintenance. Tandem drive cylinders and a hydraulic circuit provide equalized lifting.
Integrated safety features include automatic safety locks at multiple heights, wide baseplates for stability and built-in front wheel stops.

The double-width platforms shield lower vehicles from leaks or drips above. For dual-purpose service/parking use, the lightweight aluminum center decks slide out to provide open-center access to raised vehicles.
The PL-12000KDS and PL-12000KDT are covered by BendPak’s five-year warranty.
For more information, visit bendpak.com/car-lifts/parking-lifts.

articles.title: Texas State Technical College hosts auto collision Battle Royale
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Texas State Technical College (TSTC) Waco’s Auto Collision and Management program recently hosted its first Battle Royale competition at the Fentress Center.

Students competed in collision repair and refinishing contests, depending on the certificate or associate degree program they are pursuing, an Instagram post from the college states. The contests included dent repair, marking, panel blocking, and preparation. Students also completed an interview for the competition.
The provost’s office at the Waco campus provided scholarship funding for the winning students, and industry partners supported the event through sponsorships and in-kind donations, the post adds.
Local news station KWTX reports industry representatives attended the event to observe the competition and connect with prospective technicians.
Competitor Nery Martinez, a refinishing student, told KWTX the event introduced him to the high-pressure demands of the trade.

“Today, we got an interview, which is most important; we got to run down how an interview goes, and we got to mask a car, basically showing us if we can handle how to mask a car the right, proper way,” Martinez said in the newscast.
Martinez works prep with his father at Alliance Collision and told KWTX that automotive painting runs in his family.

“I want to give props to my Dad. He’s a painter himself to this day,” Martinez told the news station. “He graduated from this school about 20 years ago, and he motivates me every day just to keep pushing. Because he did it, why can’t I?”
TSTC provides hands-on training, Martinez told KWTX.

“It’s stressful, of course, but deep down, you’ve got to give it what you got. It’s not about the next person beside you,” Martinez said in the interview. “That’s how it is in the real world; they ask for what you got, not what your partner got.”

articles.title: Auto insurer switching up despite no change in YoY shopping
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Q3 Quarterly Insurance Signals Intelligence Report from JD Power and TransUnion shows auto insurance carrier switching increased even though year-over-year (YoY) shopping was flat.
The latest report shows shopping reached 13.2% and switching 5.1%, both up 0.6 percentage points from Q2.
“Looking at longer-term auto trends, shopping has flattened while switching has continued to increase; this could signal a potential for continued retention pressure on carriers,” the report states.
Among auto insurer switchers, the median premium amount moving carriers was more than $3,300 in Q3, according to the report.

According to the report’s Auto Loyalty Tracker, NJM, Erie, USAA, Country Financial, and Mercury had higher customer loyalty, while Nationwide, Alfa, Direct Auto, Root, and National General had lower loyalty.

“After a cool-down in shopping in Q2, shop rates rose again beginning in July and remained elevated through the end of Q3,” the report states. “Switching rose considerably, hitting a record high in August of 5.3% before falling slightly to 5.0%, equaling the prior record recorded in July.”
It adds that consumers are finding fewer opportunities for meaningful savings through switching carriers as rate actions moderate and premium increases stabilize.
“Auto shopping growth has slowed significantly from the elevated levels observed during 2024 and 2025, signaling a more normalized market environment,” the report states.
The report also highlights shopping and switching trends in home and renters insurance lines.
Lastly, it notes that AI agents like Meta Muse could drive shopping and switching higher by making it easier for consumers to find better rates.
Previous Quarterly Insurance Signals Intelligence reports are available here.
In a new whitepaper, LexisNexis Risk Solutions details survey findings on auto insurance shopping trends, stating that 72% of consumers who shopped for auto insurance are open to switching carriers.
Of the 72%, 17% said they were definitely seeking a new auto insurance company. Eighty-seven percent said the auto insurance shopping experience was easier than expected or met their expectations.

“Consumers are increasingly treating auto insurance as an ongoing value comparison, not a one-time renewal decision,” said Jeff Batiste, LexisNexis auto and home senior vice president and general manager, in a press release. “Our research shows that many auto insurance shoppers are open to switching, but price and perceived value ultimately determine whether they stay or leave. For insurance carriers, auto shopping behavior can be an early signal of competitive pressure and retention risk, and the ability to identify and act on those signals sooner can help retain profitable policyholders while uncovering opportunities to acquire new customers.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: LexisNexis says, according to its research:
- “Consumers are cost-conscious and willing to compare policy options, and many find the shopping experience easier than expected.
- “Price often outweighs loyalty in both switching and staying decisions.
- “While bundled policies still exhibit higher retention, bundling alone may not protect insurance carriers from consumers evaluating options.
- “Insurance affordability is becoming a key part of the vehicle purchase decision.
- “Auto and insurance-related events have a much greater impact on auto insurance shopping than life events.”

“When insurers raised rates broadly to restore profitability, they triggered a comparison-shopping habit that persists even as some rate decreases are taking effect today,” LexisNexis says in the press release. “That focus on cost extends beyond the switching decision, with price continuing to outweigh loyalty even after consumers choose a new insurance carrier.”
According to recent LendingTree survey results, half of Americans with auto or home insurance have avoided filing a claim largely because they fear their premiums would go up.
Nearly three-quarters (73%) of “claim avoiders” said their most recent situation involved car insurance.

articles.title: AkzoNobel updates basecoat blending practices in technical bulletin
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: AkzoNobel has released an updated technical service bulletin that significantly expands on the area needed to perform an effective color blend.

“A lot of times we are challenged with helping customers have a way to explain or provide information to an insurer or a customer or anybody else about the blend operation and how much room it takes to blend,” Greg Askew, AkzoNobel North America technical services specialist, automotive and speciality coatings vehicle refinishes, told Repairer Driven News (RDN).
Ultimately, Askew said technicians consider multiple factors and use their judgment on each repair.

“We are laying out what those considerations and factors are that determine how much space it may take to blend a color and if it’s going to fall into an adjacent panel,” Askew said about the bulletin.

The bulletin says that the goal is to achieve an undetectable color blend while keeping the overall repair area as small as practical. It adds that maintaining the color blend within the repaired panel may be suitable and is the preferred method for economy and efficiency when sufficient space is available.
“However, when planning the area needed for blending, it is important to consider the completed repair rather than just the original dent or scratch,” the bulletin states.

Preparation includes a sanded feather-edge for a smooth transition through the existing coating layers into the OEM clearcoat. This transition extends a few inches beyond the original damage and becomes part of the area where primer surfacer is applied, according to the bulletin.

Sanding the applied primer surfacer also requires a smooth transition into the surrounding finish, the bulletin adds. This sanding extends a few inches beyond the primer surfacer application area and further increases the size of the completed repair.

Sealer may be applied over the sanded primer surfacer, depending on the specifics of the repair and the technician’s judgement, the bulletin notes. This would extend the repair area beyond the sanded edge of the primer surfacer.

“The area needed to achieve a seamless color blend is influenced by several factors,” the bulletin states. “These include the type and extent of damage, additional sanding and filling, color application characteristics, and the location and geometry of the panel. Style lines and changes in panel angle can influence how effectively the available area can be used for blending. Translucent colors may require a ground coat or additional basecoat application, while some colors or specific paint technology may require a wet bed. These factors should be considered when determining the overall space needed for the repair.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: According to the bulletin, the available blend area must also allow for the clearcoat application. At the edge of the blend panel, AkzoNobel recommends only one coat of clearcoat to limit a perceived color shift caused by differing clearcoat depth.

However, all applied basecoat, including any wet bed, requires two coats of clearcoat to provide the necessary UV protection for the basecoat binder and pigments, the bulletin states. Basecoat and wet bed must therefore remain within the area receiving the two coats of clearcoat.

AkzoNobel adds that a clearcoat-only area extending two to four inches inward from the blend-panel edge is a reasonable planning allowance. The technician’s judgment and application technique should determine the actual extent.

“Based on AkzoNobel technical team field experience and training practice, the following groups provide general guidance for planning the blend area across basecoat systems,” the bulletin states. “Blend distances are measured outward from the final repair area edge, including any extension resulting from sealer application. The distances are general planning guidelines rather than specific requirements. Detailed application methods remain subject to the applicable TDS and any color-specific instructions. “
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Askew said the document doesn’t cover every specific scenario but tries to encompass the most common repair considerations.
“We try to be as neutral as possible because all of it’s still a judgment and there’s so many variables,” Askew said.
The bulletin was expanded to assist repairers in communicating some of these variables, he said.

“Somebody that’s not familiar with the repair process and blending thinks, ‘Well, here’s the dent and so you’ve got plenty of room to blend,’” Askew said. “But once the dent is repaired, it grows. The damage to the paint is expanded. Once you fix that edge, that edge is extended even further. Then you have to apply primer, which extends the edge a little bit further. Then, when you sand that primar edge, it extends it a little bit further. Then if you put sealer on it, which is a choice, it is going to grow that edge even more.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems also recently announced that the combined company will use the name Axanzo after their intended merger is complete.

“We’re excited to announce the new name for our combined company,” said Greg Poux-Guillaume, AkzoNobel CEO, in a news release. “Axanzo signals a bold new start for a company which will be stronger in every way. It’s a launchpad for going further and faster than we ever could alone, embodying the pace and power to innovate, the strength to deliver and the excellence to succeed.”
Poux-Guillaume will be the company’s new CEO.

Chris Villavarayan, CEO of Axalta, who will be deputy CEO of the combined company, adds: “Axanzo will continuously reset the standard of what coatings can do. The new name perfectly captures our shared ambition to push boundaries, honoring our heritage and offering an exciting glimpse of what’s to come.”
Both companies will continue to operate independently until closing, expected in early 2027.
