Productions that opt out of the additional requirements, or fail to meet the standard, still qualify for 96 percent of their allocated credit rather than the full amount.
paras.zh: 根据扩大后的规则，制作公司必须提交一份涵盖招聘、工作场所教育、劳动力发展和供应商多样性的清单。他们还必须提交一份计划，概述扩大就业机会的具体努力、拍摄开始前的临时评估以及制作完成后的最终评估。该倡议不包括种族配额或招聘目标；相反，它评估作品是否为实现其蓝图中的目标做出了真诚的努力。选择不满足额外要求或未达到标准的作品仍有资格获得其分配学分的 96%，而不是全额。

paras.en: Diversity programs requiring applicants to come from certain racial or ethnic groups have long been on legally tenuous ground, but the nail in the coffin came in 2023 when the Supreme Court struck down race-conscious admissions in colleges. Since then, there’s been heightened scrutiny around such initiatives. A year after the decision, a script coordinator for SEAL Team who was denied a staff writer job sued CBS Studios and Paramount for allegedly carrying diversity quotas that discriminate against white men. General counsels at studios have pushed to keep race out of hiring decisions. Policies meant to encourage more inclusive hiring now often employ read-between-the-lines placeholders like “underrepresented” or “underserved” or “unique experiences.”
paras.zh: 长期以来，要求申请者来自某些种族或族裔群体的多元化计划在法律上一直站不住脚，但棺材上的钉子在 2023 年敲响了警钟，当时最高法院否决了大学在招生时注重种族的做法。从那时起，对此类举措的审查就更加严格。该决定一年后，一名被拒绝担任编剧工作的海豹突击队剧本协调员起诉哥伦比亚广播公司工作室和派拉蒙影业，称其实施了歧视白人的多元化配额。工作室的总法律顾问一直在努力将种族因素排除在招聘决策之外。旨在鼓励更具包容性的招聘的政策现在经常采用字里行间的占位符，例如“代表性不足”或“服务不足”或“独特的体验”。

paras.en: Part of the Barquet’s grievance also stemmed from its belief that an untitled movie from Daniel Kawn and Daniel Scheinert had complied with the program’s requirements but was rejected three times. Universal Pictures’ Snoop Dogg biopic, he added, was rejected twice before a recent greenlight. The exec indicated that he didn’t know why these titles were initially rejected from qualifying for the state’s diversity initiative. Snoop is expected to receive $17 million in tax credits from the California Film Commission, though the figure will come in lower if the production fails to complete the program (the commission hasn’t approved Snoop yet but is expected to do so, according to a person familiar with the matter).
paras.zh: Barquet 的部分不满还源于它认为 Daniel Kawn 和 Daniel Scheinert 的一部未命名电影符合该计划的要求，但被拒绝了 3 次。他补充说，环球影业的《史努比狗狗》传记片在最近获得批准之前曾两次被拒绝。这位高管表示，他不知道为什么这些头衔最初被拒绝获得该州多元化倡议的资格。 《史努比》预计将从加州电影委员会获得 1700 万美元的税收抵免，但如果制作未能完成该计划，这一数字将会更低（据一位知情人士透露，该委员会尚未批准《史努比》，但预计会批准）。

paras.en: Some studios believe they should get credited for complying with California’s overall goal to boost diversity in the Hollywood workforce because they still maintain diversity program even though particular productions may not have sufficiently diverse cast and crew or made good-faith efforts to achieve diversity goals.
paras.zh: 一些电影公司认为，他们应该因遵守加州促进好莱坞劳动力多元化的总体目标而受到赞誉，因为他们仍然维持多元化计划，即使某些制作可能没有足够多元化的演员和工作人员，或者没有为实现多元化目标做出真诚的努力。

paras.en: Andrew Davis, Sony Pictures’ president of production administration, echoed Universal’s criticism of the diversity initiatives’ construction, saying that studios want to participate in the program but that compliance is a “tremendous burden on both television and features.” Thom Davis, the head of IATSE Local 80, argued that diversity initiatives clash with the longtime process of placing members into productions.
paras.zh: 索尼影业的制作管理总裁安德鲁·戴维斯(Andrew Davis)回应了环球影业对多元化计划建设的批评，称电影公司希望参与该计划，但合规性“对电视和故事片来说都是巨大的负担”。 IATSE Local 80 的负责人 Thom Davis 认为，多元化举措与将成员投入制作的长期流程相冲突。

paras.en: “All this work and all these resources put into [studio diversity] programs are getting no credit and are actually being discouraged,” Davis said. “We’ve got people that come in through the union side who tell us they aren’t getting on” because productions need to prioritize compliance at times.
paras.zh: 戴维斯说：“所有这些工作和投入[工作室多样性]项目的所有资源都没有得到认可，而且实际上受到了阻碍。” “工会方面的人告诉我们他们进展不顺利”，因为制作有时需要优先考虑合规性。

paras.en: By Cox’s thinking, however, increasing minority representation in Hollywood means giving a share of work to Californians looking for a foothold in the industry who also reflect the diversity of the state.
paras.zh: 然而，根据考克斯的想法，增加少数族裔在好莱坞的代表性意味着向那些寻求在该行业立足的加州人提供一份工作，这些人也反映了该州的多样性。

paras.en: “All these jobs are coming back, and they’re still going to the same people,” Cox, who no longer works with the commission, says. She adds, “This is a system-wide problem. Ultimately, it’s the studios that need to do the work.”
paras.zh: “所有这些工作岗位都会回来，而且仍然属于同一个人，”不再在该委员会工作的考克斯说。她补充道，“这是一个系统范围的问题。最终，需要做这项工作的是工作室。”

paras.en: In a statement, Bell stressed that the commission is in regular talks with the studios on the issue. “Our goal hasn’t changed: keep California the best place to make film and television, with opportunity open to everyone who wants to build a career here,” she said.
paras.zh: 贝尔在一份声明中强调，委员会正在与电影公司就这个问题进行定期会谈。 “我们的目标没有改变：让加州成为制作电影和电视的最佳之地，为每个想在这里开创事业的人提供机会，”她说。

articles.title: ‘Fear Factor’ Goes Vertical With Scripted Microdrama
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: Fox‘s Fear Factor: House of Fear is going in a couple of new directions: The reality series will be the basis for a scripted microdrama.
paras.zh: 福克斯的《恐惧因素：恐惧屋》正朝着几个新方向发展：真人秀系列将成为有剧本的微剧的基础。

paras.en: Fox Entertainment Studios and Endemol Shine North America are teaming up for a vertical video show inspired by the current iteration of Fear Factor, which is going into its second season on the network (Endemol Shine North America, a Banijay company, produces the unscripted series). The microseries will stream on the My Drama platform owned by Holywater Tech, in which Fox has an equity stake.
paras.zh: 福克斯娱乐工作室 (Fox Entertainment Studios) 和 Endemol Shine North America 正在联手制作一部垂直视频节目，其灵感来自当前版本的《恐惧因素》(Fear Factor)，该节目即将在网络上播出第二季（Banijay 公司的 Endemol Shine North America 制作了该无脚本剧集）。这部微剧将在由福克斯持有股权的 Holywater Tech 旗下的 My Drama 平台上播出。

paras.en: According to Fox, the currently untitled microdrama will mark the first unscripted-to-scripted franchise extension in television. It’s also the first horror series for My Drama (though there are a number of vampire and werewolf romances on the platform).
paras.zh: 据福克斯报道，这部目前尚未命名的微剧将标志着电视领域第一部从无剧本到有剧本的系列延伸。这也是 My Drama 的第一部恐怖系列（尽管该平台上有许多吸血鬼和狼人的爱情故事）。

paras.en: “Fear Factor has always tapped into something primal: what scares us, how far we’ll go and what happens when we’re forced to confront our fears,” said Hannah Pillemer, head of scripted at Fox Entertainment Studios. “The tremendous response [to Fear Factor: House of Fear] has opened the door to take Fear Factor somewhere it has never gone before: becoming the first unscripted television franchise to make the leap into original scripted storytelling. Our friends at Endemol Shine came to us with an inspired way to do exactly that, turning everything audiences love about Fear Factor into the foundation for a completely original horror story.”
paras.zh: “《恐惧因素》总是利用一些原始的东西：我们害怕什么，我们会走多远，以及当我们被迫面对恐惧时会发生什么，”福克斯娱乐工作室的剧本主管汉娜·皮勒默(Hannah Pillemer)说。 “《恐惧因素：恐惧之屋》的巨大反响打开了大门，让《恐惧因素》达到了前所未有的高度：成为第一部无剧本电视系列，实现了原创剧本叙事的飞跃。Endemol Shine 的朋友们向我们提出了一种充满灵感的方式来实现这一目标，将观众喜爱的《恐惧因素》的一切都转变为完全原创的恐怖故事的基础。”

paras.en: Added Michael Heyerman, executive vp unscripted series at Endemol Shine North America, “Vertical storytelling is creating a new language for entertainment, one built on immediacy, intimacy, and serialized discovery, and Fear Factor already speaks it fluently. Our partners at Fox gave the franchise a powerful new life with House of Fear, and we’re proud to build on that momentum. Alongside Holywater, together we’re creating a new generation of horror that doesn’t just fit the mobile screen but uses it as part of the experience.”
paras.zh: Endemol Shine 北美无剧本剧集执行副总裁迈克尔·海尔曼 (Michael Heyerman) 补充道：“垂直叙事正在创造一种新的娱乐语言，一种建立在即时性、亲密性和系列化发现基础上的新语言，而《恐惧因素》已经能流利地表达这种语言。福克斯的合作伙伴通过《恐惧屋》为该系列赋予了强大的新生命，我们很自豪能够在此基础上再接再厉。与 Holywater 一起，我们正在共同打造新一代恐怖游戏，不仅适合移动屏幕但将其作为体验的一部分。”

paras.en: The Fear Factor microseries will have 30 three-minute episodes. It “takes place during prep week on a remote horror television set,” the logline reads, “where a practical-effects artist and her crew unleash a haunted fortune-telling machine that forces them into personalized death trials, leaving the survivors to uncover its tragic origins before it claims everyone they love.”
paras.zh: 《恐惧因素》微型连续剧将有 30 集，每集三分钟。故事梗概是这样写的：“故事发生在远程恐怖电视台的准备周期间，一位特效艺术家和她的团队释放了一台闹鬼的算命机器，迫使他们进行个性化的死亡审判，让幸存者在它夺走他们所爱的每个人之前揭开它的悲惨起源。”

paras.en: Holywater bills itself as an “AI-first company,” but the Fear Factor series is a physical production. Ian Nsenga and Yuliia Vyshnevska are producing, with Gabriel Caste directing and Thom Woodley and Andrew Beck writing.
paras.zh: Holywater 自称为“人工智能优先公司”，但《恐惧因素》系列是实体作品。伊恩·恩森加和尤利娅·维什涅夫斯卡担任制片人，加布里埃尔·卡斯特执导，汤姆·伍德利和安德鲁·贝克编剧。

paras.en: “We’re grateful to see our vision of turning My Drama into a trusted platform for studios, creators and IP like Fear Factor come to life,” said Anatolii Kasianov and Bogdan Nesvit, co-founders and co-CEOs of Holywater Tech. “This is another step toward expanding the audience and helping vertical TV evolve into mainstream entertainment.”
paras.zh: Holywater Tech 联合创始人兼联席首席执行官阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫 (Anatolii Kasianov) 和博格丹·内斯维特 (Bogdan Nesvit) 表示：“我们很高兴看到我们的愿景得以实现，即将 My Drama 打造成工作室、创作者和《恐惧因素》等 IP 值得信赖的平台。” “这是扩大受众群体、帮助垂直电视发展成为主流娱乐的又一步。”

articles.title: Speaker Mike Johnson calls election-transfer concerns ‘absurd’

paras.en: U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., committed to a peaceful post-election transfer of power, calling concerns that President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans could contest the results if Democrats win control of Congress "absurd."
paras.zh: 美国众议院议长、路易斯安那州共和党人迈克·约翰逊致力于在选举后和平移交权力，他称，如果民主党赢得国会控制权，唐纳德·特朗普总统和国会共和党人可能会对选举结果提出质疑，这种担忧是“荒谬的”。

paras.en: "We're going to follow the Constitution. The Constitution says when a state certifies the election of members of Congress, then they're administered the oath. That's what I'll be doing on Jan. 3 to everybody who's there," Johnson said Tuesday during a campaign stop with New York Republican Rep. Mike Lawler, one week before the Nov. 3 midterm election, in response to a question from MS NOW. "I may not like some of those outcomes, but that's our system. And for anybody to suggest otherwise is absurd."
paras.zh: “我们将遵守宪法。宪法规定，当一个州批准国会议员的选举时，他们就要宣誓。这就是我将在 1 月 3 日对在场的所有人所做的事情，”约翰逊周二在与纽约共和党众议员迈克·劳勒 (Mike Lawler) 的竞选活动中说道，距离 11 月 3 日中期选举还有一周。 “我可能不喜欢其中一些结果，但这就是我们的系统。任何人提出其他建议都是荒谬的。”

paras.en: Democrats and voting rights advocates are bracing for potential challenges if control of the House flips, as is widely projected to happen, or control changes in the Senate, which is more closely contested. Republicans have a majority in both chambers of Congress.
paras.zh: 如果众议院的控制权发生翻转（正如人们普遍预计的那样），或者参议院的控制权发生变化（竞争更加激烈），民主党人和投票权倡导者正准备迎接潜在的挑战。共和党在参众两院均占多数。

paras.en: Trump, who has continued to falsely claim that widespread fraud cost him the 2020 election, has fueled those fears by calling to "nationalize" elections earlier this year and repeatedly questioning the security of mail voting, while also suggesting noncitizens could vote in large enough numbers to skew results. His administration sued California earlier this month in a fight over noncitizens voting.
paras.zh: 特朗普继续错误地声称，普遍存在的舞弊行为让他在 2020 年大选中失败。今年早些时候，他呼吁将选举“国有化”，并多次质疑邮寄投票的安全性，同时还暗示非公民可以进行足够多的投票，从而影响结果，从而加剧了这些担忧。他的政府本月早些时候就非公民投票问题起诉了加州。

paras.en: The Department of Justice also sued Alaska last week to block the certification of its results in the event of voter confusion. GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan will appear on the ballot beside Daniel J. Sullivan, a retired teacher whom Republicans have said is on the ballot only as a spoiler candidate.
paras.zh: 司法部上周还起诉阿拉斯加，要求在选民混淆的情况下阻止对其结果进行认证。共和党参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan) 将与退休教师丹尼尔·J·沙利文 (Daniel J. Sullivan) 一起出现在选票上，共和党人称他只是作为搅局者候选人出现在选票上。

paras.en: Johnson, who in the wake of the 2020 election was a key congressional ally of Trump's in his quest to overturn results, on Tuesday said questions about a peaceful transfer were "a little silly."
paras.zh: 约翰逊在 2020 年大选后是特朗普寻求推翻选举结果的重要国会盟友，他周二表示，有关和平移交的问题“有点愚蠢”。

paras.en: "Of course we'll have a peaceful transfer of power. But it will not be transferring, because we are going to keep the majority and I'm going to be the speaker of the House and I will keep steady hands at the wheel," Johnson told reporters.
paras.zh: “当然，我们会和平地进行权力移交。但它不会移交，因为我们将保留多数席位，我将成为众议院议长，我将保持稳定的权力，”约翰逊告诉记者。

articles.title: CNBC Workforce Executive Summit live updates: AI and the future of work

paras.en: Today's workplace faces a litany of challenges. Whether it's shifting power dynamics between employers and employees, the accelerating impact of artificial intelligence on how we work and the skills we need, or the financial stresses that employees of all ranks are feeling, these issues and more are challenging the cohesion of workplace communities.
paras.zh: 当今的工作场所面临着一系列挑战。无论是雇主和雇员之间权力动态的转变、人工智能对我们工作方式和所需技能的加速影响，还是各级员工所感受到的财务压力，这些问题以及更多问题都在挑战工作场所社区的凝聚力。

paras.en: To address these issues, CNBC is convening its premiere council of human resource executives in New York City on Tuesday for the annual CNBC Workforce Executive Summit. The event is exclusive to members of CNBC's Workforce Executive Council.
paras.zh: 为了解决这些问题，CNBC 将于周二在纽约召开首届人力资源高管委员会，参加年度 CNBC 劳动力高管峰会。该活动仅限 CNBC 劳动力执行委员会成员参加。

paras.en: For more about the WEC and to apply for membership, visit www.cnbccouncils.com/wec.
paras.zh: 有关 WEC 的更多信息以及申请会员资格，请访问 www.cnbccouncils.com/wec。

articles.title: Early third-quarter earnings show a 'resilient' U.S. consumer, with signs of strain

paras.en: One word keeps appearing in third-quarter earnings reports: "resilient."
paras.zh: 第三季度财报中不断出现一个词：“韧性”。

paras.en: That's the early read on U.S. consumers from various companies that released their results this week. Many businesses say Americans are still spending despite inflationary pressures, though not every company has enjoyed the same success.
paras.zh: 这是本周发布业绩的多家公司对美国消费者的初步解读。许多企业表示，尽管面临通胀压力，美国人仍在消费，但并非每家公司都取得了同样的成功。

paras.en: The commentary comes amid fears that diesel fuel prices, which hit an all-time high of $6.52 per gallon in September, would drive up prices on consumer products. Economists also worried that more expensive regular gas, combined with high borrowing costs and continued tension between the U.S. and Iran, would spur a pullback in consumer spending.
paras.zh: 发表此评论的背景是，人们担心柴油价格在 9 月份创下每加仑 6.52 美元的历史新高，这将推高消费品价格。经济学家还担心，常规天然气价格上涨，加上借贷成本高昂以及美国和伊朗之间持续紧张的局势，将刺激消费者支出缩减。

paras.en: Retail sales rose 0.8% in September, following a jump of 1.3% in August. Sales in September were boosted by rising gas station spending. Despite all those challenges, some corporate executives say the headwinds aren't yet affecting sales.
paras.zh: 继 8 月增长 1.3% 后，9 月零售额增长 0.8%。加油站支出增加推动了 9 月份的销售。尽管面临所有这些挑战，一些企业高管表示，逆风尚未影响销售。

paras.en: While retail sales rose 0.8% in September, following a jump of 1.3% in August, the September came as gas station spending jumped. Despite all those challenges, some corporate executives say the headwinds aren't yet affecting sales.
paras.zh: 继 8 月份增长 1.3% 之后，9 月份零售额增长 0.8%，但 9 月份加油站支出大幅增长。尽管面临所有这些挑战，一些企业高管表示，逆风尚未影响销售。

paras.en: "There's been a lot of noise in the market this year. There's a lot of geopolitical stuff," Royal Caribbean Chairman and CEO Jason Liberty said on the company's earnings call on Tuesday. "But I look at our business [and our results], and I think that really talks to the resilience of the business, the resilience of the consumer."
paras.zh: “今年市场上有很多噪音。有很多地缘政治因素，”皇家加勒比董事长兼首席执行官杰森·利伯蒂在周二的公司财报电话会议上表示。 “但我看看我们的业务[和我们的结果]，我认为这确实与业务的弹性、消费者的弹性有关。”

paras.en: Royal Caribbean reported an increase in bookings during its third quarter, while Sherwin-Williams's CEO said the quarter was evidence of the company's strength.
paras.zh: 皇家加勒比公司报告称，第三季度的预订量有所增加，而宣伟首席执行官表示，该季度证明了该公司的实力。

paras.en: Here's how companies are reading the consumer in the most recent three-month period:
paras.zh: 以下是公司在最近三个月内如何解读消费者的情况：

paras.en: The food and beverage company beat analysts' expectations for third-quarter earnings and revenue despite what CEO Henrique Braun called an "uneven environment."
paras.zh: 尽管首席执行官恩里克·布劳恩(Henrique Braun)称之为“不平衡的环境”，但这家食品和饮料公司第三季度的盈利和收入超出了分析师的预期。

paras.en: Coca-Cola reported that North America unit case volume was flat, indicating demand was steady in the face of higher prices. The company's overall unit case volume was helped by higher demand outside of North America.
paras.zh: 可口可乐报告称，北美单位箱销量持平，表明尽管价格上涨，需求仍保持稳定。该公司的整体单位箱量得益于北美以外地区更高的需求。

paras.en: "The underlying momentum remains quite strong," CFO John Murphy told CNBC. "Consumer sentiment is largely unchanged in the sense that, wherever you are on the income scale, you're looking for value, and I think our system here has done a good job interpreting that."
paras.zh: 首席财务官约翰·墨菲 (John Murphy) 告诉 CNBC：“潜在的势头仍然相当强劲。” “消费者情绪基本上没有变化，因为无论你的收入水平如何，你都在寻找价值，我认为我们的系统很好地解释了这一点。”

paras.en: The company increased its full-year forecast and now expects its comparable earnings per share to grow at least 11%, up from a prior forecast of growth between 9% and 10%.
paras.zh: 该公司上调了全年预测，目前预计其可比每股收益将增长至少 11%，高于之前预测的 9% 至 10% 之间的增长。

paras.en: The cruise company beat Wall Street's expectations for earnings per share and narrowly missed on revenue.
paras.zh: 该游轮公司的每股收益超出了华尔街的预期，但营收却略低于华尔街的预期。

paras.en: "Our third quarter results reflect continued strong consumer demand for our vacation experiences and the accelerated momentum across our industry leading brands," CEO Liberty said in the release.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Liberty 在新闻稿中表示：“我们第三季度的业绩反映了消费者对我们度假体验的持续强劲需求以及我们行业领先品牌的加速发展势头。”

paras.en: The company reported that the number of guests served in the third quarter increased 9% year over year to 2.7 million vacationers and said booking volumes for 2027 were already "up in the high teens," pacing ahead of historical levels and indicating high travel demand.
paras.zh: 该公司报告称，第三季度接待的游客数量同比增长 9%，达到 270 万名度假者，并表示 2027 年的预订量已经“达到十几岁”，领先于历史水平，表明旅行需求很高。

paras.en: "It's not that we don't see points of challenges, but really what we've seen is that even in those points of challenges, the consumer comes roaring back as relates to the vacation experiences," Liberty told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" following the report.
paras.zh: Liberty 在报告发布后告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk on the Street”节目：“这并不是说我们没有看到挑战，但我们真正看到的是，即使在这些挑战中，消费者也会在度假体验方面卷土重来。”

paras.en: Royal Caribbean shares rose over 8% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中，皇家加勒比股价上涨超过 8%。

paras.en: Sherwin-Williams beat analysts' expectations for revenue but fell short of expected earnings per share.
paras.zh: 宣伟公司的营收超出了分析师的预期，但每股收益未达到预期。

paras.en: Sherwin-Williams CEO Heidi Petz said in the company's earnings release that the paint retailer's performance demonstrated "the resilience of our Company and the strength of our strategy in a challenging demand environment."
paras.zh: 宣伟首席执行官海蒂·佩茨（Heidi Petz）在公司财报中表示，这家涂料零售商的业绩证明了“我们公司在充满挑战的需求环境中的韧性和战略优势”。

paras.en: "Despite muted underlying market volumes, we continued to win new customers, increase share-of-wallet and deliver sales growth across all three reportable segments," she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“尽管基础市场销量低迷，但我们继续赢得新客户，增加钱包份额，并在所有三个可报告细分市场实现销售增长。”

paras.en: Net sales increased 7.9% from the same period last year. The company attributed the gain to higher selling prices, but the benefits to profits were partially offset by increased costs of raw materials and supply-chain related expenses.
paras.zh: 净销售额较去年同期增长7.9%。该公司将收益归因于较高的销售价格，但利润带来的收益被原材料成本和供应链相关费用的增加部分抵消。

paras.en: And the company maintained full-year guidance, saying "customer sentiment and the leading indicators we track point to muted demand over the remainder of the year and into 2027."
paras.zh: 该公司维持全年指引，称“客户情绪和我们跟踪的领先指标表明，今年剩余时间和 2027 年需求疲软。”

paras.en: UPS beat Wall Street expectations for both earnings per share and revenue in the third quarter.
paras.zh: UPS 第三季度每股收益和营收均超出华尔街预期。

paras.en: Revenue in the U.S. rose 4.5% during the period to $14.86 billion.
paras.zh: 同期美国收入增长 4.5% 至 148.6 亿美元。

paras.en: CEO Carol Tomé told investors on the company's earnings call that consumers remain "resilient" ahead of the holiday season, the company's busiest period. She said the company expects that average daily shipping volume will grow next quarter at a rate consistent with last year. However, fourth-quarter domestic average daily volume will likely fall due to reducing deliveries with Amazon, she said.
paras.zh: 首席执行官卡罗尔·托梅（Carol Tomé）在公司财报电话会议上告诉投资者，消费者在公司最繁忙的假日季节之前保持“弹性”。她表示，该公司预计下季度日均发货量将以与去年一致的速度增长。然而，她表示，由于亚马逊的送货量减少，第四季度国内日均交易量可能会下降。

paras.en: UPS has been in the midst of unwinding its partnership with Amazon at the same time it's executing a broad turnaround effort to operate more leanly.
paras.zh: UPS 一直在解除与亚马逊的合作伙伴关系，同时正在进行广泛的转型努力，以更加精益运营。

paras.en: The company raised its full-year forecast for the second quarter in a row, projecting consolidated revenue of approximately $92.6 billion, up from its previous expectations of $91.2 billion.
paras.zh: 该公司连续上调第二季度全年预期，预计合并营收约为 926 亿美元，高于此前预期的 912 亿美元。

paras.en: Shares rose more than 4% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中该股上涨超过 4%。

paras.en: Not every company is seeing the same spending trends, however.
paras.zh: 然而，并非每家公司都看到相同的支出趋势。

paras.en: Appliance maker Whirlpool missed on both the top and bottom lines for its third quarter and cut its full-year revenue guidance.
paras.zh: 家电制造商惠而浦第三季度的营收和利润均未达标，并下调了全年营收预期。

paras.en: Net sales in North America fell more than 8% year over year during the period ending on Sept. 30.
paras.zh: 截至 9 月 30 日的期间，北美地区的净销售额同比下降超过 8%。

paras.en: Even still, the company cited its own read on "resilience."
paras.zh: 尽管如此，该公司还是引用了自己对“弹性”的解读。

paras.en: "Through disciplined working capital management, we are protecting our year end free cash flow and
paras.zh: “通过严格的营运资金管理，我们正在保护我们的年终自由现金流和

paras.en: our balance sheet resilience to navigate challenging market conditions," CFO Roxanne Warner said in the earnings release.
paras.zh: 我们的资产负债表具有应对充满挑战的市场条件的弹性，”首席财务官罗克珊·华纳(Roxanne Warner)在财报中表示。

paras.en: Shares were down nearly 1% in Tuesday trading.
paras.zh: 周二交易中该股下跌近 1%。

paras.en: — CNBC's Amelia Lucas and Laya Neelakandan contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Amelia Lucas 和 Laya Neelakandan 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Underwater data centers may be coming to the U.S.—smack in the middle of endangered whale habitat

paras.en: The battle over where to put data centers is heading below the waves: the Trump administration is considering proposals to build two massive underwater data centers off the country’s coast. The sites selected for the projects—one in Cook Inlet, Alaska, and one in the Gulf of Maine—are smack in the middle of two endangered whale populations’ habitats.
paras.zh: 关于数据中心选址的争论正在水下进行：特朗普政府正在考虑在该国海岸建造两个大型水下数据中心的提议。项目选定的地点（一处位于阿拉斯加库克湾，一处位于缅因湾）正好位于两个濒临灭绝的鲸鱼种群栖息地的中间。

paras.en: Whales are “skittish animals,” says Arial Brewer, a beluga researcher at the University of Washington and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. “A massive-scale project like this could really stress them out in a lot of different ways.”
paras.zh: 华盛顿大学和国家海洋与大气管理局的白鲸研究员阿里尔·布鲁尔 (Arial Brewer) 表示，鲸鱼是“易受惊吓的动物”。 “像这样的大规模项目确实会给他们带来很多不同的压力。”

paras.en: Data centers, with their thousands of servers, generate considerable heat that can damage equipment if not offset in some way. Land-based facilities use massive amounts of fresh water to cool down. By putting a data center underwater, the ocean can easily dispel that heat. “Cooling is a large part of what a data center costs to run, and seawater is a free sink,” says Vishal Misra, a computer scientist and professor at Columbia University.
paras.zh: 拥有数千台服务器的数据中心会产生大量热量，如果不以某种方式抵消，可能会损坏设备。陆上设施使用大量淡水来冷却。通过将数据中心置于水下，海洋可以轻松驱散热量。哥伦比亚大学计算机科学家兼教授维沙尔·米斯拉 (Vishal Misra) 表示：“冷却是数据中心运行成本的很大一部分，而海水是免费的水槽。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Microsoft showed that the concept could work with a pilot project off California in 2015 and another off Scotland a few years later. Currently, there are only two operational underwater data centers in the world, one off the Chinese island of Hainan and another off the coast of Shanghai, and they’re a fraction of the size of the proposed centers at the two U.S. sites.
paras.zh: 微软表明，这一概念可以在 2015 年加利福尼亚州附近的一个试点项目中发挥作用，并在几年后在苏格兰附近的另一个试点项目中发挥作用。目前，世界上只有两个正在运行的水下数据中心，一个位于中国海南岛，另一个位于上海沿海，它们的规模只是拟议的美国两个地点的一小部分。

paras.en: In the Maine project, a cluster of what official documents call “subsea-compute hives” or “data center pods” would rest on the seabed, powered by up to 50 tidal turbines across 27 acres. In Cook Inlet, the data center would be made up of 66 pods and more than 300 tidal turbines. Its footprint would span 1,650 acres—more than 1,000 football fields.
paras.zh: 在缅因州项目中，官方文件中所称的“海底计算蜂巢”或“数据中心吊舱”集群将位于海底，由占地 27 英亩的多达 50 个潮汐涡轮机提供动力。在库克湾，数据中心将由 66 个吊舱和 300 多个潮汐涡轮机组成。其占地面积达 1,650 英亩，相当于 1,000 多个足球场。

paras.en: The locations were chosen by DeepGreen Holdings LLC—a U.S.-based developer—because of their potential for tidal power, which works by harnessing the movement of water.
paras.zh: 美国开发商 DeepGreen Holdings LLC 选择这些地点是因为它们具有利用水的运动产生潮汐能的潜力。

paras.en: But each spot is also home to beleaguered groups of whales. A distinct population of around 300 critically endangered beluga whales lives in Cook Inlet. And the Gulf of Maine hosts feeding grounds for the North Atlantic right whale, a species whose numbers have dropped below 400 individuals.
paras.zh: 但每个地点也是陷入困境的鲸鱼群的家园。库克湾生活着约 300 头极度濒危白鲸的独特种群。缅因湾是北大西洋露脊鲸的觅食地，该物种的数量已降至 400 头以下。

paras.en: The primary concern over data centers underwater is the same as for those on land: they are exceedingly noisy. “Pumps, fans and especially turbine arrays make continuous low-frequency sound, and pile-driving during construction is louder still,” Misra says.
paras.zh: 水下数据中心的主要问题与陆地数据中心相同：它们的噪音非常大。 “泵、风扇，尤其是涡轮机阵列会发出连续的低频声音，施工期间打桩的声音更大，”米斯拉说。

paras.en: Shipping noise has doubled every decade since the 1960s, and there’s evidence to suggest that when the volume goes down, marine mammals are less stressed. One study found that when ship noise decreased immediately after 9/11, right whales in the Gulf of Maine had lower levels of stress hormones. As for the belugas in Cook Inlet, they are particularly sensitive to noise, Brewer says. Because of glacial runoff, the bay is very turbid. “It literally looks like chocolate milk,” she says, so the belugas there rely almost entirely on echolocation to feed, mate and move around.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 60 年代以来，航运噪音每十年就会增加一倍，有证据表明，当噪音降低时，海洋哺乳动物的压力就会减轻。一项研究发现，当 9/11 事件后船舶噪音立即减少时，缅因湾的露脊鲸的应激激素水平较低。布鲁尔说，至于库克湾的白鲸，它们对噪音特别敏感。由于冰川径流，海湾非常浑浊。 “它看起来就像巧克力牛奶，”她说，因此那里的白鲸几乎完全依靠回声定位来进食、交配和移动。

paras.en: The purpose for putting the data centers underwater—heat shedding—also threatens the whales. When a pattern of warming waters hit the Gulf of Maine in the early 2010s, right whales started to abandon their feeding grounds. “Ocean warming is a big, big deal to them,” says Philip Hamilton, a senior scientist at the New England Aquarium.
paras.zh: 将数据中心置于水下的目的——散热——也威胁到鲸鱼。 2010 年代初，当缅因湾出现一系列变暖的海水时，露脊鲸开始放弃它们的觅食地。 “海洋变暖对他们来说是一件非常非常大的事情，”新英格兰水族馆的高级科学家菲利普·汉密尔顿说。

paras.en: In Alaska, salmon are one of the main prey sources for belugas—and the fish need cold water to develop their eggs, keep their metabolism stable and prevent energy depletion during long migratory journeys. “All that hot energy, what’s that going to do to very delicate salmon populations that rely on cold water?” Brewer says.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加，鲑鱼是白鲸的主要猎物来源之一，这些鱼需要冷水来产卵、保持新陈代谢稳定并防止在长途迁徙过程中能量耗尽。 “所有这些热能，会对依赖冷水的非常脆弱的鲑鱼种群产生什么影响？”布鲁尔说。

paras.en: Community backlash has been fervent: The city of Eastport, Maine, issued a moratorium halting all permits and applications for all industrial data centers. The local Passamaquoddy tribe has also publicly expressed that it has no interest in any sort of collaboration with DeepGreen. Several groups have filed motions to intervene with the proposal for Cook Inlet.
paras.zh: 社区的强烈反对：缅因州东港市发布暂停令，停止所有工业数据中心的所有许可证和申请。当地的帕萨马科迪部落也公开表示，没有兴趣与 DeepGreen 进行任何形式的合作。一些团体已提出动议，要求干预库克湾的提案。

paras.en: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), which oversees such energy projects, notes that these proposals are just that: proposals. “A preliminary permit does not authorize construction of any kind,” says Celeste Miller, a FERC representative.
paras.zh: 负责监督此类能源项目的联邦能源管理委员会 (FERC) 指出，这些提案只是提案。 “初步许可证并不授权任何形式的建设，”联邦能源监管委员会 (FERC) 代表塞莱斯特·米勒 (Celeste Miller) 表示。

paras.en: Indeed, FERC found the original proposals for both projects “deficient,” citing a lack of details and insufficient identification of Indigenous tribes who have historic ties to the local areas. But the agency has accepted amended versions; the Maine project, which originally called for 170 turbines on 400 acres of seafloor, now has a smaller proposed footprint. The public comment period for Maine closed on October 19, but the one for Cook Inlet is open until November 2. After that, FERC will review the applications and comments and issue preliminary permit decisions.
paras.zh: 事实上，联邦能源监管委员会发现这两个项目的最初提案“有缺陷”，理由是缺乏细节，并且对与当地地区有历史联系的土著部落的识别不充分。但该机构已接受修改后的版本；缅因州项目最初要求在 400 英亩的海底安装 170 台涡轮机，现在提议的占地面积较小。缅因州的公众评议期已于 10 月 19 日结束，但库克湾的公众评议期开放至 11 月 2 日。此后，FERC 将审查申请和意见，并发布初步许可决定。

paras.en: “We have no intent to build at this stage,” Louis Wolfson, the luxury real estate developer behind DeepGreen, says. “If equipment cannot operate safely well within federal marine mammal thresholds, it will never be licensed or deployed.”
paras.zh: DeepGreen 背后的豪华房地产开发商路易斯·沃尔夫森 (Louis Wolfson) 表示：“我们现阶段无意建造。” “如果设备无法在联邦海洋哺乳动物阈值内安全运行，则永远不会获得许可或部署。”

paras.en: But over the past two years, the federal government has sought to strip back those very thresholds. For example, the Senate is considering a bill that would delay new protections for right whales against entanglements in fishing gear. And though belugas and right whales have historically been protected under the Marine Mammal Protection Act, proposed amendments to it would drastically draw back protections.
paras.zh: 但在过去的两年里，联邦政府一直试图取消这些门槛。例如，参议院正在考虑一项法案，该法案将推迟对露脊鲸实施新的保护措施，防止其被渔具缠住。尽管白鲸和露脊鲸历来受到《海洋哺乳动物保护法》的保护，但拟议的修正案将大大削弱保护。

paras.en: “It feels like every day they’re chopping at another protection,” Hamilton says.
paras.zh: “感觉就像他们每天都在砍伐另一种保护，”汉密尔顿说。

articles.title: Sleep and depression may be more intertwined than we thought

paras.en: A lesser-known form of depression may be caused by disrupted sleep-wake cycles—and could be more likely to cause severe symptoms than other forms of the condition. Called circadian depression, it could indicate that our body clock—which is based on our exposure to light and dark and regulates cycles of wakefulness and sleep—may have a greater effect on our mental and physical health than we realized.
paras.zh: 一种鲜为人知的抑郁症可能是由睡眠-觉醒周期紊乱引起的，并且比其他形式的抑郁症更有可能导致严重症状。这种现象被称为昼夜节律抑制，它可能表明我们的生物钟（基于我们接触光明和黑暗的情况并调节清醒和睡眠的周期）可能对我们的身心健康产生比我们意识到的更大的影响。

paras.en: Sleep disturbances are common in depression, and night owls (who tend to get less sleep than early birds) are likely to have more and worse depressive symptoms. Understanding the link between sleep patterns and depression could help clinicians better diagnose and treat the condition, especially in people whose depression seems less responsive to conventional therapies.
paras.zh: 睡眠障碍在抑郁症中很常见，而夜猫子（他们往往比早起的鸟儿睡眠更少）可能会出现更多、更严重的抑郁症状。了解睡眠模式和抑郁症之间的联系可以帮助临床医生更好地诊断和治疗这种疾病，特别是对于那些抑郁症似乎对传统疗法反应较差的人。

paras.en: “Diagnosing depression can be tricky,” says Amy Marschall, a clinical psychologist based in Sioux Falls, S.D. “Getting to what’s going on beneath the surface or what’s causing the [depression] matters.”
paras.zh: “诊断抑郁症可能很棘手，”南达科他州苏福尔斯市的临床心理学家艾米·马歇尔 (Amy Marschall) 说。 “了解表面之下发生的事情或导致[抑郁症]的原因很重要。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Our 24-hour circadian rhythm is primarily driven by light. Our eyes send signals to the brain’s master clock, which coordinates our body’s systems and processes, such as wakefulness, body temperature and energy metabolism. “Bright light throughout the day, but especially in the morning, helps stabilize and anchor the circadian rhythm, while light exposure at night can delay it,” explains Emiliana Tonini, a researcher studying circadian rhythms and mood disorders at the University of Sydney.
paras.zh: 我们的 24 小时昼夜节律主要由光驱动。我们的眼睛向大脑的主时钟发送信号，它协调我们身体的系统和过程，例如觉醒、体温和能量代谢。悉尼大学研究昼夜节律和情绪障碍的研究员艾米利亚娜·托尼尼 (Emiliana Tonini) 解释说：“全天的明亮光线，尤其是早上，有助于稳定和固定昼夜节律，而夜间的光照会延迟昼夜节律。”

paras.en: Low or irregular light during the day, or too much evening light, can weaken or shift circadian rhythms. Other factors, such as genetics, environment and physical health, can mess with our sleep cycles, too. That can cause the body to feel out of line with its environment or cause “different body rhythms [to] drift out of step with one another,” Tonini says. “Both may have a negative effect on health.”
paras.zh: 白天光线不足或不规则，或者夜间光线过多，都会削弱或改变昼夜节律。其他因素，如遗传、环境和身体健康，也会扰乱我们的睡眠周期。托尼尼说，这可能会导致身体感觉与环境格格不入，或者导致“不同的身体节奏彼此不一致”。 “两者都可能对健康产生负面影响。”

paras.en: In a recent study in the British Journal of Psychiatry, Tonini and her colleagues analyzed clinical and genetic data of 11,380 people with depression who participated in the Australian Genetics of Depression Study (AGDS). Almost a quarter met the proposed criteria for circadian depression. These participants experienced a combination of body clock disturbances that could include having irregular sleep-wake times, waking up tired, being a night owl or sleeping longer when they felt more depressed.
paras.zh: 在《英国精神病学杂志》最近的一项研究中，托尼尼和她的同事分析了参加澳大利亚抑郁症遗传学研究 (AGDS) 的 11,380 名抑郁症患者的临床和遗传数据。近四分之一的人符合拟议的昼夜节律抑制标准。这些参与者经历了一系列生物钟紊乱，包括睡眠-觉醒时间不规律、醒来时感到疲倦、成为夜猫子或在感到更加抑郁时睡得更长。

paras.en: These individuals also showed more severe symptoms on average and greater genetic risk for other health problems, including other mental health conditions, as well as inflammatory, metabolic and cardiovascular issues. Another analysis of AGDS participants found that antidepressants worked less well for night owls, and they reported more side effects.
paras.zh: 这些人平均还表现出更严重的症状，以及其他健康问题的遗传风险更大，包括其他心理健康问题，以及炎症、代谢和心血管问题。另一项针对 AGDS 参与者的分析发现，抗抑郁药对夜猫子的效果较差，而且他们报告了更多的副作用。

paras.en: “Conventional antidepressants may not directly address these disturbances,” Tonini says. Treatments that target the body’s internal clock, such as melatonin or light therapy, may prove beneficial. “We do have effective treatments,” she says, “but currently, we are not really good at matching a patient to an effective treatment that will work for them on the first try.”
paras.zh: “传统的抗抑郁药可能无法直接解决这些障碍，”托尼尼说。针对人体生物钟的治疗，例如褪黑激素或光疗法，可能会被证明是有益的。 “我们确实有有效的治疗方法，”她说，“但目前，我们并不擅长为患者匹配一次就能奏效的有效治疗方法。”

paras.en: The researchers still aren’t sure whether these cases of depression are caused by, or simply associated with, problems with circadian rhythm. Tonini says they hope to test the link in more diverse populations in the future.
paras.zh: 研究人员仍然不确定这些抑郁症病例是否是由昼夜节律问题引起的，或者仅仅是与昼夜节律问题有关。托尼尼说，他们希望将来在更多样化的人群中测试这种联系。

paras.en: Marschall also notes that sleep-wake cycles vary naturally from person to person. “A lot of advice around sleep says humans are wired to be asleep from this time to this time, but some people have different natural rhythms,” she says.
paras.zh: 马歇尔还指出，睡眠-觉醒周期因人而异。 “很多关于睡眠的建议都说，人类天生就会从这个时间到这个时间睡觉，但有些人有不同的自然节律，”她说。

articles.title: Dueling proofs from OpenAI and Anthropic astound scientists

paras.en: Just a few weeks after dropping hundreds of artificial-intelligence-generated math breakthroughs on a field that’s already in crisis, OpenAI is piling on more.
paras.zh: 就在几周前，OpenAI 在一个已经陷入危机的领域放弃了数百项由人工智能产生的数学突破，而现在又在不断取得更多突破。

paras.en: Yesterday the company dropped three massive proofs that touched on math, physics and computer science, sending shockwaves rippling through those fields. Experts are still staggering.
paras.zh: 昨天，该公司公布了三项涉及数学、物理和计算机科学的大规模证明，在这些领域引发了轩然大波。专家们至今仍大吃一惊。

paras.en: These latest releases from OpenAI continue to contradict the recommendations of the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence (AGMAI), the expert panel the company organized in response to widespread criticism from mathematicians. The large language model (LLM) that produced the new proofs remains proprietary, and the exact prompts used, time spent computing and “chain of thought outputs” involved have not been made public. Two of the results coincide with closely related work involving OpenAI’s competitor Anthropic.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的这些最新发布仍然与数学和人工智能咨询小组 (AGMAI) 的建议相矛盾，该专家小组是该公司为回应数学家的广泛批评而组织的。产生新证明的大型语言模型（LLM）仍然是专有的，所使用的确切提示、计算所花费的时间以及所涉及的“思想链输出”尚未公开。其中两项结果与 OpenAI 竞争对手 Anthropic 的密切相关工作相吻合。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: OpenAI’s approach to two of the three results also directly violates a clarifying statement AGMAI issued just a day before they were released by designating specific experts to shepherd the results into the public sphere. Among the work of such experts, a paper relating to the “million-dollar” Yang-Mills problem (one of seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000) has still not been made public. Writing that “there is no scientific reason for delaying ... any further,” AGMAI has already called on OpenAI to release the paper.
paras.zh: OpenAI 对三项结果中两项的处理方式也直接违反了 AGMAI 在发布前一天发布的澄清声明，该声明指定了特定专家将结果引入公共领域。在这些专家的工作中，一篇有关“百万美元”杨-米尔斯问题（克莱数学研究所2000年设立的七大千年奖问题之一）的论文至今尚未公开。 AGMAI 写道，“没有科学理由进一步推迟……”，AGMAI 已经呼吁 OpenAI 发布这篇论文。

paras.en: Here’s a quick breakdown of what the three new results are and why they matter.
paras.zh: 以下是这三个新结果及其重要性的快速分析。

paras.en: The Kakeya conjecture is about swirling a needle or stylus around in the air cleverly—so that it points in every direction once but sweeps out as little volume as possible. Specifically, the conjecture says that the volume cannot be less than a certain number. Surprisingly, this simple geometry problem is one of the most important conjectures in harmonic analysis, the study of how all kinds of mathematical objects can be built from waves.
paras.zh: 挂谷猜想是指巧妙地在空中旋转一根针或触笔，使其一次指向各个方向，但扫出的体积尽可能小。具体来说，该猜想说体积不能小于某个数字。令人惊讶的是，这个简单的几何问题是调和分析中最重要的猜想之一，调和分析是研究如何从波构建各种数学对象的学科。

paras.en: Last year mathematicians Hong Wang and Joshua Zahl proved the conjecture in three dimensions in one of the biggest math breakthroughs of this century. The feat won Wang a Fields Medal—math’s highest honor—at this summer’s International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia. But the problem remained open in higher-dimensional spaces.
paras.zh: 去年，数学家王宏和约书亚·扎尔在三个维度上证明了这个猜想，这是本世纪最大的数学突破之一。这一壮举为王在今年夏天于费城举行的国际数学家大会上赢得了菲尔兹奖——数学界的最高荣誉。但这个问题在高维空间中仍然存在。

paras.en: In last month’s “slop drop,” OpenAI’s internal model solved the four-dimensional Kakeya problem. Now it’s solved the problem in every dimension, proving that there’s a limit to how small a space a high-dimensional stylus can take up.
paras.zh: 在上个月的“slop drop”中，OpenAI的内部模型解决了四维挂谷问题。现在它已经解决了各个维度的问题，证明高维手写笔占用的空间是有限度的。

paras.en: The Yang-Mills problem, one of Clay’s five million-dollar Millennium Prize Problems that remain open, is about particle physics. Specifically, it asks whether the mathematics that underpins the “Standard Model” of particle physics is actually sound.
paras.zh: 杨-米尔斯问题是克莱的五百万美元千禧年奖问题之一，目前仍悬而未决，它与粒子物理学有关。具体来说，它询问支撑粒子物理学“标准模型”的数学是否确实可靠。

paras.en: This question comes down to two parts, referred to as “existence” and “mass gap.” The Clay Mathematics Institute’s definition of the problem asks for answers to both. Today OpenAI claimed to prove the first of the two—that the “Yang-Mills theory” is mathematically consistent in all relevant cases: in other words, it “exists.” The part of the Clay problem that remains open is more quantitative, asking whether a certain number in the theory, called the “mass gap,” is always bigger than zero.
paras.zh: 这个问题可以归结为两个部分，即“存在”和“质量差距”。克莱数学研究所对这个问题的定义要求回答这两个问题。今天，OpenAI 声称证明了两者中的第一个——“杨-米尔斯理论”在所有相关案例中在数学上都是一致的：换句话说，它“存在”。克莱问题中尚未解决的部分更加定量，询问理论中称为“质量间隙”的某个数字是否始终大于零。

paras.en: In the late 1980s, a little more than a decade before the Clay Mathematics Institute existed, mathematician Tadeusz Balaban published a series of massive, dense papers that sketched out a path to prove the “existence” part of the problem. As voluminous as “Balaban’s program” is, it only codifies the problem’s broad contours—filling in the gaps to construct a mathematically rigorous proof would demand far more laborious and exhaustive calculations. The project is so immense—and Balaban’s papers are so difficult to parse—that no one has carried it out more than three decades later. “He basically did it,” says Roland Bauerschmidt, a mathematician at New York University. “But I think there’s no one who understands these papers and can tell whether they’re correct or not.”
paras.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代末，也就是克莱数学研究所成立前十多年，数学家塔德乌什·巴拉班 (Tadeusz Balaban) 发表了一系列大量、密集的论文，勾勒出一条证明问题“存在”部分的路径。尽管“巴拉班纲领”浩如烟海，但它只是将问题的大致轮廓编入法典——填补空白以构建数学上严格的证明将需要更加费力和详尽的计算。这个项目是如此浩大——巴拉班的论文又如此难以解析——以至于三十多年后无人实施它。 “他基本上做到了，”纽约大学数学家罗兰·鲍尔施密特说。 “但我认为没有人能理解这些论文并能判断它们是否正确。”

paras.en: Recently, sensing that a race was on to finish Balaban’s program, some experts began using LLMs to churn out the necessary tomes of tedious mathematical steps. Working with Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge, Ethan Sussman, a mathematician at Northwestern University, created and publicized a public GitHub repository to do just that. They were making considerable progress and believed they were near to finishing the program. OpenAI’s claim—with no publicly available proof—appears to have beaten them to the finish line.
paras.zh: 最近，一些专家意识到完成巴拉班项目的竞赛即将开始，因此开始利用法学硕士来编写必要的乏味数学步骤大部头。西北大学数学家 Ethan Sussman 与 Anthropic 员工 Levent Alpöge 合作，创建并发布了一个公共 GitHub 存储库来实现这一目标。他们取得了相当大的进展，并相信他们即将完成该计划。 OpenAI 的说法（没有公开证据）似乎已经击败了他们。

paras.en: The exponential time hypothesis (ETH) is about computational complexity—the science of ranking computer science problems by how hard they are.
paras.zh: 指数时间假说（ETH）是关于计算复杂性的——根据计算机科学问题的难度对问题进行排名的科学。

paras.en: Specifically, ETH suggests that a famous task called the 3-satisfiability, or 3-SAT, problem cannot be solved in less than exponential time. This means that as the number of variables in the problem increases, any algorithm that solves it will run exponentially slower. OpenAI’s proof provides an algorithm to solve 3-SAT that is just a tiny bit faster than exponential time, refuting ETH.
paras.zh: 具体来说，ETH 表明，一个名为 3-可满足性（3-SAT）的著名任务无法在指数时间内解决。这意味着随着问题中变量数量的增加，任何解决该问题的算法的运行速度都会呈指数级下降。 OpenAI 的证明提供了一种解决 3-SAT 的算法，该算法仅比指数时间快一点点，反驳了 ETH。

paras.en: ETH is important because of its relationship to “P versus NP,” which is another of the Clay institute’s Millennium Prize Problems and widely considered to be one of the most difficult, with major implications for modern encryption.
paras.zh: ETH 之所以重要，是因为它与“P 与 NP”的关系，这是克莱研究所的另一个千年奖问题，被广泛认为是最困难的问题之一，对现代加密具有重大影响。

paras.en: First suggested in 1999, ETH can be thought of as an even stronger version of P ≠ NP (the conjecture that P does not equal NP, which the majority of people in the field believe) and has been treated as a bedrock tenet of computer science by most experts. Because 3-SAT is a problem computer scientists know to be central to the debate, ETH would show that there were problems that were not only fundamentally hard to solve but that would also scale up so brutally that they would be effectively unassailable.
paras.zh: ETH 于 1999 年首次提出，可以被认为是 P ≠ NP 的更强版本（该领域的大多数人都相信 P 不等于 NP 的猜想），并且已被大多数专家视为计算机科学的基本原则。因为计算机科学家知道 3-SAT 是一个争论的核心问题，所以 ETH 将表明，有些问题不仅从根本上难以解决，而且规模扩大得如此残酷，以至于实际上是无懈可击的。

paras.en: Although the new result doesn’t necessarily translate to a transformative breakthrough about P versus NP, the potential effects are so sweeping that OpenAI has tapped outside experts to vet its claim. Russell Impagliazzo and Ramamohan Paturi, two computer scientists at the University of California, San Diego, who first suggested ETH, as well as Ryan Williams, a computer scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, are now working with OpenAI to perform an independent investigation of the result. The company will also sponsor a computer science conference about the proof as part of this investigation, according to Williams.
paras.zh: 尽管新结果并不一定意味着 P 与 NP 之间的革命性突破，但其潜在影响是如此广泛，以至于 OpenAI 已聘请外部专家来审查其主张。加州大学圣地亚哥分校的两位计算机科学家 Russell Impagliazzo 和 Ramamohan Paturi 最先提出了 ETH 的建议，麻省理工学院的计算机科学家 Ryan Williams 目前正在与 OpenAI 合作，对结果进行独立调查。威廉姆斯表示，作为本次调查的一部分，该公司还将赞助一场有关该证据的计算机科学会议。

paras.en: The result hasn’t been without controversy, either. Mere hours after OpenAI’s announcement, Anthropic posted its own independent result disproving ETH, based on work by an internal Anthropic model.
paras.zh: 结果也并非没有争议。就在 OpenAI 宣布这一消息几个小时后，Anthropic 发布了自己的独立结果，该结果反驳了 ETH，该结果基于 Anthropic 内部模型的工作。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (10/27/26): This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（10/27/26）：这是一个突发新闻报道，将会更新。

articles.title: Eating too much sugar on antibiotics could squash helpful gut bacteria
articles.author: Mariella Careaga

paras.en: While a spoonful of sugar might help us gulp down a bitter-tasting antibiotic, it also may increase the damage that these drugs cause to the gut microbes.
paras.zh: 虽然一勺糖可能会帮助我们吞下苦味抗生素，但它也可能会增加这些药物对肠道微生物造成的损害。

paras.en: In patients being treated for blood cancers, eating sugary items during antibiotic treatment was linked to a greater reduction in gut bacteria diversity than taking the antibiotics alone. The combination was also tied to the growth of gut bacteria associated with hard-to-treat infections, researchers report September 30 in Nature.
paras.zh: 在接受血癌治疗的患者中，与单独服用抗生素相比，在抗生素治疗期间吃含糖食物会导致肠道细菌多样性更大程度的减少。研究人员于 9 月 30 日在《自然》杂志上报道称，这种组合还与肠道细菌的生长有关，这些细菌与难以治疗的感染有关。

paras.en: Cancer patients have lots of variation in their diets and take medications that can damage their microbiome. So, these patients provide a unique opportunity to study dramatic gut changes “that we believe are also relevant in the healthy context,” says Jonas Schluter, a microbiologist at NYU Langone Health.
paras.zh: 癌症患者的饮食有很大差异，并且服用的药物可能会损害他们的微生物群。因此，这些患者提供了一个独特的机会来研究肠道的巨大变化，“我们认为这些变化与健康环境相关，”纽约大学兰格尼健康中心的微生物学家乔纳斯·施卢特说。

paras.en: Previous evidence separately suggested that antibiotics and sugars can disrupt the gut microbiome. But their combined effects, particularly in people at greater risk of infection, was unclear.
paras.zh: 先前的证据分别表明抗生素和糖会破坏肠道微生物组。但它们的综合影响，特别是对感染风险较高的人来说，尚不清楚。

paras.en: Researchers closely tracked more than 9,000 meals eaten by 173 people hospitalized in a treatment center to undergo blood-forming stem cell transplants. “Diet records are one of the biggest black boxes in a lot of diet microbiome studies,” since meals are often self-reported, says Tiffany Weir, a microbiologist at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: 研究人员密切追踪了 173 名在治疗中心接受造血干细胞移植住院治疗的患者所吃的 9000 多顿饭。 “饮食记录是许多饮食微生物组研究中最大的黑匣子之一”，因为膳食通常是自我报告的，科林斯堡科罗拉多州立大学的微生物学家蒂芙尼·威尔（Tiffany Weir）说，她没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Standardized hospital meals allowed researchers to measure multiple days’ worth of food intake down to the gram, then compare the amounts of various nutrients eaten with bacterial diversity data obtained from stool samples.
paras.zh: 标准化的医院膳食使研究人员能够测量多天的食物摄入量，精确到克，然后将摄入的各种营养素的量与从粪便样本中获得的细菌多样性数据进行比较。

paras.en: For every additional 100 grams of sugar (the equivalent of 2.5 cans of Coke) that patients on antibiotics ate in the two days before sampling, the team found a 24 percent decrease in bacterial diversity. Consuming sweets and sugary beverages during antibiotic treatment was also associated with blooms of Enterococcus bacteria, which can be drug-resistant and are linked to difficult-to-treat infections associated with longer hospital stays and higher mortality.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，服用抗生素的患者在采样前两天每多吃 100 克糖（相当于 2.5 罐可乐），细菌多样性就会减少 24%。在抗生素治疗期间食用甜食和含糖饮料也与肠球菌大量繁殖有关，肠球菌可能具有耐药性，并与难以治疗的感染有关，从而导致住院时间更长和死亡率更高。

paras.en: “Some bacteria, sometimes, survive antibiotics, or perhaps more dangerously, they are resistant to [them],” Schluter says. By giving these bacteria the “universal resource for life, which is simple sugars, we are exacerbating their dominance. It’s almost like burning down the rainforest with a lot of fire, and then trying to extinguish the flames by putting in more petrol.”
paras.zh: “有些细菌有时能够在抗生素的作用下存活下来，或者更危险的是，它们对抗生素产生抗药性，”施卢特说。通过为这些细菌提供“生命的通用资源，即单糖，我们正在加剧它们的统治地位。这几乎就像用大量的火烧毁雨林，然后试图通过加入更多的汽油来扑灭火焰。”

paras.en: The researchers also exposed mice on standard or sucrose-rich diets to a single dose of antibiotics. They found that the sugar exacerbated the enterococcal abundance after antibiotic exposure.
paras.zh: 研究人员还将标准饮食或富含蔗糖饮食的小鼠暴露于单剂量的抗生素。他们发现，接触抗生素后，糖会加剧肠球菌的丰度。

paras.en: “Reducing sugar intake could be another way for patients to support their gut microbiome during antibiotic treatment,” says Sarah Berry, a nutrition scientist at King’s College London who was not involved in the study. Still, more research is needed to determine whether the findings apply to anyone on these drugs.
paras.zh: “减少糖的摄入量可能是患者在抗生素治疗期间支持肠道微生物组的另一种方式，”伦敦国王学院的营养科学家莎拉·贝里（Sarah Berry）说，她没有参与这项研究。尽管如此，还需要更多的研究来确定这些发现是否适用于任何服用这些药物的人。

paras.en: Schluter hopes that further studies and clinical trials can help uncover more about the exact relationship between sugar, antibiotics and the gut microbiome.
paras.zh: 施卢特希望进一步的研究和临床试验能够帮助揭示更多关于糖、抗生素和肠道微生物组之间的确切关系。

paras.en: “You need to take antibiotics to fight infections, but you should also be aware that they have side effects to the microbiome,” Schluter says. “Now, we need to find strategies to mitigate this damage.”
paras.zh: “你需要服用抗生素来对抗感染，但你也应该意识到它们对微生物组有副作用，”施鲁特说。 “现在，我们需要找到减轻这种损害的策略。”

articles.title: After the dinosaurs died, the massive ‘D. rex’ fungus ruled the woods
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: A pineapple-sized fungus has quietly grown undetected in the forests of southwestern China – until now. The massive mushroom may set a size record for a major branch of the fungal family tree.
paras.zh: 直到现在，一种菠萝大小的真菌在中国西南部的森林中悄然生长，未被发现。这种巨大的蘑菇可能会创下真菌家族树主要分支的大小记录。

paras.en: The fungus — named Dianjunus rex — may also represent a previously unknown family, researchers report September 28 in Frontiers in Fungal Biology. Fittingly, D. rex is part of a lineage that split off from other fungi right after the dinosaurs — like T. rex — went extinct.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 28 日在《真菌生物学前沿》上报道，这种名为 Dianjunus rex 的真菌也可能代表一个以前未知的家族。恰如其分的是，霸王龙是恐龙（如霸王龙）灭绝后立即从其他真菌中分离出来的谱系的一部分。

paras.en: In 2024, researchers in China were conducting a survey of fungal diversity in a tropical rainforest in Yunnan Province when local farmers tipped them off to an unusual fungus in the area. The farmers included photos, says Indunil Chinthani Senanayake, a mycologist at the Kunming Institute of Botany in China. Some of the farmers who’d made the discovery took a bite of the mystery fungus, Senanayake says, and the tipster “wanted to confirm whether it was edible or not.”
paras.zh: 2024 年，中国的研究人员正在对云南省热带雨林中的真菌多样性进行调查，当地农民向他们透露该地区有一种不寻常的真菌。中国昆明植物研究所的真菌学家因杜尼尔·钦塔尼·塞纳纳亚克 (Indunil Chinthani Senanayake) 说，农民们附上了照片。塞纳纳亚克说，发现这一神秘真菌的一些农民咬了一口，而消息提供者“想确认它是否可以食用”。

paras.en: When Senanayake and her colleagues went to the location, they found strange, yellowish, tentacle-like and spatula-like mushrooms growing out of decaying tree roots. These were some kind of ascomycete, or “sac fungi”. Sac fungi like morels, truffles and molds make their spores in microscopic bladderlike receptacles, unlike the bowling pin-shaped reproductive structures in club fungi, the group that includes most culinary mushrooms.
paras.zh: 当塞纳纳亚克和她的同事前往该地点时，他们发现腐烂的树根中长出了奇怪的、淡黄色的、触手状和铲状的蘑菇。这些是某种子囊菌，或“囊真菌”。羊肚菌、松露和霉菌等囊真菌在微观的囊状容器中产生孢子，这与俱乐部真菌（包括大多数烹饪蘑菇）的保龄球瓶形状的生殖结构不同。

paras.en: The mushrooms we see growing out of the ground are called fruiting bodies and make the spore-producing cells for the often hidden or subterranean fungus. Most sac fungi have relatively small fruiting bodies. But the mushrooms growing off these mysterious Yunnan fungi were enormous, with some reaching 50 centimeters tall. The team took samples of the fungi back to the lab for further study and found that they weighed up to 2.2 kilograms. By their estimates, these are the largest spore-making fruiting bodies among all sac fungi.
paras.zh: 我们看到的从地里长出来的蘑菇被称为子实体，它们为通常隐藏的或地下的真菌提供产孢细胞。大多数囊真菌的子实体相对较小。但这些神秘的云南真菌长出的蘑菇非常巨大，有些高达 50 厘米。研究小组将真菌样本带回实验室进行进一步研究，发现它们重达2.2公斤。据他们估计，这些是所有囊真菌中最大的产孢子实体。

paras.en: Torda Varga — a mycologist at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew in Richmond, England who was not involved with the research — notes that some truffle species are known to get close to the bulk. D. rex appears to be the largest sac fungal fruiting body he’s aware of. “What I find particularly remarkable is that a fungus with such an enormous fruiting body appears to have remained scientifically undocumented until now,” says Varga, though he adds his experience has mostly been within Europe.
paras.zh: 英国里士满邱园皇家植物园的真菌学家托尔达·瓦尔加（Torda Varga）并未参与这项研究，他指出，已知某些松露品种的体积接近于块菌的体积。霸王龙似乎是他所知道的最大的囊真菌子实体。瓦尔加说：“我发现特别引人注目的是，迄今为止，具有如此巨大子实体的真菌似乎尚未在科学上得到记录。”不过他补充说，他的经历主要发生在欧洲。

paras.en: The researchers compared samples of the fungus’s DNA with those from other fungi to determine its evolutionary relationships. They found that it was a relative of species like candlesnuff fungus and dead-man’s-fingers, which make fruiting bodies only a few centimeters tall, but that it was probably in its own, unique family. The team gave the new species the name Dianjunus rex, referencing both the Latin “rex” for “king” and the ancient Dian kingdom of the region.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种真菌的 DNA 样本与其他真菌的 DNA 样本进行了比较，以确定其进化关系。他们发现，它是烛鼻真菌和死人指等物种的近亲，这些物种的子实体只有几厘米高，但它可能属于自己独特的家族。研究小组将这个新物种命名为“Dianjunus rex”，既指拉丁语“rex”，意为“国王”，也指该地区的古滇王国。

paras.en: The team’s genetic analysis suggests D. rex’s family first evolved in the aftermath of the mass extinction at the end of the Cretaceous Period that wiped out the dinosaurs, some 65 million years ago. “During the dark, cold, postimpact years after the mass extinction, fungi that decompose dead organic matter could keep functioning better than light-dependent photosynthesizers,” Senanayake says.
paras.zh: 该团队的基因分析表明，霸王龙家族首次进化是在大约 6500 万年前的白垩纪末期恐龙大灭绝之后。 Senanayake 说：“在大灭绝发生后的黑暗、寒冷和撞击后的几年里，分解死亡有机物的真菌可以比依赖光的光合作用器继续更好地发挥作用。”

paras.en: Varga wonders if searching databases for bits of DNA shed into the environment could help uncover other members of D. rex’s royal family in the absence of physical specimens.
paras.zh: 瓦尔加想知道，在数据库中搜索流失到环境中的 DNA 片段是否有助于在缺乏实物标本的情况下发现霸王龙王室的其他成员。

paras.en: “Some of these [genetic] sequences might belong to previously undocumented relatives of Dianjunus rex,” he says. Finding these hidden species could tell researchers more about the biology and evolutionary history of this king of the sac fungi.
paras.zh: “其中一些[遗传]序列可能属于以前未记录的Dianjunus rex亲戚，”他说。发现这些隐藏的物种可以让研究人员更多地了解这种囊真菌之王的生物学和进化历史。

articles.title: Roller coaster safety is a matter of science
articles.author: Lindsay Lee Wallace

paras.en: The first roller coaster in the United States to loop upside down tucked riders by twos into bench seats, secured them with a single seat belt and subjected them to an estimated 7.5 times the force of gravity (some say it was closer to 12 g). The Flip Flap Railway opened in New York City’s Sea Lion Park in 1895, where the roller coaster reportedly strained backs, wrenched necks and dazzled spectators until the park closed in 1902.
paras.zh: 美国第一座倒转的过山车将乘客两人一组塞进长椅上，用一条安全带将他们固定，并让他们承受估计 7.5 倍的重力（有人说接近 12 克）。 Flip Flap 铁路于 1895 年在纽约市的海狮公园投入运营，据报道，这座过山车曾让游客扭伤背部、扭断脖子，让观众眼花缭乱，直到公园于 1902 年关闭。

paras.en: Now, roller coaster safety is in the news again. In September, three lawsuits were filed against Six Flags and ride manufacturer S&S Global, alleging that riders sustained “catastrophic” brain injuries on the roller coaster X2 at California’s Magic Mountain theme park. These are just the most recent cases related to the ride, filed after a CNN investigation found dozens of injuries on X2 leading to hospitalization, disability and death. On September 29, Six Flags announced X2 would shut down permanently even though it said the ride “consistently passed a multitude of safety tests.”
paras.zh: 现在，过山车安全再次成为新闻焦点。 9 月份，针对六旗游乐设施和游乐设施制造商 S&S Global 提起了三起诉讼，指控乘客在加州魔术山主题公园的 X2 过山车上遭受“灾难性”脑损伤。这些只是与该游乐设施相关的最新案件，CNN 调查发现 X2 上有数十人受伤，导致住院、残疾和死亡。 9 月 29 日，六旗宣布 X2 将永久关闭，尽管该游乐设施“始终通过了多项安全测试”。

paras.en: Weeks later, the company said it would temporarily close another nine coasters across the United States and Canada after a man fell from his seat on the roller coaster Goliath and died at Six Flags Over Georgia. Six Flags announced Oct. 24 that it would add seat belts to Goliath and other coasters, and a spokesperson told Science News that the company is “committed to rigorous ride inspection, maintenance and safety procedures.” But the incidents and closures are prompting new questions about coaster design and safety — particularly when they are operating correctly — and whether guidelines overlook crucial factors.
paras.zh: 几周后，该公司表示，在佐治亚六旗游乐园的“歌利亚”过山车上一名男子从座位上坠落身亡后，该公司将暂时关闭美国和加拿大的另外九个过山车。六旗乐园于 10 月 24 日宣布，将为歌利亚和其他过山车添加安全带，发言人告诉《科学新闻》，该公司“致力于严格的游乐设施检查、维护和安全程序”。但这些事件和关闭引发了有关过山车设计和安全的新问题——特别是当它们正确运行时——以及指导方针是否忽视了关键因素。

paras.en: Roller coasters are not regulated at the federal level in the United States; each state has its own approach to their management. But an international technical group comprising over 1,000 industry professionals, the ASTM Committee F24 on Amusement Rides and Devices, publishes recommendations that are considered industry standards.
paras.zh: 过山车在美国不受联邦层面的监管；每个州都有自己的管理方法。但由 1,000 多名行业专业人士组成的国际技术团体——ASTM 游乐设施和设备委员会 F24，发布了被视为行业标准的建议。

paras.en: The first ASTM standards for roller coaster design were released in 1982. The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission had been stripped of authority to regulate fixed-site amusement rides the year before. In the wake of this newfound freedom, it was a “roller coaster arms race,” says Brian Avery, an event and tourism management researcher at the University of Florida in Gainesville who studies risk and amusement ride safety protocols. The period was characterized by attempts to “build it taller, faster, longer.”
paras.zh: 第一个过山车设计 ASTM 标准于 1982 年发布。前一年，美国消费品安全委员会被剥夺了监管固定场所游乐设施的权力。佛罗里达大学盖恩斯维尔分校的活动和旅游管理研究员布莱恩·艾弗里（Brian Avery）研究风险和游乐设施安全协议，他说，在这种新获得的自由之后，这是一场“过山车军备竞赛”。这一时期的特点是试图“把它建得更高、更快、更长”。

paras.en: When X2, originally called X, opened in 2002, it was the world’s first fourth-dimension coaster. It catapulted people 60 meters high, traveling 122 kilometers per hour while its seats rotated independently on their own tracks. In the 24 years since, only 20 or so other fourth-dimension coasters have been built, and several have closed.
paras.zh: X2（最初称为 X）于 2002 年开放时，是世界上第一个第四维度过山车。它将人弹射到 60 米高的地方，以每小时 122 公里的速度行驶，而其座椅则在自己的轨道上独立旋转。此后的 24 年里，仅建造了 20 个左右的第四维过山车，其中有几个已经关闭。

paras.en: As roller coasters grew more extreme, injuries increased and were more publicized, sparking calls for further research and regulation.
paras.zh: 随着过山车变得越来越极端，伤害增加并且更加公开，引发了进一步研究和监管的呼声。

paras.en: Generally, roller coasters are quite safe. Out of 1.7 billion annual amusement park rides across North America, just 652 roller coaster injuries were reported in 2024 by parks choosing to share data. Studies suggest that riding a roller coaster is very unlikely to cause a brain injury, although most research on roller coaster brain impacts is about a decade or more old.
paras.zh: 一般来说，过山车是相当安全的。 2024 年，在北美每年 17 亿次的游乐园游乐设施中，选择共享数据的公园仅报告了 652 起过山车受伤事件。研究表明，乘坐过山车不太可能导致脑损伤，尽管大多数关于过山车大脑影响的研究已有十年或更久的历史。

paras.en: In 2002, a study used reported g forces from three roller coasters in a mathematical model to determine that their acceleration levels were below those predicted to cause head injuries. A 2017 study found brain effects on three roller coasters that were low on average, but “comparable with mild sports impacts,” like those sustained by heading a soccer ball, at their peak.
paras.zh: 2002 年，一项研究在数学模型中使用报告的三个过山车的重力来确定它们的加速度水平低于预计会导致头部受伤的水平。 2017 年的一项研究发现，三座过山车对大脑的影响平均较低，但“与轻度运动影响相当”，比如在巅峰时期头球足球所带来的影响。

paras.en: “The limiting of g forces alone might be an insufficient design criterion for roller coaster rides,” wrote the authors of the 2017 study.
paras.zh: 2017 年研究的作者写道：“仅限制重力可能不足以构成过山车游乐设施的设计标准。”

paras.en: In 2020, David Eager, a biomechanical engineer at the University of Technology Sydney, coauthored a paper on under-acknowledged forces affecting roller coaster safety, including jerk (the rate at which acceleration changes), snap (the rate at which jerk changes) and vibration.
paras.zh: 2020 年，悉尼科技大学生物力学工程师 David Eager 与人合着了一篇论文，内容涉及影响过山车安全的未被充分认识的力，包括加加速度（加速度变化的速率）、折断（加加速度变化的速率）和振动。

paras.en: “Roller coaster passengers need time to sense acceleration changes and adjust their muscle tension or suffer conditions such as whiplash,” Eager wrote.
paras.zh: “过山车乘客需要时间来感知加速度的变化并调整他们的肌肉张力，否则就会遭受颈部扭伤等情况，”伊格写道。

paras.en: The ASTM standards are exacting in some ways. Research conducted during the space race led to a 6g recommended limit on roller coaster acceleration exposure. However, ASTM doesn’t make recommendations about other types of motion on a roller coaster that might impact the neck, head and brain. It disregards forces lasting less than 200 milliseconds, no matter how intense.
paras.zh: ASTM 标准在某些方面非常严格。太空竞赛期间进行的研究建议将过山车加速暴露限制为 6 克。然而，ASTM 并未对过山车上可能影响颈部、头部和大脑的其他类型的运动提出建议。它忽略持续时间少于 200 毫秒的力，无论强度如何。

paras.en: But each tiny imperfection and variation in the circumference of the track — especially plentiful in coasters built before modern manufacturing techniques — causes a jolt, says Jurnan Schilder, a mechanical engineer and researcher who teaches roller coaster design at the University of Twente in Amsterdam. He studies ways to create smoother roller coaster rides.
paras.zh: 但在阿姆斯特丹特温特大学教授过山车设计的机械工程师兼研究员朱尔南·希尔德 (Jurnan Schilder) 表示，轨道周长的每一个微小缺陷和变化——尤其是在现代制造技术之前制造的过山车中大量出现——都会引起震动。他研究如何创造更平稳的过山车游乐设施。

paras.en: Schilder’s research suggests that at each track imperfection, “theoretically, you experience infinite jerk.” On a fourth-dimension coaster, he says, two sets of tracks mean double the variations. “Not only is the train sometimes shaking, but also the tilting mechanism is shaking.”
paras.zh: 希尔德的研究表明，在每条赛道不完美的情况下，“理论上，你都会经历无限的颠簸。”他说，在第四维过山车上，两组轨道意味着双倍的变化。 “不仅火车有时会晃动，而且倾斜机构也在晃动。”

paras.en: Research beyond rides also suggests intense and repeated rattling, jostling and vibration could meaningfully impact the brain. The U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration recommends limiting the duration and intensity of whole-body vibration. In April, the Virginia Tech Helmet Lab, which studies the science of brain injuries, published an article suggesting some concussions experienced by baseball players may result from just milliseconds of vibration.
paras.zh: 游乐设施之外的研究还表明，强烈且重复的嘎嘎声、推挤和振动可能会对大脑产生有意义的影响。美国职业安全与健康管理局建议限制全身振动的持续时间和强度。今年四月，研究脑损伤科学的弗吉尼亚理工大学头盔实验室发表了一篇文章，指出棒球运动员经历的一些脑震荡可能是由几毫秒的振动引起的。

paras.en: North Carolina high school student Kayleigh Bonner’s quest to understand her father’s death exposed similar risks. After her father, a retired U.S. Coast Guard surfman who captained boats through rough waves for 21 years, experienced symptoms of a brain injury and died by suicide, Kayleigh surveyed 77 other elite surfmen for a senior capstone project. She found that 89 percent of those she spoke to had some symptoms of brain injury likely caused by the intense, rapidly changing forces traveling through their bodies as their boats were tossed by waves. Her quest to understand her father’s death was written about in July in the New York Times, and soon after acknowledged by the Coast Guard.
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州高中生凯莉·邦纳（Kayleigh Bonner）试图了解父亲的死因，也面临着类似的风险。凯莉的父亲是一位退休的美国海岸警卫队冲浪运动员，曾在汹涌的海浪中驾驶船只长达 21 年，出现脑损伤症状并自杀身亡。凯莉为一项高级顶点项目对其他 77 名精英冲浪运动员进行了调查。她发现，在与她交谈的人中，89% 的人都有一些脑损伤症状，这可能是由于船只被海浪颠簸时，强烈、快速变化的力量穿过他们的身体而引起的。七月，《纽约时报》报道了她对父亲之死的了解，不久之后就得到了海岸警卫队的承认。

paras.en: Of course, professional baseball players and Coast Guard surfmen have more significant and prolonged exposure to these forces than occasional roller coasters riders. But as researchers discover more about how different kinds of motion impact the brain, safety standards seem to lag behind. Minimizing jerk and snap is “an important consideration,” Eager says.
paras.zh: 当然，职业棒球运动员和海岸警卫队冲浪者比偶尔乘坐过山车的人更长时间地接触这些力量。但随着研究人员更多地了解不同类型的运动如何影响大脑，安全标准似乎落后了。伊格说，最大限度地减少冲击和折断是“一个重要的考虑因素”。

paras.en: The mounting roller coaster-related headlines have renewed scrutiny of both the existing coaster safety standards and the lack of federal regulation. U.S. Rep. André Carson, a Democrat from Indiana, has called to pass a bill he first introduced in 2025 that would create federal oversight of amusement rides. Since 1999, Democratic U.S. Sen. Ed Markey of Massachusetts has repeatedly introduced legislation to regulate fixed rides, but the bills have consistently stalled.
paras.zh: 越来越多的与过山车相关的头条新闻重新引发了对现有过山车安全标准和缺乏联邦监管的审查。来自印第安纳州的民主党众议员安德烈·卡森 (André Carson) 呼吁通过他于 2025 年首次提出的一项法案，该法案将对游乐设施实行联邦监管。自1999年以来，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员埃德·马基多次提出监管固定游乐设施的立法，但这些法案一直停滞不前。

paras.en: The amusement industry has long opposed federal oversight. In 2010, Avery coauthored a paper asserting that “the industry needs to find a collective voice and establish consistent self‐regulating policies in order to curb the incidents rates and avoid federal regulation.”
paras.zh: 娱乐业长期以来一直反对联邦监管。 2010 年，艾弗里与人合着了一篇论文，声称“该行业需要找到集体声音并建立一致的自我监管政策，以控制事故发生率并避免联邦监管。”

paras.en: But Schilder says: “It makes you wonder: Are the current safety standards sufficient?”
paras.zh: 但席尔德说：“这让你想知道：当前的安全标准是否足够？”

paras.en: For modern rides, Schilder says he believes they are. Modern manufacturing techniques mean roller coasters designed and built today are much smoother than predecessors. ASTM standards that filter out brief but intense forces, like vibration and jerk, are likely fine for rides that don’t vibrate and jerk very much. But at many parks, the ambitious and intense rides born of the roller coaster arms race are still in place.
paras.zh: 对于现代游乐设施，席尔德说他相信它们是这样的。现代制造技术意味着今天设计和制造的过山车比以前的过山车要平稳得多。 ASTM 标准可以过滤掉短暂但强烈的力，例如振动和冲击力，对于振动和冲击力不大的游乐设施来说可能很好。但在许多公园里，过山车军备竞赛所带来的雄心勃勃和激烈的游乐设施仍然存在。

paras.en: Riders are “flirting, if you would, with danger when they experience rides and devices. They know that they’re more likely than not going to be safe,” Avery says. The point is to be “right on the cusp.”
paras.zh: 乘客“在体验游乐设施和设备时，如果你愿意的话，就是在与危险调情。他们知道自己更有可能是安全的，”艾弗里说。关键是要“处于风口浪尖”。

articles.title: Cranberry Juice Appears to Suppress Dental Plaque Growth, Study Reveals
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Do not underestimate the power of the humble cranberry.
paras.zh: 不要低估蔓越莓的力量。

paras.en: In recent years, studies have confirmed that cranberries can help people prevent urinary tract infections (UTIs), harnessing traditional knowledge that goes back thousands of years in Native American culture, but which has often been debated in research circles.
paras.zh: 近年来，研究证实蔓越莓可以帮助人们预防尿路感染（UTI），利用美洲原住民文化中可追溯到数千年前的传统知识，但这一点在研究界经常引起争议。

paras.en: Now, it appears the same compounds that make cranberries effective against UTIs could offer benefits for a completely different aspect of human health – dental hygiene.
paras.zh: 现在，使蔓越莓有效对抗尿路感染的相同化合物似乎可以为人类健康的一个完全不同的方面——牙齿卫生——带来益处。

paras.en: In a new study published in Scientific Reports, researchers found that consuming cranberry juice appears to suppress the growth of dental plaque, which might come as a surprise to some.
paras.zh: 在《科学报告》上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员发现饮用酸果蔓汁似乎可以抑制牙菌斑的生长，这可能会让一些人感到惊讶。

paras.en: "Most people think of cranberry juice as very sour, very acidic and sugary, and therefore may not contribute positively to oral health," says pediatric dentist Christine Wu from the University of Illinois Chicago.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的儿科牙医 Christine Wu 表示：“大多数人认为蔓越莓汁非常酸、非常酸且含糖量高，因此可能对口腔健康没有积极贡献。”

paras.en: Cranberries contain compounds called proanthocyanidins (PACs), which can inhibit bacterial infections.
paras.zh: 蔓越莓含有称为原花青素（PAC）的化合物，可以抑制细菌感染。

paras.en: In the case of UTIs, the proanthocyanidins in cranberry juice can make it harder for Escherichia coli to attach to the cells lining the bladder.
paras.zh: 就尿路感染而言，蔓越莓汁中的原花青素会使大肠杆菌更难附着在膀胱内壁的细胞上。

paras.en: But evidence is emerging to suggest that proanthocyanidins can also help protect your mouth, inhibiting bacteria such as Streptococcus mutans, which build up in the plaque biofilm amassing on your teeth, producing acids that can contribute to tooth decay.
paras.zh: 但越来越多的证据表明，原花青素还可以帮助保护您的口腔，抑制变形链球菌等细菌，这些细菌会在牙齿上积聚的牙菌斑生物膜中积聚，产生可能导致蛀牙的酸。

paras.en: To investigate whether the proanthocyanidins present in commercially available cranberry juice might offer a protective effect, Wu and fellow researchers conducted a small study involving eight adults and 14 children.
paras.zh: 为了调查市售蔓越莓汁中的原花青素是否可能提供保护作用，Wu 和其他研究人员进行了一项涉及 8 名成人和 14 名儿童的小型研究。

paras.en: In a randomized crossover trial, the participants each tested three separate drinks on different days: pure cranberry juice, a sweetened cranberry drink containing 27 percent cranberry juice, and water serving as a control.
paras.zh: 在一项随机交叉试验中，参与者每人在不同的日子测试了三种不同的饮料：纯蔓越莓汁、含有 27% 蔓越莓汁的甜蔓越莓饮料，以及作为对照的水。

paras.en: In each phase of the test, the participants refrained from oral hygiene for 24 hours, before having one side of their mouth swabbed for plaque.
paras.zh: 在测试的每个阶段，参与者在 24 小时内不进行口腔卫生，然后用拭子擦拭一侧口腔以清除牙菌斑。

paras.en: After this first swab, the participants would take their test drink and swish it around their mouth, before swallowing it. Thirty minutes later, researchers would swab plaque from the other side of the participants' mouths.
paras.zh: 第一次擦拭后，参与者将拿起测试饮料，在嘴里漱口，然后吞咽。三十分钟后，研究人员将从参与者嘴的另一侧擦拭牙菌斑。

paras.en: When the team subsequently compared the baseline swabs to the swabs taken after the drinking experiment, results showed that drinking pure cranberry juice resulted in 44 percent less bacterial growth, with a 33 percent reduction seen in the child participants, compared to the baseline swabs.
paras.zh: 当研究小组随后将基线拭子与饮用实验后采集的拭子进行比较时，结果显示，与基线拭子相比，饮用纯酸果蔓汁可使细菌生长减少 44%，其中儿童参与者的细菌生长减少 33%。

paras.en: "The greater numerical reduction observed in adults may reflect age-related differences in plaque composition, leading to variable susceptibility to cranberry-derived antimicrobial compounds," the researchers explain in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中解释说：“在成年人中观察到的更大的数字减少可能反映了与年龄相关的牙菌斑成分差异，导致对蔓越莓衍生的抗菌化合物的敏感性不同。”

paras.en: "Recent studies have demonstrated clear age-dependent differences in the composition, diversity, and abundance of the oral microbiome, with distinct microbial communities contributing to the caries process in adults versus children."
paras.zh: “最近的研究表明，口腔微生物组的组成、多样性和丰度存在明显的年龄依赖性差异，成人与儿童的龋齿过程有不同的微生物群落。”

paras.en: The regrowth of plaque bacteria after exposure to the sweetened 27 percent cranberry juice drink was numerically lower than in the pre-exposed plaque bacteria, but the difference was not statistically significant.
paras.zh: 暴露于加糖的 27% 蔓越莓汁饮料后，菌斑细菌的再生在数值上低于暴露前的菌斑细菌，但差异不具有统计学意义。

paras.en: In addition to curbing bacterial growth, the pure cranberry juice also yielded a significant reduction in plaque acid production in the participants, potentially limiting the damage these acids can cause to tooth enamel.
paras.zh: 除了抑制细菌生长之外，纯蔓越莓汁还可以显着减少参与者牙菌斑酸的产生，从而可能限制这些酸对牙釉质造成的损害。

paras.en: While the researchers didn't specifically test for it, they suggest the pure cranberry juice outperformed the sweetened cranberry drink due to higher proanthocyanidin content, although future research would be needed to confirm this.
paras.zh: 虽然研究人员没有专门对其进行测试，但他们认为，由于原花青素含量较高，纯蔓越莓汁的表现优于加糖蔓越莓饮料，尽管需要未来的研究来证实这一点。

paras.en: It's worth noting this was only a very small study, and the researchers didn't measure whether cranberry juice consumption protected the participants from tooth decay over time, as they only measured plaque activity and acid levels at the time of the experiment.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，这只是一项非常小的研究，研究人员没有测量蔓越莓汁的摄入是否会随着时间的推移保护参与者免受蛀牙，因为他们只测量了实验时的牙菌斑活性和酸水平。

paras.en: Another question is whether the juice's own high acidity could damage teeth, although the researchers note that existing evidence on the dental erosion caused by acidic beverages is inconsistent, and there is research to suggest that drinking cranberry juice can reduce dentin erosion.
paras.zh: 另一个问题是果汁本身的高酸度是否会损害牙齿，尽管研究人员指出，关于酸性饮料引起牙齿侵蚀的现有证据并不一致，并且有研究表明饮用酸果蔓汁可以减少牙本质侵蚀。

paras.en: Given that we know plaque activity and acid production are two of the chief culprits behind dental cavities, the findings offer preliminary evidence that cranberries may be a 'functional food' that offers oral health benefits beyond the basic nutrition they supply.
paras.zh: 鉴于我们知道牙菌斑活性和酸产生是蛀牙背后的两个罪魁祸首，这些研究结果提供了初步证据，表明蔓越莓可能是一种“功能性食品”，除了提供基本营养之外，还提供口腔健康益处。

paras.en: A final concern could be its sour taste, though, with the researchers observing that the low-sugar tartness of cranberry juice could limit its palatability for people, especially children.
paras.zh: 不过，最后一个担忧可能是它的酸味，研究人员观察到蔓越莓汁的低糖酸味可能会限制其对人们，尤其是儿童的适口性。

paras.en: "Future incorporation of non-cariogenic sweeteners may improve acceptability without compromising safety or efficacy," they suggest.
paras.zh: 他们建议：“未来添加非致龋甜味剂可能会提高可接受性，而不会影响安全性或功效。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《科学报告》中。

articles.title: Scientists Have Discovered Where Native Hawaiians Came From, And The Genetic Effect of Their Long Voyage
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: It took approximately 4 billion years of cumulative evolution to make modern humans, but it only took us 0.000075 of that immense span to settle the entire globe – including (kind of) Antarctica, thanks to the invention of high-capacity poo incinerators.
paras.zh: 现代人类经历了大约 40 亿年的累积进化，但由于大容量粪便焚烧炉的发明，我们只用了 0.000075 年的时间就定居在整个地球上——包括（某种程度上）南极洲。

paras.en: Our innate intrepidity and ants-in-the-pants-iness have driven us across scorching deserts, the rarefied air atop jagged mountains, and slashing through jungles. Then, when the endless oceans stopped us, we built boats.
paras.zh: 我们天生的勇敢和裤衩里的蚂蚁驱使我们穿越灼热的沙漠、锯齿状山脉顶上稀薄的空气，并穿过丛林。然后，当无尽的海洋阻止我们时，我们建造了船只。

paras.en: And thus, over 3,000 years ago, our ancestors began peopling Polynesia, which includes over 1,000 islands spanning an expanse of the Pacific Ocean the size of North and South America combined.
paras.zh: 因此，3000 多年前，我们的祖先开始在波利尼西亚定居，波利尼西亚包括 1000 多个岛屿，横跨太平洋，面积相当于北美和南美的总和。

paras.en: Millennia later, they reached Hawaii, a lush paradise born of Earth's inner fire, and among the most isolated places on Earth. But where did these communities come from?
paras.zh: 几千年后，他们到达了夏威夷，这是一个由地球内部之火诞生的郁郁葱葱的天堂，也是地球上最偏僻的地方之一。但这些社区从何而来？

paras.en: Science now has the clearest answer yet, as published in the journal Science:
paras.zh: 《科学》现在有了迄今为止最明确的答案，发表在《科学》杂志上：

paras.en: "What we uncover in this paper is where the native people of Hawaii had come from," says Alexander Ioannidis, a genetics and biomedical data science researcher at Stanford University and the study's co-senior author.
paras.zh: “我们在这篇论文中揭示的是夏威夷原住民的来源，”斯坦福大学遗传学和生物医学数据科学研究人员、该研究的共同高级作者亚历山大·约安尼迪斯 (Alexander Ioannidis) 说道。

paras.en: "Hawaii is the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere, so it's a long way from everything."
paras.zh: “夏威夷是北半球唯一的波利尼西亚岛屿，因此距离任何地方都很远。”

paras.en: A long way is an understatement. Accordingly, the crux of this landmark study is the evidence that the closest genetic ties are between the two most-separated islands: Hawaii and Rapa Nui (also known as Easter Island), which are each over 3,000 kilometers (nearly 2,000 miles) from the nearest inhabited island and 7,000 kilometers from each other.
paras.zh: 遥远的距离是轻描淡写的。 Accordingly, the crux of this landmark study is the evidence that the closest genetic ties are between the two most-separated islands: Hawaii and Rapa Nui (also known as Easter Island), which are each over 3,000 kilometers (nearly 2,000 miles) from the nearest inhabited island and 7,000 kilometers from each other.

paras.en: They're a bit less related to people from Mangareva Island, suggesting this locality was the ancestral launching point for the modern populations of Hawaii and Rapa Nui.
paras.zh: 他们与来自曼加雷瓦岛的人关系不大，这表明该地区是夏威夷和拉帕努伊现代人口的祖先起源点。

paras.en: Altogether, the Polynesian peopling was achieved piecemeal and in small populations.
paras.zh: 总而言之，波利尼西亚人的定居是零散且人口较少的。

paras.en: This eventually led to one of the dark sides of exploration: the founder effect, a genetic bottleneck in which small founding populations experience reduced genomic variation and resilience, increasing the odds of harmful mutations.
paras.zh: 这最终导致了探索的阴暗面之一：创始人效应，这是一种遗传瓶颈，在这种瓶颈中，小型创始种群的基因组变异和恢复力减少，从而增加了有害突变的可能性。

paras.en: In the absence of written chronicles, and TikTok still millennia away, the researchers genetically recreated the history of the Polynesian peoples.
paras.zh: 在没有书面编年史的情况下，而且 TikTok 距今已有数千年的历史，研究人员通过基因技术重现了波利尼西亚人民的历史。

paras.en: They explored these genetic histories and how they relate to founder effects by analyzing previously published whole-genome sequencing data from 1,050 individuals across French Polynesia. Also, 12 unpublished genomes from Rapa Nui, and genomic data from Native Hawaiians, Samoans, and Tongans from the NIH's All of Us Biobank.
paras.zh: 他们通过分析之前发布的法属波利尼西亚 1,050 人的全基因组测序数据，探索了这些遗传历史以及它们与创始人效应的关系。此外，还有来自拉帕努伊岛的 12 个未发表的基因组，以及来自 NIH 的 All of Us Biobank 的夏威夷原住民、萨摩亚人和汤加人的基因组数据。

paras.en: They isolated genetic segments of Polynesian ancestry via the machine learning Gnomix analyzer, using genomic data from diverse populations around the world as a reference panel.
paras.zh: 他们使用来自世界各地不同人群的基因组数据作为参考面板，通过机器学习 Gnomix 分析仪分离出波利尼西亚血统的遗传片段。

paras.en: They then applied an identity by descent (IBD) method, which links past people to living descendants to reveal common ancestors - a technique that previously illuminated some of America's earliest colonists.
paras.zh: 然后，他们应用了血统身份（IBD）方法，将过去的人与现在的后代联系起来，以揭示共同的祖先——这种技术此前曾启发过一些美国最早的殖民者。

paras.en: And while other populations, like the Amish and Finnish, have experienced a known bottleneck or two, Native Hawaiians may have experienced a series of them, as modest populations navigated between islands on double-hulled catamarans that could only accommodate dozens of people.
paras.zh: 虽然其他人群，如阿米什人和芬兰人，经历过一两个已知的瓶颈，但夏威夷原住民可能经历过一系列瓶颈，因为少数人口乘坐只能容纳数十人的双体双体船在岛屿之间航行。

paras.en: The researchers' previous genetic study pinpointed the ultra-migrations of Polynesians as they crisscrossed the Pacific:
paras.zh: 研究人员之前的基因研究准确地指出了波利尼西亚人在穿越太平洋时的超级迁徙：

paras.en: From Samoa to Fiji and Tonga, followed by an eastward inching toward the Cook Islands, then the Society Islands, which include Tahiti, then, after yet more island hopping, Rapa Nui in 1210.
paras.zh: 从萨摩亚到斐济和汤加，然后向东一点点到达库克群岛，然后是社会群岛，其中包括塔希提岛，然后，经过更多的跳岛游，在 1210 年到达拉帕努伊岛。

paras.en: The researchers also performed a genetic analysis of people from Tahiti, as they represent the largest genomic dataset. A comparison of IBD snippets suggests that the island was founded by around 800 individuals of reproductive age (an estimate excluding elders and children) who arrived 34 generations ago, circa 1070.
paras.zh: 研究人员还对塔希提岛人进行了基因分析，因为他们代表了最大的基因组数据集。对 IBD 片段的比较表明，该岛是由大约 800 名育龄人士（估计不包括老人和儿童）创建的，他们在 34 代人之前（大约 1070 年）抵达。

paras.en: But, how do these bottlenecks actually affect the odds of disease?
paras.zh: 但是，这些瓶颈实际上是如何影响疾病发生的几率的呢？
