articles.title: TechnoMile Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
articles.author: TechnoMile

paras.en: TechnoMile, the leading AI solution that unifies growth, contracts, compliance, and security workflows, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 是统一增长、合同、合规性和安全工作流程的领先 AI 解决方案，被评为 2026 年 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖得主，认可该公司是支持全国企业家和企业的领先 B2B 合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.
paras.zh: 一年一度的 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖旨在表彰那些在帮助企业家和企业应对创建和发展公司的挑战方面取得良好记录的 B2B 公司。从招聘和合规到技术、基础设施、筹款、营销等，这些合作伙伴提供专业知识和服务，使企业能够运营、扩大规模并实现其抱负。

paras.en: “Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”
paras.zh: Inc 编辑总监邦尼·戈什 (Bonny Ghosh) 表示：“企业主并不缺乏可用的工具，B2B 公司需要明确为什么他们的产品和服务值得投资。今年 Power Partners 名单上的公司已经做到了这一点。他们不仅拥有客户，还拥有超级粉丝和传播者。在营销、金融服务和技术等行业，他们已经证明了自己致力于帮助其他企业主成长和成功。”

paras.en: TechnoMile was recognized for its investment in their clients’ long-term success, solving the persistent challenges that growing government contractors face – identifying the right opportunities among thousands of federal solicitations, managing pipelines through manual processes, lacking visibility to forecast and make confident pursuit decisions, and meeting stringent compliance and security requirements once contracts are won.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 因其对客户长期成功的投资而获得认可，解决了不断增长的政府承包商面临的持续挑战——在数千个联邦招标中识别合适的机会，通过手动流程管理管道，缺乏预测和做出自信的追求决策的可见性，以及赢得合同后满足严格的合规性和安全要求。

paras.en: TechnoMile’s unified platform connects growth, contracts, and security workflows, delivering GovCon, Defense, and Public Sector organizations greater visibility, stronger compliance, lower risk, and more efficient operations. By combining purpose-built technology, trusted AI, and deep government contracting experience, TechnoMile helps organizations compete for, win, and successfully execute mission-critical government work.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 的统一平台连接增长、合同和安全工作流程，为 GovCon、国防和公共部门组织提供更高的可视性、更强的合规性、更低的风险和更高效的运营。通过将专用技术、可信人工智能和深厚的政府签约经验相结合，TechnoMile 帮助组织竞争、获胜并成功执行关键任务的政府工作。

paras.en: “TechnoMile solves a real problem for the contracting market – providing a unified way to manage the full lifecycle of federal business,” said Ashish Khot, CEO of TechnoMile. “This award is a special honor because it is largely based on the feedback and experience of our customers and shows that we are living up to our promise to be a partner for business growth, helping companies better manage the work behind winning and delivering federal business.”
paras.zh: “TechnoMile 解决了承包市场的一个真正问题——提供统一的方式来管理联邦业务的整个生命周期，”TechnoMile 首席执行官 Ashish Khot 表示。 “这个奖项是一项特殊的荣誉，因为它主要基于我们客户的反馈和经验，表明我们正在履行我们的承诺，成为业务增长的合作伙伴，帮助公司更好地管理赢得和交付联邦业务背后的工作。”

paras.en: For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards.
paras.zh: 有关 Inc. 电力合作伙伴奖的更多信息或查看获奖者的完整列表，请访问 https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards。

paras.en: Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.
paras.zh: Inc. 是领先的媒体品牌，是为塑造我们未来的企业家和商业领袖提供的手册。 Inc. 旨在通过其新闻报道、教育和提升其社区的形象：冒险者、创新者和正在创造商业未来的超强进取者。 Inc. 由 Mansueto Ventures 以及领先的商业出版物 Fast Company 共同出版。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.inc.com。

articles.title: Craft Prospect kicks off PERSEUS project to advance optical communications for space
articles.author: Craft Prospect

paras.en: Craft Prospect is working with Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics (Fraunhofer CAP) and Vector Photonics on a new project exploring the potential of next-generation laser technology for high-performance optical communications in space.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 正在与弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心 (Fraunhofer CAP) 和 Vector Photonics 合作开展一个新项目，探索下一代激光技术在太空高性能光通信中的潜力。

paras.en: PERSEUS (PCSEL Environmental and Radiation Sensitivity: Evaluation for Use in Space) will investigate whether a promising new laser technology called Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers (PCSELs) is suitable for operation in space and can offer a differentiated capability for both space-to-space and space/ground networks.
paras.zh: PERSEUS（PCSEL环境和辐射敏感性：太空使用评估）将研究一种有前途的新型激光技术，称为光子晶体表面发射激光器（PCSEL）是否适合在太空中运行，并可以为空对空和空/地网络提供差异化​​的功能。

paras.en: The project will evaluate the technology under conditions relevant to space deployment, demonstrate its compatibility with representative spacecraft hardware, and identify the next engineering steps required to move towards a commercial solution.
paras.zh: 该项目将在与太空部署相关的条件下评估该技术，展示其与代表性航天器硬件的兼容性，并确定迈向商业解决方案所需的下一步工程步骤。

paras.en: The project is funded through the Advanced Connectivity Technologies (ACT) programme, delivered by Innovate UK and funded by the Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS). The ACT R&D Programme was announced by Minister Ian Murray during his speech at Connected Britain on 9 September 2026.
paras.zh: 该项目由先进连接技术 (ACT) 计划资助，该计划由创新英国组织实施，并由文化、媒体和体育部 (DCMS) 资助。 ACT 研发计划是由 Ian Murray 部长于 2026 年 9 月 9 日在 Connected Britain 上发表演讲时宣布的。

paras.en: Exploring a new approach to optical communications
paras.zh: 探索光通信新方法

paras.en: PCSEL technology offers the potential to address some of the limitations of existing optical and RF communications systems in space, supporting the move towards longer-range, higher-capacity, and more secure free-space optical links between ground stations, satellites, and potentially deeper-space assets.
paras.zh: PCSEL 技术有可能解决太空中现有光学和射频通信系统的一些局限性，支持地面站、卫星和潜在的深空资产之间建立更远距离、更高容量和更安全的自由空间光学链路。

paras.en: By bridging the gap between component and space system, PERSEUS will chart a course from disruptive technology to differentiated on-orbit capability for the fast-growing space market.
paras.zh: 通过弥合组件和太空系统之间的差距，PERSEUS 将为快速增长的太空市场制定从颠覆性技术到差异化在轨能力的路线。

paras.en: From device testing to spacecraft integration
paras.zh: 从设备测试到航天器集成

paras.en: The PERSEUS programme will subject PCSELs to a range of test campaigns expected of space qualified technologies, as well as carrying out long-range, high-bandwidth free-space demonstrations to showcase early performance.
paras.zh: PERSEUS 计划将使 PCSEL 接受一系列符合太空技术要求的测试活动，并进行远距离、高带宽自由空间演示，以展示早期性能。

paras.en: PCSEL devices will undergo characterisation and testing, including radiation, vibration, and thermal-vacuum campaigns, to better our understanding of how the technology fares in the launch and space environments.
paras.zh: PCSEL 设备将接受特性描述和测试，包括辐射、振动和热真空活动，以更好地了解该技术在发射和太空环境中的表现。

paras.en: Furthermore, the project will demonstrate early integration success with other flight-representative hardware for end-to-end data transmission, and develop mission concepts that harness the unique capabilities of PCSELs.
paras.zh: 此外，该项目还将展示与其他飞行代表硬件进行端到端数据传输的早期集成成功，并开发利用 PCSEL 独特功能的任务概念。

paras.en: The findings will feed into a future communications system design concept and help define the engineering roadmap required to progress PCSEL technology towards a differentiated space communications solution.
paras.zh: 研究结果将纳入未来的通信系统设计概念，并帮助定义将 PCSEL 技术发展为差异化空间通信解决方案所需的工程路线图。

paras.en: Bringing together photonics and space engineering expertise
paras.zh: 汇集光子学和空间工程专业知识

paras.en: At Craft Prospect, Head of Engineering Kevin Quillien is serving as Project Lead, supported by Chief Engineer Paul Yarr and Systems Engineers Lauryn Atkinson and Kairavi Pandit.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 的工程主管 Kevin Quillien 担任项目负责人，并由总工程师 Paul Yarr 以及系统工程师 Lauryn Atkinson 和 Kairav Pandit 提供支持。

paras.en: At Fraunhofer CAP, Dr Gerald Bonner is subcontract lead, while at Vector Photonics Dr Richard Taylor serves as subcontract lead and Dr Graham Goldberg as Project Manager.
paras.zh: 在 Fraunhofer CAP，Gerald Bonner 博士担任分包负责人，而在 Vector Photonics，Richard Taylor 博士担任分包负责人，Graham Goldberg 博士担任项目经理。

paras.en: The project also builds on Craft Prospect’s growing quantum-optical communications capability, including our work on OPS-SAT VOLT, where we are developing and testing space-to-ground free-space quantum and optical communications technologies as part of our wider mission to deliver Smart Secure Space.
paras.zh: 该项目还建立在 Craft Prospect 不断增长的量子光通信能力的基础上，包括我们在 OPS-SAT VOLT 上的工作，我们正在开发和测试空对地自由空间量子和光通信技术，作为我们提供智能安全空间的更广泛使命的一部分。

paras.en: Kevin Quillien, Project Lead and Head of Engineering Craft Prospect, said of the project:
paras.zh: 项目负责人兼 Engineering Craft Prospect 负责人 Kevin Quillien 谈到该项目时说道：

paras.en: ‘PERSEUS is an exciting opportunity to take a promising new photonics technology and understand the potential it has to offer the space industry.
paras.zh: “PERSEUS 是一个令人兴奋的机会，可以采用有前途的新型光子技术并了解它为航天工业带来的潜力。

paras.en: ‘By carrying out all the necessary early-stage work to test and characterise PCSELs for space, we will build a strong understanding of the potential that the technology offers in building the next generation of communication solutions. We’re looking forward to working with Fraunhofer CAP and Vector Photonics to explore where this roadmap will take us.’
paras.zh: “通过开展所有必要的早期工作来测试和表征太空 PCSEL，我们将深入了解该技术在构建下一代通信解决方案方面的潜力。我们期待与 Fraunhofer CAP 和 Vector Photonics 合作，探索该路线图将带我们走向何方。

paras.en: Craft Prospect is a Glasgow-based space engineering company advancing its vision of Smart Secure Space through onboard intelligence, quantum technologies, and satellite subsystem innovation. Learn more here.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 是一家总部位于格拉斯哥的空间工程公司，通过机载智能、量子技术和卫星子系统创新推进其智能安全空间的愿景。在这里了解更多信息。

paras.en: About Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics
paras.zh: 关于弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心

paras.en: Fraunhofer CAP is a not-for-profit research and technology organisation (RTO) offering industry a professional development capability in the fields of photonics, lasers and quantum technologies. Learn more about Fraunhofer CAP here.
paras.zh: Fraunhofer CAP 是一家非营利性研究和技术组织 (RTO)，为业界提供光子学、激光和量子技术领域的专业开发能力。点击此处了解有关弗劳恩霍夫 CAP 的更多信息。

paras.en: Vector Photonics Limited, based in Glasgow, is advancing its revolutionary, proprietary, PCSEL technology from proven R&D and commercial fab environments to high-volume manufacturing. Further information can be found here
paras.zh: 总部位于格拉斯哥的 Vector Photonics Limited 正在将其革命性的专有 PCSEL 技术从经过验证的研发和商业晶圆厂环境推进到大批量制造。更多信息可以在这里找到

articles.title: NEO Surveyor’s Sunshade Gets Inspected

paras.en: The large sunshade of NASA’s Near-Earth Object (NEO) Surveyor is mounted on an assembly ring during inspections in a clean room at BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems in Boulder, Colorado, in July 2026.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月，在科罗拉多州博尔德市 BAE 系统空间与任务系统公司的洁净室中进行检查时，NASA 近地天体 (NEO) 测量仪的大型遮阳罩被安装在装配环上。

paras.en: The sunshade structure stands 20 feet (6 meters) tall and measures 8 feet (2.4 meters) wide at its base. Its two flat panels, joined at a 23.5-degree angle, were covered with 864 interconnected solar cells and then tested before arriving in Colorado. This specialized solar array can produce up to 2 kilowatts of power and will generate all the required electricity to charge the onboard batteries that power the spacecraft’s systems.
paras.zh: 遮阳结构高 20 英尺（6 米），底部宽 8 英尺（2.4 米）。它的两个平板以 23.5 度角连接，上面覆盖着 864 个互连的太阳能电池，然后在抵达科罗拉多州之前进行了测试。这种专门的太阳能电池阵列可产生高达 2 千瓦的电力，并将产生为航天器系统供电的机载电池充电所需的所有电力。

paras.en: Built by Applied Aerospace in Stockton, California, the sunshade structure was outfitted with its solar cells by SolAero Technologies in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in January. Environmental testing of the sunshade and solar array was completed at a commercial thermal vacuum testing facility in El Segundo, California, in March and it was delivered to BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems ahead of schedule in May.
paras.zh: 该遮阳结构由加利福尼亚州斯托克顿的应用航空航天公司建造，今年 1 月由新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的 SolAero Technologies 公司配备了太阳能电池。遮阳罩和太阳能电池阵列的环境测试于 3 月份在加利福尼亚州埃尔塞贡多的商业热真空测试设施完成，并于 5 月份提前交付给 BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems。

paras.en: When in space, NEO Surveyor will seek out some of the hardest-to-find asteroids and comets, some of which may be located in the direction of the Sun — a region of sky where ground-based optical telescopes have a harder time searching.
paras.zh: 在太空中，NEO Surveyor 将寻找一些最难发现的小行星和彗星，其中一些可能位于太阳的方向——这是地面光学望远镜难以搜索的天空区域。

paras.en: More information about NEO Surveyor is available at:
paras.zh: 有关 NEO Surveyor 的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: How a Johnson Mentor Shapes the Next Generation of NASA Talent
articles.author: Sumer Loggins

paras.en: When Rice University student Malvika Bhardwaj asked her mentor Daniel Cohen, a Guidance, Navigation & Control (GN&C) engineer at NASA’s Johnson Space Center, whether he had time to keep teaching interns with his busy workload, he answered, “You decide what’s important.”
paras.zh: 当莱斯大学的学生马尔维卡·巴德瓦吉 (Malvika Bhardwaj) 问她的导师、美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的制导、导航与控制 (GN&C) 工程师丹尼尔·科恩 (Daniel Cohen)，他是否有时间在繁忙的工作量中继续教导实习生时，他回答说：“你来决定什么是重要的。”

paras.en: In honor of National Mentoring Day on Oct. 27, Bhardwaj reflects on how Cohen’s advice and support has shaped her internship experience at Johnson.
paras.zh: 为了纪念 10 月 27 日的国家辅导日，Bhardwaj 反思了科恩的建议和支持如何塑造了她在约翰逊的实习经历。

paras.en: Through NASA’s Office of STEM Engagement, interns like Bhardwaj contribute to agency projects while learning from NASA mentors and gaining technical skills and hand-on experience to build a future career in space exploration.
paras.zh: 通过 NASA 的 STEM 参与办公室，像 Bhardwaj 这样的实习生为机构项目做出贡献，同时向 NASA 导师学习，获得技术技能和实践经验，以建立未来的太空探索职业生涯。

paras.en: Bhardwaj studies computational and applied mathematics at Rice University and interns with the GN&C team, which focuses on how spacecraft determine their position and maneuver in orbit. She is developing tools to analyze thruster firings on the U.S. Deorbit Vehicle that will help NASA safely deorbit the International Space Station at the end of its operational life. Bhardwaj also uses computer simulations to test the vehicle’s control system and identify conditions under which it could fail.
paras.zh: Bhardwaj 在莱斯大学学习计算和应用数学，并在 GN&C 团队实习，该团队专注于航天器如何确定其在轨道上的位置和机动。她正在开发分析美国脱轨飞行器上推进器点火的工具，这将帮助美国宇航局在国际空间站运行寿命结束时安全地使其脱轨。巴德瓦吉还使用计算机模拟来测试车辆的控制系统并确定其可能发生故障的条件。

paras.en: “I’ve learned about the culture of community and support at Johnson and NASA as a whole. Daniel made an effort to introduce me to the team and include me in conversations and meetings. I saw how team members step up to help one another and keep the whole unit moving forward,” Bhardwaj said.
paras.zh: “我了解了约翰逊和整个 NASA 的社区文化和支持。丹尼尔努力将我介绍给团队，并让我参与对话和会议。我看到团队成员如何站出来互相帮助并推动整个团队不断前进，”巴德瓦吉说。

paras.en: Cohen, a Rice University alumnus with a master’s in mechanical engineering, began his NASA career as a flight operations intern in 2020. He later held internships in docking dynamics, propulsion systems, and GN&C analysis before joining Johnson as a full-time engineer in August 2024.
paras.zh: 科恩是莱斯大学的校友，拥有机械工程硕士学位，于 2020 年以飞行操作实习生的身份开始了他在 NASA 的职业生涯。后来，他在对接动力学、推进系统和 GN&C 分析方面进行了实习，然后于 2024 年 8 月加入约翰逊担任全职工程师。

paras.en: His current work includes developing simulations and models for studies of the U.S. Deorbit Vehicle, analyzing its control algorithms and GN&C performance, and evaluating SpaceX’s design at multiple life-cycle reviews.
paras.zh: 他目前的工作包括开发用于研究美国脱轨飞行器的模拟和模型、分析其控制算法和 GN&C 性能，以及在多个生命周期审查中评估 SpaceX 的设计。

paras.en: He also analyzes settings for the Orion spacecraft’s docking camera, which provides positioning measurements that can help inform navigation during future Artemis rendezvous activities.
paras.zh: 他还分析了猎户座飞船对接摄像头的设置，该摄像头提供的定位测量结果可以帮助为未来阿耳忒弥斯交会活动期间的导航提供信息。

paras.en: Cohen supports Bhardwaj beyond her internship, giving her a closer look at how colleagues collaborate on projects and share ideas. He sets aside a couple of hours each week to teach interns topics such as orbital mechanics and control systems.
paras.zh: 科恩在实习之外为巴德瓦吉提供支持，让她更仔细地了解同事如何在项目上进行协作和分享想法。他每周留出几个小时来向实习生讲授轨道力学和控制系统等主题。

paras.en: Bhardwaj took Cohen’s advice to heart: How she spends her time and energy reflects what she values. She believes that her internship has shown her that problem-solving is rarely an individual effort. Team members bring different perspectives and need to understand how their work connects to a larger project.
paras.zh: 巴德瓦吉牢记科恩的建议：她如何度过时间和精力反映了她的价值观。她认为，她的实习经历告诉她，解决问题很少需要个人努力。团队成员带来不同的观点，需要了解他们的工作如何与更大的项目联系起来。

paras.en: Working alongside interns in outreach, social media, and digital design has also broadened Bhardwaj’s view of STEM careers. “No matter what interests you, there’s likely a role for you here,” she said.
paras.zh: 与外展、社交媒体和数字设计领域的实习生一起工作也拓宽了 Bhardwaj 对 STEM 职业的视野。 “无论你对什么感兴趣，这里都可能有适合你的职位，”她说。

paras.en: She was proud to complete her first project, a set of analysis tools she built from scratch. Working through the debugging process and seeing a finished, functioning product was especially rewarding.
paras.zh: 她很自豪地完成了她的第一个项目，这是她从头开始构建的一套分析工具。完成调试过程并看到完成的、功能正常的产品是特别有意义的。

paras.en: Bhardwaj’s advice to students interested in NASA internships is to apply even if they do not feel fully prepared.
paras.zh: 巴德瓦吉对对 NASA 实习感兴趣的学生的建议是，即使他们觉得自己没有做好充分准备，也要申请。

paras.en: “You’re probably never going to feel 100% ready, but so much of the learning happens on the job,” she said. “Trust in your ability to navigate new environments.”
paras.zh: “你可能永远不会感到 100% 准备好了，但很多学习都是在工作中发生的，”她说。 “相信你驾驭新环境的能力。”

articles.title: NASA’s Neo Surveyor Sunshade
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: A technician inspects the large sunshade of NASA’s Near-Earth Object (NEO) Surveyor mission in this image released on Oct. 26, 2026. The sunshade structure, which stands 20 feet (6 meters) tall and measures 8 feet (2.4 meters) wide at its base, will keep the infrared space telescope cool as it searches for near-Earth asteroids and comets while also providing the spacecraft with power.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布的这张图片中，一名技术人员正在检查 NASA 近地天体 (NEO) 勘测者任务的大型遮阳罩。遮阳罩结构高 20 英尺（6 米），底部宽 8 英尺（2.4 米），它将在红外太空望远镜搜索近地小行星和彗星时保持凉爽，同时为航天器提供动力。

paras.en: When in space, NEO Surveyor will detect some of the hardest-to-find asteroids and comets, some of which may be located in the direction of the Sun — a region of sky where ground-based optical telescopes have a harder time searching.
paras.zh: 在太空中，NEO Surveyor 将探测到一些最难发现的小行星和彗星，其中一些可能位于太阳的方向——这是地面光学望远镜难以搜索的天空区域。

paras.en: Image credit: BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems
paras.zh: 图片来源：BAE Systems 空间与任务系统

articles.title: World News in Brief: Ethiopians flee to Kenya amidst renewed conflict, new head of UN’s food programme, UN mission in Somalia concludes

paras.en: World News in Brief: Ethiopians flee to Kenya amidst renewed conflict, new head of UN’s food programme, UN mission in Somalia concludes
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：联合国粮食计划署新任负责人、联合国驻索马里特派团得出结论，埃塞俄比亚人在新的冲突中逃往肯尼亚

paras.en: That’s according to the UN migration agency, IOM.
paras.zh: 这是联合国移民机构国际移民组织的说法。

paras.en: Forces from the Somali and Oromia regions in Southern Ethiopia have been fighting for over two decades over boundary demarcations and resources, with recent escalations since last week sparking a new wave of displacement.
paras.zh: 来自埃塞俄比亚南部索马里和奥罗米亚地区的武装力量为争夺边界划分和资源问题已经进行了二十多年的斗争，自上周以来冲突不断升级，引发了新一波的流离失所。

paras.en: Amongst those who fled, nearly 11,000 have sought sanctuary within the large compound of the Oriental Mission Church (OMC), a prominent Korean-American Christian organisation based in Los Angeles, which does missionary and humanitarian work in Kenya, said IOM.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织表示，在逃亡者中，近 11,000 人在东方传教会 (OMC) 的大院内寻求庇护，这是一家总部位于洛杉矶的著名韩裔美国基督教组织，在肯尼亚从事传教和人道主义工作。

paras.en: The remaining 25,600 people are being hosted by communities along the border.
paras.zh: 其余 25,600 人由边境沿线社区收容。

paras.en: IOM is working with the Kenyan government and the UN refugee agency, UNHCR, to collect and manage displacement data, as well as assess humanitarian needs.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织正在与肯尼亚政府和联合国难民署难民署合作，收集和管理流离失所数据，并评估人道主义需求。

paras.en: So far it has identified needs for water and sanitation, shelter and essential household items, food assistance, health support and protection.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，它已经确定了对水和卫生设施、住房和基本生活用品、粮食援助、健康支持和保护的需求。

paras.en: It also stresses the need to pay special attention to the needs of host communities, who are accommodating most of the displaced, despite already limited resources.
paras.zh: 它还强调需要特别关注收容社区的需求，尽管资源已经有限，但收容社区仍在收容大多数流离失所者。

paras.en: Lindberg takes helm at WFP with call to end famine
paras.zh: 林德伯格掌管世界粮食计划署，呼吁结束饥荒

paras.en: Luke J. Lindberg took office as Executive Director of the UN World Food Programme (WFP) on Monday, calling on donors, partners and supporters worldwide to help sustain the agency’s life-saving work.
paras.zh: 卢克·J·林德伯格 (Luke J. Lindberg) 周一就任联合国世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 执行主任，呼吁世界各地的捐助者、合作伙伴和支持者帮助维持该机构的救生工作。

paras.en: “Conflict is driving people into hunger, and extreme weather and maritime choke points exacerbate this reality,” Mr. Lindberg said.
paras.zh: “冲突正在使人们陷入饥饿，而极端天气和海上阻塞点则加剧了这一现实，”林德伯格先生说。

paras.en: “We cannot do it alone. Governments, institutions, businesses, and individuals need to stand with us, fund the work, and help get food to people before it’s too late. No more famines.”
paras.zh: “我们无法独自做到这一点。政府、机构、企业和个人需要与我们站在一起，为工作提供资金，并帮助为人们提供食物，以免为时已晚。不再有饥荒。”

paras.en: As many as 266 million people faced acute hunger worldwide last year, with conflict driving the most severe crises. WFP teams currently operate in 83 countries.
paras.zh: 去年，全球有多达 2.66 亿人面临严重饥饿，其中冲突引发了最严重的危机。粮食计划署团队目前在 83 个国家开展工作。

paras.en: Mr. Lindberg succeeds Cindy McCain, who led WFP from April 2023 to May 2026, and Carl Skau, who has served as Acting Executive Director since June.
paras.zh: 林德伯格先生接替辛迪·麦凯恩（Cindy McCain）和卡尔·斯考（Carl Skau），辛迪·麦凯恩于 2023 年 4 月至 2026 年 5 月期间领导粮食计划署，卡尔·斯考自 6 月起担任代理执行主任。

paras.en: He previously served as Under Secretary for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs at the US Department of Agriculture.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任美国农业部负责贸易和对外农业事务的副部长。

paras.en: Somalia takes the lead as UN mission bows out after three decades
paras.zh: 联合国特派团在三十年后退出，索马里发挥带头作用

paras.en: The UN’s political mission in Somalia will close on Saturday, ending more than three decades of UN missions in the country supporting peace, state-building and reconciliation.
paras.zh: 联合国在索马里的政治使命将于周六结束，结束联合国三十多年来在该国支持和平、国家建设与和解的使命。

paras.en: The UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) completes its two-year mandate on 31 October.
paras.zh: 联合国索马里过渡时期援助团（UNTMIS）于 10 月 31 日结束其为期两年的任务。

paras.en: The Security Council has decided not to renew it, at the request of the Somali Government, which wants to take greater ownership of its own peacebuilding and state-building.
paras.zh: 应索马里政府的要求，安理会决定不再延长该期限，因为索马里政府希望对自己的建设和平和国家建设拥有更大的自主权。

paras.en: The mission’s work will pass to Somali institutions and to the UN agencies, funds and programmes already operating in the country.
paras.zh: 该特派团的工作将移交给索马里机构以及已在该国运作的联合国机构、基金和项目。

paras.en: Secretary-General António Guterres praised the progress made over the decades and thanked those who made it possible, in particular his successive Special Representatives and the mission’s staff.
paras.zh: 秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯赞扬了几十年来取得的进展，并感谢那些使之成为可能的人，特别是他的历任特别代表和特派团工作人员。

paras.en: He also paid tribute to UN personnel who lost their lives while serving in Somalia.
paras.zh: 他还向在索马里服役期间丧生的联合国人员表示敬意。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres acknowledged that Somalia still faces serious political, security, humanitarian and development challenges, and called on the international community to keep up its support so that the gains made are not lost.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯承认索马里仍面临严峻的政治、安全、人道主义和发展挑战，呼吁国际社会继续提供支持，不让已取得的成果丧失。

paras.en: That means pushing forward with inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, building stronger institutions, protecting human rights and confronting Al Shabaab, the Somalia-based terrorist group affiliated with al-Qaeda.
paras.zh: 这意味着推动包容性政治对话与和解、建立更强有力的机构、保护人权以及对抗隶属于基地组织的索马里恐怖组织青年党。

articles.title: Ebola: 20 contacts released from quarantine in Kenya, amid vaccine ‘hope’ in DR Congo

paras.en: Ebola: 20 contacts released from quarantine in Kenya, amid vaccine ‘hope’ in DR Congo
paras.zh: 埃博拉：刚果民主共和国疫苗接种“希望”，肯尼亚 20 名接触者解除隔离

paras.en: Twenty people associated with Kenya’s first case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease have been reunited with their families after being released from quarantine following completion of a mandatory 21-day monitoring period.
paras.zh: 与肯尼亚首例埃博拉本迪布焦病毒病相关的 20 名人员在完成 21 天的强制性监测期后解除隔离，现已与家人团聚。

paras.en: They were discharged on Monday, according to the UN World Health Organization (WHO), which has been assisting the Kenyan authorities with Ebola preparedness since the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared an outbreak on 15 May.
paras.zh: 据联合国世界卫生组织 (WHO) 称，他们已于周一出院。自刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 5 月 15 日宣布埃博拉疫情爆发以来，该组织一直在协助肯尼亚当局做好埃博拉疫情的防范工作。

paras.en: Another 98 contacts remain in quarantine.
paras.zh: 另有 98 名接触者仍处于隔离状态。

paras.en: The people who are now back at home remained asymptomatic during quarantine and underwent standard protocols, including a final health assessment, counselling on post-discharge precautions and follow-up where required before being released.
paras.zh: 现在回到家中的人在隔离期间没有出现症状，并接受了标准方案，包括最终健康评估、出院后预防措施咨询以及出院前所需的后续行动。

paras.en: “We ask communities to welcome them home warmly,” said Dr Patrick Amoth, Kenya’s director general for health. “Having completed 21 days without symptoms, they pose no risk of infection to anyone.”
paras.zh: “我们请求社区热烈欢迎他们回家，”肯尼亚卫生总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯博士说。 “他们已经 21 天没有出现任何症状，因此不会对任何人构成感染风险。”

paras.en: The WHO representative to Kenya, Dr Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, echoed his message.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织驻肯尼亚代表 Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo 博士也赞同他的观点。

paras.en: “People who complete quarantine have helped protect their families, their communities and the whole country,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“完成隔离的人们帮助保护了他们的家人、社区和整个国家。”

paras.en: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on 6 October – a Kenyan man who had been working in the DRC, where the caseload is approaching the 10,000 mark.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚于 10 月 6 日确认了首例埃博拉病例，患者是一名曾在刚果民主共和国工作的肯尼亚男子，该国病例数已接近 10,000 例。

paras.en: He flew back to Kenya via Uganda on 3 October and died in a Nairobi hospital two days later.
paras.zh: 他于 10 月 3 日经乌干达飞回肯尼亚，两天后在内罗毕一家医院去世。

paras.en: The Ministry of Health conducted robust contact tracing of anyone who may have been exposed, including family members, airline passengers and crew, airport workers and medical personnel. By 22 October, all contacts were traced – both in Kenya and abroad – and placed in quarantine.
paras.zh: 卫生部对任何可能接触过病毒的人进行了强有力的接触者追踪，包括家庭成员、航空公司乘客和机组人员、机场工作人员和医务人员。到 10 月 22 日，肯尼亚和国外的所有接触者都已被追踪并被隔离。

paras.en: As of Monday, eight contacts had developed symptoms and were confirmed positive for Ebola disease through laboratory testing. They were immediately transferred to the Ebola treatment centre in Nairobi.
paras.zh: 截至周一，八名接触者出现症状，并通过实验室检测证实埃博拉病毒呈阳性。他们立即被转移到内罗毕的埃博拉治疗中心。

paras.en: In total, Kenya has reported nine confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths. All are part of one connected group and there is no evidence that the virus has spread to the community.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚总共报告了 9 例埃博拉确诊病例和 2 例死亡。所有人都是一个相互关联的群体的一部分，没有证据表明该病毒已传播到社区。

paras.en: “WHO commends the Ministry of Health, the Kenya National Public Health Institute, national and county health teams for their work in responding quickly to every new case,” said Dr. Kimambo.
paras.zh: “世卫组织赞扬卫生部、肯尼亚国家公共卫生研究所、国家和县卫生团队对每一个新病例做出快速反应的工作，”Kimambo 博士说。

paras.en: The UN agency continues to support Kenya in all aspects of Ebola response, including coordination, disease surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory testing, case management, infection prevention and control, health screening at points of entry, risk communication and community engagement.
paras.zh: 联合国机构继续在埃博拉应对工作的各个方面支持肯尼亚，包括协调、疾病监测、接触者追踪、实验室检测、病例管理、感染预防和控制、入境口岸健康筛查、风险沟通和社区参与。

paras.en: Although there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus disease, WHO stressed that early detection and supportive care improve chances of recovery.
paras.zh: 尽管本迪布焦病毒病尚无获得许可的疫苗或具体治疗方法，但世卫组织强调，早期发现和支持性护理可提高康复机会。

paras.en: Meanwhile, “a crucial clinical trial” was launched in the DRC on Friday to determine if vaccines can provide protection against the disease, said WHO’s Dr. Meg Doherty, speaking from the eastern city of Bunia to journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 与此同时，世界卫生组织的梅格·多尔蒂博士在东部城市布尼亚对日内瓦的记者表示，周五在刚果民主共和国启动了“一项重要的临床试验”，以确定疫苗是否能够提供针对这种疾病的保护。

paras.en: The TUMAINI trial platform is designed so that several vaccine candidates can be evaluated within one research framework using a strategy called the ring vaccination approach involving contacts of people with a confirmed case of Ebola.
paras.zh: TUMAINI 试验平台的设计使得可以在一个研究框架内使用一种称为环疫苗接种方法的策略对几种候选疫苗进行评估，该方法涉及埃博拉确诊病例的接触者。

paras.en: “Tumaini actually means ‘hope’ in Swahili, and is giving us some hope,” said Dr. Doherty, director of WHO’s Department of Science for Health.
paras.zh: “图迈尼在斯瓦希里语中实际上意味着‘希望’，它给我们带来了一些希望，”世卫组织健康科学司司长多尔蒂博士说。

paras.en: The first vaccine under evaluation is Ervebo which has been effective against Ebola caused by the Zaire virus. It is not yet known if it will have any protective effect against the Bundibugyo strain.
paras.zh: 第一个接受评估的疫苗是 Ervebo，它对扎伊尔病毒引起的埃博拉病毒有效。目前尚不清楚它是否对 Bundibugyo 菌株有任何保护作用。

paras.en: Dr. Doherty attended the launch, where four people were vaccinated.
paras.zh: 多尔蒂博士出席了发布会，四人接种了疫苗。

paras.en: “It was moving to see this trial begin, just as it has been deeply sad to see the effect of this outbreak on communities,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“看到这次试验的开始令人感动，就像看到这次疫情对社区的影响深感悲痛一样。”

paras.en: “I lived and worked in DRC nearly 40 years ago, and it is quite heartbreaking to see this beautiful country challenged by outbreaks on top of humanitarian crises.”
paras.zh: “近40年前，我在刚果民主共和国生活和工作，看到这个美丽的国家在人道主义危机之外还面临疫情的挑战，真是令人心碎。”

paras.en: Last week, WHO convened technical advisory groups that evaluated the evidence on two vaccines designed specifically against Bundibugyo virus: ChAdOx1, developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India, and mRNA-1469 developed by the American company Moderna.
paras.zh: 上周，世卫组织召集了技术咨询小组，评​​估了两种专门针对本迪布焦病毒设计的疫苗的证据：牛津大学与印度血清研究所合作开发的 ChAdOx1 和美国公司 Moderna 开发的 mRNA-1469。

paras.en: Recommendations will be published this week.
paras.zh: 建议将于本周发布。

paras.en: “In the meantime, rings are being set up, with people who have a family member sick with Ebola, or who have been exposed to the virus another way,” she said, noting that two rings are currently in place and several more are being prepared.
paras.zh: 她说：“与此同时，正在为那些有家庭成员患有埃博拉病毒或以其他方式接触过该病毒的人设立环。”她指出，目前已经设立了两个环，另外几个环正在准备中。

paras.en: “Community members are already walking into the site asking to be enrolled, highlighting the intense need for an efficacious vaccine,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“社区成员已经走进该网站要求注册，这凸显了对有效疫苗的迫切需求。”

paras.en: Dr. Doherty explained that a decade ago, WHO and partners used the ring vaccination approach in Guinea during the West African Ebola outbreak to help establish the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine.
paras.zh: Doherty博士解释说，十年前，世卫组织及其合作伙伴在西非埃博拉疫情爆发期间在几内亚使用环疫苗接种方法来帮助确定Ervebo疫苗的有效性。

paras.en: “Today, scientists are building on that experience to seek answers about the Bundibugyo virus,” she said.
paras.zh: “今天，科学家们正在利用这一经验来寻找有关本迪布焦病毒的答案，”她说。

paras.en: The trial is led by the Congolese authorities and is integrated into the ongoing response to the outbreak. It is being managed by the National Public Health and Biomedical Research Institute, known by the French acronym IRNRB.
paras.zh: 该试验由刚果当局领导，并被纳入正在进行的疫情应对工作中。它由国家公共卫生和生物医学研究所（法语缩写 IRNRB）管理。

paras.en: “We do not yet know for certain when results will begin to emerge. We expect it will take several months,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们还不确定结果何时会开始出现。我们预计这需要几个月的时间，”她说。

paras.en: “But already, having this trial in place is an important step towards gathering scientific data that will help policy makers reach decisions on vaccine use, and we anticipate, to protect people in this outbreak and future outbreaks.”
paras.zh: “但是，进行这项试验已经是收集科学数据的重要一步，这将有助于政策制定者就疫苗的使用做出决定，我们预计，这将在这次疫情和未来疫情中保护人们。”

paras.en: Dr Doherty noted that several other vaccines are under development, “and as they go through their initial studies, if they look promising, they too could be brought into this vaccine platform trial.”
paras.zh: 多尔蒂博士指出，其他几种疫苗正在开发中，“当它们进行初步研究时，如果它们看起来有希望，它们也可以被纳入这个疫苗平台试验。”

articles.title: Record carbon dioxide levels will impact us for centuries, says UN weather agency

paras.en: Record carbon dioxide levels will impact us for centuries, says UN weather agency
paras.zh: 联合国气象机构称，创纪录的二氧化碳水平将影响我们几个世纪

paras.en: Levels of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other major greenhouse gases in the atmosphere caused by burning fossil fuels reached record highs in 2025, locking in more long-term global warming, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 世界气象组织(WMO)周二表示，燃烧化石燃料引起的大气中二氧化碳(CO2)和其他主要温室气体的含量将在2025年达到历史新高，从而导致更长期的全球变暖。

paras.en: The agency’s latest Greenhouse Gas Bulletin indicates an average global concentration of CO2 at 426.8 parts per million (ppm) last year, or 153 per cent of the 1750 pre-industrial baseline.
paras.zh: 该机构最新的温室气体公报显示，去年全球二氧化碳平均浓度为百万分之 426.8 (ppm)，即 1750 年工业化前基线的 153%。

paras.en: “Every additional part per million matters because it traps additional heat. In effect, we are supercharging the ocean and the atmosphere. That means that heat waves, tropical cyclones, and rainstorms are intensifying faster than our historical baselines prepared us for,” WMO Deputy Secretary-General Ko Barrett told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: “每一百万分之一的增加都很重要，因为它会捕获更多的热量。实际上，我们正在给海洋和大气增压。这意味着热浪、热带气旋和暴雨的加剧速度比我们准备的历史基线要快，”世界气象组织副秘书长科·巴雷特在日内瓦对记者说。

paras.en: Equally worrying, levels of methane and nitrous oxide – the second and third most important long-lived greenhouse gases caused by human activities – also hit a new peak in 2025.
paras.zh: 同样令人担忧的是，甲烷和一氧化二氮（人类活动造成的第二和第三重要的长期温室气体）的水平也在 2025 年达到了新的峰值。

paras.en: “Another year, another new record. Greenhouse gases are trapping an unprecedented amount of heat in the atmosphere, providing energy for more extreme weather and associated risks to our economies and societies,” Ms. Barrett stressed.
paras.zh: “又一年，又一个新纪录。温室气体在大气中吸收了前所未有的热量，为更加极端的天气以及我们的经济和社会带来的相关风险提供了能量，”巴雷特女士强调。

paras.en: “The past 11 years have been the warmest on record and this trend is set to continue. CO2 has a very long lifetime and so will affect the global climate not just for years but for decades and even centuries.”
paras.zh: “过去 11 年是有记录以来最热的一年，这种趋势还将持续下去。二氧化碳的寿命很长，因此不仅会影响全球气候数年，而且会持续数十年甚至数百年。”

paras.en: When the Bulletin was first published in 2004, the annual average level of CO2 measured by WMO’s Global Atmosphere Watch network of monitoring stations was 377.5 ppm, compared with nearly 427 ppm today.
paras.zh: 当该公报于 2004 年首次发布时，WMO 全球大气监测站网络测得的二氧化碳年平均水平为 377.5 ppm，而如今的数值接近 427 ppm。

paras.en: Growth rates of CO2 have tripled since the 1960s, accelerating from an annual average increase of 0.8 ppm per year to 2.4 ppm per year in the decade from 2011 to 2020.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 60 年代以来，二氧化碳的增长率增加了两倍，从 2011 年到 2020 年的十年间，年均增长率从每年 0.8 ppm 加速到每年 2.4 ppm。

paras.en: The “exceptional [3.5 ppm] surge” of 2023-2024 coincided with a strong El Niño “which reduced the efficiency of the biosphere through more drought, drier vegetation and more wildfires”, said WMO senior scientific officer Oksana Tarasova.
paras.zh: WMO 高级科学官员奥克萨娜·塔拉索娃 (Oksana Tarasova) 表示，2023 年至 2024 年的“异常[3.5 ppm]激增”恰逢强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，“厄尔尼诺现象导致更多的干旱、植被干燥和更多的野火，降低了生物圈的效率”。

paras.en: She noted that although the 2.8 ppm annual increase from 2024-2025 represented a more modest increase, it was nonetheless “a substantial addition of carbon to the atmosphere from fossil fuel burning. We can expect to see a further increase in concentrations in 2026 because of fossil fuel burning and the development of a powerful El Niño which will impact land carbon sinks as it did in 2023-2024.”
paras.zh: 她指出，虽然 2024 年至 2025 年期间每年增加 2.8 ppm 的增幅较为温和，但这仍然是“化石燃料燃烧导致大气中碳的大量增加。由于化石燃料燃烧和强大的厄尔尼诺现象的发展，我们预计 2026 年浓度将进一步增加，这将像 2023 年至 2024 年那样影响土地碳汇。”

paras.en: The agency’s Bulletin reports on the amount of gas that accumulates in the atmosphere and not new annual emissions. About half of the total CO2 emitted each year remains in the atmosphere and the rest is absorbed by Earth’s land ecosystems and oceans.
paras.zh: 该机构的公报报告的是大气中积聚的气体量，而不是新的年度排放量。每年排放的二氧化碳总量中约有一半残留在大气中，其余的则被地球的陆地生态系统和海洋吸收。

paras.en: The U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Annual Greenhouse Gas Index shows that from 1990 to 2025, the warming effect on our climate caused by greenhouse gases increased by 56 per cent, with CO2 accounting for about 81 per cent of this increase, known as “radiative forcing”.
paras.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）年度温室气体指数显示，从1990年到2025年，温室气体对我们气候造成的变暖效应增加了56%，其中二氧化碳约占这一增量的81%，被称为“辐射强迫”。

paras.en: WMO noted that as countries transform their energy systems towards decarbonization, careful attention should be given to two potent but less abundant trace gases closely related to electricity production and distribution: molecular hydrogen (H2) and sulphur hexafluoride (SF6).
paras.zh: WMO指出，随着各国将其能源系统转向脱碳，应特别关注与电力生产和分配密切相关的两种有效但含量较低的微量气体：分子氢（H2）和六氟化硫（SF6）。

paras.en: Widely used as a spark suppressant in electricity distribution, SF6 use has risen steadily in the past three decades in line with increased global electrification. “It has an atmospheric lifetime of over 1,000 years and has the highest 100-year global warming potential of approximately 24,300 times that of CO2. The increase of SF6 in 2025 was a record high,” the agency’s report notes.
paras.zh: SF6 广泛用作配电中的火花抑制剂，随着全球电气化程度的提高，SF6 的使用量在过去三十年中稳步增长。该机构的报告指出：“它在大气中的寿命超过 1,000 年，最高 100 年全球变暖潜力约为二氧化碳的 24,300 倍。2025 年 SF6 的增加量创历史新高。”

paras.en: Hydrogen concentration has increased by 5.3 per cent between 2010 and 2024. Hydrogen is being used as an energy storage medium for hard-to-decarbonize sectors such as steelmaking, shipping, and long-duration energy storage, as well as for renewable sources and as an energy source for transport.
paras.zh: 2010年至2024年间，氢浓度增加了5.3%。氢气被用作难以脱碳的部门的储能介质，如炼钢、航运和长期储能，以及可再生能源和运输能源。

paras.en: “Its leakage into the atmosphere from production facilities, pipelines, storage tanks, and fuel cells poses a growing concern,” WMO said, highlighting that although hydrogen is not a greenhouse gas, “it influences atmospheric chemistry” and has a strong indirect effect on warming, the agency explained.
paras.zh: 世界气象组织表示： “氢气从生产设施、管道、储罐和燃料电池泄漏到大气中，引起了越来越多的担忧。”该机构解释说，尽管氢气不是温室气体，但“它会影响大气化学” ，并对变暖产生强烈的间接影响。

paras.en: “Both H2 leakage and SF6 persistence represent potential threats that could undermine the climate benefits of the energy transition,” WMO said. “Careful monitoring of the composition of Earth’s atmosphere is essential to detect, understand and prevent unintended consequences of these changes.”.
paras.zh: WMO 表示：“氢气泄漏和 SF6 持久性都是潜在威胁，可能会损害能源转型带来的气候效益。” “仔细监测地球大气的成分对于检测、理解和防止这些变化的意外后果至关重要。”

paras.en: WMO releases the Bulletin to provide authoritative scientific data for negotiators attending the annual UN Climate conference. The aim of the Conference of the Parties meeting (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9 to 20 November is to turn climate commitments into concrete action.
paras.zh: WMO发布该公报，为参加联合国气候大会年度会议的谈判者提供权威的科学数据。 11 月 9 日至 20 日在土耳其安塔利亚举行的缔约方大会 (COP31) 的目标是将气候承诺转化为具体行动。

articles.title: 'Why Mahomes is one of greatest athletes of his generation'

paras.en: Patrick Mahomes: 'Extra special' Kansas City Chiefs quarterback has proven he is one of the greatest athletes of his generation
paras.zh: 帕特里克·马霍姆斯：“特别”的堪萨斯城酋长队四分卫已经证明他是这一代人中最伟大的运动员之一

paras.en: Sky Sports NFL's Neil Reynolds and Jeff Reinebold analyse the 'generational' mentality of Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes on the latest episode of Inside the Huddle; watch Mahomes' Chiefs face the Denver Broncos live on Sky Sports NFL from 9.25pm this Sunday
paras.zh: 天空体育 NFL 的尼尔·雷诺兹和杰夫·雷内博尔德在最新一集的 Inside the Huddle 中分析了堪萨斯城酋长队四分卫帕特里克·马霍姆斯的“世代”心态；本周日晚上 9 点 25 分，您可以在天空体育 NFL 观看马霍姆斯酋长队对阵丹佛野马队的直播

paras.en: Even in defeat Patrick Mahomes seemingly finds new ways to underline what makes him one of the greatest players the NFL has seen.
paras.zh: 即使在失败中，帕特里克·马霍姆斯似乎也找到了新的方法来强调他是 NFL 有史以来最伟大的球员之一的原因。

paras.en: The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback endured a frustrating night on Sunday as his side saw their perfect start to the season come to an end in a 20-3 loss to the Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks.
paras.zh: 这位堪萨斯城酋长队四分卫在周日经历了一个令人沮丧的夜晚，他的球队本赛季的完美开局最终以 20-3 输给了超级碗冠军西雅图海鹰队。

paras.en: Speaking on Inside the Huddle, Sky Sports NFL's Neil Reynolds and Jeff Reinebold hailed further evidence of the 'generational' competitiveness and mentality that has amounted to three Super Bowl victories, five Super Bowl appearances and seven straight AFC Championship Game outings from 2018-2024.
paras.zh: 天空体育 NFL 的尼尔·雷诺兹 (Neil Reynolds) 和杰夫·雷内博尔德 (Jeff Reinebold) 在 Inside the Huddle 节目中发表讲话，赞扬了“世代”竞争力和心态的进一步证据，这种竞争力和心态在 2018 年至 2024 年期间赢得了 3 次超级碗胜利、5 次参加超级碗比赛以及连续 7 次参加亚足联冠军赛。

paras.en: Among the game's flashpoints was a third-quarter fumble by Mahomes himself, prompting a chaotic sequence in which he put his body on the line while chasing down the loose ball.
paras.zh: 这场比赛的爆发点之一是马霍姆斯在第三节的一次失误，导致了一场混乱的场面，他在追球时将身体置于线上。

paras.en: - Rodgers lifts Steelers past Saints in historic Paris game

paras.en: "I know he lost, but Patrick Mahomes is an incredible competitor," said Sky Sports NFL presenter Reynolds on Inside the Huddle. "I want to go back to Super Bowl 50, it was a fumble, Cam Newton stood there and didn't dive on the pile, watched the ball, just watched it, left it. It was a Super Bowl. We were very critical of him in that moment.
paras.zh: “我知道他输了，但帕特里克·马霍姆斯是一位令人难以置信的竞争者，”天空体育 NFL 主持人雷诺兹在 Inside the Huddle 节目中说道。 “我想回到第50届超级碗，那是一次掉球，卡姆·牛顿站在那里，没有跳到球堆上，看着球，只是看着它，然后离开了。那是一场超级碗。那一刻我们对他非常批评。

paras.en: "There's a part in the game. It's 13-0 to Seattle. Mahomes gets absolutely slammed in the back by Derick Hall, fumbles the ball, ball's on the ground rolling towards the sideline. Mahomes chases it, gets tripped over by another defender, falls flat on his face, gets back up, dives, by which time, it's a melee then, there's offensive linemen, defensive linemen, he dives in there again, disappears under the bottom of the pile and comes out with the football.
paras.zh: “比赛有一部分。西雅图队以13-0领先。马霍姆斯被德里克·霍尔从后面猛击，掉球，球在地上滚向边线。马霍姆斯追球，被另一名后卫绊倒，脸朝下摔倒，站起来，俯冲，到了这个时候，这是一场混战，有进攻线卫，防守线卫，他再次冲进去，消失在下面和足球一起出来。

paras.en: "They kick a field goal, he gets the ball back, they're rolling a little bit, it gave them energy for a period. I just haven't seen that before, a quarterback so hungry, maybe at his own expense, to get after a football.
paras.zh: “他们踢了一个射门，他把球接回来，他们滚动了一点，这给了他们一段时间的能量。我以前从未见过这样的情况，一个四分卫如此渴望，也许是自费，去追赶足球。”

paras.en: Mahomes and the Chiefs, thanks to a lot of help from marquee addition Kenneth Walker III, have rediscovered their spark on offense this year after Kansas City missed out on the playoffs for the first time since 2014 last season.
paras.zh: 在堪萨斯城上赛季自 2014 年以来首次错过季后赛后，马霍姆斯和酋长队在新援肯尼思·沃克三世的大力帮助下，今年重新发现了进攻的火花。

paras.en: It had been something of a team reborn ahead of their defeat in Seattle, Mahomes teasing shades of his best once more after undergoing knee surgery last year.
paras.zh: 这就像一支球队在西雅图失利之前重获新生，马霍姆斯在去年接受膝盖手术后再次展现了自己的最佳状态。

paras.en: "I've seen him practice as well at Chiefs training camp three, four times, and on a couple of those occasions there aren't even fans watching," Reynolds continued. "Bad weather forced the Chiefs inside, in their indoor facility. So it's just a handful of media there. He competes all the time. I mean, all the time. It's not like he's getting up for the fans when they're out on the practice field in training camp, indoor facility, no one watching.
paras.zh: “我在酋长训练营见过他训练三四次，有几次甚至没有球迷观看，”雷诺兹继续说道。 “恶劣的天气迫使酋长队进入他们的室内设施。所以那里只有少数媒体。他一直在比赛。我的意思是，一直。当球迷在训练营、室内设施的训练场上、没有人观看时，他不会为球迷起立。

paras.en: "Ask him for a race or game of cards in the locker room, bet he's the same way. There's just some people that are just wired different. That's how they get to where they are."
paras.zh: “请他在更衣室里进行比赛或打牌，我打赌他也是这样。只是有些人的性格不同。这就是他们到达现在位置的方式。”

paras.en: Reinebold likened Mahomes' mindset to that of NBA icons Kobe Bryant and Michael Jordan, insisting his will to win and competitive drive have been just as important as his arm talent and intelligence in fuelling his rise to greatness.
paras.zh: 雷内博尔德将马霍姆斯的心态比作 NBA 偶像科比·布莱恩特和迈克尔·乔丹，并坚称他的求胜欲望和竞争动力与他的手臂天赋和智慧一样重要，推动了他的崛起。

paras.en: "There are a lot of reasons why Pat Mahomes is one of the top quarterbacks that we've seen in our generation," said Reinebold. I think I can say that fairly. He's got all the physical tools, but it's the intangible things, right? His football intelligence, and his competitive heart. That was on display in that game. That's how you get your team to rally, when they see you as the quarterback putting yourself at risk for the team, that speaks volumes to that football team.
paras.zh: “帕特·马霍姆斯成为我们这一代顶级四分卫之一的原因有很多，”雷内博尔德说。我想我可以公平地说。他拥有所有有形的工具，但这是无形的东西，对吗？他的足球智慧和他的竞争之心。这在那场比赛中得到了体现。这就是你如何让你的球队团结起来，当他们看到你作为四分卫将自己置于球队的危险之中时，这对球队来说意义重大。

paras.en: "How can you as an offensive lineman or a receiver or another position player not give it up when you see the best quarterback in our generation putting himself at risk for the football? I love the fact that he competes as hard as he does. He doesn't have to prove anything to anybody because we've watched him play hurt over his career."
paras.zh: “当你看到我们这一代最好的四分卫将自己置于足球的危险之中时，作为一名进攻线卫、接球手或其他位置球员，你怎么能不放弃呢？我喜欢他像他一样努力竞争的事实。他不需要向任何人证明任何东西，因为我们在他的职业生涯中看到他带着伤病打球。”

paras.en: Mahomes, whose Chiefs play the Denver Broncos live on Sky Sports this weekend, is one of just five quarterbacks in history to win three or more Super Bowls as a starter, is a two-time MVP, a three-time Super Bowl MVP and holds NFL records in total single-season yards by a quarterback (5,608) and career passing yards per game (285.2).
paras.zh: 马霍姆斯所在的酋长队本周末将在天空体育直播对阵丹佛野马队，他是历史上仅有的五位以先发身份赢得三次或以上超级碗的四分卫之一，他是两届 MVP、三届超级碗 MVP，并保持着 NFL 单赛季四分卫总码数（5,608 码）和职业生涯场均传球码数（285.2 码）的纪录。

paras.en: "The playoff game where he could barely walk and he went out and finished the game and won the game for his football team. This guy is an extra special talent," Reinebold continued.
paras.zh: “在季后赛中，他几乎无法行走，但他出去完成了比赛，并为他的橄榄球队赢得了比赛。这个人是一个特别的天才，”雷内博尔德继续说道。

paras.en: "That's probably a common thread among all of the great athletes of of the day. You talk about Mamba Mentality with Kobe Bryant. He wrote books about how competitive he was and how intense his workouts were, I'm sure [Cristiano] Ronaldo and all the great ones have that same thread running through them that they're intensely competitive about everything.
paras.zh: “这可能是当今所有伟大运动员的共同点。你和科比·布莱恩特谈论曼巴精神。他写了很多书，讲述他的竞争力和训练强度，我相信克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多和所有伟大的运动员都有同样的主线，他们对一切都充满了强烈的竞争性。

paras.en: "Michael Jordan was famous that he wanted to compete at everything, when they would go on on trips the luggage would come on the carousel, he'd bet his luggage came off first. That's how competitive those guys are."
paras.zh: “迈克尔·乔丹是出了名的，他想在所有事情上竞争，当他们继续旅行时，行李会被放在传送带上，他打赌他的行李会先下来。这就是那些家伙的竞争力。”

paras.en: DP World Tour: Which players are missing from the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship and who can still win the Race to Dubai?
paras.zh: DP 世界巡回赛：阿布扎比阿尔达尔锦标赛缺席了哪些选手，谁仍能赢得迪拜之战？

paras.en: Who is playing in the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship? A look at who is missing from the field for the first of two DP World Tour Play-Offs and which players remain in the running to top the season-long Race to Dubai standings; watch the conclusion to the season live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 谁参加阿布扎比阿尔达尔锦标赛？看看谁缺席了两场 DP 世界巡回赛附加赛中的第一场比赛，以及哪些球员仍在争夺整个赛季迪拜赛积分榜上的榜首；观看天空体育直播赛季结束

paras.en: Ryder Cup players Matt Fitzpatrick, Shane Lowry, Robert MacIntyre and Justin Rose are among the notable names who have elected against featuring in next week’s Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship.
paras.zh: 莱德杯球员马特·菲茨帕特里克、肖恩·洛瑞、罗伯特·麦金泰尔和贾斯汀·罗斯都是选择不参加下周阿布扎比阿尔达尔锦标赛的知名人士。

paras.en: Only the top 70 available players in the season-long Race to Dubai standings will feature at Yas Links, the first of two events in the Middle East for the DP World Tour Play-Offs.
paras.zh: 只有整个赛季迪拜赛积分榜上排名前 70 的选手才能参加亚斯林克斯赛，这是 DP 世界巡回赛附加赛在中东举办的两场赛事中的第一场。

paras.en: The entry list was released on Monday after the conclusion of the regular season ahead of the tournament taking place from November 5-8, live on Sky Sports, with 10 eligible players not named in the field.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日至 8 日举行的比赛之前，常规赛结束后，天空体育于周一公布了参赛名单，其中有 10 名符合条件的球员未在名单上。

paras.en: Several of those not involved have previously expressly safety concerns about playing the season-ending events in the Middle East, with Houthi strikes in Saudi Arabia heightening fears of a wider regional conflict.
paras.zh: 一些没有参与其中的人此前曾明确表示过对在中东参加赛季末赛事的安全担忧，沙特阿拉伯胡塞武装的袭击加剧了人们对更广泛地区冲突的担忧。

paras.en: Fitzpatrick sits 10th in the Race to Dubai standings and is set to defend his DP World Tour Championship the following week, having defeated Rory McIlroy in a play-off last year to claim the trophy for a third time.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克在迪拜之行积分榜上排名第十，他去年在延长赛中击败罗里·麦克罗伊，第三次夺得该奖杯，并准备在下周卫冕 DP 世界巡回赛冠军。

paras.en: Speaking about the possibility of playing in the Middle East, Fitzpatrick said at last month's BMW PGA Championship: "No, I wouldn't be that comfortable.
paras.zh: 谈到在中东打球的可能性，菲茨帕特里克在上个月的宝马 PGA 锦标赛上说道：“不，我不会那么舒服。

paras.en: "If the [DP World] Tour does go, I'm sure they have had the best advice possible on what that looks like. As things stand right now, I wouldn't necessarily be too keen on going."
paras.zh: “如果 [DP World] 巡回赛确实举行，我相信他们已经就巡回赛的情况提供了最好的建议。就目前情况而言，我不一定太热衷于参加。”

paras.en: Open champion Ryan Fox is the highest-ranked player in the Race to Dubai standings not playing in Abu Dhabi, although the New Zealander is currently still scheduled to feature at the DP World Tour Championship in Dubai.
paras.zh: 公开赛冠军瑞恩·福克斯（Ryan Fox）是迪拜赛积分榜上排名最高但不在阿布扎比参赛的选手，尽管新西兰人目前仍计划参加在迪拜举行的 DP 世界巡回锦标赛。

paras.en: "I'm obviously of the opinion that the Tour is doing their due diligence," Fox said last month. "If they feel like it's safe for us to go, I'm willing to support that. But I can understand, also, why guys have some reservations."
paras.zh: “我显然认为巡回赛正在尽职调查，”福克斯上个月表示。 “如果他们觉得我们去是安全的，我愿意支持。但我也能理解为什么人们有一些保留。”

paras.en: Lowry (16th), Alex Fitzpatrick (24th), Min Woo Lee (38th), Ludvig Åberg (45th), MacIntyre (56th), Si Woo Kim (62nd), Rose (69th) and Ryan Gerard (70th) are the other eligible players not listed in the field.
paras.zh: 洛瑞（第16位）、亚历克斯·菲茨帕特里克（第24位）、李珉宇（第38位）、路德维格·奥伯格（第45位）、麦金泰尔（第56位）、金时宇（第62位）、罗斯（第69位）和瑞恩·杰拉德（第70位）是其他未列入名单的符合资格的球员。

paras.en: The UK's Foreign Office doesn't currently have any restrictions to travel to the region, although updated guidelines on the government website warns those travelling "should be prepared for possible flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions".
paras.zh: 英国外交部目前对前往该地区的旅行没有任何限制，但政府网站上的最新指南警告称，旅行人士“应该为可能的航班取消、空域关闭和旅行中断做好准备”。

paras.en: The US government updated their travel advisories on Friday to "reflect the threat of increased Iranian-supported Houthi regional aggression". Their guidelines say travellers should "reconsider travel to the United Arab Emirates due to terrorism and armed conflict".
paras.zh: 美国政府周五更新了旅行警告，以“反映伊朗支持的胡塞武装地区侵略活动加剧的威胁”。他们的指南称，旅行者应该“由于恐怖主义和武装冲突而重新考虑前往阿拉伯联合酋长国的旅行”。

paras.en: No player has to publicly specify whether their reason not to play is related to safety concerns or their own schedule, while only the top 50 available golfers after Abu Dhabi then progress to the DP World Tour Championship at Jumeirah Golf Estates a week later.
paras.zh: 没有球员必须公开说明他们不参加比赛的原因是否与安全问题或自己的日程安排有关，而只有阿布扎比比赛后排名前 50 的高尔夫球手才能晋级一周后在朱美拉高尔夫庄园举行的 DP 世界巡回锦标赛。

paras.en: Race to Dubai battle heats up in Abu Dhabi
paras.zh: 阿布扎比的迪拜争夺战愈演愈烈

paras.en: The top five players in the Race to Dubai standings are all currently scheduled to feature in Abu Dhabi, where the result is likely to play a key role in determining who ends the season and No 1 and lifts the Harry Vardon Trophy.
paras.zh: 迪拜之行积分榜前五名的选手目前都计划在阿布扎比亮相，比赛结果可能会在决定谁结束赛季、夺得第一并捧起哈里·瓦尔登奖杯方面发挥关键作用。

paras.en: Eugenio Chacarra tops the standings by 669.27 points after winning the DP World India Championship, a third victory of the season, with Patrick Reed and McIlroy his two closest challengers.
paras.zh: 尤金尼奥·查卡拉 (Eugenio Chacarra) 在赢得 DP 世界印度锦标赛后以 669.27 分位居积分榜榜首，这是本赛季的第三场胜利，帕特里克·里德 (Patrick Reed) 和麦克罗伊 (McIlroy) 是他最接近的两个挑战者。

paras.en: Two-time DP World Tour winner Casey Jarvis and defending Abu Dhabi champion Aaron Rai complete the top five, where there's a $9m (£6.76m) prize purse and the winner picks up $1.53m (£1.15m).

paras.en: Mitchell Starc claimed his 20th five-wicket haul as South Africa collapsed from 203-1 to 329 all out on day one of the decisive third and final Test against Australia at Newlands.

paras.en: Markram and Ackerman had put on 140 by lunch, with Australia looking clueless after having made four changes to the side - including dropping opener Nic Maddinson and having veteran Steve Smith ruled out through injury
paras.zh: 马克拉姆和阿克曼在午餐时已经打出了 140 分，而澳大利亚队在对球队进行了四次调整之后看起来毫无头绪——包括放弃揭幕战尼克·马丁森和老将史蒂夫·史密斯因伤缺阵

paras.en: Ackerman was stumped for 95 off Nathan Lyon after charging the off-spinner, having hit 12 fours and two sixes before falling short in his bid for his maiden Test century.
paras.zh: 阿克曼在对内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）发起冲锋后，打出 95 分，打出 12 个四分球和两个六分球，但在他的第一个测试世纪中未能实现。

paras.en: Markram - dropped off Starc in the morning session - added 45 with Bedingham as South Africa moved to 203-1, then Starc pulled off a stunning catch at square leg to dismiss Markram off Josh Hazlewood.
paras.zh: 马克拉姆（Markram）在早上的比赛中击败了斯塔克（Starc），与贝丁厄姆（Bedingham）一起得分45分，南非队将比分追至203-1，然后斯塔克（Starc）在方腿上完成了一次惊人的接球，将马克拉姆（Markram）从乔什·黑兹尔伍德（Josh Hazlewood）手中击倒。

paras.en: Lyon bowled skipper Temba Bavuma for a three-ball duck and left-arm spinner Cooper Connolly picked up his maiden Test wicket, as he trapped Matthew Breetzke lbw for two.
paras.zh: 里昂向船长坦巴·巴武马投出三球鸭子，左臂旋转球员库珀·康诺利拿起了他的第一个测试三柱门，因为他困住了马修·布里茨克（Matthew Breetzke），获得了两个球。

paras.en: Starc removed Bedingham after tea and had Wiaan Mulder caught behind two balls later for a duck, with South Africa losing five wickets for just 29 runs before Marco Jansen (52) and Ryan Rickelton stemmed the tide.
paras.zh: 茶后斯塔克将贝丁汉姆撤下，并让威安·穆德在两个球后面被抓到鸭子，南非队仅以 29 分就丢掉了 5 个三柱门，然后马可·詹森（52 分）和瑞安·里克尔顿阻止了这股潮流。

paras.en: Jansen scored a second successive half-century and Rickelton made 42 as the pair added 95 for the seventh wicket, only for Starc to strike again with the second new ball to rip through the tail.
paras.zh: 詹森连续第二个半个世纪得分，里克尔顿得分 42 分，两人在第七个三柱门上得分 95 分，但斯塔克再次击中第二个新球，撕开了尾部。

paras.en: Starc had Rickelton lbw in the 81st over and two balls later bowled Jansen, then made it four wickets in six balls when he bowled Gerald Coetzee for a golden duck and removed Kagiso Rabada for another nought.
paras.zh: Starc在第81回合中拥有Rickelton lbw，随后将两个球投给了Jansen，然后在六个球中打进了四个三柱门，当时他向Gerald Coetzee投出了金鸭，并移除了Kagiso Rabada，再次获得了零分。

paras.en: South Africa plunged from 327-6 to 329 all out to hand momentum back to Australia, who won the first Test in Durban by 214 runs before being thrashed in the second by an innings and 31 runs in Gqeberha.
paras.zh: 南非队全力以赴，从 327 比 6 跌至 329 分，将势头交还给澳大利亚，澳大利亚队在德班以 214 分赢得了第一场测试赛，但在第二场比赛中在格克贝哈 (Gqeberha) 被一局和 31 分击败。

articles.title: Mao, memes and Mbappé: Chinese brands drop soccer star in fury over ‘dictator’ joke
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: HONG KONG — He’s one of the world’s most popular athletes, but Kylian Mbappé is suddenly paying the penalty for being on the wrong side of China’s fervent nationalism.
paras.zh: 香港——凯利安·姆巴佩是世界上最受欢迎的运动员之一，但他突然因为站在中国狂热民族主义的错误一边而付出了代价。

paras.en: The French soccer star’s own goal? Suggesting that Mao Zedong, the founding leader of communist China, was a dictator, in comments that revolved around memes portraying Mbappé as an authoritarian figure.
paras.zh: 法国足球明星的乌龙球？在围绕将姆巴佩描绘成独裁者的表情包的评论中，暗示共产主义中国的开国领袖毛泽东是独裁者。

paras.en: A host of Chinese brands said Tuesday that they were cutting ties with the French captain, the latest example of how rapidly celebrities can go from having their faces plastered in subway stations and on drink bottles to drawing condemnation over political sensitivities that are little understood outside China.
paras.zh: 许多中国品牌周二表示，他们将切断与法国队长的关系，这是最新的一个例子，说明名人的脸从被贴在地铁站和饮料瓶上到因政治敏感问题而受到谴责，而中国以外的国家对此知之甚少。

paras.en: The scale of the backlash prompted La Liga, the Spanish league of which Mbappé is the leading light, to apologize and distance itself from his remarks. Mbappé himself then apologized “to everyone my words have upset,” saying that his “comment was ill-judged.”
paras.zh: 强烈反对的规模促使以姆巴佩为领军人物的西甲联赛道歉并与他的言论保持距离。姆巴佩本人随后向“我的话让大家感到不安”道歉，并表示他的“评论是错误的”。

paras.en: The swift apologies aimed to head off what had been a wave of outrage.
paras.zh: 迅速道歉旨在平息一波愤怒浪潮。

paras.en: Dongpeng Beverage, known for its energy drinks, Inner Mongolia Mengniu Dairy, one of China’s largest dairy producers, and cheesemaker Milkground all issued similarly worded statements early Tuesday announcing that they were terminating their ties with Mbappé.
paras.zh: 以能量饮料闻名的东鹏饮料、中国最大的乳制品生产商之一的内蒙古蒙牛乳业和奶酪制造商Milkground都在周二早些时候发表了措辞类似的声明，宣布终止与姆巴佩的合作关系。

paras.en: The Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu also distanced itself from Mbappé, saying its contract with him had ended after he appeared in a 2024 ad for the platform that went viral. On Tuesday, a note on Mbappé’s Xiaohongshu account, which had more than a million followers, said it had been suspended “for violating community guidelines.”
paras.zh: 中国社交媒体平台小红书也与姆巴佩保持了距离，称在姆巴佩出现在该平台2024年的一则病毒式广告后，小红书与他的合同就终止了。周二，姆巴佩拥有超过 100 万粉丝的小红书账户上的一条说明称，该账户“因违反社区准则”而被暂停。

paras.en: The companies did not specify Mbappé’s missteps, but the statements came after a clip circulated widely on social media Monday showing an interview last spring with the French online talk show “The Bridge.”
paras.zh: 两家公司没有具体说明姆巴佩的失误，但周一在社交媒体上广泛流传的一段剪辑显示了去年春天法国在线脱口秀节目“The Bridge”的采访后，发表了上述声明。

paras.en: Mbappé is often depicted jokingly online as a dictator because of his outsize presence on and off the field. Fans have created memes comparing him to a number of authoritarian historical figures, including Mao.
paras.zh: 由于姆巴佩在场内外的巨大影响力，他经常在网上被戏称为独裁者。粉丝们创作了一些表情包，将他与包括毛泽东在内的许多独裁历史人物进行比较。

paras.en: In the clip, Mbappé was asked which meme was his favorite.
paras.zh: 在视频中，姆巴佩被问到他最喜欢哪个表情包。

paras.en: “A video someone made of a guy… I think he was a Chinese dictator,” he said. The clip then shows Mbappé’s face superimposed on an image of Mao, whom Mbappé did not mention by name.
paras.zh: “有人制作了一个关于一个人的视频……我认为他是一个中国独裁者，”他说。视频中，姆巴佩的脸叠加在毛泽东的图像上，但姆巴佩没有提及毛泽东的名字。

paras.en: His comments drew fury in China, where he was accused of insulting a country that has been a lucrative source of income for him.
paras.zh: 他的言论在中国引起了愤怒，他被指控侮辱了一个对他来说是有利可图的收入来源的国家。

paras.en: “Words and actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people will naturally be met with a collective boycott by all sectors of Chinese society,” Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Tuesday at a regular briefing in Beijing.
paras.zh: 外交部发言人郭家琨周二在北京举行的例行记者会上表示：“伤害中国人民感情的言行，自然会遭到中国社会各界的集体抵制。”

paras.en: Foreign athletes have run afoul of Chinese sensitivities in the past, sometimes with profound economic consequences for major sports leagues. NBA games were largely suspended from Chinese broadcast for years in 2019 after a Houston Rockets manager expressed support for anti-government protests in the Chinese territory of Hong Kong, and in 2023 former NBA star Dwight Howard drew controversy when he referred to the Beijing-claimed island of Taiwan as a country.
paras.zh: 外国运动员过去曾与中国的敏感问题发生冲突，有时会给主要体育联盟带来深远的经济后果。 2019 年，休斯敦火箭队 (Houston Rockets) 的一名主教练表示支持中国香港的反政府抗议活动后，NBA 比赛在中国的转播中基本上暂停了数年。2023 年，前 NBA 球星德怀特·霍华德 (Dwight Howard) 将北京声称拥有主权的台湾岛称为一个国家，引发了争议。

paras.en: “Mbappé is not an isolated case. He has now paid the price, and deservedly so,” the commentary said. “His experience should serve as a clear red line for all foreign public figures seeking to enter the Chinese market.”
paras.zh: “姆巴佩并不是一个孤立的案例。他现在已经付出了代价，而且是应得的，”评论说。 “他的经历应该成为所有寻求进入中国市场的外国公众人物的明确红线。”

paras.en: After reports that broadcasts of the Spanish league, where Mbappé plays for Real Madrid, had been suspended in China, the league distanced itself from the remarks.
paras.zh: 有报道称姆巴佩效力皇家马德里的西班牙联赛在中国的转播已被暂停，该联盟与上述言论保持了距离。

paras.en: “We deeply regret” the comments “that have caused discomfort and offense in China,” La Liga President Javier Tebas said in a post on social media. “We cannot allow an individual’s action to tarnish” La Liga and its clubs’ relationship with China, Tebas said, adding that it was working with its partners in China to “overcome the situation.”
paras.zh: 西甲主席哈维尔·特巴斯在社交媒体上发帖称，“我们对这些在中国引起不适和冒犯的言论深感遗憾”。特巴斯表示，“我们不能允许个人行为玷污”西甲联赛及其俱乐部与中国的关系，并补充说，西甲正在与中国的合作伙伴合作“克服这种情况”。

paras.en: In his own apology, also posted to social media, Mbappé said that “during a recent interview, I reacted to an image of myself. My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world.”
paras.zh: 姆巴佩在自己也在社交媒体上发布的道歉中表示，“在最近的一次采访中，我对自己的照片做出了反应。我的评论是错误的，我现在明白这伤害了中国和世界各地华人社区的许多人。”

paras.en: He added: “I apologize to everyone my words have upset. This was absolutely not my intention. I have deep respect for the Chinese people and their history, and I am sincerely sorry.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我向所有因我的言论而感到不安的人道歉。这绝对不是我的本意。我对中国人民及其历史怀有深深的敬意，我真诚地感到抱歉。”

paras.en: Mbappé came a close second Monday for soccer’s prestigious Ballon d’Or award.
paras.zh: 姆巴佩在第二个星期一以微弱优势获得了著名的足球界金球奖。

paras.en: He has criticized the dictator memes in the past, telling the French sports newspaper L’Équipe last month that while he knew they were meant to be humorous, they also showed “a lack of political and human awareness.”
paras.zh: 他过去曾批评过独裁者模因，上个月告诉法国体育报纸《队报》，虽然他知道这些模因是幽默的，但它们也表现出“缺乏政治和人类意识”。

paras.en: Mao has a deeply mixed legacy in China, which he led for more than a quarter-century until his death in 1976.
paras.zh: 毛泽东在中国领导了超过四分之一个世纪的政治遗产，直至 1976 年去世。

paras.en: In 1949, Mao’s communist forces won China’s drawn-out civil war, unifying the country after a century of foreign invasion and domestic turmoil. In the decades that followed, Mao oversaw sweeping reforms that included the “Great Leap Forward” — a radical industrialization campaign that contributed to famines that are believed to have killed tens of millions of people — as well as the “Cultural Revolution,” a violent anti-capitalist movement that stirred political and social chaos for the last decade of his rule.
paras.zh: 1949年，毛泽东的共产党军队赢得了中国旷日持久的内战，在经历了一个世纪的外国入侵和国内动乱后统一了国家。在接下来的几十年里，毛泽东领导了全面的改革，其中包括“大跃进”——一场激进的工业化运动，导致了据信造成数千万人死亡的饥荒——以及“文化大革命”——一场暴力的反资本主义运动，在他统治的最后十年里引发了政治和社会混乱。

paras.en: China’s ruling Communist Party has acknowledged Mao’s role in those events but maintains that his achievements outweigh his mistakes. His stature within the party remains high, and his portrait appears on the 100-yuan bill, the largest denomination of Chinese currency.
paras.zh: 中国执政的共产党承认毛泽东在这些事件中的作用，但坚称他的成就大于错误。他在党内的地位仍然很高，他的肖像出现在中国最大面额的百元纸币上。

paras.en: Mao also continues to be a source of inspiration for some young people frustrated by China’s slowing economy and fiercely competitive society, and Mbappé’s comments drew online criticism.
paras.zh: 毛泽东还继续成为一些因中国经济放缓和社会竞争激烈而感到沮丧的年轻人的灵感源泉，姆巴佩的言论招致了网上的批评。

paras.en: Many didn’t know what exactly Mbappé had said, however, given China’s strict censorship controls.“I don’t care what exactly he said. If it was insulting to China, then it hurt my feelings. I support boycotting him,” read one comment on Weibo.
paras.zh: 然而，考虑到中国严格的审查制度，许多人不知道姆巴佩到底说了什么。“我不在乎他到底说了什么。如果这是侮辱中国，那就伤害了我的感情。我支持抵制他，”微博上的一条评论写道。

paras.en: Mark Dreyer, author of a book on China’s sports industry, said the episode was the latest involving China in which a story fuels outrage that forces brands to take action to protect commercial interests no matter the context or truth.
paras.zh: 一本有关中国体育产业的书的作者马克·德雷尔表示，这是最新一起涉及中国的事件，其中一个故事激起了愤怒，迫使品牌采取行动保护商业利益，无论背景或真相如何。

paras.en: “The ultimate result is that sports stars and global celebrities will become increasingly cautious about engaging with China,” Dreyer said. “It’s hard to see how this outcome benefits China or its sports fans in the long run.”
paras.zh: 德雷尔说：“最终的结果是体育明星和全球名人在与中国交往时将变得越来越谨慎。” “从长远来看，很难看出这一结果对中国或其体育迷有何好处。”

articles.title: Crossbench push to give Australians a free way to fight back against big tech
articles.author: Clare Armstrong

paras.en: The crossbench is pushing for a free, independent ombudsman to help Australians resolve disputes with tech giants.
paras.zh: 中立议员正在推动设立一名自由、独立的监察员，以帮助澳大利亚人解决与科技巨头的纠纷。

paras.en: Labor argues its proposed digital safety laws already provide stronger complaints protections, but needs Greens support to pass them through the Senate.
paras.zh: 工党辩称，其拟议的数字安全法已经提供了更强有力的投诉保护，但需要绿党的支持才能在参议院获得通过。

paras.en: Independent MP Sophie Scamps will move her amendment today when the bill is expected to pass the lower house.
paras.zh: 独立议员索菲·斯坎普斯将于今天提出修正案，预计该法案将在下议院获得通过。

paras.en: Australians would have a free and simple way to raise complaints against tech giants under a crossbench amendment to Labor’s proposed digital safety laws.
paras.zh: 根据工党拟议的数字安全法的中立修正案，澳大利亚人将有一种自由而简单的方式对科技巨头提出投诉。

paras.en: Independents and the Greens are in favour of establishing a new industry-funded online ombudsman to resolve disputes, but the federal government has argued its draft digital duty of care bill already puts the onus on big tech to provide Australians with effective complaint pathways.
paras.zh: 独立人士和绿党赞成建立一个由行业资助的新在线监察员来解决纠纷，但联邦政府辩称，其数字谨慎责任法案草案已经让大型科技公司有责任为澳大利亚人提供有效的投诉途径。

paras.en: Mackellar MP Sophie Scamps will today put forward an amendment that would create an external avenue for appeal in cases like a small business owner being locked out of their social media account or individuals wanting harmful content addressed.
paras.zh: Mackellar 议员 Sophie Scamps 今天将提出一项修正案，该修正案将为小企业主被锁定在其社交媒体帐户之外或希望解决有害内容的个人等情况创建外部上诉途径。

paras.en: Labor has the numbers in parliament to pass the bill in the lower house without entertaining any changes but needs the support of the Greens, who are also in favour of an online ombudsman, to get the duty of care through the Senate next month.
paras.zh: 工党在议会中拥有足够的席位，可以在下议院通过该法案，而无需进行任何修改，但需要绿党的支持，绿党也支持在线监察员，才能在下个月参议院通过注意义务。

paras.en: The Coalition party room yesterday resolved to oppose the legislation after likening the digital duty of care to political censorship.
paras.zh: 在将数字谨慎义务比作政治审查制度后，联合党党室昨天决定反对这项立法。

paras.en: Labor's proposed duty would require online platforms like Facebook, TikTok and Instagram to take reasonable steps to prevent a range of harms for children, including bullying, misogyny and content promoting eating disorders.
paras.zh: 工党提议的职责将要求 Facebook、TikTok 和 Instagram 等在线平台采取合理措施，防止对儿童的一系列伤害，包括欺凌、厌女症和宣扬饮食失调的内容。

paras.en: Big tech would also have to limit adults' exposure to "serious" harms like threats of violence, stalking and the non-consensual sharing of intimate images.
paras.zh: 大型科技公司还必须限制成年人遭受“严重”伤害，例如暴力威胁、跟踪和未经同意分享亲密图像。

paras.en: The bill would also pave the way for Australians aged 16 and over to switch off algorithm-driven feeds and see content only from accounts they chose to follow.
paras.zh: 该法案还将为 16 岁及以上的澳大利亚人关闭算法驱动的源并仅查看他们选择关注的帐户中的内容铺平道路。

paras.en: Ms Scamps said establishing an Online Services Ombudsman within the remit of the existing Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman would help people who currently felt "powerless" to resolve their problems.
paras.zh: 斯坎普斯女士表示，在现有电信行业监察员的职权范围内设立在线服务监察员将帮助那些目前感到“无力”解决问题的人们。

paras.en: "For many Australians, dealing with big tech platforms can feel like shouting into the void, with complaints met by automated responses, endless online forms or no meaningful response at all," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“对于许多澳大利亚人来说，与大型科技平台打交道就像是对着虚空大喊大叫，投诉只能通过自动回复、无休无止的在线表格或根本没有任何有意义的回复来解决。”

paras.en: "When platforms fail to act, there is nowhere independent to turn."
paras.zh: “当平台无法采取行动时，就无处可去。”

paras.en: Ms Scamps said Labor's bill provided for stronger internal complaints and dispute resolution processes, but that alone was "not enough".
paras.zh: 斯坎普斯表示，工党的法案规定了更强有力的内部投诉和争议解决程序，但仅此“还不够”。

paras.en: Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman Cynthia Gebert said the crossbench amendment was the "missing piece" in the government's digital agenda.
paras.zh: 电信行业监察员辛西娅·格伯特表示，中立议员修正案是政府数字议程中“缺失的一块”。

paras.en: "People want someone to turn to when they're locked out of their social media account without warning or realistic avenue to appeal against big tech companies," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“当人们被锁定在社交媒体帐户之外时，人们希望有人能够向他们求助，而没有任何警告或现实的途径来对大型科技公司提出上诉。”

paras.en: Ms Gebert said thousands of people and small businesses were already reaching out seeking help she was unable to provide despite wanting to.
paras.zh: 格伯特女士表示，成千上万的人和小企业已经向她寻求帮助，尽管她很想提供帮助，但她却无法提供帮助。

paras.en: "The TIO stands ready to expand our role to help people when things go wrong online," she said.
paras.zh: “TIO 随时准备扩大我们的作用，以便在网上出现问题时为人们提供帮助，”她说。

paras.en: Greens communications spokeswoman Sarah Hanson-Young said her party would be fighting to ensure the digital duty of care had "real teeth," prioritising tougher fines and the right to privately sue big tech.
paras.zh: 绿党通讯发言人莎拉·汉森-杨(Sarah Hanson-Young)表示，她的政党将努力确保数字谨慎义务具有“真正的效力”，优先考虑更严厉的罚款和私下起诉大型科技公司的权利。

paras.en: "We know that these companies only respond to one thing: penalties that hit them where it hurts," she said.
paras.zh: “我们知道这些公司只会对一件事做出反应：对他们进行痛处的处罚，”她说。

paras.en: Senator Hanson-Young said Australians also needed an external complaints pathway that was free from the "whims" of big tech moderators.
paras.zh: 汉森-杨参议员表示，澳大利亚人还需要一条不受大型科技监管者“突发奇想”影响的外部投诉途径。

paras.en: "This would put the safety of user, accountability and basic decency ahead of corporate profits," she said.
paras.zh: “这会将用户的安全、责任和基本尊严置于企业利润之上，”她说。

paras.en: A spokeswoman for Communications Minister Anika Wells said the government understood how "frustrating" it was for Australians to report a complaint to a tech company and hear nothing back.
paras.zh: 通讯部长阿尼卡·威尔斯(Anika Wells)的发言人表示，政府理解澳大利亚人向一家科技公司投诉却得不到任何回复是多么“令人沮丧”。

paras.en: She said Labor's proposal empowered the eSafety commissioner to create "enforceable standards" to resolve disputes, which currently do not exist.
paras.zh: 她说，工党的提案授权电子安全专员制定“可执行的标准”来解决目前不存在的争议。

paras.en: The Coalition will oppose Labor's bill, with Shadow Communications Minister Sarah Henderson taking issue with what she described as "dangerously vague" definitions and concerns the government would be able to spread propaganda.
paras.zh: 联盟党将反对工党的法案，影子通讯部长萨拉·亨德森(Sarah Henderson)对她所说的“危险的模糊”定义提出异议，并担心政府将能够传播宣传。

paras.en: "This is information control because of the wide range of discretion, both of the minister and also the eSafety commissioner, to determine what is harm online," she told News24 earlier this week.
paras.zh: 她本周早些时候对 News24 表示：“这是信息控制，因为部长和电子安全专员在确定网络危害方面拥有广泛的自由裁量权。”

articles.title: 50,000 people could get compensation for unlawful Centrelink suspensions
articles.author: Bronwyn Herbert

paras.en: The Commonwealth Ombudsman found almost 1,000 jobseekers had their payments cancelled over two years under a Centrelink compliance regime.
paras.zh: 联邦监察员发现，根据 Centrelink 合规制度，近 1,000 名求职者的付款在两年内被取消。

paras.en: Following a review, the department is reinstating the framework, allowing Centrelink payment suspensions and penalties to resume.
paras.zh: 经过审查后，该部门正在恢复该框架，允许恢复 Centrelink 付款暂停和罚款。

paras.en: More than 50,000 people have been invited to apply for compensation over the failure, as advocates question whether enough has been done to address the underlying issues.
paras.zh: 超过 50,000 人已被邀请就此次失败申请赔偿，因为倡导者质疑是否已采取足够措施来解决根本问题。

paras.en: More than 50,000 welfare recipients could now get compensation after the government unlawfully stopped their payments, claiming they had failed to meet "mutual obligation" requirements.
paras.zh: 在政府以未能满足“共同义务”要求为由非法停止发放福利后，超过 50,000 名福利受益者现在可以获得赔偿。

paras.en: That scheme, which was partially paused in July 2024 when concerns it may have been operating unlawfully first arose, has now restarted with advocates warning the problems have not been fixed.
paras.zh: 该计划于 2024 年 7 月部分暂停，当时人们担心该计划可能非法运作，但现在已重新启动，支持者警告问题尚未得到解决。

paras.en: A Commonwealth Ombudsman investigation last year found 964 payment cancellations were not made in accordance with the law.
paras.zh: 联邦监察员去年的一项调查发现，有 964 起付款取消行为并未依法进行。

paras.en: Adelaide man Daniel* was one of those affected. His Centrelink payments were suspended in 2022, despite being exempt from mutual obligations with no compulsory activities to complete.
paras.zh: 阿德莱德男子丹尼尔*是受影响的人之一。他的 Centrelink 付款于 2022 年被暂停，尽管他免除了相互义务，也没有强制完成的活动。

paras.en: "I kept ringing them and saying, 'I've got zero points, I've got no requirements, why am I getting these suspensions?' But it just kept happening," he said.
paras.zh: “我一直打电话给他们说，‘我得了零分，我没有任何要求，为什么我会被停职呢？’但这种情况一直在发生，”他说。

paras.en: His payments were later cancelled, leaving him without income support for more than three years.
paras.zh: 他的付款后来被取消，使他在三年多的时间里没有收入支持。

paras.en: Daniel said without income support, he could not secure rental accommodation, experienced periods of homelessness and relied on help from family and friends to get by.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔说，如果没有收入支持，他无法获得出租房屋，经历了无家可归的时期，只能依靠家人和朋友的帮助度日。

paras.en: "Without my pensioner dad helping me, I honestly don't know what would have happened. There were times I had nowhere to live."
paras.zh: “如果没有我领取养老金的父亲帮助我，老实说，我不知道会发生什么。有时我无处可住。”

paras.en: The 51-year-old challenged the Centrelink decision after he was alerted to the Ombudsman's findings last year.
paras.zh: 这位 51 岁的男子去年得知监察员的调查结果后，对 Centrelink 的决定提出了质疑。

paras.en: A week before his case was due to be heard in October 2025, the department conducted a minister-initiated review, reversed the cancellation decision and paid him about $53,000 in back pay.
paras.zh: 在他的案件定于 2025 年 10 月审理的前一周，该部门进行了部长发起的审查，推翻了取消决定，并向他支付了约 53,000 美元的欠薪。

paras.en: The Department of Employment and Workplace Relations (DEWR) said it had fixed the issues identified by the Commonwealth Ombudsman through IT system changes, system testing, improved participant communications and additional training for decision-makers.
paras.zh: 就业和工作场所关系部 (DEWR) 表示，已通过 IT 系统变更、系统测试、改进参与者沟通以及对决策者进行额外培训，解决了联邦监察员指出的问题。

paras.en: But advocacy groups fear not enough has been done to fix the underlying issues, with questions set to be put to the government over the scale of the payment cancellations and what evidence it relied on before resuming the program.
paras.zh: 但倡导团体担心，解决根本问题的措施还不够，他们将向政府提出有关取消付款的规模以及在恢复该计划之前依赖哪些证据的问题。

paras.en: The department said one reason identified for the system failure stemmed from an IT system change introduced in December 2020, which caused some welfare recipients to have their payments cancelled up to four days earlier than legislation allowed.
paras.zh: 该部门表示，确定的系统故障原因之一是 2020 年 12 月引入的 IT 系统变更，导致一些福利领取者的付款比立法允许的提前四天取消。

paras.en: The department's 2025-26 annual report released last week showed $870,000 has been paid in compensation to more than 600 people following the review.
paras.zh: 该部门上周发布的 2025-26 年度报告显示，审查后已向 600 多人支付了 87 万美元的赔偿金。

paras.en: It is now inviting a further 50,652 people to also apply for compensation. However, advocacy groups argue the number of people affected by unlawful cancellations may be substantially higher, with estimates ranging from more than 100,000 people to as many as 300,000.
paras.zh: 现在它正在邀请另外 50,652 人也申请赔偿。然而，倡导团体认为，受非法取消影响的人数可能要高得多，估计人数从超过 100,000 人到多达 300,000 人不等。

paras.en: The cancellations occurred automatically under the framework, a system set up to monitor "mutual obligations".
paras.zh: 取消是在该框架下自动发生的，该框架是一个为监控“相互义务”而建立的系统。

paras.en: These are conditions people must meet to continue receiving payments, like job hunting and attending interviews.
paras.zh: 这些是人们必须满足才能继续收到付款的条件，例如找工作和参加面试。

paras.en: New laws introduced after the Robodebt scandal required agencies to consider the jobseeker's circumstances before cancelling their payment.
paras.zh: Robodebt 丑闻后出台的新法律要求各机构在取消付款之前考虑求职者的情况。

paras.en: This didn't occur in 964 cancellations between April 2022 and July 2024.
paras.zh: 2022 年 4 月至 2024 年 7 月期间的 964 次取消航班中没有发生这种情况。

paras.en: The department then paused the cancellations of payments while it reviewed affected decisions.
paras.zh: 该部门随后暂停取消付款，同时审查受影响的决定。

paras.en: Anti-poverty centre coordinator Jay Coonan said advocacy groups including the Australian Council of Social Service, Economic Justice Australia, National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Legal Services and Inclusion Australia, remain unconvinced the underlying problems of the compliance system have been resolved.
paras.zh: 反贫困中心协调员杰伊·库南（Jay Coonan）表示，包括澳大利亚社会服务委员会、澳大利亚经济正义协会、国家原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民法律服务和包容性澳大利亚在内的倡导团体仍然不相信合规制度的根本问题已经得到解决。

paras.en: He said the government has yet to demonstrate the system can operate fairly and lawfully at scale.
paras.zh: 他表示，政府尚未证明该系统可以公平、合法地大规模运行。

paras.en: "We have both publicly raised and privately raised with the department that we do not believe that the targeted compliance framework and the current regime of payment suspensions is used fairly or lawfully," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们已向该部门公开和私下提出，我们认为目标合规框架和现行的暂停付款制度没有得到公平或合法的使用。”

paras.en: Despite participating in the department's Targeted Compliance Framework Reference group, Mr Coonan said advocacy organisations had not been provided evidence that the issues identified by the Ombudsman had been fixed.
paras.zh: 库南先生表示，尽管参加了该部门的目标合规框架参考小组，但倡导组织尚未获得证据表明监察员发现的问题已得到解决。

paras.en: Disability groups have also criticised the decision, arguing people with disability are disproportionately affected by payment suspensions and cancellations and calling for the framework to be abolished.
paras.zh: 残疾人组织也批评了这一决定，认为暂停和取消付款对残疾人造成了不成比例的影响，并呼吁废除该框架。

paras.en: DEWR said it would closely monitor the resumed provisions and noted the most serious cancellation powers remained paused until further safeguards were put in place, with those measures expected to return in 2027.
paras.zh: DEWR 表示，将密切关注恢复的规定，并指出，在进一步的保障措施到位之前，最严重的取消权仍处于暂停状态，这些措施预计将于 2027 年恢复。

paras.en: The department has not publicly disclosed its estimated total compensation liability.
paras.zh: 该部门尚未公开披露其估计的赔偿责任总额。

paras.en: *Daniel is identified by his first name only because of concerns about the impact of identifying him as a recipient of income support payments.
paras.zh: *丹尼尔仅以他的名字命名，因为担心将他列为收入补助金接受者会产生影响。

articles.title: Will AI crush the things that make life meaningful?
articles.author: Gareth Hutchens

paras.en: Do policymakers know what dark forces they're messing with?
paras.zh: 政策制定者知道他们正在对付哪些黑暗势力吗？

paras.en: In their rush to force AI on us, they're embracing a technology that is exceptionally good at destroying the things that bring meaning to our lives.
paras.zh: 在他们急于将人工智能强加给我们的过程中，他们正在拥抱一种非常擅长摧毁为我们的生活带来意义的东西的技术。

paras.en: Artists, writers, and musicians have had their skills radically devalued by AI.
paras.zh: 艺术家、作家和音乐家的技能被人工智能彻底贬值。
