paras.en: “Spain, despite its [progressive] speeches in Europe, is not ensuring that human rights guarantees are met for people who cross its borders in Ceuta and Melilla,” said Virginia Alvarez, an Amnesty International researcher.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织研究员弗吉尼亚·阿尔瓦雷斯表示：“尽管西班牙在欧洲发表了[进步]言论，但它并没有确保在休达和梅利利亚跨越其边境的人们的人权得到保障。”

paras.en: “Morocco does not respect many human rights.”
paras.zh: “摩洛哥不尊重很多人权。”

paras.en: However, Madrid disputes the rights group’s accusations. In a statement, the interior ministry told Reuters that the European Union considers Morocco to be a safe country, adding that deportations are carried out “with all the necessary safeguards”.
paras.zh: 然而，马德里对人权组织的指控提出异议。内政部在一份声明中告诉路透社，欧盟认为摩洛哥是一个安全的国家，并补充说驱逐是在“一切必要的保障措施下”进行的。

paras.en: Most of those who entered Ceuta in late July left within days. However, about 8,000 migrants still remain. Some are sleeping on the streets, while others are being housed by Spain, charities and civil society groups.
paras.zh: 大多数七月底进入休达的人在几天内就离开了。然而，仍有约 8,000 名移民留存。一些人露宿街头，另一些人则被西班牙、慈善机构和民间社会团体安置。

articles.title: Protesters storm Serbian pro-Vucic TV station after his loss at polls

paras.en: Protesters stormed a Serbian television station supportive of former President Aleksandar Vucic, interrupting broadcasting to call for the arrest of its editor, as tens of thousands took to the streets for a second night of post-election celebrations late Monday after his defeat at the polls.
paras.zh: 抗议者袭击了支持前总统亚历山大·武契奇的塞尔维亚电视台，中断了广播，呼吁逮捕其编辑。周一晚间，数万人在前总统在民意调查中落败后走上街头，参加选举后的第二个晚上的庆祝活动。

paras.en: Live footage broadcast by Informer TV showed about 30 people entering its newsroom on Monday evening and surrounding editor-in-chief and owner Dragan Vucicevic. Some protesters shouted, “This is how it is in free Serbia!” and “Where is Vucic now?” Others called for Vucicevic’s arrest.
paras.zh: Informer TV 播放的现场录像显示，周一晚间约有 30 人进入其新闻编辑室，周围环绕着主编兼所有者 Dragan Vucicevic。一些抗议者高喊：“自由的塞尔维亚就是这样！”以及“武契奇现在在哪里？”其他人则呼吁逮捕武西切维奇。

paras.en: On his personal Instagram account, Vucic, dressed in a jumper displaying the crossed-out word “sorry”, called the incident an attack on free speech and the freedom of journalism.
paras.zh: 武契奇在他的个人Instagram账户上身穿一件套头衫，上面写着“抱歉”，他称这一事件是对言论自由和新闻自由的攻击。

paras.en: Serbia’s Student List, born out of a student-led anticorruption protest movement, defeated Vucic’s alliance in a historic election on Sunday, bringing to an end his party’s 14-year grip on power. Vucic, who became prime minister in 2014 and president in 2017, previously served as information minister under Slobodan Milosevic and maintained tight control over the media during his rule.
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚学生名单诞生于学生领导的反腐败抗议运动，在周日的历史性选举中击败了武契奇的联盟，结束了该党对权力长达14年的控制。武契奇于2014年成为总理，2017年成为总统，此前曾在斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇时期担任信息部长，并在其执政期间对媒体保持严格控制。

paras.en: Celebrations erupted across Serbia, with fireworks lighting the sky almost immediately after Vucic made an announcement conceding defeat.
paras.zh: 武契奇宣布认输后，塞尔维亚各地爆发了庆祝活动，烟花照亮了天空。

paras.en: “It means freedom from a dictatorship that has lasted for 12 years, that I cannot remember a time before,” voter Jana Vasic told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 选民贾娜·瓦西克 (Jana Vasic) 告诉半岛电视台：“这意味着摆脱持续了 12 年的独裁统治，我不记得以前有过这样的独裁统治。”

paras.en: The student movement has no clear leader, and Serbians are waiting to see whom it will appoint as prime minister and to other key positions. The leading candidate on its election list, cardiologist Ilija Srdanovic, called for calm.
paras.zh: 学生运动没有明确的领导人，塞尔维亚人正在等待学生运动将任命谁为总理和其他关键职位。其选举名单上的领先候选人、心脏病专家伊利亚·斯丹诺维奇（Ilija Srdanovic）呼吁保持冷静。

paras.en: “We ask of you to stay calm and dignified until the end of the electoral process, just like you have been until now,” he said in a video posted on his Instagram account. “Don’t resort to any form of violence. Your Student List and your student movement urge you on this.”
paras.zh: 他在 Instagram 账户上发布的一段视频中表示：“我们要求你们在选举过程结束之前保持冷静和尊严，就像到现在为止一样。” “不要诉诸任何形式的暴力。你的学生名单和你的学生运动敦促你这样做。”

paras.en: The Independent Association of Journalists of Serbia said in a statement that it would submit an application on Tuesday to have Informer TV’s broadcasting licence revoked, citing systematic violations of law and programme obligations.
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚独立记者协会在一份声明中表示，该协会将于周二提交申请，撤销 Informer TV 的广播许可证，理由是其系统性违反法律和节目义务。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Informer’s Vucicevic released a statement saying, “On the very first day of [Student List] power, they want to ban the media. They have said everything about themselves, and nothing about us.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，《Informer》杂志的 Vucicevic 发表声明称，“在[学生名单]上台的第一天，他们就想禁止媒体。他们已经说了关于他们自己的一切，却对我们只字不提。”

paras.en: In a separate development, a group of people also gathered outside the private pro-Vucic Pink TV station in Belgrade on Monday evening, which was cordoned off by police.
paras.zh: 在另一起事件中，周一晚上，一群人还聚集在贝尔格莱德支持武契奇的私人电视台外，该电视台已被警方封锁。

paras.en: Earlier, public broadcaster RTV in the Vojvodina region began its evening news bulletin by apologising to viewers for failing to fulfil its role, citing uncritical, one-sided reporting.
paras.zh: 早些时候，伏伊伏丁那地区的公共广播公司RTV在晚间新闻公报开始时，以不加批判、片面的报道为由，对未能履行其职责向观众表示歉意。

paras.en: Serbia was ranked 104th out of 180 countries in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index by Reporters Without Borders, its lowest position ever and worst in the European Union-Balkan region.
paras.zh: 在无国界记者组织的 2026 年世界新闻自由指数中，塞尔维亚在 180 个国家中排名第 104 位，这是有史以来的最低排名，也是欧盟-巴尔干地区最差的排名。

paras.en: The Centre for Research, Transparency and Accountability (Crta) election monitor said last week that television stations with national reach gave three-quarters of the time allotted to politicians to government representatives. The Student List was portrayed negatively more than 80 percent of the time it was discussed, Crta added.
paras.zh: 研究、透明度和问责中心（Crta）选举监测员上周表示，具有全国影响力的电视台将分配给政客的四分之三的时间分配给了政府代表。 Crta 补充说，在讨论学生名单时，超过 80% 的讨论都是负面的。

articles.title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，民主党在中期选举中具有优势。而且，以色列人在高风险选举中投票

paras.en: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll reveals that Democrats hold significant advantages in the midterm elections and are favored to gain control of the U.S. House. But there are also signs suggesting that a potential wave may be limited. The poll highlights key issues influencing voters; one in three Americans face financial hardships, and four in 10 say their personal finances are worsening. Preserving democracy resonates with Democrats and independents, while immigration ranks as the top issue for MAGA supporters.
paras.zh: NPR/PBS News/Marist 的一项新民意调查显示，民主党在中期选举中占据显着优势，有望获得美国众议院的控制权。但也有迹象表明，潜在的浪潮可能有限。该民意调查突出了影响选民的关键问题；三分之一的美国人面临财务困难，十分之四的人表示他们的个人财务状况正在恶化。维护民主引起了民主党人和独立人士的共鸣，而移民则是 MAGA 支持者的首要问题。

paras.en: - 🎧 Democrats hold an 8-point advantage among likely voters on the generic congressional ballot, indicating a strong position, NPR's Domenico Montanaro tells Up First. President Trump remains unpopular. His approval rating sits at 40%, which is a slight improvement. While it seems unlikely that Democrats will lose the House, the Senate remains a toss-up. Montanaro says patience will be crucial for the outcomes of many races because it's unlikely the winners will be clear by election night, which is to be expected of vote counting in close elections.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的多梅尼科·蒙塔纳罗 (Domenico Montanaro) 告诉 Up First，在一般国会选票中，民主党在可能选民中拥有 8 个百分点的优势，这表明民主党处于强势地位。特朗普总统仍然不受欢迎。他的支持率为40%，略有提高。尽管民主党似乎不太可能失去众议院，但参议院仍然是一个难以预测的局面。蒙塔纳罗表示，耐心对于许多竞选的结果至关重要，因为在选举之夜之前不太可能分出胜负，而在势均力敌的选举中，计票时预计会出现赢家。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: A federal judge today hears arguments in the Trump administration's bid to compel California to set aside ballots from voters it alleges may not be citizens. This comes after an appeals court last night declined the administration's request to get involved.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官今天听取了特朗普政府试图迫使加州搁置其声称可能不是公民的选民选票的论点。此前，上诉法院昨晚拒绝了政府的介入请求。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump announced yesterday that he is offering a $1 million reward for tips on voter fraud that lead to a conviction. The president has claimed fraud in every election he has participated in, prompting Democrats, election officials and good-governance groups to prepare for similar accusations, NPR's Eric McDaniel says. The White House says its efforts aim to secure elections. But McDaniel says credible evidence of voter fraud significant enough to affect election outcomes in the U.S. has never been found.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普昨天宣布，他将悬赏 100 万美元，奖励那些举报选民欺诈并最终定罪的人。 NPR 的埃里克·麦克丹尼尔 (Eric McDaniel) 表示，总统在他参加的每一次选举中都声称存在舞弊行为，这促使民主党人、选举官员和善政团体为类似的指控做好准备。白宫表示，其努力的目的是确保选举顺利进行。但麦克丹尼尔表示，从未发现足以影响美国选举结果的选民欺诈的可靠证据。

paras.en: - ➡️ With the elections a week away, Polymarket has already investigated "dozens" of bets on its prediction markets concerning the midterm elections, according to Shana Bautista, the company's head of global intelligence and investigations.
paras.zh: - ➡️Polymarket 全球情报和调查主管 Shana Bautista 表示，距离选举还有一周时间，Polymarket 已经调查了与中期选举相关的预测市场上的“数十个”赌注。

paras.en: Israelis are voting today in an election that will shape their country's future. This marks the first time since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas attacks that Israelis can choose their leaders. Voters will decide whether to keep Israel's far-right, longest-serving prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, or replace him with Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief promising more diplomacy and less extremism. Here's what you need to know about the leading candidates, the issues shaping the vote and what could happen next.
paras.zh: 以色列人今天将在一场将塑造其国家未来的选举中投票。这标志着自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以来以色列首次可以选择领导人。选民将决定是否继续留任以色列任期最长的极右翼总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，还是用承诺加强外交和减少极端主义的前军事首领加迪·艾森科特取代他。以下是您需要了解的有关主要候选人、影响投票的问题以及接下来可能发生的情况的信息。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Ruth Sherlock says a high voter turnout is expected, and many people casting their votes believe this is a critical election for the country's future. Israelis abroad have flown in to participate. At a polling station, Sherlock met Itamar Ariel, who believes that only Netanyahu can ensure Israel's security, even though the country faces problems. Others in the country believe Netanyahu should be voted out due to security failures. Those wanting change in leadership want an investigation into how the Oct. 7 attacks in Israel happened, which Netanyahu has blocked. Sherlock says by Wednesday morning, we should see which side secures the most seats in Parliament, but the vote count could continue for days, and the prime minister won't be determined until after days or possibly weeks of negotiations between the parties.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的露丝·夏洛克 (Ruth Sherlock) 表示，预计会有很高的选民投票率，许多投票的人认为这是对国家未来至关重要的选举。海外的以色列人纷纷飞来参加。在投票站，夏洛克遇到了伊塔马尔·阿里尔，后者认为只有内塔尼亚胡才能确保以色列的安全，尽管该国面临着问题。该国其他人认为，由于安全问题，内塔尼亚胡应该被投票下台。那些希望更换领导层的人希望对以色列 10 月 7 日的袭击事件进行调查，但内塔尼亚胡已阻止了这一调查。夏洛克说，到周三早上，我们应该看看哪一方在议会中获得最多席位，但计票可能会持续数天，而总理人选要在双方进行数天或可能数周的谈判后才能确定。

paras.en: Hours of screen time at your desk can turn you into a stiff, bleary-eyed version of yourself. Prolonged sitting can take a real toll, but a few smart habits can help reset your body and mind. Here are Life Kit's best strategies to help with the discomfort and health risks that can come from sitting at a desk all day.
paras.zh: 坐在办公桌前几个小时的屏幕时间会让你变得僵硬、睡眼惺忪。长时间坐着确实会造成损害，但一些聪明的习惯可以帮助您调整身心。以下是 Life Kit 的最佳策略，可帮助缓解整天坐在办公桌前带来的不适和健康风险。

paras.en: - 🧘 Walking for five minutes every 30 minutes helps combat fatigue, weight gain and joint pain, reducing the risk of chronic diseases like obesity, heart disease and cancer.
paras.zh: - 🧘 每 30 分钟步行 5 分钟有助于对抗疲劳、体重增加和关节疼痛，降低患肥胖、心脏病和癌症等慢性疾病的风险。

paras.en: - 🧘 If your back aches from slouching at your desk, rotate your spine to relieve stress and enhance flexibility by mimicking its natural movements.
paras.zh: - 🧘 如果您因无精打采地坐在办公桌前而感到背部疼痛，请模仿脊柱的自然运动，旋转脊柱以缓解压力并增强灵活性。

paras.en: - 🧘 Fidgeting indicates a need to change your position. Pay attention to your body and switch between sitting, standing, reclining and moving.
paras.zh: - 🧘 坐立不安表明需要改变你的位置。注意你的身体，在坐、站、斜躺和移动之间切换。

paras.en: - 🧘 To relieve eye strain from screen time, stretch your eye muscles. Hold your arm straight in front of you, thumb pointing up. Move your arm in a big circle while keeping your head still and follow your thumb with your eyes.
paras.zh: - 🧘 为了缓解屏幕时间造成的眼睛疲劳，请伸展眼部肌肉。将手臂伸直放在身前，拇指向上。将手臂绕一个大圈移动，同时保持头部不动，并用眼睛跟随拇指。

paras.en: Forget flying brooms. Cape Town is home to South Africa's real-world Hogwarts: the College of Magic. Every Saturday, almost 200 students ages 10 to 18 attend classes in a variety of things, including puppetry, mime and clowning, juggling, card tricks, illusions, mentalism, stage magic, theater production and escapology. In 1980, David Gore and a friend came up with the idea of starting a magic school. At the time, South Africa was grappling with apartheid, a brutal system of racial segregation. But from day one, the establishment was multiracial, even though state schools were still strictly segregated. Almost 50 years later, the College of Magic continues to stand out in a city that remains deeply divided along racial and economic lines. These photos capture how the school has turned young dreamers into magicians.
paras.zh: 忘记飞扫帚吧。开普敦是南非现实世界霍格沃茨魔法学院的所在地。每周六，近 200 名 10 至 18 岁的学生参加各种课程，包括木偶、默剧和小丑、杂耍、纸牌戏法、幻术、唯心论、舞台魔术、戏剧制作和逃脱术。 1980年，大卫·戈尔和一位朋友提出了开办一所魔法学校的想法。当时，南非正在努力应对种族隔离这一残酷的种族隔离制度。但从第一天起，尽管公立学校仍然严格隔离，但这个机构就是多种族的。近 50 年后，魔法学院继续在这座种族和经济分歧严重的城市中脱颖而出。这些照片记录了学校如何将年轻的梦想家变成魔术师。

paras.en: - Blue crabs in the Chesapeake Bay are threatened by invasive blue catfish. To tackle the problem, officials are creating kid-friendly catfish recipes that meet federal dietary requirements for school lunches in Maryland and Virginia.
paras.zh: - 切萨皮克湾的蓝蟹受到入侵蓝鲶鱼的威胁。为了解决这个问题，官员们正在制作适合儿童的鲶鱼食谱，以满足马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州学校午餐的联邦饮食要求。

paras.en: - Microsoft sent memos yesterday to about 60,000 employees, offering voluntary buyouts to further reduce its headcount. The offer is available to roughly one quarter of its workforce. (via KUOW)
paras.zh: - 微软昨天向大约 60,000 名员工发送了备忘录，提出自愿买断以进一步减少员工人数。大约四分之一的员工可以享受这项优惠。 （来自 KUOW）

paras.en: - The Archdiocese of New York has agreed to pay $800 million to settle claims from around 1,300 people who say they faced sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers.
paras.zh: - 纽约大主教管区同意支付 8 亿美元来解决约 1,300 人提出的索赔，这些人称自己遭受神职人员和非专业工人的性虐待。

articles.title: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
articles.author: Durrie Bouscaren

paras.en: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
paras.zh: “绿军”出击阻止厄尔尼诺洪水

paras.en: Nairobi is a city of rivers, streams and almost six million people.
paras.zh: 内罗毕是一座拥有河流、溪流和近六百万人口的城市。

paras.en: For weeks, Kenya's bustling capital has braced for potentially catastrophic floods, as forecasters predict the strongest El Niño event on record this winter. Globally, this year's Super El Niño will likely peak in November or December and continue into early 2027. But Nairobi isn't just watching and waiting.
paras.zh: 数周以来，肯尼亚繁华的首都一直在为潜在的灾难性洪水做好准备，因为预报员预测今年冬天将出现有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象。从全球范围来看，今年的超级厄尔尼诺现象可能会在 11 月或 12 月达到峰值，并持续到 2027 年初。但内罗毕并不只是在观望和等待。

paras.en: On a sunny October day near the city center, a team of workers in reflective vests shovels dirt and clears debris from the bank of a river. It's unseasonably hot — and hot days usually suggest there's an unusually strong rainy season ahead.
paras.zh: 十月阳光明媚的一天，市中心附近，一群穿着反光背心的工人正在铲土并清除河岸上的碎片。天气异常炎热，炎热的天气通常预示着即将到来的异常强雨季。

paras.en: "The best thing to do is to be prepared," says Alex Oyando, a 30-year-old worker. "These drainage troughs are full of different things. When we remove the dirt, the water can flow — and it prevents flooding."
paras.zh: “最好的办法就是做好准备，”30 岁的工人亚历克斯·奥扬多 (Alex Oyando) 说。 “这些排水槽里充满了不同的东西。当我们清除污垢时，水就可以流动——并且可以防止洪水泛滥。”

paras.en: Nairobi frequently experiences catastrophic flash floods. More than 100 people died during rain-induced flash floods last March, and residents have pressured Kenya's government to do more to prevent these disasters in the future.
paras.zh: 内罗毕经常遭受灾难性的山洪爆发。去年 3 月，降雨引发的山洪爆发导致 100 多人死亡，居民向肯尼亚政府施压，要求其采取更多措施防止未来发生此类灾害。

paras.en: As part of the preparations, Nairobi's county government has mobilized the "Green Army," a youth-employment program of more than 4,000 people. While generally assigned to trash pickups and city greening projects, the workers have been out in full force to prepare for El
paras.zh: 作为筹备工作的一部分，内罗毕县政府动员了“绿军”，这是一项涵盖 4000 多人的青年就业计划。虽然工人们通常被分配到垃圾收集和城市绿化工程，但他们已经全力以赴为El

paras.en: Niño, clearing drainages and dismantling illegal structures like food stalls. These buildings are generally constructed by the community without government permits and are at an increased risk of collapsing during natural disasters.
paras.zh: 尼诺（Niño），清理排水系统并拆除食品摊位等非法建筑。这些建筑物通常是由社区在未经政府许可的情况下建造的，在自然灾害期间倒塌的风险增加。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Oyando and his colleagues widened a drainage ditch that runs along a busy road lined with stalls selling clothing. Piles of fabric, plastic bottles and other litter often build up in the stream, triggering flash floods.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，奥扬多和他的同事拓宽了一条排水沟，这条排水沟沿着一条繁忙的道路延伸，两旁都是出售服装的摊位。成堆的织物、塑料瓶和其他垃圾经常堆积在溪流中，引发山洪。

paras.en: While the pay isn't as much as he could make elsewhere, Oyando admits, the shifts are manageable and not too grueling.
paras.zh: 奥扬多承认，虽然他的薪水不如在其他地方赚得那么多，但轮班是可以控制的，而且不会太累人。

paras.en: "It's something that gives me an opportunity to make a living," he says.
paras.zh: “这给了我谋生的机会，”他说。

paras.en: Many of Oyando's colleagues live or grew up in Nairobi's low-income neighborhoods, which are the hardest hit by flash floods. Aging drainage infrastructure and clogged waterways can cause stormwater to build up. When it rains, he says, it's not unusual for his street to fill with water and flood his home.
paras.zh: 奥扬多的许多同事在内罗毕的低收入社区生活或长大，这些社区是山洪暴发的重灾区。老化的排水基础设施和堵塞的水道会导致雨水积聚。他说，下雨时，他的街道被水淹没并淹没他的家并不罕见。

paras.en: "The infrastructure we've had in place for decades was tailored for a population of not more than 2 million people," says Bramwell Simiyu, the chief officer of disaster management for Nairobi's county government. "We're now talking about a daytime population of close to 7 million."
paras.zh: 内罗毕县政府灾害管理首席官员布拉姆韦尔·西米尤 (Bramwell Simiyu) 表示：“我们几十年来建立的基础设施是为不超过 200 万人口量身定制的。” “我们现在谈论的是白天人口接近 700 万。”

paras.en: Kenya's federal government has put in place a $385 million plan to widen Nairobi's waterways, build affordable housing and improve the city's trash pickup and sewer system by the end of 2027. In addition, the program supports a national youth employment program called Climate WorX, which is working with the Green Army on El Niño preparations.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚联邦政府已制定一项耗资 3.85 亿美元的计划，旨在到 2027 年底拓宽内罗毕的水道、建造经济适用房并改善该市的垃圾收集和下水道系统。此外，该计划还支持一项名为“Climate WorX”的国家青年就业计划，该计划正在与绿军合作应对厄尔尼诺现象的准备工作。

paras.en: Now, Simiyu says, the county is preparing supplies and evacuation centers for the rainy season.
paras.zh: 西米尤说，现在该县正在为雨季准备物资和疏散中心。

paras.en: "We're also preparing for a worst-case scenario, where up to about 20,000 households may be affected — mostly in the low -income settlements," Simiyu said.
paras.zh: 西米尤说：“我们也在为最坏的情况做准备，最多约 20,000 个家庭可能会受到影响，其中大部分位于低收入定居点。”

paras.en: In these settlements, the demolition of illegally built structures, such as food hawker stalls, has caused an outcry. Tobias Sifuna, a supervisor for Green Army teams in the Kamukunji area of Nairobi, says it's a necessary step.
paras.zh: 在这些定居点，拆除食品小贩摊位等非法建筑引起了强烈抗议。内罗毕 Kamukunji 地区绿军团队的主管托比亚斯·西富纳 (Tobias Sifuna) 表示，这是必要的一步。

paras.en: "These are small kiosks that are built illegally, by the community — without the authorization from the county government," Sifuna said.
paras.zh: “这些小亭子是社区非法建造的，没有得到县政府的授权，”西弗纳说。

paras.en: But nearby communities rely on them, for income and for daily shopping.
paras.zh: 但附近的社区依赖它们来获得收入和日常购物。

paras.en: Wycliffe Ochieng, a 32-year-old fruit vendor, says many workers in central Nairobi now have nowhere to buy an affordable hot lunch during the day.
paras.zh: 32 岁的水果摊贩威克利夫·奥钦 (Wycliffe Ochieng) 表示，内罗毕市中心的许多工人现在白天无处可买负担得起的热午餐。

paras.en: "Now, we have to sleep without food because we can't afford it," Ochieng says.
paras.zh: “现在，我们不得不不吃东西睡觉，因为我们买不起，”奥钦说。

paras.en: When the county government destroys the shops, it's the community that feels the loss — whether or not the floods eventually come. But it's these neighborhoods that were hit the hardest by the floods during the last rainy season. Ochieng himself had to sleep outdoors, because he could not reach his home in the floodwaters.
paras.zh: 当县政府摧毁商店时，无论洪水是否最终到来，感受到损失的是社区。但上个雨季期间，这些社区受到洪水的打击最严重。奥钦本人不得不睡在户外，因为他在洪水中无法到达家中。

paras.en: "This place, it's like an ocean when it's raining," Ochieng says. "When the flood came, all the food stalls were swept away."
paras.zh: “这个地方，下雨的时候就像一片海洋，”奥钦说。 “洪水来临时，所有的小吃摊都被冲走了。”

paras.en: His friend, a woman who owned a food stall, died as she tried to escape. He lost his own stand, a small grocery, as well. He struggled to rebuild his business in a new neighborhood, where customers no longer knew him by reputation.
paras.zh: 他的朋友是一位经营食品摊位的女士，在试图逃跑时死亡。他也失去了自己的摊位，一家小杂货店。他努力在一个新社区重建自己的生意，那里的顾客不再以声誉来认识他。

paras.en: "After the flood I really suffered. It was hard to put food on the table," Ochieng says.
paras.zh: “洪水过后，我真的很痛苦。餐桌上很难有食物，”奥钦说。

paras.en: He says he hopes the county can do more to prevent flooding and safeguard livelihoods. There are only so many times he can rebuild his life from scratch.
paras.zh: 他表示，希望县政府能够在防洪、保障民生方面做出更多努力。他能从头开始重建生活的次数是有限的。

paras.en: "We are all scared. I fear if El Niño comes, I won't come back again."
paras.zh: “我们都很害怕。我担心如果厄尔尼诺现象来了，我就不会再回来了。”

articles.title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的政党承认巴西选举失败，但他拒绝承认

paras.en: BRASILIA, Brazil — Brazil's Liberal Party, the party of defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, has acknowledged the results of Sunday's presidential election, recognizing incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's victory. But Bolsonaro himself has yet to formally concede defeat.
paras.zh: 巴西巴西利亚——落败的总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗所在的巴西自由党承认了周日总统选举的结果，承认现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦的胜利。但博尔索纳罗本人尚未正式承认失败。

paras.en: The party's president, Valdemar Costa Neto, said in a statement Monday that the party recognizes the election results but believes "questions raised about the vote" still need to be clarified.
paras.zh: 该党主席瓦尔德马·科斯塔·内托周一在一份声明中表示，该党承认选举结果，但认为“有关投票的问题”仍需要澄清。

paras.en: The concession came as President Trump questioned the election's legitimacy, telling reporters Monday, "I didn't take sides, but it looked like another rigged election." Trump offered no evidence of fraud.
paras.zh: 这一让步是在特朗普总统质疑选举的合法性之际做出的，他周一告诉记者，“我没有选边站队，但这看起来像是另一场被操纵的选举。”特朗普没有提供欺诈证据。

paras.en: Bolsonaro initially said he would seek to annul the election results, citing alleged irregularities, including a last-minute extension of voting hours.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗最初表示，他将寻求废除选举结果，理由是涉嫌违规行为，包括在最后一刻延长投票时间。

paras.en: On Sunday, the Supreme Court ordered polling stations to remain open for two additional hours, until 7 p.m., following an appeal by Lula's campaign, which cited public transportation disruptions. Bolsonaro's campaign also requested an extension, citing heavy rain in southern Brazil.
paras.zh: 周日，在卢拉竞选团队以公共交通中断为由提出上诉后，最高法院下令投票站再开放两个小时，直至晚上 7 点。博尔索纳罗的竞选团队也以巴西南部大雨为由，要求延期。

paras.en: In a video posted Monday, Bolsonaro shifted his approach, saying he would seek to have Lula's election victory disqualified over alleged abuses of political and economic power. "The law must apply to everyone," he said. "The competition must be fair and equal, which did not happen." Bolsonaro did not provide any evidence for this claim.
paras.zh: 在周一发布的一段视频中，博尔索纳罗改变了态度，表示他将寻求取消卢拉的选举胜利资格，理由是涉嫌滥用政治和经济权力。 “法律必须适用于所有人，”他说。 “竞争必须公平、平等，但这并没有发生。”博尔索纳罗没有为这一说法提供任何证据。

paras.en: Bolsonaro also said Brazil's Federal Police had ordered him to surrender his passports after he visited his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in Brasília.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗还表示，在他前往巴西利亚探望父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗后，巴西联邦警察命令他交出护照。

paras.en: The former far-right president is under house arrest after being sentenced to 27 years in prison for his role in the 2022 coup attempt against Lula.
paras.zh: 这位前极右翼总统因参与 2022 年针对卢拉的政变而被判处 27 年监禁，目前已被软禁。

paras.en: "I was ordered right on the street to hand over my passports, and I'm also prohibited from leaving the country," he said in the video. Bolsonaro said the order was based on remarks by his brother Eduardo, who lives in the U.S., suggesting he should leave Brazil if he lost the election. The passport order was issued by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes in connection with a separate investigation.
paras.zh: 他在视频中说：“我在街上被命令交出护照，而且还被禁止出境。”博尔索纳罗表示，该命令是基于他居住在美国的弟弟爱德华多的言论，他建议如果他输掉选举，他应该离开巴西。护照令是由最高法院法官亚历山大·德·莫赖斯根据一项单独调查发布的。

paras.en: Lula won just over 51% of the valid votes, or approximately 64.2 million, compared with more than 48%, or nearly 59.8 million, for Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卢拉赢得了略高于 51% 的有效选票，即约 6420 万张，而博尔索纳罗赢得了超过 48% 的有效选票，即近 5980 万张。

paras.en: The result marked a major comeback for Lula, who trailed his challenger in the first round, and put the breaks on a run of right-wing electoral victories in Latin America.
paras.zh: 这一结果标志着卢拉的重大逆转，他在第一轮落后于他的挑战者，并打破了拉丁美洲右翼选举的连胜。

paras.en: Lula's victory celebrations rang out across Brazil on Sunday night. Near downtown Rio de Janeiro, supporters hugged, shouted and sang the national anthem. Gains in major cities, including Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, helped Lula overcome his first-round defeat, along with support from younger, older and working-class voters.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，卢拉的胜利庆祝活动在巴西各地响起。在里约热内卢市中心附近，支持者拥抱、喊叫并高唱国歌。在里约热内卢和圣保罗等主要城市取得的胜利，以及年轻、年长和工薪阶层选民的支持，帮助卢拉克服了第一轮的失败。

paras.en: In his victory speech in São Paulo, Lula singled out young people who had helped mobilize support for his campaign.
paras.zh: 卢拉在圣保罗的胜利演讲中特别提到了帮助动员支持他竞选活动的年轻人。

paras.en: "I wanted to thank the Brazilian people for the generosity they have shown me for a long time," he said. "And in this second round, I want to thank the Brazilian youth for their generosity in taking to the streets. They took to the streets to defend democracy in the country."
paras.zh: “我要感谢巴西人民长期以来对我的慷慨，”他说。 “在第二轮中，我要感谢巴西年轻人走上街头的慷慨。他们走上街头捍卫国家的民主。”

paras.en: 17-year-old Brisa Pereira cast her first vote at a busy polling place in one of Brasília's sprawling suburbs. She said Lula's journey from poor factory worker to president had inspired her. She also wanted to send a message to Trump and what she described as his push to dominate Latin America.
paras.zh: 17 岁的布里萨·佩雷拉 (Brisa Pereira) 在巴西利亚广阔郊区的一个繁忙投票站投了她的第一票。她说，卢拉从贫穷的工厂工人到总统的经历激励了她。她还想向特朗普传达一个信息，以及她所描述的特朗普统治拉丁美洲的努力。

paras.en: "It's not the '90s anymore. We have rights, and Donald Trump can't speak for all of America," Pereira said.
paras.zh: “现在已经不再是 90 年代了。我们有权利，唐纳德·特朗普不能代表整个美国，”佩雷拉说。

paras.en: Lula had to win over voters across different demographic and geographic groups to defeat Bolsonaro. He gained more than 10 million additional votes compared with the first round, helped by increased turnout and support from voters who had backed other candidates or had previously stayed away from the polls.
paras.zh: 卢拉必须赢得不同人口和地理群体的选民才能击败博尔索纳罗。与第一轮相比，他获得了超过 1000 万张选票，这得益于投票率的增加以及支持其他候选人或之前没有参与投票的选民的支持。

paras.en: "No wonder pollsters said a Lula victory was almost impossible," said Thiago Vidal, a political analyst with Prospectiva consultants.
paras.zh: Prospectiva 顾问公司的政治分析师蒂亚戈·维达尔 (Thiago Vidal) 表示：“难怪民意测验专家表示卢拉获胜几乎是不可能的。”

paras.en: "This was a nationwide victory, a systemic victory — from top to bottom, and from left to right," Vidal said.
paras.zh: 维达尔说：“这是一场全国性的胜利，一场系统性的胜利——从上到下，从左到右。”

paras.en: The decisive margin gives Lula a mandate to govern, Vidal said, but the next four years will be challenging. Bolsonaro's Liberal Party made significant gains in Congress, leaving Lula facing a conservative opposition and a deeply divided electorate.
paras.zh: 维达尔表示，决定性的优势让卢拉获得了执政权，但未来四年将充满挑战。博尔索纳罗领导的自由党在国会取得重大进展，使卢拉面临保守派反对派和严重分裂的选民。

paras.en: Vidal said Lula also learned important lessons about communicating with voters, particularly through social media. The president, who had relied more heavily on traditional media, embraced a more digital campaign in the final weeks.
paras.zh: 维达尔说，卢拉还学到了与选民沟通的重要教训，特别是通过社交媒体。这位更加依赖传统媒体的总统在最后几周接受了更加数字化的竞选活动。

paras.en: "Part of that has to do with communication, and part of that therefore has to do with Lula, setting aside the traditional media and becoming more digital," Vidal said.
paras.zh: 维达尔说：“部分与沟通有关，因此部分与卢拉有关，抛开传统媒体并变得更加数字化。”

paras.en: Much of that shift was credited to André Janones, a congressman from the bellwether state of Minas Gerais who helped direct Lula's online campaign. Janones used Instagram and WhatsApp to reach younger voters and mobilize supporters. His WhatsApp channel, dubbed "Lula's Army," attracted over 10 million followers.
paras.zh: 这一转变很大程度上归功于安德烈·雅诺内斯（André Janones），他是来自领头羊米纳斯吉拉斯州的国会议员，帮助指导了卢拉的在线竞选活动。雅诺内斯使用 Instagram 和 WhatsApp 来接触年轻选民并动员支持者。他的 WhatsApp 频道被称为“卢拉军队”，吸引了超过 1000 万粉丝。

paras.en: In an election-night Instagram post, Janones captured the spirit of the celebrations with a message summing up the campaign: "Nothing is more powerful than when the people unite."
paras.zh: 在选举之夜的 Instagram 帖子中，雅诺内斯捕捉了庆祝活动的精神，并总结了竞选活动：“没有什么比人民团结起来更强大的了。”

articles.title: After her $523M horror film breakout, Inde Navarrette wants in on Taylor Sheridan's next project

paras.en: Hollywood's newest rising star Inde Navarrette wants to take her talents to the Taylor Sheridan universe.
paras.zh: 好莱坞新星因德·纳瓦雷特 (Inde Navarrette) 希望将她的才华带入泰勒·谢里丹 (Taylor Sheridan) 的世界。

paras.en: Navarrette's profile absolutely exploded in the entertainment industry after she starred in the recent horror film "Obsession."
paras.zh: 纳瓦雷特在出演最近的恐怖电影《痴迷》后，她的形象在娱乐界绝对爆炸了。

paras.en: The film earned more than $523 million globally, and it was a refreshing reminder that original ideas are what audiences want to spend their hard-earned money on.
paras.zh: 这部电影在全球的票房收入超过 5.23 亿美元，它令人耳目一新地提醒我们，观众愿意将辛苦赚来的钱花在原创创意上。

paras.en: With her profile growing at a monumental rate, Navarrette would like to link up with the most powerful man in entertainment:
paras.zh: 随着她的个人资料以惊人的速度增长，纳瓦雷特希望与娱乐界最有权势的人建立联系：

paras.en: "Obsession" star Inde Navarrette wants to be in Taylor Sheridan's "Call of Duty" film.
paras.zh: 《痴迷》主演因德·纳瓦雷特希望出演泰勒·谢里丹的《使命召唤》电影。

paras.en: Taylor Sheridan is writing the script for an upcoming "Call of Duty" film being directed by Peter Berg. Given the record both men have, expectations are sky-high for the film based on the popular video game franchise.
paras.zh: 泰勒·谢里丹正在为彼得·伯格执导的即将上映的《使命召唤》电影撰写剧本。考虑到两人的记录，人们对这部根据流行视频游戏系列改编的电影的期望很高。

paras.en: Navarrette would absolutely jump at the opportunity for a role in the film.
paras.zh: 纳瓦雷特绝对会抓住在电影中扮演角色的机会。

paras.en: She spoke with Collider about the upcoming project led by Sheridan and Berg and what it would take to convince her to join the cast.
paras.zh: 她与 Collider 讨论了谢里登和伯格即将领导的项目，以及如何说服她加入演员阵容。

paras.en: "Nothing. It's a phone call. It's a text. if they call me, they're like, 'There's a car outside. You gotta go.' Definitely. I'm a big fan. I'm really excited to see what they do. As a fan, I would be excited. I'm a big fan. Yeah. Very excited," she explained to the outlet the following.
paras.zh: “没什么。这是一个电话。这是一条短信。如果他们打电话给我，他们会说，‘外面有一辆车。你得走了。’绝对是。我是它的忠实粉丝。我很高兴看到他们所做的事情。作为粉丝，我会很兴奋。我是它的忠实粉丝。是的。非常兴奋，”她向媒体解释道。

paras.en: Sheridan is no stranger to working with major stars. Morgan Freeman, Kevin Costner, Sylvester Stallone, Nicole Kidman, Jeff Bridges, Chris Pine, Jeremy Renner, Zoe Saldaña, Sam Elliott, Kurt Russell and Michelle Pfeiffer are just some of the major names who have appeared in his projects.
paras.zh: 谢里丹对于与大牌明星合作并不陌生。摩根·弗里曼、凯文·科斯特纳、西尔维斯特·史泰龙、妮可·基德曼、杰夫·布里吉斯、克里斯·派恩、杰瑞米·雷纳、佐伊·萨尔达纳、萨姆·埃利奥特、库尔特·拉塞尔和米歇尔·菲佛只是出现在他的项目中的一些主要人物。

paras.en: Appearing in any Sheridan project would probably provide a major boost for Navarrette's already blossoming career.
paras.zh: 出现在谢里登的任何项目中都可能会为纳瓦雷特已经蓬勃发展的职业生涯提供重大推动。

paras.en: Would you like to see the "Obsession" star appear in "Call of Duty"? Let me know at David.Hookstead@outkick.com.
paras.zh: 你想看到“痴迷”明星出现在《使命召唤》中吗？请通过 David.Hookstead@outkick.com 联系我。

articles.title: Reporter caught in violent Paris protests recalls how 'all of a sudden, it exploded' after peaceful march

paras.en: A New York Post reporter caught in the chaos of violent protests in Paris recounted how a peaceful march of more than 100,000 people took a frightening turn.
paras.zh: 一名身陷巴黎暴力抗议混乱的《纽约邮报》记者讲述了10万多人的和平游行如何发生可怕的转变。

paras.en: "All of a sudden, it exploded," Gabrielle Fahmy recalled Tuesday on "Fox & Friends."
paras.zh: “突然间，它爆炸了，”加布里埃尔·法赫米周二在“福克斯与朋友”节目中回忆道。

paras.en: "When it got dark, when they reached the endpoint of the march, it's like they didn't know what to do anymore," she continued.
paras.zh: “当天黑时，当他们到达游行终点时，他们就好像不知道该做什么了，”她继续说道。

paras.en: "Tensions had been mounting. These new people I saw sort of joined the protest towards the end. We saw some people arrive by metro. They were dressed differently, hiding their faces. They had masks, and that's sort of when I could see things start to shift."
paras.zh: “紧张局势一直在加剧。我看到的这些新人在接近尾声时加入了抗议活动。我们看到一些人乘地铁到达。他们穿着不同，遮住了脸。他们戴着口罩，就在那时我可以看到事情开始发生变化。”

paras.en: Fahmy told co-host Brian Kilmeade the protests were peaceful for several hours, describing the transition from police leading the crowd to violence erupting in the streets as "very surreal."
paras.zh: 法赫米告诉联合主持人布莱恩·基尔米德，抗议活动平静地持续了几个小时，他形容从警察带领人群到街头爆发暴力的转变“非常超现实”。

paras.en: She said the newcomers appeared to be younger demonstrators, many in their late teens and early 20s, and suggested some might have been "factions of the far-left."
paras.zh: 她说，新来者似乎是年轻的示威者，其中许多人只有十几岁和二十岁出头，并暗示其中一些人可能是“极左派别”。

paras.en: The protests began as student-led demonstrations over teacher shortages and poor conditions at schools but have since evolved into a broader anti-government movement, with protesters voicing frustration over the cost of living and other grievances.
paras.zh: 抗议活动最初是学生主导的针对教师短缺和学校条件恶劣的示威活动，但后来演变成一场更广泛的反政府运动，抗议者表达了对生活成本的不满和其他不满。

paras.en: "The people there on Saturday, it was a general sort of cost of living that they were complaining about," Fahmy recalled.
paras.zh: “周六那里的人们抱怨的是普遍的生活成本，”法赫米回忆道。

paras.en: "There's not enough jobs, they're not making enough money, they can't afford to put food on the table. But also anti-government, they are fed up with Emmanuel Macron, who's on his way out anyway. But, it was just a very general, general reason."
paras.zh: “没有足够的工作机会，他们赚不到足够的钱，他们买不起食物。但也是反政府的，他们厌倦了埃马纽埃尔·马克龙，无论如何，他即将下台。但这只是一个非常普遍的原因。”

paras.en: Fahmy also recalled seeing Palestinian flags, noting that "everybody with a grievance" seemed to have joined the demonstrations.
paras.zh: 法赫米还回忆起看到巴勒斯坦国旗的情景，并指出“每个心怀不满的人”似乎都加入了示威活动。

paras.en: Separate protests have also turned violent in Rome and Albania's capital, Tirana, where demonstrators set government buildings on fire.
paras.zh: 罗马和阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那的单独抗议活动也演变成暴力活动，示威者放火焚烧政府大楼。

paras.en: Fox News' James Cirrone and Brittany Miller contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的詹姆斯·西罗恩和布列塔尼·米勒对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Serbia’s student movement topples Vucic’s party after 14 years, but political agenda remains unclear

paras.en: Serbia’s longtime leader, President Aleksandar Vucic, conceded defeat Sunday to the student-led opposition in an election that sent shock waves throughout Europe and the Western Balkans.
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚长期领导人、总统亚历山大·武契奇周日承认，在这场选举中输给了学生领导的反对派，这场选举震惊了整个欧洲和西巴尔干地区。

paras.en: "We do not have the final results yet, and many people will be surprised. Based on a stratified sample, it is clear that we have lost these elections. The student-led protest list has won," Vucic said in an address to the nation Sunday night.
paras.zh: “我们还没有最终结果，很多人会感到惊讶。根据分层样本，很明显我们输掉了这些选举。学生领导的抗议名单赢了，”武契奇周日晚上向全国发表讲话时说。

paras.en: The Student List victory brings an end to 14 years of Vucic and his Serbian Progressive Party rule, in what many are saying is the biggest political shake-up in the Balkans since the toppling of Yugoslav dictator Slobodan Milosevic in 2000.
paras.zh: 学生名单的胜利结束了武契奇和他的塞尔维亚进步党14年的统治，许多人认为这是自2000年南斯拉夫独裁者斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇被推翻以来巴尔干地区最大的政治动荡。

paras.en: Observers say the Student List party's policies remain vague, which has some worried about Serbia's future.
paras.zh: 观察人士表示，学生名单党的政策仍然含糊不清，这让一些人对塞尔维亚的未来感到担忧。

paras.en: Ana Brnabic, vice president of the main Board of the Serbian Progressive Party, told Fox News Digital that, "The election victory of the Student List recalls similar electoral triumphs in other countries. The Student List represents a classical anti-establishment movement: it had neither a program nor a coherent political ideology. In an essentially anarchic fashion, it opposed everything, claiming to fight for justice and against corruption."
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚进步党中央委员会副主席安娜·布尔纳比奇向福克斯新闻数字频道表示，“学生名单的选举胜利让人回想起其他国家类似的选举胜利。学生名单代表了一场经典的反建制运动：它既没有纲领，也没有连贯的政治意识形态。它以一种本质上无政府主义的方式反对一切，声称为正义和反腐败而战。”

paras.en: She added, "After 14 years of Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) rule, people may have wanted change. That is understandable and logical. But the grim consequences of this movement in power will soon become apparent."
paras.zh: 她补充道，“经过塞尔维亚进步党（SNS）14年的统治，人们可能想要改变。这是可以理解的，也是合乎逻辑的。但这场权力运动的严峻后果很快就会显现出来。”

paras.en: Turnout reached 69 %, the highest this century, with more than 4.4 million people casting their ballots, according to Rasa Nedeljkov, head of the CRTA Election Observation Mission.
paras.zh: CRTA 选举观察团团长 Rasa Nedeljkov 表示，投票率达到 69%，是本世纪最高的，有超过 440 万人投票。

paras.en: "This is by all means a historic victory and indeed a surprise to many. While it was clear from the beginning that the students will have an impressive result, very few expected a landslide," Helena Ivanov, associate fellow at the Henry Jackson Society, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 亨利·杰克逊协会副研究员海伦娜·伊万诺夫（Helena Ivanov）告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“这无论如何都是一次历史性的胜利，确实让许多人感到惊讶。虽然从一开始就很明显学生们将取得令人印象深刻的成绩，但很少有人预料到会取得压倒性胜利。”

paras.en: The Election Observation Mission reported that the Student List won 52.45 % of the vote and is projected to hold 138 of 250 seats in the National Assembly, an absolute majority, allowing it to form a government on its own.
paras.zh: 选举观察团报告称，学生名单赢得了52.45%的选票，预计将在国民议会250个席位中占据138个席位，占绝对多数，使其能够独立组建政府。

paras.en: Vucic won 39.2 % and is projected to hold 103 seats.
paras.zh: 武契奇赢得 39.2%，预计将获得 103 个席位。

paras.en: Supporters celebrated throughout Belgrade and across Serbia as it became clear the Student List won by a larger margin that caught many experts and observers by surprise.
paras.zh: 整个贝尔格莱德和整个塞尔维亚的支持者都在庆祝，因为很明显学生名单以更大的优势获胜，这让许多专家和观察家感到惊讶。

paras.en: Many claimed they were concerned about the possibility of violence escalating as polls began to close. Almost two hours after polling stations closed, Vucic addressed the nation, confirming his defeat and announcing the peaceful transfer of power.
paras.zh: 许多人声称，随着投票开始结束，他们担心暴力事件可能升级。投票站关闭近两个小时后，武契奇向全国发表讲话，确认自己失败并宣布权力和平移交。

paras.en: "The path to an electoral victory with such a decisive margin will undoubtedly earn its own chapter in the handbooks on how to topple an autocrat. Two years of unprecedented grassroots mobilization, creative organization and impeccable campaigning kept the student list two steps ahead of the regime. Vučić was left playing catch-up, and all his attempts to co-opt, demoralize and fragment the movement failed," Sinisa Vukovic, director of the Global Policy Program at the School of Advanced International Studies at Johns Hopkins University, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 高级国际学院全球政策项目主任西尼萨·武科维奇表示：“以如此决定性的优势赢得选举胜利的道路无疑将在如何推翻独裁者的手册中占有一章。两年来前所未有的基层动员、创造性的组织和无可挑剔的竞选活动使学生名单领先政权两步。武契奇只能追赶，他所有拉拢、瓦解和分裂运动的尝试都失败了。”约翰·霍普金斯大学的研究告诉福克斯数字新闻。

paras.en: The CRTA Election Observation Mission reported that the campaign was marked by the abuse of state resources, pressure on candidates and voters, attempts to bring the media under total government control, and attacks on independent election observers.
paras.zh: CRTA 选举观察团报告称，这场竞选活动的特点是滥用国家资源、对候选人和选民施压、试图将媒体置于政府的全面控制之下，以及对独立选举观察员的攻击。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of Serbians volunteered to run and monitor polling stations across the country, and the vote was mostly peaceful.
paras.zh: 数万名塞尔维亚人自愿管理和监督全国各地的投票站，投票大多是和平的。

paras.en: Student led protests marched in the streets for two years after the deaths of 16 people following the collapse of a railway station in the town of Novi Sad in November 2024. People had taken to the streets, demanding justice for those killed and accountability for anyone responsible for the disaster.
paras.zh: 2024 年 11 月诺维萨德镇火车站倒塌导致 16 人死亡，学生领导的街头抗议活动持续了两年。人们走上街头，要求为遇难者伸张正义，并追究对这场灾难负有责任的人的责任。

paras.en: The momentum of nearly two years of street demonstrations culminated in a nationwide movement ready for change. The political novices were able to rally the nation behind a simple message against corruption and state capture.
paras.zh: 近两年的街头示威势头最终演变成一场准备变革的全国性运动。这些政治新手能够将全国团结起来，传达反对腐败和国家掠夺的简单信息。

paras.en: Serbs across the country embraced the Student List, who are viewed as fresh faces in politics and are not tied to Serbia’s traditional political opposition, which is perceived as ineffective and corrupt by a lot of the voters.
paras.zh: 全国各地的塞尔维亚人都欢迎学生名单，他们被视为政界的新鲜面孔，并且与塞尔维亚传统的政治反对派无关，许多选民认为塞尔维亚传统的政治反对派效率低下且腐败。

paras.en: Milos Jevtic, a 48-year-old professor with the Faculty of Organizational Sciences at the University of Belgrade, was among the many Student List candidates who won a seat in parliament.
paras.zh: 贝尔格莱德大学组织科学学院 48 岁教授米洛斯·耶夫蒂奇 (Milos Jevtic) 是众多赢得议会席位的学生名单候选人之一。

paras.en: Jevtic told Fox News Digital that their victory came from the values that the students have stood for from the very beginning: expertise, professionalism, responsibility, solidarity and unity.
paras.zh: 耶夫蒂奇告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，他们的胜利来自于学生们从一开始就坚持的价值观：专业知识、专业精神、责任感、团结和团结。

paras.en: "What is particularly important is that the students have never compromised on these values and principles. Of course, widespread public dissatisfaction also played a major role, along with a lack of trust in both the current regime and the opposition parties," Jevtic explained.
paras.zh: “特别重要的是，学生们从未在这些价值观和原则上妥协。当然，公众普遍的不满情绪以及对现政权和反对党缺乏信任也发挥了重要作用，”耶夫提奇解释道。

paras.en: Jevtic said he believes the priorities for the new Student List-run government should be economic stability, fighting corruption, establishing the rule of law and strengthening institutions, much of what carried the student-led protests since 2024.
paras.zh: 杰夫蒂克表示，他认为新的学生名单政府的首要任务应该是经济稳定、打击腐败、建立法治和加强机构，这些都是 2024 年以来学生主导的抗议活动的主要内容。

paras.en: "The ultimate goal is to build a system in which institutions function in the interests of all citizens," Jevtic said.
paras.zh: 耶夫蒂克说：“最终目标是建立一个制度，让各机构为所有公民的利益发挥作用。”

paras.en: On foreign policy, there is an expectation that there will be a certain degree of continuity with the Vucic administration in international relations, including maintaining good relations with neighboring European countries and all major international partners.
paras.zh: 在外交政策上，人们期望在国际关系上与武契奇政府保持一定程度的连续性，包括与欧洲邻国和所有主要国际伙伴保持良好关系。

paras.en: But Brnabic warned that "Serbia has lost meaningful political pluralism. After 35 years of a multiparty system, the country is effectively left with one established political party, SNS, while the rest of the political scene is dominated by largely unknown movements without a clear ideology. This is catastrophic for any parliamentary democracy."
paras.zh: 但布尔纳比奇警告说，“塞尔维亚已经失去了有意义的政治多元化。经过35年的多党制，该国实际上只剩下一个既定的政党——SNS，而政治舞台的其余部分则由基本上不为人知的运动主导，没有明确的意识形态。这对任何议会民主制来说都是灾难性的。”

paras.en: She added, "Secondly, nobody in Serbia knows where the country is heading. Are we firmly pro-EU? Will we maintain our ties with Russia? What about China? Will we continue to enhance our relations with the United States — which was a priority of Aleksandar Vucic? Will economic policy be more left-liberal or conservative? Are we heading towards a woke liberal society, or will we preserve our traditional Orthodox Christian values? There are no clear answers to any of these questions."
paras.zh: 她补充道，“其次，塞尔维亚没有人知道这个国家的发展方向。我们是坚定支持欧盟吗？我们会维持与俄罗斯的关系吗？中国呢？我们会继续加强与美国的关系——这是亚历山大·武契奇的优先事项吗？经济政策会更加左翼自由还是更加保守？我们是走向一个觉醒的自由社会，还是会保留我们传统的东正教价值观？这些问题都没有明确的答案。”

paras.en: She concluded by noting, "We have also called for Parliament and all state institutions to be constituted as soon as possible, so that the country has functioning institutions on which people can rely. We will be a strong but constructive opposition. We call on the Student List’s representatives to end the intimidation and assume the responsibility entrusted to them by the voters."
paras.zh: 她最后指出，“我们还呼吁尽快组建议会和所有国家机构，以便国家拥有人民可以依赖的运转良好的机构。我们将成为强有力但建设性的反对派。我们呼吁学生名单的代表停止恐吓，承担起选民赋予他们的责任。”

articles.title: US military says strike on alleged drug vessel in eastern Pacific kills five people
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: The US military said on Tuesday it killed five people after an airstrike on a suspected drug-trafficking vessel in the eastern Pacific.
paras.zh: 美国军方周二表示，在东太平洋对一艘涉嫌贩毒的船只进行空袭后，造成五人死亡。

paras.en: Tuesday’s strike was among more than 70 such attacks since the beginning of Donald Trump’s second presidency, according to media tallies. Collectively, they have killed more than 240 people.
paras.zh: 据媒体统计，自唐纳德·特朗普就任第二任总统以来，周二发生的袭击事件已超过 70 起。他们总共杀死了 240 多人。

paras.en: The Trump administration has maintained the people and boats were involved in trafficking. Trump has said the US is locked in armed conflict with Latin American cartels while justifying strikes as necessary to stem the flow of drugs into the US.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府坚称这些人和船只参与了贩运活动。特朗普表示，美国与拉丁美洲贩毒集团陷入武装冲突，同时为阻止毒品流入美国而采取必要的打击行动。

paras.en: But the Trump administration has not provided definitive evidence to back up its contentions of drug trafficking and has prompted debate about the legality of the strikes.
paras.zh: 但特朗普政府尚未提供明确的证据来支持其贩毒论点，并引发了有关袭击合法性的争论。

paras.en: Legal experts and rights groups argue the strikes could amount to extrajudicial killings because they have apparently targeted civilians who do not pose an immediate threat to the US.
paras.zh: 法律专家和人权组织认为，这些袭击可能构成法外处决，因为他们显然针对的是不会对美国构成直接威胁的平民。

paras.en: Reuters, the Associated Press and Agence France-Presse contributed reporting
paras.zh: 路透社、美联社和法新社提供报道

articles.title: Oleshky truce appears to hold as two European leaders have ‘frank’ call with Putin
articles.author: Luke Harding and Pjotr Sauer

paras.en: A local ceasefire in a southern Ukrainian city under Russian occupation appeared to be holding on Tuesday, with both sides ceasing drone attacks ahead of an apparent evacuation of about 2,000 trapped and desperate civilians.
paras.zh: 周二，俄罗斯占领下的乌克兰南部城市的局部停火似乎得以实现，双方停止了无人机袭击，随后约 2000 名被困绝望的平民明显撤离。

paras.en: The temporary truce began at 3am in Russian-controlled Oleshky. The city sits on the Dnipro River and is about 3 miles (5km) from Kherson, a larger city on the opposite bank. Ukrainian troops recaptured Kherson in autumn 2022.
paras.zh: 临时休战于凌晨 3 点在俄罗斯控制的奥列什基开始。该城市坐落在第聂伯河沿岸，距离对岸较大的城市赫尔松约 3 英里（5 公里）。乌克兰军队于 2022 年秋季收复赫尔松。

paras.en: Witnesses reported that the deadly frontline across the river was quiet for the first time in four years. The pause in fighting is due to last until 11pm on Sunday, Ukrainian officials said, and represents a significant if limited moment of de-escalation.
paras.zh: 目击者称，河对岸的致命前线四年来首次陷入平静。乌克兰官员表示，战斗暂停将持续到周日晚上 11 点，这代表着紧张局势缓和的一个重要但有限的时刻。

paras.en: Finland’s president, Alexander Stubb, and Norway’s prime minister, Jonas Gahr Støre, held what they described as a “frank and substantive” phone call with Vladimir Putin about efforts to end the war in Ukraine. Støre indicated afterwards that big differences remained.
paras.zh: 芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布和挪威首相乔纳斯·加尔·斯托尔与弗拉基米尔·普京就结束乌克兰战争的努力进行了“坦诚而实质性”的通话。斯托尔事后指出，仍然存在很大差异。

paras.en: The two Nordic leaders said the call – a rare instance of direct contact between Putin and western leaders – was linked to upcoming talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US, expected to take place in Abu Dhabi next month.
paras.zh: 两位北欧领导人表示，这次通话是普京与西方领导人之间罕见的直接接触，与俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国即将举行的会谈有关，会谈预计将于下个月在阿布扎比举行。

paras.en: The ceasefire in Oleshky appears to be an attempt by the Kremlin to curry favour with Donald Trump before the trilateral meeting and next week’s US midterm elections. The first lady, Melania Trump, requested the humanitarian mission, and in a post on X said it was brought forward by two days to allow the delivery of critical aid.
paras.zh: 奥列什基停火似乎是克里姆林宫试图在三边会议和下周美国中期选举之前讨好唐纳德·特朗普。第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普请求执行人道主义任务，并在 X 上发帖表示，任务提前了两天，以便运送关键援助物资。

paras.en: Its geographical scope had been extended beyond Oleshky “within the Kherson region”, she added, to provide safe passage for convoys. Calls for a ceasefire were also issued by Pope Leo, the United Nations, EU officials and the Council of Europe.
paras.zh: 她补充说，其地理范围已超出奥列什基“赫尔松地区内”的范围，以便为车队提供安全通道。教皇利奥、联合国、欧盟官员和欧洲委员会也呼吁停火。

paras.en: Between 1,500 and 2,000 people in the city have been living under a complete blockade by Russia. The last delivery of food to stores was in May, and many people are now starving and eating weeds. The Ukrainian military has airdropped food using drones but locals say Russian security forces detain anyone who takes it.
paras.zh: 该市有1500至2000人一直生活在俄罗斯的全面封锁之下。上次向商店运送食物是在五月份，许多人现在正在挨饿并吃杂草。乌克兰军方使用无人机空投食物，但当地人称俄罗斯安全部队拘留了任何拿走食物的人。

paras.en: Russian soldiers have mined roads and use ruined buildings to coordinate round-the-clock strikes against Kherson. Some Oleshky residents have managed to escape, walking or cycling past bodies lying on the street and the burnt-out shells of vehicles.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯士兵在道路上埋设地雷，并利用毁坏的建筑物来协调对赫尔松的全天候打击。一些奥列什基居民设法逃脱，步行或骑自行车经过街上的尸体和烧毁的车辆外壳。

paras.en: Ukrainian observers say the Kremlin is planning a major propaganda tour this week in which Kyiv is blamed for Oleshky’s destruction. Trump-supporting US media channels have been invited to witness the evacuation, in which buses will take residents to occupied Crimea and Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰观察家表示，克里姆林宫计划本周进行一次大型宣传巡演，其中基辅被指责为奥列什基的破坏事件。支持特朗普的美国媒体渠道已被邀请见证这次疏散，巴士将把居民送往被占领的克里米亚和俄罗斯。

paras.en: Ksenia Arkhipova, who fled the city in 2022 and now, as a volunteer, helps others leave, said some residents have told her they fear Russian officials may “filter out” evacuees with pro-Ukraine views.
paras.zh: 克塞尼亚·阿尔希波娃 (Ksenia Arkhipova) 于 2022 年逃离该市，现在作为志愿者帮助其他人离开。她说，一些居民告诉她，他们担心俄罗斯官员可能会“过滤掉”持亲乌克兰观点的撤离者。

paras.en: “People say they are genuinely afraid that the Russians will check their phones and look for evidence of Ukrainian relatives or ties to the Armed Forces of Ukraine – something they have done repeatedly in other occupied territories,” Arkhipova told the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 阿尔希波娃告诉美联社：“人们说，他们真的担心俄罗斯人会检查他们的手机，寻找乌克兰亲属或与乌克兰武装部队有联系的证据——他们在其他被占领土上多次这样做过。”

paras.en: The ceasefire does not extend to other parts of Ukraine. Overnight, Russia bombarded Kyiv with drones and ballistic missiles, killing at least one person and injuring 15. It hit a university campus, wounding students, as well as a bridge over the Dnipro and metro infrastructure. Ten other regions came under fire.
paras.zh: 停火协议并未延伸至乌克兰其他地区。一夜之间，俄罗斯用无人机和弹道导弹轰炸了基辅，造成至少 1 人死亡、15 人受伤。飞机袭击了一所大学校园，造成学生受伤，还击中了第聂伯河上的一座桥梁和地铁基础设施。其他十个地区也受到攻击。

paras.en: The bridge remains closed to traffic, but some commuters walked across it to get to work. Writing on social media, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia “must stop dragging out this war” and said he welcomed European attempts to end it.
paras.zh: 这座桥仍然禁止通行，但一些通勤者步行穿过它去上班。弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在社交媒体上写道，俄罗斯“必须停止拖延这场战争”，并表示他欢迎欧洲结束这场战争的努力。

paras.en: He said Stubb and Støre had briefed him on their call with Putin. “Alex and Jonas clearly conveyed to the Russian leadership the need for genuine steps towards de-escalation, particularly when it comes to our energy sector and infrastructure,” Zelenskyy wrote.
paras.zh: 他说斯塔布和斯托雷向他通报了他们与普京的通话情况。泽伦斯基写道：“亚历克斯和乔纳斯明确向俄罗斯领导层传达了采取真正步骤缓和局势的必要性，特别是在我们的能源部门和基础设施方面。”

paras.en: The Finnish-Norwegian initiative comes amid growing efforts by some European nations to establish a direct channel of communication with Moscow and secure a stronger European voice in negotiations. Stubb and Støre said they took part in the call as leaders of their respective countries and were not speaking on behalf of Europe as a whole.
paras.zh: 芬兰和挪威的倡议是在一些欧洲国家不断努力建立与莫斯科的直接沟通渠道并确保欧洲在谈判中拥有更强有力的声音的背景下提出的。斯塔布和斯托尔表示，他们作为各自国家的领导人参加了这次电话会议，并不代表整个欧洲发言。

paras.en: European governments remain divided over whether direct engagement with Putin is worthwhile, given Russia’s maximalist demands remain stubbornly unchanged. There is little agreement on who should lead such talks. Stubb is seen by some EU officials as a candidate.
paras.zh: 鉴于俄罗斯的最高要求仍然顽固地保持不变，欧洲各国政府对于与普京直接接触是否值得存在分歧。对于谁应该领导此类会谈几乎没有达成一致。一些欧盟官员将斯塔布视为候选人。

paras.en: The divisions were laid bare shortly after news of the call emerged, when Denmark’s prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, criticised the move. “I am very sceptical about this independent initiative by Norway and Finland. It was not agreed with any of us,” Frederiksen said.
paras.zh: 这一呼吁的消息传出后不久，丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森(Mette Frederiksen)批评了此举，分歧就暴露无遗。 “我对挪威和芬兰的这项独立倡议非常怀疑。我们没有人同意它，”弗雷德里克森说。

paras.en: She added: “I see no signs that Russia wants peace with Europe – neither in the hybrid warfare it wages every day, nor in Ukraine, where brutal and aggressive strikes continue daily, claiming many lives.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“我没有看到任何迹象表明俄罗斯希望与欧洲实现和平——无论是在它每天发动的混合战争中，还是在乌克兰，那里每天都在发生残酷和侵略性的袭击，夺去了许多人的生命。”

paras.en: Russia’s foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, said the Europeans had offered “nothing new”, and were simply trying to insert themselves in the negotiation process.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫表示，欧洲人没有提出“任何新内容”，只是试图介入谈判进程。

paras.en: This month Putin said he was willing to resume peace talks, but only on Russia’s hardline terms. They include the handover of the entire eastern Donbas region, including parts Russia has been unable to seize since 2014, as well as further territory in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia provinces.
paras.zh: 普京本月表示，他愿意恢复和谈，但前提是俄罗斯提出强硬条件。其中包括移交整个顿巴斯东部地区，包括俄罗斯自2014年以来无法夺取的部分地区，以及赫尔松省和扎波罗热省的更多领土。

paras.en: Last week Zelenskyy said he was open to a peace agreement that would freeze the war along the current frontlines. “Yes, we are ready to stop this war as soon as possible,” he said in an interview with ABC News. He made clear that Ukraine would not recognise land seized and occupied by Russia as Russian.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基上周表示，他对一项和平协议持开放态度，该协议将冻结当前前线的战争。 “是的，我们准备尽快停止这场战争，”他在接受美国广播公司新闻采访时说。他明确表示，乌克兰不会承认俄罗斯夺取和占领的土地是俄罗斯的。

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro flees Brazil after presidential election loss, reports say
articles.author: Tiago Rogero in Brasília and Tom Phillips in São Paulo

paras.en: The far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro has reportedly fled Brazil and is on his way to the United States after losing Sunday’s presidential election to the leftwing incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
paras.zh: 据报道，极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在周日的总统选举中输给左翼现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦后，已逃离巴西，前往美国。

paras.en: A report by the news website Metrópoles, citing people close to the politician’s family, said he was en route to the US. “The plane is in flight,” Metrópoles reported, without making clear where it had departed from.
paras.zh: 新闻网站Metrópoles援引这位政治家家人的知情人士的话报道说，他正在前往美国的途中。梅特罗波尔斯报道称：“飞机正在飞行中”，但没有明确说明飞机是从哪里起飞的。

paras.en: Bolsonaro allies told Metrópoles that he would land in Florida on Tuesday afternoon and planned to request political asylum. “The Donald Trump administration has been informed,” the website added.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的盟友告诉大都会报，他将于周二下午抵达佛罗里达州，并计划申请政治庇护。该网站补充道：“唐纳德·特朗普政府已获悉。”

paras.en: Allies also confirmed to the Folha de S Paulo newspaper that he was on his way to the US, and said the escape plan had been “organized and enabled by a lawyer close to the Bolsonaro clan”.
paras.zh: 盟友还向《圣保罗页报》证实，他正在前往美国的途中，并表示逃跑计划是“由一位与博尔索纳罗家族关系密切的律师组织和促成的”。

paras.en: “They say the flight should land in a few hours,” the newspaper added.
paras.zh: “他们说航班将在几个小时内降落，”该报补充道。

paras.en: The news network CNN Brasil reported that Bolsonaro had fled to the US with his wife and two daughters in the early hours of this morning.
paras.zh: 据CNN巴西新闻网报道，博尔索纳罗今天凌晨与妻子和两个女儿逃往美国。

paras.en: Bolsonaro had not been seen since Monday and missed a Tuesday-morning deadline to hand his passport to the federal police, fuelling rumours that he may have fled Brazil after losing on Sunday.
paras.zh: 自周一以来，博尔索纳罗就再也没有出现过，并且错过了周二上午将护照交给联邦警察的最后期限，这加剧了有关他在周日落败后可能逃离巴西的谣言。

paras.en: A report in the Brazilian newspaper O Globo said that during a meeting with friends and lawyers on Monday, the defeated candidate had appeared “possessed and made it clear he was afraid of being arrested”.
paras.zh: 巴西《环球报》的一篇报道称，在周一与朋友和律师的会面中，落选的候选人显得“着魔了，并明确表示他害怕被捕”。

paras.en: A supreme court justice cancelled Bolsonaro’s passport minutes after the result in a ruling related to a criminal case against the senator. He had until 11am to surrender the document to the federal police, but did not appear.
paras.zh: 最高法院法官在针对博尔索纳罗的刑事案件作出裁决后几分钟就取消了他的护照。他必须在上午 11 点之前将文件交给联邦警察，但他没有出现。

paras.en: The Argentinian news website Infobae reported that on Monday night he reportedly fled to Argentina, where he was expected to board a private jet in Puerto Iguazú bound for the US, but the plane did not take off.
paras.zh: 阿根廷新闻网站Infobae报道称，周一晚间，据报道他逃往阿根廷，预计他将在伊瓜苏港登上一架飞往美国的私人飞机，但飞机没有起飞。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, who has yet to concede defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, posted a video on Monday in which, commenting on the cancellation of his passport, he said: “I never thought about leaving the country.”
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗尚未承认输给路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦，他周一发布了一段视频，在评论他的护照被取消时，他说：“我从未想过离开这个国家。”

paras.en: One of the senator’s brothers, the former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, who is in self-imposed exile in the US, had said in an interview last Friday that his brother should leave Brazil if he lost.
paras.zh: 这位参议员的兄弟之一、目前在美国自我流亡的前国会议员爱德华多·博索纳罗(Eduardo Bolsonaro)上周五在接受采访时表示，如果他失败了，他的兄弟应该离开巴西。

paras.en: The Brazilian newspaper Folha de S Paulo reported that allies in the Bolsonaro family’s inner circle had been told that he had indeed left for Argentina and intended to travel from there to the US.
paras.zh: 巴西《圣保罗页报》报道称，博尔索纳罗家族的核心盟友被告知，他确实已前往阿根廷，并打算从那里前往美国。

paras.en: As there is no record of him passing through any regular Brazilian immigration checkpoint, the federal police are trying to establish from Argentinian authorities whether there is any record of him entering the country.
paras.zh: 由于没有他通过巴西任何常规移民检查站的记录，联邦警察正在试图向阿根廷当局确认是否有他进入该国的记录。

paras.en: The Argentinian channel Todo Noticias reported that the senator had reportedly crossed the border into Argentina on foot and abandoned plans to board the plane once news of his movements leaked.
paras.zh: 阿根廷《消息报》频道报道称，据报道，这位参议员步行越过边境进入阿根廷，并在其行踪消息泄露后放弃了登机计划。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was told to surrender his passport over a criminal case in which the federal police are investigating him for possible involvement in a money-laundering scheme worth about £680m ($905m) involving betting companies.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗因一起刑事案件被告知交出护照，联邦警察正在调查他可能参与涉及博彩公司的价值约 6.8 亿英镑（合 9.05 亿美元）的洗钱计划。

paras.en: The senator’s possible flight makes the future of the far right after the presidential election even more uncertain. The family patriarch, Jair Bolsonaro, is under house arrest for attempting a coup, and one of his sons is in the US and the whereabouts of another unclear.
paras.zh: 参议员可能的出逃使得总统选举后极右翼的未来更加不确定。该家族族长雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗因企图政变而被软禁，他的一个儿子在美国，另一个儿子下落不明。

paras.en: Eduardo Bolsonaro has an outstanding arrest warrant against him in Brazil, after being sentenced to four years in prison for trying to interfere in his father’s trial by lobbying Donald Trump to impose sanctions on the justices hearing the case.
paras.zh: 爱德华多·博尔索纳罗在巴西因试图游说唐纳德·特朗普对审理此案的法官实施制裁而干预其父亲的审判而被判处四年监禁，目前尚未对他发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Political scientist Magna Inácio, a professor at the Federal University of Minas Gerais, believes a power vacuum may now emerge within the right.
paras.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯联邦大学教授、政治学家麦格纳·伊纳西奥认为，右翼内部现在可能出现权力真空。

paras.en: “The resistance of Brazilian voters to handing victory to this more extremist camp sends a signal that the right leadership is now up for grabs,” she said.
paras.zh: “巴西选民抵制将胜利交给这个更加极端主义的阵营，这发出了一个信号，即正确的领导层现在正在等待争夺，”她说。

paras.en: Since Jair Bolsonaro, then a career congressman with few laws to his name, surprisingly won the presidency in 2018, there has effectively been no right wing in Brazil, only the far-right Bolsonarismo movement.
paras.zh: 贾尔·博尔索纳罗（Jair Bolsonaro）当时是一名职业国会议员，名下几乎没有什么法律，但自从他在 2018 年出人意料地赢得总统职位以来，巴西实际上已经没有右翼了，只有极右翼的博尔索纳主义运动。

paras.en: Camila Rocha, a political scientist who studies Brazil’s new right, believes the fact that three Bolsonaros are now potentially out of the picture could trigger a “shift in power” away from blood ties.
paras.zh: 研究巴西新右翼的政治学家卡米拉·罗查 (Camila Rocha) 认为，三名博尔索纳罗现在有可能退出这一事实，这可能会引发血缘关系的“权力转移”。

paras.en: “I think there is a tendency for power to move away from the sons,” said Rocha, noting that before the election, polls showed Jair Bolsonaro supporters preferred other potential candidates over his eldest son, including Jair Bolsonaro’s wife, Michelle Bolsonaro, who was recently elected senator, and the São Paulo governor, Tarcísio de Freitas.
paras.zh: 罗查表示：“我认为权力有从儿子手中转移的趋势。”他指出，选举前的民意调查显示，雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的支持者更喜欢其他潜在候选人，而不是他的长子，其中包括雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的妻子、最近当选参议员的米歇尔·博尔索纳罗和圣保罗州长塔尔西西奥·德弗雷塔斯。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro reportedly did not want to run because he thought a presidential campaign would turn his life into “hell”, and believed his re-election to the senate was assured. But with Eduardo, his father’s “plan A”, now living in the US, the senator was chosen to run.
paras.zh: 据报道，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗不想参选，因为他认为总统竞选会让他的生活变成“地狱”，并相信他将再次当选参议员。但随着他父亲的“A计划”爱德华多现在居住在美国，这位参议员被选为参选人。

paras.en: Most observers agree that Flávio lacks his father’s charisma. He had a 24-year political career in which he passed very few laws as a state legislator and senator, and the only previous time he ran for executive office was for mayor of Rio de Janeiro in 2016, when he fainted during a televised debate and finished fourth.
paras.zh: 大多数观察家都认为弗拉维奥缺乏他父亲的魅力。他拥有 24 年的政治生涯，作为州议员和参议员，通过的法律很少。他上一次竞选行政职务是 2016 年竞选里约热内卢市长，当时他在电视辩论中晕倒，最终获得第四名。

paras.en: Even in a family frequently embroiled in legal trouble he stood out, facing longstanding criminal allegations, including suspicions that he embezzled part of his staff’s salaries, as well as more recent accusations.
paras.zh: 即使在一个经常卷入法律纠纷的家庭中，他也脱颖而出，面临着长期的刑事指控，包括怀疑他挪用部分员工工资，以及最近的指控。

paras.en: Even so, 48.21% of Brazilians voted for Flávio Bolsonaro on Sunday, which many analysts see as both an anti-Lula vote and a vote for whomever Jair Bolsonaro had chosen.
paras.zh: 即便如此，周日仍有 48.21% 的巴西人投票支持弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，许多分析人士认为，这既是反对卢拉的投票，也是对雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗选择的人的投票。

paras.en: Inácio believes the struggle over the Bolsonaro legacy will also play out among family members who remain in Brazil, including Michelle and Bolsonaro’s other political sons, the senator-elect Carlos Bolsonaro and congressman-elect Jair Renan Bolsonaro, who publicly do not get along with their stepmother.
paras.zh: 伊纳西奥认为，围绕博尔索纳罗遗产的斗争也将在留在巴西的家庭成员中展开，包括米歇尔和博尔索纳罗的其他政治儿子、当选参议员卡洛斯·博尔索纳罗和当选国会议员贾尔·雷南·博尔索纳罗，他们在公开场合与继母相处不睦。

paras.en: “Michelle clearly has a political project of her own, but she is likely to face strong resistance from the two stepsons who are in congress. It is only a matter of time before tensions between them grow,” said the political scientist.
paras.zh: 这位政治学家表示：“米歇尔显然有自己的政治计划，但她可能会面临国会中两个继子的强烈抵制。他们之间的紧张关系加剧只是时间问题。”

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's passports cancelled after he fails to surrender them

paras.en: Police in Brazil say they have cancelled the passports of the defeated right-wing presidential candidate, FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro, after he failed to comply with an order to surrender the documents.
paras.zh: 巴西警方表示，因失败的右翼总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗未能遵守交出文件的命令，他们已取消了他的护照。

paras.en: On Monday, the Supreme Court ordered Bolsonaro to hand his passports over to police within 24 hours as part of an investigation into alleged money laundering, which he denies.
paras.zh: 周一，最高法院命令博尔索纳罗在 24 小时内将护照交给警方，作为洗钱指控调查的一部分，但博尔索纳罗否认了这一点。

paras.en: At the time, Bolsonaro said he had no plans to leave the country, and insisted that he would stay in Brazil to lead the opposition to his left-wing rival, President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva.
paras.zh: 当时，博尔索纳罗表示，他没有离开巴西的计划，并坚称他将留在巴西，领导反对派反对他的左翼竞争对手、总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦。

paras.en: However, the deadline has passed without the senator surrendering the passports, prompting speculation he may have left the country.
paras.zh: 然而，截止日期已过，参议员仍未交出护照，这引发了人们对他可能已离开该国的猜测。

paras.en: Federal officers are checking border crossings to establish if Bolsonaro may have travelled to neighbouring Argentina, according to a police source consulted by BBC News Brasil.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司巴西新闻部咨询的警方消息人士透露，联邦官员正在检查边境口岸，以确定博尔索纳罗是否可能前往邻国阿根廷。

paras.en: However, Argentine authorities have told the BBC there is no record of Bolsonaro entering their country through any border crossing.
paras.zh: 然而，阿根廷当局告诉英国广播公司，没有博尔索纳罗通过任何过境点进入阿根廷的记录。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was already under investigation for alleged corruption over the financing of a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted of plotting a coup and is under house arrest.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗已经因涉嫌为其父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的电影融资而受到调查，博尔索纳罗因策划政变而被定罪，目前被软禁。

paras.en: In addition to that investigation, Brazil's Supreme Court ordered police on Tuesday to probe FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro's electoral campaign over alleged foreign funding.
paras.zh: 除了这项调查外，巴西最高法院周二还命令警方调查弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗涉嫌接受外国资助的竞选活动。

paras.en: The 45-year-old senator suffered a stinging defeat on Sunday when he was beaten by Lula in a presidential run-off, which Bolsonaro had been widely expected to win.
paras.zh: 这位45岁的参议员周日在总统决选中惨遭卢拉击败，此前人们普遍预计博尔索纳罗会获胜。

paras.en: Opinion polls had put him narrowly ahead of Lula and analysts pointed out that Bolsonaro's win in the first round of the election on 4 October, meant he was likely to take victory in the run-off.
paras.zh: 民调显示他以微弱优势领先卢拉，分析人士指出，博尔索纳罗在10月4日第一轮选举中获胜，意味着他很可能在决选中获胜。

paras.en: But after an early lead in the count, he was overtaken by the veteran incumbent, who became the first presidential candidate to overturn a first round loss to win in the second round.
paras.zh: 但在计票初期领先后，他被这位资深的现任总统超越，成为第一位扭转第一轮失利并在第二轮获胜的总统候选人。

paras.en: Lula won 51.79% of the vote, compared to Bolsonaro's 48.21%.
paras.zh: 卢拉赢得了51.79%的选票，而博尔索纳罗的得票率为48.21%。

paras.en: Despite trailing by 4.4 million votes, Bolsonaro has not conceded and has called for the election to be annulled.
paras.zh: 尽管落后 440 万票，博尔索纳罗并未认输，并呼吁取消选举。

paras.en: He argues that he was put at a disadvantage because polling was extended by two hours on election day - even though the extension was requested by both his party and that of his rival.
paras.zh: 他辩称，他处于不利地位，因为投票在选举日延长了两个小时——尽管他的政党和竞争对手都要求延长投票时间。

paras.en: He called the extension, which was ordered by a Supreme Court justice, a "dirty trick".
paras.zh: 他称最高法院法官下令的延期是“肮脏的伎俩”。

paras.en: However the party he represented, the Liberal Party, has accepted the result, although it did say that the extension of voting "merits investigation".
paras.zh: 然而，他所代表的自由党已经接受了这一结果，尽管它确实表示延长投票“值得调查”。

articles.title: Nanotyrannus skeleton sells for $47.3m in New York auction

paras.en: The mounted skeleton of a newly-identified dinosaur once mistaken for a young Tyrannosaurus rex has sold at auction for a colossal $47.3m (Â£35.5m).
paras.zh: 一具新发现的恐龙骨架曾被误认为是年轻的霸王龙，如今在拍卖会上以 4730 万美元（3550 万英镑）的天价售出。

paras.en: Nicknamed Jodi, the roughly 10-foot-tall (3m) skeleton was auctioned by Sotheby's in New York. The sale comes a year after researchers confirmed that the skeleton belongs to a distinct genus.
paras.zh: 这具绰号为“乔迪”(Jodi) 的骨架高约 10 英尺 (3m)，由纽约苏富比拍卖行拍卖。此次拍卖是在研究人员确认该骨骼属于一个独特属一年后进行的。

paras.en: The Late Cretaceous carnivore was expected to fetch at least $9m when it went under the hammer on Tuesday. The auction comes after Sotheby's sold a Tyrannosaurus rex, dubbed Gus, for a record $50.1m in July.
paras.zh: 这只白垩纪晚期的食肉动物周二拍卖时预计售价至少为 900 万美元。此次拍卖是在苏富比拍卖行于 7 月份以创纪录的 5010 万美元售出一只名为 Gus 的霸王龙之后进行的。

paras.en: The sale has reignited debate in the scientific community over whether dinosaur remains should be sold privately or displayed publicly.
paras.zh: 这次出售重新引发了科学界关于恐龙遗骸是否应该私下出售还是公开展示的争论。

paras.en: Sotheby's described Jodi as an "excellent exhibition-ready" skeleton with about 191 fossil-bone elements and a "beautifully preserved, virtually complete skull".
paras.zh: 苏富比将乔迪描述为“优秀的展览就绪”骨架，包含约 191 个化石骨骼元素和“保存完好、几乎完整的头骨”。

paras.en: The auction house added that the Nanotyrannus is "one of only three such skeletons known to science". The specimen is the first to come to market since the existence of the genus was confirmed by US researchers last October, Sotheby's said.
paras.zh: 拍卖行补充说，矮暴龙是“科学界已知的仅有的三具此类骨骼之一”。苏富比表示，该标本是自去年 10 月美国研究人员证实该属存在以来第一个进入市场的标本。

paras.en: The identify of the buyer, who won after a thrilling 12 minutes of auction bidding between six interested parties, has not been disclosed.
paras.zh: 六位感兴趣的各方经过 12 分钟的激动人心的拍卖竞价后获胜，买家的身份尚未透露。

paras.en: It becomes the second-most valuable dinosaur fossil ever sold, behind Gus. The third-most valuable was a Stegosaurus named Apex, which was sold by Sotheby's in July 2024 for $44.6m.
paras.zh: 它成为有史以来售出的第二高价值的恐龙化石，仅次于格斯。第三高价值的是一只名为 Apex 的剑龙，它于 2024 年 7 月被苏富比拍卖行以 4460 万美元的价格售出。

paras.en: Megan Jenkins, a palaeontologist at the University of Portsmouth, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme on Tuesday that Nanotyrannus "was for a very long time believed to be sort of a teenager of T. rex".
paras.zh: 朴茨茅斯大学的古生物学家梅根·詹金斯 (Megan Jenkins) 周二在 BBC 广播四台的《今日》节目中表示，矮暴龙“很长一段时间以来都被认为是霸王龙的少年”。

paras.en: "But it's a lot smaller and its a lot more gracile. So it's very sort-of sleek, slender, [with] blade-like teeth for slicing through meat," Jenkins said.
paras.zh: “但它要小得多，而且更纤细。所以它非常光滑、细长，有刀片状的牙齿，可以切肉，”詹金斯说。

paras.en: Tyrannosaurus rex and Nanotyrannus lived alongside one another during the same geological period approximately 67 million years ago.
paras.zh: 霸王龙和矮暴龙在大约 6700 万年前的同一地质时期共同生活。

paras.en: Jodi was initially exhibited as a juvenile T. rex at London's Frieze Masters international art fair in October 2023, before the Nanotyrannus genus was classified.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月，在小暴龙属被分类之前，乔迪最初以幼年霸王龙的身份在伦敦弗里兹大师国际艺术博览会上展出。

paras.en: The skeleton was discovered in the US state of Montana by rancher Jodi Pierson on her land in the Hell Creek Formation, a heavily studied geological site. It was later excavated by commercial palaeontologist Clayton Phipps.
paras.zh: 这具骨架是由牧场主乔迪·皮尔森 (Jodi Pierson) 在美国蒙大拿州地狱溪地层 (Hell Creek Formation) 的土地上发现的，这是一个经过深入研究的地质地点。后来它被商业古生物学家克莱顿·菲普斯挖掘出来。

paras.en: Phipps also discovered the famous "Dueling Dinosaurs" fossil. That specimen, which shows the remains of a Nanotyrannus and Triceratops apparently in combat, was found eight miles (13km) away from Jodi in 2006.
paras.zh: 菲普斯还发现了著名的“决斗恐龙”化石。该标本于 2006 年在距乔迪 8 英里（13 公里）处发现，显示了显然正在战斗的矮暴龙和三角龙的遗骸。

paras.en: The "Dueling Dinosaurs" discovery became crucial to the research published by Lindsay Zanno and James Napoli that classified Nanotyrannus as separate from T. rex. Their paper ended decades of debate over whether the dinosaurs were distinct from one another.
paras.zh: “决斗恐龙”的发现对于 Lindsay Zanno 和 James Napoli 发表的研究至关重要，该研究将小暴龙与霸王龙分开。他们的论文结束了数十年来关于恐龙是否彼此不同的争论。

paras.en: The auction of Jodi comes as some scientists warn that auctions could herald a new era in fossil collecting by the ultra-rich.
paras.zh: 乔迪的拍卖正值一些科学家警告称，拍卖可能预示着超级富豪化石收藏的新时代。

paras.en: Researchers told the BBC after the sale of Gus that such remains should be exhibited in public spaces where they can be more freely studied.
paras.zh: 研究人员在古斯出售后告诉英国广播公司，这些遗骸应该在公共场所展出，以便人们可以更自由地研究它们。

paras.en: Prof Steve Brusatte, a palaeontologist at the University of Edinburgh and consultant on the Jurassic Park films, told BBC World Service's What in the World programme in July that the T. rex's auction was "concerning".
paras.zh: 爱丁堡大学古生物学家、《侏罗纪公园》电影顾问史蒂夫·布鲁萨特 (Steve Brusatte) 教授在 7 月份向 BBC 国际频道的“世界观”节目表示，霸王龙的拍卖“令人担忧”。

paras.en: "I don't know of any museum or university that can afford a price tag like that," he said. "Imagine if the Mona Lisa was just owned by a super-wealthy person and it wasn't on display and people couldn't see it, couldn't enjoy it."
paras.zh: “我不知道有哪个博物馆或大学能负担得起这样的价格，”他说。 “想象一下，如果《蒙娜丽莎》只是一位超级富豪的拥有者，而它没有被展示出来，人们就看不到它，无法欣赏它。”

paras.en: He said at the time that he hoped such a sale didn't become a trend, adding it could adversely affect scientific research and public education.
paras.zh: 他当时表示，他希望这种出售不会成为一种趋势，并补充说这可能会对科学研究和公共教育产生不利影响。

paras.en: Responding to Tuesday's auction, Brusatte called it "harrowing" that Jodi could disappear from public view.
paras.zh: 在回应周二的拍卖时，布鲁萨特称乔迪可能从公众视野中消失是“令人痛苦的”。

paras.en: "We've really just found out that Nanotyrannus is real, and now one of the best skeletons is about to be sold to the highest bidder, and it's harrowing to think it could disappear into the vaults of a collector rather than displayed on a museum where it can wow and inspire kids and families and the public at large," he told the BBC.
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司：“我们刚刚发现矮暴龙是真实的，现在最好的骨架之一即将被卖给出价最高的人，一想到它可能会消失在收藏家的金库里，而不是在博物馆里展示，它可以让孩子、家庭和广大公众惊叹不已，激发他们的灵感，真是令人痛苦。”

paras.en: But Jenkins told the Today programme on Tuesday there were two sides to the debate, and that a lot of time, effort and money went into excavating the specimens.
paras.zh: 但詹金斯周二告诉《今日》节目，争论有两个方面，挖掘标本投入了大量的时间、精力和金钱。

paras.en: "I don't begrudge the people involved for wanting to sell it for such a large amount of money," she said. "Although its a scary prospect, actually a lot of them have ended up in the public eye... these things without a doubt will end end up in a museum at some point."
paras.zh: 她说：“我并不嫉妒那些想要以如此大的价格出售它的人。” “虽然这是一个可怕的前景，但实际上其中很多已经出现在公众视野中......毫无疑问，这些东西最终会在某个时候进入博物馆。”

articles.title: Turnout so far highest on record as Israelis vote in pivotal election

paras.en: Turnout so far is the highest on record, as Israelis vote in what many view as one of the most pivotal elections in the country's history.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，投票率是有记录以来最高的，因为以色列人在许多人看来是该国历史上最关键的选举之一进行了投票。

paras.en: Polling published on Friday suggests incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu is almost neck-and-neck with former military chief Gadi Eisenkot in the race to become prime minister.
paras.zh: 周五公布的民意调查显示，现任总理内塔尼亚胡在总理竞选中与前军事首长加迪·艾森科特几乎不相上下。

paras.en: But neither of their political blocs is projected to win the 61 seats needed to form a government - and weeks or months of political wrangling may lie ahead.
paras.zh: 但预计他们的政治集团都无法赢得组建政府所需的 61 个席位，而且未来可能会持续数周或数月的政治角力。

paras.en: The campaign has been shaped by the issues of democracy and security, and the election is widely being seen as a referendum on Netanyahu's rule.
paras.zh: 此次竞选活动受到民主和安全问题的影响，这次选举被广泛视为对内塔尼亚胡统治的全民公投。

paras.en: Throughout polling day, Netanyahu has posted on social media about a reportedly high turnout among Arab voters. He has labelled it an "emergency" and a "matter of life or death" for the Israeli right, and called on his supporters to get out and vote.
paras.zh: 在整个投票日，内塔尼亚胡在社交媒体上发布了有关阿拉伯选民投票率高的消息。他将其称为以色列右翼的“紧急情况”和“生死攸关的问题”，并呼吁他的支持者出去投票。

paras.en: His Likud party has said it has asked for voting to be extended beyond 22:00 (20:00 GMT). But Eisenkot's camp has called it an attempt to "lay the groundwork for allegations challenging the integrity of the election".
paras.zh: 他的利库德集团表示，已要求将投票时间延长至 22:00（格林威治标准时间 20:00）之后。但艾森科特的阵营称其为“为挑战选举公正性的指控奠定基础”的尝试。

paras.en: Many leading parties complained on Tuesday morning of alleged irregularities at polling stations across the country - but Israel's Central Election Committee (CEC) said there is no evidence of systematic tampering with ballot slips.
paras.zh: 许多主要政党周二上午抱怨全国各地投票站涉嫌违规行为，但以色列中央选举委员会（CEC）表示，没有证据表明选票被系统性篡改。

paras.en: Israel's proportional representation system means governments have always been coalitions - and the race to power can, and has, produced unexpected alliances. But this election looks especially tight - and lines in the sand have already been drawn.
paras.zh: 以色列的比例代表制意味着政府一直都是联盟——而权力竞赛可以而且已经产生了意想不到的联盟。但这次选举看起来特别紧张——而且界线已经划定。

paras.en: Eisenkot, who leads the newly formed Yashar Party, is the main figure in the so-called "change bloc", a collection of parties which have ideological differences but share the goal of ousting Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导新成立的亚沙尔党，是所谓“变革集团”的主要人物。“变革集团”是一个由意识形态不同但共同目标是推翻内塔尼亚胡的政党组成的联盟。

paras.en: Other leaders in the bloc include former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett and Avigdor Lieberman - both right-wingers who take hardline positions on security - and Yair Golan, a left-leaning former general.
paras.zh: 该集团的其他领导人包括前总理纳夫塔利·贝内特和阿维格多·利伯曼——两人都是在安全问题上采取强硬立场的右翼分子——以及左倾前将军亚伊尔·戈兰。

paras.en: For Netanyahu, a titan of Israeli politics who first served as prime minister in 1996, a new term will hinge on another alliance with the far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties that make up his current governing coalition - the most right-wing in Israel's history.
paras.zh: 对于1996年首次担任总理的以色列政坛巨头内塔尼亚胡来说，新任期将取决于与极右翼和极端正统政党的再次联盟，这些政党组成了他目前的执政联盟——以色列历史上最右翼的联盟。

paras.en: There are two Arab party blocs in the running too, as about one-fifth of Israel's population is Arab - many of whom describe themselves as Palestinian citizens of Israel. In theory, they could prove kingmakers. However, all but one of the leading Jewish parties have ruled out working with them.
paras.zh: 还有两个阿拉伯政党集团也在竞选，因为以色列约五分之一的人口是阿拉伯人，其中许多人自称是以色列的巴勒斯坦公民。理论上，他们可以成为拥王者。然而，除了一个主要犹太政党外，其他所有政党都排除了与他们合作的可能性。

paras.en: The campaign has been dominated by the issue of security - with the opposition bloc hammering Netanyahu for the unprecedented security failure that led to the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel, in which nearly 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken back to Gaza as hostages.
paras.zh: 这场运动的主要议题是安全问题——反对派集团抨击内塔尼亚胡在安全方面史无前例的失败，导致哈马斯领导的2023年10月7日对以色列发动袭击，造成近1,200人死亡，251人被带回加沙作为人质。

paras.en: They have pushed for an independent commission of inquiry into the attacks - something Netanyahu has long resisted, insisting it would be biased against him.
paras.zh: 他们推动成立一个独立委员会对袭击事件进行调查，但内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直拒绝这样做，坚称这会对他产生偏见。

paras.en: They also point to what they see as threats to democracy under Netanyahu, who faces an ongoing trial on corruption charges - which he denies - and is still pursuing contentious plans for reforms to the judicial system, which led to mass protests before the 7 October attacks.
paras.zh: 他们还指出，他们认为内塔尼亚胡领导下的民主受到威胁，内塔尼亚胡面临着腐败指控的持续审判（他对此予以否认），并且仍在推行有争议的司法系统改革计划，这导致 10 月 7 日袭击之前引发大规模抗议。

paras.en: Despite the opposition's attack lines, Netanyahu has once again framed himself as "Mr Security" - pointing to what he says are strategic victories in Israel's wars across the Middle East and his close relationship with US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 尽管反对派的攻击路线，内塔尼亚胡再次将自己称为“安全先生” - 指出他所说的以色列在中东战争中的战略胜利以及他与美国总统唐纳德特朗普的密切关系。

paras.en: On Sunday, Israel's Channel 12 reported that Netanyahu had pushed for last-minute military action that could trigger a confrontation with Iran prior to the elections, but was opposed by his own military chief Eyal Zamir. The following day, CNN reported that he had also tried to persuade Trump to carry out new strikes on Iran, but the US leader had refused to give the green light. Netanyahu denied both reports.
paras.zh: 周日，以色列第 12 频道报道称，内塔尼亚胡曾推动在选举前最后一刻采取军事行动，这可能引发与伊朗的对抗，但遭到了他自己的军事首长埃亚尔·扎米尔 (Eyal Zamir) 的反对。第二天，美国有线电视新闻网报道称，他还试图说服特朗普对伊朗进行新的打击，但美国领导人拒绝批准。内塔尼亚胡否认了这两项报道。
